title: Registered Fund Administration, Associate Director
description:
Position Overview

PINE Advisor Solutions, A Centralis Company, is seeking an Associate Director to join our Principal Financial Officer (PFO) Services team. This individual will support the Directors in managing a portfolio of client relationships and deliverables across registered fund products, including mutual funds, ETFs, interval funds, tender offer funds, and closed-end funds.

In this role, you will serve as the primary reviewer of deliverables prepared by the fund administration and fund accounting teams on behalf of our clients, ensuring high-quality execution and regulatory compliance. You will manage a book of multiple clients as their day-to-day point of contact, gaining hands-on exposure to the responsibilities and dynamics of acting as an outsourced financial officer and treasury team.

This is a strong opportunity for a detail-oriented professional to step into a client-facing leadership role with visibility across critical fund operations. Over time, there is potential for growth into a director-level position, including the possibility of taking on outsourced Treasurer responsibilities.

About PINE

PINE Advisor Solutions ("PINE") is a dynamic and fast-growing organization that provides institutional-quality outsourced solutions for funds and investment managers. Our team is driven by the belief that we are contributing to something remarkable.

At PINE, we prioritize client service and a collaborative culture. The ideal candidate will be motivated, detail-oriented, eager to learn, and thrive in a high-performing and supportive environment. Our culture is built around an “all for one and one for all” philosophy. Your contributions matter, and we are a team that embraces challenges and believes in growing through doing.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for multiple fund clients, managing deliverables and deadlines across your client book
  • Serve as primary reviewer of fund administrator and fund accountant deliverables, escalating issues to Directors as needed
  • Perform detailed and analytical reviews of fund regulatory filings including Forms N-CSR, N-PORT, N-CEN, 24F-2, 10-Q, 10-K, 8-K, repurchase offers and annual prospectus updates
  • Oversee fund expense administration activities
  • Review fund income and capital gain distributions
  • Review and maintain valuation schedules of private investments
  • Prepare and coordinate materials relating to fund board meetings, valuation committee meetings, and disclosure control meetings relating to the Sarbanes-Oxley Act
  • Coordinate the external audit and tax process on behalf of clients, serve as main audit contact
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and business partners, ensuring effective communication and collaboration
  • Train and mentor Associates, reviewing their work and providing day-to-day feedback
  • Draft and maintain process procedures for recurring deliverables, and keep client workflows, deadlines, and task status current in our internal systems and tools
  • Maintain knowledge of changing industry regulations

Qualifications:

  • 5+of experience in the financial services industry, with a strong preference for fund accounting, fund administration, or audit of registered fund products
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, business, economics, or a related field required;
  • Demonstrated expertise in regulatory and compliance reporting for registered funds
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite with advanced Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, formulas, data analysis)
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial concepts clearly
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially in financial and compliance documentation
  • Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, high-growth environment
  • Eagerness to learn and apply regulatory changes and industry best practices
  • Collaborative mindset with a strong commitment to client service and team success

Work Model (Hybrid Preferred)

  • Candidates who can work out of our Denver office 2-3 days per week are preferred
  • We are open to hiring remote employees located anywhere in the US with direct experience
  • Some periodic travel to Denver will be expected for remote hires

Salary: $80,000 - $110,000

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonus compensation.

Employee Benefits

  • Health Insurance – we cover 100% of the cost for employees
  • A comprehensive selection of medical, dental, and vision health plans
  • Life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) savings plan
  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

What You Can Expect From PINE

Work-life Balance

  • We trust you to be the expert on creating an environment that allows you to bring your best self to work. With unlimited vacation and flexible work-from-home options, we encourage a work-life balance that brings out the best in our team.

Be a Leader

  • At PINE, we prioritize ensuring that each team member has the chance to emerge as a leader and make substantial contributions to our company.

Experience an Environment of Learning

  • We place an emphasis on learning from each other and celebrating our unique expertise. There are abundant opportunities to learn and hone new skills.

PINE Advisor Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately two weeks. The posting may close sooner if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of qualified applicants are received.

title: Senior Manager, Information Assurance Services
description:
Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything. Aprio has 40 U.S. office locations, as well as international office locations and more than 3,200 team members that speak 60+ languages across the globe. By bringing together proven expertise, deep understanding, and strategic foresight for fast-growing industries, Aprio ensures clients are prepared for wherever life or business may take them. Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio.

Job Summary

Aprio is seeking a Senior Manager, Information Assurance Services to lead client delivery across a growing portfolio of compliance and assurance engagements, including SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, and privacy advisory services. In this role, you will manage all phases of the client engagement lifecycle, build lasting client relationships, and drive quality outcomes across delivery teams. You will play a meaningful role in developing team members and contributing to business development as part of a practice experiencing sustained growth of over 30% year over year. This is an opportunity to bring your technical expertise and leadership skills to a team making a real impact for clients navigating complex regulatory environments.

What You'll Gain / Impact:

  • Opportunity to lead and shape a high-growth Information Assurance Services practice at a national scale.
  • Exposure to a broad range of compliance frameworks, regulatory environments, and client industries.
  • Ability to influence team member development, career growth, and practice talent strategy.
  • Hands-on leadership across client delivery, business development, and practice operations.
  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and initiative drive real outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead client engagements across all phases, including planning, delivery, staffing, quality management, issue resolution, and reporting.
  • Apply industry and technical expertise to identify and assess risks and controls relevant to clients' business environments.
  • Deliver a range of compliance and assurance services, including SOC 1, SOC 2, SOC 3, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, GDPR, CCPA, and Privacy Shield.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor throughout the engagement lifecycle.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support practice growth and individual career advancement.
  • Contribute to business development efforts, including supporting sales initiatives and practice growth strategies.
  • Lead and participate in internal initiatives that strengthen practice operations and service delivery quality.

Candidate Qualifications

  • Relevant certification (CPA, CISA, CISSP, CISM, or equivalent), or demonstrated willingness to obtainMinimum of 7 years of IT audit or equivalent consulting and/or auditing experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead engagement teams, manage client relationships, and oversee work paper review and testing.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality reports and audit documentation.
  • Proven project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple delivery teams and client engagements simultaneously.
  • Ability to train, develop, and retain team members in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Commitment to exceptional client service with strong problem-solving skills and a consultancy mindset.
  • Preferred: Experience supporting business development, sales, or practice growth initiatives.
The application window is anticipated to close on December 1, 2026 and may be extended as needed.

Why work for Aprio:
Whether you are just starting out, looking to advance into management or searching for your next leadership role, Aprio offers an opportunity to grow with a future-focused, innovative firm.
Perks/Benefits we offer for full-time team members:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance on the first day of employment
- Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Account
- 401k with Profit Sharing
- 9+ holidays and discretionary time off structure
- Parental Leave – coverage for both primary and secondary caregivers
- Tuition Assistance Program and CPA support program with cash incentive upon completion
- Discretionary incentive compensation based on firm, group and individual performance
- Incentive compensation related to origination of new client sales
- Top rated wellness program
- Flexible working environment including remote and hybrid options
What’s in it for you:
- Working with an industry leader: Be part of a high-growth firm that is passionate for what’s next.
- An awesome culture: Thirty-one fundamental behaviors guide our culture every day ensuring we always deliver an exceptional team-member and client experience. We call it the Aprio Way. This shared mindset creates lasting relationships between team members and with clients.
- A great team: Work with a high-energy, passionate, caring and ambitious team of professionals in a collaborative culture.
- Entrepreneurship: Have the freedom to innovate and bring your ideas to help us grow to become the CPA firm of choice nationally.
- Growth opportunities: Grow professionally in an environment that fosters continuous learning and advancement.
- Competitive compensation: You will be rewarded with competitive compensation, industry-leading benefits and a flexible work environment to enjoy work/life balance.
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Aprio is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; religion; national origin; sex; pregnancy; sexual orientation; gender identity and/or expression; age; disability; genetic information, citizenship status; military service obligations or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
Aprio, LLP and Aprio Advisory Group, LLC, operate in an alternative business structure, with Aprio Advisory Group, LLC providing non-attest tax and consulting services, and Aprio, LLP providing CPA firm services.

title: Backend Software Engineer - Python  (we have office locations in Cambridge, Leeds and London)
description:
Backend Software Engineer - Python

Join Genomics England and use your backend engineering skills to make a difference in genomics and healthcare. We’re looking for an experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrable track record of delivering and owning backend software.

The role

You’ll use your Python expertise to design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs and cloud-native applications on AWS. Working across databases, microservices and identity management solutions, you’ll deliver secure, reliable platforms.

Your work will help build and evolve products that support genomic testing, clinical decision making and research at national scale. You’ll contribute to the systems and services that enable large-scale genomic research in a collaborative, supportive and empowering environment.

Your team

You’ll join the Interpretation Portal (IP) team and provide software engineering expertise for the Decision Support System (DSS). DSS is a key component of our Healthcare Genomics Service.

Your responsibilities

Backend development and feature ownership

  • Lead feature development across the team.

  • Design and develop scalable, high-quality Python software following best practices.

  • Design, develop and maintain REST APIs for internal and external integrations.

Cloud infrastructure, data and identity

  • Design and maintain resources hosted on AWS, ensuring reliability and efficiency.

  • Work with relational databases, including AWS RDS and SQL-based solutions.

  • Support and integrate identity and access management solutions, including Okta and other Identity Providers (IdPs).

Quality and troubleshooting

  • Build and enhance test automation frameworks to support robust, reliable applications.

  • Troubleshoot and help resolve issues during development and testing.

Collaboration and continuous learning

  • Work closely with front-end developers, QA and Platform Engineers to create reliable, seamless solutions.

  • Use tools such as GitLab, Confluence and Jira to support collaborative development.

  • Collaborate with third-party suppliers to create technical specifications.

  • Stay informed about industry trends and embrace new technologies.

Skills and experience for success

  • Python: expertise in developing scalable solutions.

  • AWS and architecture: experience with AWS services, including IAM, and microservice architectures.

  • Databases: experience with relational databases and SQL, ideally Postgres.

  • REST APIs: experience designing, developing and consuming APIs.

  • Identity and authentication: experience integrating with platforms such as Okta or similar Identity Providers (IdPs).

  • Development practices: familiarity with agile methodologies and test-driven development.

  • Teamwork and problem solving: a proactive, collaborative approach supported by collaborative tools.

Additional skills we’d love to see

  • Experience with Amazon API Gateway, ECS, Fargate and Lambda.

  • Experience with test automation frameworks.

  • Familiarity with front-end React development, knowledge of JavaScript for front-end applications, or a willingness to learn.

  • A strong understanding of code review best practices.

  • Experience mentoring and/or coaching junior team members.

Make a difference

Use your Python and backend engineering skills to build the systems, services and platforms that enable genomic medicine and research at national scale. If you want your work to directly support life-changing genomic research and healthcare innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

BSc in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Closing date for applications: Friday 20th November at 23:00 (UK time)

Salary from: £73,500 per annum

Please note: we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Being an integral part of such a meaningful mission is extremely rewarding in itself, but in order to support our people, we’re continually improving our benefits package. We pride ourselves on investing in our people and supporting them to achieve their career goals, as well as offering a benefits package including:

  • Generous Leave: 30 days’ holiday, plus bank holidays, plus additional leave for long service, and also the option to apply for up to 30 days of remote working abroad annually (approval required).
  • Family-Friendly: Blended working arrangements, flexible working, enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental leave benefits.
  • Pension & Financial: Defined contribution pension (Genomics England double-matches up to 10%, however you can contribute more if you wish), Life Assurance (3x salary), an Electric Vehicle salary sacrifice scheme and a Give As You Earn scheme.
  • Learning & Development: Individual learning budgets, support for training and certifications, and reimbursement for one annual professional subscription (approval required).
  • Recognition & Rewards: Employee recognition programme and referral scheme.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Subsidised gym membership, a free Headspace account, and access to an Employee Assistance Programme, eye tests, flu jabs.

Equal opportunities and our commitment to a diverse and inclusive workplace

Genomics England is actively committed to providing and supporting an inclusive environment that promotes equity, diversity and inclusion best practice both within our community and in any other area where we have influence. We are proud of our diverse community where everyone can come to work and feel welcomed and treated with respect regardless of any disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, sexual orientation, or social background.

Genomics England’s policies of non-discrimination and equity and will be applied fairly to all people, regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, being pregnant or recently becoming a parent, race, religion or beliefs, sex or sexual orientation, length of service, whether full or part-time or employed under a permanent or a fixed-term contract or any other relevant factor.

Genomics England does not tolerate any form of discrimination, harassment, victimisation or bullying at work. Such behaviour undermines our mission and core values and diminishes the dignity, respect and integrity of all parties. Our People policies outline our commitment to inclusivity.

We aim to remove barriers in our recruitment processes and to be flexible with our interview processes. Should you require any adjustments that may help you to fully participate in the recruitment process, we encourage you to discuss this with us.

Culture

We have four key behaviours that represent what we would like Genomics England to feel like and the culture we want to encourage, in order for us to achieve our mission. These behaviours help us all work well together, deliver on our outcomes, celebrate our successes and share feedback with each other. You can read about these and other aspects of our culture here Culture | Genomics England

Blended working model

Genomics England operates a blended working model as we know our people appreciate the flexibility that hybrid working can bring. We expect most people to come into the office a minimum of 2 times each month. However, this will vary according to role and will be agreed with your team leader. There is no expectation that people will return to the office full time unless they want to, however, some of our roles require full time on site attendance e.g., lab teams, reception team.

Our teams and squads have, and will continue to reflect on what works best for them to work together successfully and have the freedom to design working patterns to suit, beyond the minimum. Our office locations are: Canary Wharf, Cambridge and Leeds.

Onboarding background checks

As part of our recruitment process, all successful candidates are subject to a Standard Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. We therefore require applicants to disclose any previous offences at point of application, as some unspent convictions may mean we are unable to proceed with your application due to the nature of our work in healthcare.

title: Associate Technical Project Manager
description:
Prolific Machines is ushering in a new era of biotechnology with light. Our first-of-its-kind optogenetic platform delivers unprecedented control, precisely guiding cellular behavior when and where it matters most. Unlike existing tools used to control biology, our technology enables dynamic, tunable control over virtually any cellular function in any cell type. We're enabling partners to unlock robust efficiency, quality, and reproducibility advantages across the most complex pharmaceuticals and therapeutic proteins. Prolific is supported by leading investors, including Bill Gates’s Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Mayfield and SOSV.


We’re looking for a Technical Project Manager with experience managing innovative scientific projects to manage critical customer & internal programs in Prolific’s pipeline. These projects can include, but are not limited to:

  1. R&D efforts focused on building new capabilities and platforms.
  2. Full cell line development and scale up of customer molecules integrated into our optogenetic cell lines.
  3. Enabling pharmaceutical partners to build optogenetic capabilities at their sites.

As part of a broad technical organization tasked with commercializing Prolific Machine’s unique technology, the successful candidate will lead technical planning, coordination, and results reporting for these projects. They will work with technical leads from R&D, Technical Operations, Hardware, Product, and Business Development to support cross-team collaboration and communication, as well as coordinate with senior leadership for reporting project outcomes. This position will report into the Head of the Project Management Office. This role will be based on-site in Emeryville, CA.

Accountabiliites:

  • Support internal and client-facing projects by building and maintaining project schedules, trackers, and risk/decision logs
  • Own day-to-day coordination for assigned projects or workstreams: scheduling and running meetings, capturing decisions and action items, and following up to closure.
  • Gather inputs from technical leads to help senior PMs and leadership with resource planning, scope alignment, and schedule coordination.
  • Prepare project reporting, such as monthly project updates, dashboards, and milestone/data summaries.
  • Flag risks, delays, and dependencies early and help the team work through them.
  • Contribute to new project standards, templates, and improvement initiatives alongside project management colleagues.
  • Collaborate and communicate with:
  • Research & Development, cell line development, process development, analytics, hardware, business development and product development teams for cross-functional coordination on tech transfers and technical support.
  • Client/ customer teams including technical leads and business development representatives, with support from senior PMO members.
  • Third-parties, suppliers and partners to coordinate capital equipment and materials that support our teams.

About You:

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented.
  • You have good verbal and written communication skills with a focus on clarity and conciseness.
  • You have a scientific background and are comfortable learning new technical areas.
  • You follow through, and you are comfortable asking questions and raising issues early.
  • You thrive in a dynamic environment and can adapt to the changing priorities that are inherent to startups.
  • You are eager to learn, actively seek feedback from your colleagues, and want to grow your career in project management.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a life science or engineering field with 3+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 2+ year, in a biotech, biopharmaceutical or similar industry.
  • Experience coordinating projects, timelines, or cross-functional work, whether in a formal project management role or as part of a lab, technical, or operations team.
  • Hands-on or adjacent experience with cell engineering, cell line development, or process development/scale-up is desired.
  • Familiarity with project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, MS Project, Asana, or similar) and strong spreadsheet skills.

Benefits: Generous equity package in an early stage company, retirement plan with company contribution, flexible PTO with healthy time off minimums, company-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, career coaching, mental health support, free team lunches everyday, great snacks, and companywide social events!

Diversity: Prolific Machines values diverse perspectives, backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees can bring their authentic selves to work and have equal opportunities to succeed. Prolific Machines is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Senior AI Engineer, Marketing
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

We are looking for an innovative engineer for the GTM Product Team to strengthen the technology beneath OPSWAT's marketing operations. Marketing runs on HubSpot today, and it works hard for us: 1.1 million contacts, 817 active workflows, and the integrations that connect it to SugarCRM, Salesloft, My OPSWAT, websites and our data master. Your first job is to make that foundation more reliable — keeping the integrations healthy, resolving the sync and data-quality issues that slow the team down, and giving Marketing Operations a technical partner who understands their platform from the inside.

From there, you will help us build the next generation of that capability in house. The four functions HubSpot performs for us are the roadmap: marketing automation and email; lead capture from web, portal, events and webinars; lead management, meaning scoring, lifecycle and routing; contact data governance and consent and tight integration with our OPSWAT Data Master (ODM). Along the way you will bring AI into the product to enable smarter lead qualification, routing and scoring and more automated campaign managements.

What You Will Be Doing

Build the Platform

  • Build one governed front door for every lead, whatever the source — web forms, My OPSWAT, webinars, field events, partner and list imports — so each lead is validated, de-duplicated, consented and enriched once, at the gate, and nothing reaches the CRM or the data spine any other way.
  • Build AI-native lead qualification: a model that reads fit and engagement across every signal we hold — product usage in My OPSWAT, Academy progress, web behavior, intent, firmographics — ranks the whole database with real resolution, explains every score in plain language, and learns from what SDRs actually convert.
  • Build intelligent lead routing: the right lead to the right rep at the right moment, with territory, capacity, availability and priority held as data that Marketing Operations can shape and preview themselves, and a decision record behind every assignment so anyone can see why a lead went where it did.
  • Make every hand-off dependable: each lead tracked from capture to first touch, stalls surfaced automatically, every priority tier followed up, and nothing lost between systems.
  • Give Marketing Operations a self-service campaign layer: per-campaign behavior — routing, priority, nurture — configured in minutes with a preview of what it would have done to yesterday's leads, so new campaigns stop requiring new workflows and old overrides expire on their own.
  • Build the platform AI-native from day one: expose its data and actions through an MCP server so OPSWAT's internal agents and assistants can look up a lead, explain a routing decision, or trigger a campaign action in natural language — and design every capability so an agent can use it as readily as a person can.
  • Make consent and suppression a single source of truth, enforced at the gate and impossible to bypass, and stream every signal and every decision into OPSWAT Data Master so marketing, product and sales data finally join in one place.
  • Build the seams to SugarCRM, the email service provider, visitor identification, enrichment and My OPSWAT so that a failure in any one of them is contained, retried and visible — never silent, never lossy.
  • Leveraging OPSWAT Agentic SDLC — use the Platform team's agentic coding platform as your primary means of production, own the quality and security of what ships, and document the system as you go so it stays knowable.

Keep HubSpot Running Through the Transition

  • Own the health of HubSpot's existing integrations until each one is retired: the SugarCRM sync through the Sugar Data Tool, Salesloft, the My OPSWAT feed (portal and Academy), 6sense enrichment, web forms and the Forms API.
  • Triage and resolve integration incidents across HubSpot and its neighbors — root-cause them, fix them permanently, and write down what happened.
  • Make safe, minimal changes in HubSpot when the business needs them, and hold the line against new workflow and list sediment that the migration would only have to unwind.
  • Build the Forms Gateway pull-forward so website capture decouples from HubSpot early, and run the interim enrollment connector that keeps Salesloft working through cutover.
  • Reconcile HubSpot and platform data continuously during the parallel run so drift is caught long before a cutover gate.

What We Need From You

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 6+ years building and operating production backend systems, with at least 3 in Python
  • Demonstrated, recent, daily practice building software with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot agent mode, Codex or similar). You can show us the workflow, the review and test loop, and something real that shipped through it.
  • Production support of a marketing automation platform's integrations — HubSpot strongly preferred; Marketo or Pardot considered — including its APIs, its data model, and its sync to a CRM. You have kept one of these healthy while other things changed around it.
  • Production experience with event-driven and durable-execution patterns: message queues, outboxes, idempotency keys, replay. Temporal or a comparable workflow engine strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on integration engineering against real vendor APIs — REST, webhooks, OAuth 2.0, rate limits, retries — built and operated, not configured through a wizard.
  • PostgreSQL to a strong level: schema design, JSONB, partitioning, migrations with Alembic, and query performance work you can describe.
  • Cloud deployment on Azure or AWS: containers, infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), CI/CD with GitHub Actions, secrets management, observability.
  • Experience shipping LLM features into a product: structured outputs, evaluation discipline, confidence thresholds, fallbacks and guardrails — consuming a provided model gateway rather than building the infrastructure.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and the skill to explain a technical trade-off to a marketing operations lead in their terms.

It Would Be Nice If You Had

  • SugarCRM logic hooks and REST API, or another CRM's server-side extension model; Salesforce Apex or triggers transferable.
  • Marketing technology domain knowledge: lead scoring and routing, consent and suppression, deliverability and ESP warm-up, campaign attribution.

title: Carrier Operations Intern (Portfolio Analytics)
location: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States; Mountain View, California, United States
description:
Overview:

If you're looking for the stability of a profitable, growing company with the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup, we’re hiring. SageSure, a leader in catastrophe-exposed property insurance, is seeking an Intern to join the Rising Pioneer Program as part of our Carrier Operations (Carrier Ops) team.

Over the course of this 10-week program, interns will gain tangible, hands-on experience and insight into our business operations. After 3 days of orientation and training, you’ll join our Carrier Ops team where you’ll be assigned projects, with unlimited opportunity for challenges and achievement, and direct visibility to the CEO. We have, very often, considered our interns for post-graduation roles within the company.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Conduct product-level portfolio analysis to identify profitability trends and performance drivers, including actual performance relative to expectations, and translate findings into actionable portfolio insights.
  • Partner with Carrier Operations leadership and Portfolio Managers to evaluate carrier profitability, providing analysis and insights that support portfolio management decisions and business planning.
  • Develop presentation materials that clearly communicate portfolio performance and profitability insights to carrier partners, supporting operating reviews and other strategic discussions.
  • Build and maintain profitability models and analytical tools, helping modernize how profitability and portfolio reporting is developed, hosted, and shared internally and with carrier partners.
  • Learning and networking with employees, leaders, and other interns during a 10-week, on the job experience with potential to earn college credit
  • Own an individual Capstone project with deliverables and presentation to CEO
  • Additional 2-3 projects over the course of 10 weeks prioritized by the Carrier Ops team with weekly/bi-weekly updates to the OCEO (Office of the CEO) team
  • Research/analysis support on ad-hoc projects, specifically corporate projects important to the CEO
  • Recommend solutions to industry issues and latest news insights relevant to the business
  • Receive coaching, mentoring and feedback from knowledgeable SageSure professionals

We’re looking for someone who has:

  • Desire to work in the insurance industry
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to multitask and hungry to learn
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Ability to work independently, as a team member, and own challenging tasks
  • Strategic mindset and highly analytical thinker with sound business judgment
  • An undergraduate education pursuing a degree in business, insurance, risk management, operations, analytics, or a related field, with an anticipated graduation date in 2028
  • Authorization to work in the United States

Highly preferred candidates also have:

  • Prior internship experience or coursework related to insurance, underwriting, operations, analytics, or process improvement
  • GPA of 3.0 or higher
  • AI experience or coursework (e.g., applied AI, machine learning, natural language processing, or workplace analytics tools)

About SageSure:

Named among the Best Places to Work in Insurance by Business Insurance for four years in a row (2020-2023), SageSure is one of the largest managing general underwriters (MGU) focused on catastrophe-exposed property in the US. Since its founding in 2009, SageSure has experienced exceptional growth while generating underwriting profits for carrier partners through hurricanes, wildfires, and hail. Available in 16 states, SageSure offers more than 110 home, flood, and commercial products on behalf of its highly rated carrier partners. Today, SageSure manages more than $3.2 billion of inforce premium and helps protect more than 970,000 policyholders.

We have more than 1,000 employees in a distributed workforce environment across 12 offices—Fairfield, CA; Mountain View, CA; Cheshire, CT; Jacksonville, FL; Tallahassee, FL; Tampa, FL; Chicago, IL; Jersey City, NJ; Marlton, NJ; Cincinnati, OH; Houston, TX; Sheboygan, WI—who are tackling the industry’s toughest challenges.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

The Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the senior technical anchor for Bounteous client engagements built on Claude. You embed with client teams, find the workflows where agents change business outcomes, and ship governed, production-grade agentic systems on Anthropic's stack. The role combines hands-on engineering, solution architecture, and client leadership. You are the person a client's engineering leadership calls when an agent has to work in production, not just in a demo.

You will lead integrated squads using Bounteous Arc, our framework for running a hardened, repeatable, governable agentic development lifecycle with Claude Code. You will also turn what you learn in the field into reusable patterns for every engagement that follows.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Own the end-to-end technical design of agentic solutions on Claude, from discovery and workflow mapping through production rollout and continuous improvement.
  • Match autonomy to the use case using Anthropic's agent design patterns: start with the simplest composable workflow (prompt chaining, routing, parallelization) and move to orchestrator-subagent or evaluator-optimizer designs only when the task requires it.
  • Select the right runtime for each workload: the Claude Agent SDK for agents embedded in client applications, Claude Managed Agents for long-running hosted agents, and Claude Code for engineering workflows, deployed through the Claude Platform, Claude Platform on AWS, or Amazon Bedrock based on client cloud and compliance needs.
  • Design the tool and context layer: build and govern MCP servers that connect Claude to enterprise systems and data, package domain expertise as Agent Skills, and apply context engineering (progressive disclosure, compaction, memory, subagent context isolation) so agents stay accurate across long, multi-step tasks.
  • Lead model strategy across the Claude family, matching Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku to task complexity, latency, and volume, and using prompt caching, batch processing, and extended thinking and effort controls to keep cost predictable.
  • Define human-in-the-loop checkpoints, permission scopes, and approval gates matched to each workflow's risk profile.

Delivery & Engineering Excellence

  • Lead and mentor engineers across geographies, including Context Engineers, Evaluation Engineers, and Orchestration Architects, through an AI development lifecycle.
  • Build with Claude Code as the primary engineering environment, using subagents, hooks, plugins, project memory conventions, and headless runs in CI to deliver consistently at speed.
  • Make evaluation the backbone of delivery: define success criteria before building, create eval suites from real client tasks (code-graded, model-graded, and human review), and gate every release on them.
  • Instrument observability and cost controls from day one, with tracing of agent sessions, tool calls, and token spend per workflow.
  • Ship production artifacts (MCP servers, Agent Skills, subagents, plugins) and harden the best of them into reusable assets across engagements.

Client & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Embed with client engineering, platform, and business teams as their primary technical point of contact, including on-site when the work calls for it.
  • Run discovery to identify where agents create measurable value, and translate findings into a phased, fundable roadmap.
  • Partner with client risk, security, and governance stakeholders on data handling, MCP server approval, audit logging, and enterprise admin controls.
  • Work alongside Anthropic's account and Applied AI teams on joint engagements, representing Bounteous as a trusted delivery partner.
  • Drive lasting adoption by helping client teams roll out Claude Enterprise, Claude Cowork, and Claude Code with organization-managed skills and plugins, so value persists after the engagement ends.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years in software engineering and solution architecture, with significant client-facing or forward-deployed delivery.
  • A track record of shipping LLM-based agents to production (not only prototypes), ideally on Claude.
  • Hands-on depth with the Claude API (tool use, structured outputs, prompt caching, streaming), the Claude Agent SDK, and MCP server development.
  • Daily fluency with Claude Code and agentic coding practices.
  • Strong prompt and context engineering: system prompts, tool descriptions, and skills that hold up against messy enterprise data.
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks and using them to drive engineering decisions.
  • Proficiency in Python and TypeScript, modern backend architecture, and cloud deployment (AWS preferred).
  • Enterprise data integration experience, including when to use retrieval-augmented generation versus agentic search over live systems.
  • A strong grasp of agent governance, security, observability, and risk controls.
  • Experience leading teams in complex, regulated enterprise environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Anthropic certification, such as Claude Certified Architect (Foundations or Professional).
  • Prior experience in BFSI or other regulated industries.
  • Production experience with Claude Managed Agents or multiagent orchestration.
  • Claude deployments on AWS, including IAM, network isolation, and data residency requirements.
  • Experience rolling out Claude Enterprise or Claude Cowork with admin-managed skills and plugins.
  • Experience in global, distributed delivery models.
  • Contributions to the MCP or Agent Skills ecosystems, or other open-source work.

What Success Looks Like

  • Client agents run in production, governed and measured by business outcomes rather than demo quality.
  • Every engagement leaves behind MCP servers, skills, and eval suites that make the next one faster.
  • Clients see Bounteous as the Claude partner they call for their hardest problems, not just a delivery vendor.
  • Cost, latency, and risk are predictable, tracked, and reported.

Why This Role at Bounteous

  • Lead strategic Claude engagements as part of Bounteous's Anthropic Preferred partnership.
  • Shape how Bounteous delivers agentic systems at scale across clients and industries.
  • Balance hands-on engineering with architectural and leadership impact.
  • Work in a culture that values clarity, pragmatism, and real-world outcomes over hype.

Information Security Responsibilities

  • Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

title: Card Product Analyst
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION: Forbright is a nationwide full-service bank and commercial lender focused on helping to build a brighter future for our clients and the communities we serve. Forbright is committed to exceptional client service by providing seamless, innovative personal banking services to depositors and creative financing solutions to visionary middle market businesses and investors in healthcare, technology, financial services, real estate, and other industries.
COMPANY CULTURE: We are a dynamic, high energy, fun, and fast-paced organization that has an exciting growth trajectory, meaningful mission, and embedded responsible practices into our daily interactions. We offer our team members a culture of collaboration, inclusion, flexibility, recognition, and giving back. We look to hire individuals that are passionate about our mission, and who are motivated, customer and results-oriented, innovative, adaptable, and thoughtful.
COMPANY MISSION: We are a mission-driven institution. We operate a sound dynamic institution that is well capitalized, liquid, profitable and uses best practices to manage risk and assure compliance with laws and regulations. We use Forbright’s capital, capabilities, innovation, and expertise to help our clients succeed and contribute broadly to building a brighter future.

JOB SUMMARY: The Card Product Analyst supports the growth, performance, and ongoing management of Forbright Bank's debit card program and future secured card offerings. This role works across Product, Operations, Marketing, Finance, Fraud, Compliance, Risk, Technology, Customer Care, and external partners to translate program data, customer feedback, network requirements, and business needs into well-defined, executable solutions. The Card Product Analyst maintains card program reporting, coordinates network and incentive requirements, supports product delivery, and identifies opportunities to improve cardholder engagement, customer experience, operational efficiency, and program controls.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build, maintain, and enhance card program performance dashboards, scorecards, and recurring management reporting

  • Monitor and analyze card activation, usage, transaction volume, purchase activity, fraud, ATM activity, disputes, chargebacks, digital wallet adoption, and other customer engagement and program performance metrics

  • Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities, and prepare clear findings and recommendations for product leadership and cross-functional partners

  • Manage Network incentive reimbursement activities, including tracking eligible commitments, coordinating required documentation with Marketing, submitting support, and monitoring reimbursement status

  • Partner with Operations and Finance to ensure Network rebates and reimbursements are accurately recorded, reconciled, and reported

  • Manage Network mandates, certifications, reporting obligations, and implementation requirements; coordinate quarterly network reporting submissions for accuracy and timeliness

  • Support day-to-day relationships with card networks, processors, ATM networks, digital wallet partners, and other vendors; coordinate issue resolution, operational readiness, and follow-up actions

  • Partner with Product leadership to define, prioritize, and maintain the card product roadmap and backlog; support backlog grooming, release planning, and prioritization activities

  • Gather and document business requirements, business rules, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications for card product and operational enhancements

  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, defect validation, production validation, release readiness, implementation planning, and post-production monitoring

  • Track roadmap commitments, implementation milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, open questions, and required stakeholder actions; escalate issues when necessary

  • Analyze customer complaints, servicing trends, contact drivers, disputes, transaction exceptions, and Voice of Customer feedback to identify recurring pain points and enhancement opportunities

  • Partner with Operations, Customer Care, Fraud, and Technology to identify and implement product enhancements that reduce operational workload, manual intervention, call volume, and customer friction

  • Support customer communications, disclosures, launch activities, and change-management efforts associated with card program enhancements and network requirements

  • Support audit, compliance, risk, and regulatory examinations related to the card program, including gathering evidence, responding to requests, and tracking remediation items

  • Maintain card program documentation, procedures, controls, decision logs, governance materials, and implementation artifacts

  • Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, Legal, Fraud, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Care to advance product objectives and resolve issues

  • Prepare executive-ready reports, presentations, recommendations, and program updates

  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Marketing, Data Analytics, or a related field required

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in product management, product operations, business analysis, payments, card programs, banking operations, digital banking, fintech, or a related field required

  • Experience supporting debit card, prepaid card, credit card, secured card, payments, money movement, or digital wallet products preferred

  • Experience working with card processors, payment networks, ATM networks, digital wallets, or card program vendors preferred

  • Experience gathering business requirements and translating business needs into product or process enhancements preferred

  • Experience managing backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, testing, and prioritization processes preferred.

  • Experience working in a regulated financial services environment preferred

  • Familiarity with card network mandates and rules, Regulation E, card disputes, fraud operations, digital wallets, tokenization, and card servicing processes preferred

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Outstanding analytical, problem-solving, and time-management skills

  • Ability to translate data, customer feedback, network requirements, and operational information into practical recommendations

  • Self-motivated, self-directed, and results-oriented

  • Adaptable and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Can work independently and within a team; solution-oriented with a collaborative approach

POSITION REQUIREMENTS: We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are capable of performing their job position. Work is primarily conducted in an office setting while certain positions may allow for remote work through the use of technology at management discretion. The functions described below are representative of those to successfully perform duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees to perform the essential functions. While performing duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required for extended periods of time to:
• Remain in a stationary position
• Use hands and fingers
• Utilize a computer monitor with visual acuity
• Operate technology or other office machinery such as printers, scanners, etc.
• Communicate clearly verbally and/or in writing with others
ADDITIONAL DUTIES: For Forbright Bank to remain efficient and nimble as a growing organization, team members are expected to exhibit a high level of flexibility regarding any duties that may be situationally assigned outside of this job description.
PERKS/BENEFITS:
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
• 4 weeks PTO
• 401k + company match
• Metro SmartTrip benefits ($50/mo)
• Remote or hybrid (4 days per week in-office) work schedules for most positions
• Incentives for purchasing solar panels, electric vehicles, biking to work, etc.
• Paid subscriptions to Veterans Compost, Capital Bikeshare, Imperfect Foods reimbursement, and more!
• The Washington Post Top Workplaces winner for four consecutive years (2023-2026)
CORE PRINCIPLES:
• Excellence: Excellence is not a goal, but a standard, reflected in the precision of our work and the quality of our decisions. Excellence is a discipline that compounds over time and creates lasting value; it must be measured and managed.
• People: Our people are our greatest strength. We foster a culture of respect, inclusion, and ambition - where everyone matters. We celebrate collaboration and teamwork and prize loyalty - to one another, the company, our mission, and values.
• Innovation: We invest boldly in technology, harnessing innovation not for its own sake but to make banking and lending better, faster, and smarter for our clients, more efficient for our team, and more profitable for our shareholders. By combining human insight with technological excellence, we strengthen our ability to serve, to adapt, and to succeed in a changing world. Innovation is a continuous investment in new ideas.
• Sound Practices: Our foundation rests on prudence, care, integrity, and discipline. We manage credit and business risk with rigor and fundamentals-based judgment, act with transparency, and uphold the highest standards of corporate governance and regulatory compliance to ensure sustainable growth and enduring financial strength.
• Distinct Value: We focus our energy where we add value. We avoid the commoditized and the ordinary, choosing to compete through insight, specialization, technology and service. By concentrating on areas where expertise matters and relationships endure, we create differentiation that is defensible and lasting.
• Clients: We exist to advance our clients’ success and to help them grow. We listen deeply, think creatively, and deliver solutions that solve problems, drive impact and add value. Every client relationship is built on partnership, performance, and purpose.
• Shareholders: We are committed to creating exceptional value for our shareholders. We invest for the long term and view our shareholders as partners – not observers - in value creation. title: Senior UX Designer
description:
Would you like to design digital solutions that help some of the world's leading industrial companies manage and make complex product information more accessible?

At Aleido, we develop solutions in technical information and learning, with a current focus on the continued development of our modular product information platform. We are now looking for a Senior UX Designer with particular expertise in interaction design who wants to help shape the user experience of the platform and other digital solutions for our customers.

You will join Aleido's tech team in Gothenburg, where UX plays an important role in product and software development. You will be part of a small design team consisting of both junior and senior UX and UI designers.

One of our major ongoing initiatives is the continued development of our modular product information platform. While this will be a significant part of your work, the role may also involve other digital solutions and customer projects. This gives you the opportunity to address different user needs and design challenges while contributing to the long-term development of a product.

The Role

As a Senior UX Designer, you will work on digital products and systems used in industrial environments. A key focus is Aleido's new product information platform, which enables users to create, structure, manage and distribute technical information. This requires well-designed user journeys and intuitive interfaces that make complex tasks easier to accomplish.

Interaction design is at the heart of the role, but your responsibilities will span the entire UX process, from user research and needs analysis to concept development, prototyping and usability testing. Experience working with AI and designing AI-powered experiences is highly desirable.

You will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Software Developers and AI Engineers to develop solutions that meet user needs while remaining technically feasible.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading UX activities throughout the design process, from user research and needs analysis to concept development, prototyping, usability testing and final design solutions.

  • Designing user flows, interactions, navigation structures and information architecture for complex digital systems.

  • Creating wireframes and interactive prototypes to communicate, explore and evaluate design concepts.

  • Translating user insights and business requirements into practical, intuitive and user-centred design solutions.

  • Collaborating with Product Owners, Developers and AI Engineers to ensure designs are both effective for users and technically achievable.

  • Exploring and designing interfaces and workflows for AI-powered features.

  • Contributing to the development and evolution of design systems, component libraries and shared design principles.

  • Evaluating and continuously improving existing solutions based on usability testing, user feedback and identified usability challenges.

  • Sharing your expertise and supporting less experienced colleagues in UX and interaction design.

Who You Are

We are looking for an experienced UX Designer who is confident taking ownership of the design process, from early ideas through to well-considered, fully developed solutions.

You understand how user needs, technical possibilities and business requirements come together, and you can clearly articulate and justify your design decisions based on user insights, established design principles and practical considerations.

You are analytical, curious and collaborative, with the confidence to present, discuss and align design proposals with different stakeholders and specialist teams. You are comfortable working independently but also enjoy exploring and developing ideas with others.

As a senior member of the team, you bring valuable experience, take initiative and actively contribute to improving the team's ways of working.

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

  • Several years of professional experience in UX design, product design or a similar role.

  • Experience designing complex B2B services, SaaS platforms or other information-intensive digital systems.

  • Strong expertise in interaction design, user flows, navigation and information architecture.

  • Hands-on experience in user research, wireframing, prototyping and usability testing.

  • The ability to translate user needs and research insights into clear, well-founded design solutions.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and other specialists in cross-functional teams.

  • Experience working with design systems, component libraries and design tools such as Figma.

  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

Why Join Aleido?

Opportunities to grow: Develop your skills alongside colleagues with a wide range of specialist expertise. We value knowledge sharing, collaboration and an open exchange of ideas.

Technology meets usability: Work on digital solutions for industrial applications, where UX design plays a vital role in making complex technical information accessible and useful.

Variety and new challenges: Join a team working on different types of digital solutions. One of our current priorities is the continued development of our modular product information platform.

A culture of learning: We encourage curiosity, initiative and continuous development, both in individual expertise and in how we work together.

About Aleido

Aleido is a Swedish company with an international presence and extensive experience in developing technical information and learning solutions. We help organisations that develop complex products and systems make advanced technology easier to understand and use.

With nearly 1,000 colleagues across five countries, we work together to bridge the gap between technology and the people who depend on it. By combining technical expertise with a deep understanding of people's needs, we create information solutions that make a real difference.

description:
About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents.

The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.


As a Principal Risk Analyst, you'll identify, measure, and mitigate the risks that come with operating a crypto payments business, including counterparty exposure, liquidity and market risk, and the technical risks unique to blockchain rails. You'll work with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Treasury, and Operations to make sure we can grow quickly without taking risks we don't understand.

What You'll Do

  • Review & challenge risk assessment across our payment flows, including on-ramps, off-ramps, card and bank funding, stablecoin settlement, and cross-border transfers.

  • Assess and monitor counterparty risk across liquidity providers, exchanges, custodians, banking partners, payment processors, and blockchain infrastructure vendors.

  • Evaluate exposure from cross-chain bridges, DEX swaps, and smart contract interactions, including protocol risk, liquidity depth, slippage, and settlement failure.

  • Review & challenge risks related to crypto trading, including price slippage, execution latency, and hedging liquidity across venues.

  • Work with Treasury on market, liquidity, and FX risk, including hedging strategy, inventory and float management, and stablecoin de-peg scenarios.

  • Provide an independent review of new product proposals, collaborating early with Product and Engineering, ensuring all risks are identified and controls are integrated from inception, and recommending approval with or without conditions.

  • Review business continuity testing and business impact analyses to ensure operational resilience and preparedness for disruptions.

  • Develop, maintain, and evolve the risk framework, with a strong focus on defining and embedding Risk Appetite Statements and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), alongside risk registers, limits, and escalation procedures.

  • Review technology and information security risks across core systems, infrastructure, and third-party integrations to ensure robust safeguards and data protection.

  • Prepare risk reporting for senior leadership, the board, auditors, and partners

  • Conduct third-party risk assessments and continuous monitoring for critical vendors, service providers, and partners.

What You'll Bring

Experience

  • 5-10 years in risk management at a payments company, fintech, exchange, bank, or crypto firm.

  • Hands-on experience with credit/counterparty, operational, or market risk in a regulated or high-growth environment.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills. You are comfortable building dashboards and models from raw data.

Crypto payments knowledge (essential)

  • A deep understanding of how crypto payments work end to end: fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat flows, crypto swaps, stablecoin settlement, merchant and card acquiring,

  • Working knowledge of blockchain fundamentals: consensus, finality, confirmations, reorgs, gas and fees, wallets, and key management.

  • Understanding of cross-chain bridges and their trust and security models, plus the history of bridge exploits.

  • Understanding of swaps, DEXs and AMMs, liquidity pools, slippage, MEV, and aggregator routing.

  • Knowledge of hedging approaches in crypto, such as spot, perpetuals, futures, options, and stablecoin basis risk.

  • Familiarity with stablecoin mechanics and reserve and de-peg risk, and with smart contract risk and audits.

  • Experience with blockchain analytics tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM, Elliptic) and on-chain data exploration.

Core skills

  • Excellent judgment under uncertainty. You can make a call with incomplete information and explain your reasoning.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to translate technical risk into business impact for non-specialists.

  • A collaborative approach: you can say "no" or "yes, with conditions" without becoming a blocker.

Nice to Have

  • A professional risk certification (FRM, PRM, CAMS) or a quantitative degree.

  • Experience in DeFi or familiarity with writing or reading simple smart contract logic.

  • Prior experience building a risk function at a scaling company.

title: Director, Global PV Management
location: Princeton, New Jersey, United States; San Diego, California, United States; South San Francisco, California, United States
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, CA, San Diego, CA, or Princeton, NJ with an expectation to work onsite three days per week.

Position Summary

The Director, Global PV Management is responsible for assessing regional and international pharmacovigilance regulatory requirements and translating them into effective drug safety & pharmacovigilance (DSP) procedures and operational processes. In partnership with DSP team members and other cross-functional key stakeholders, the role monitors regulatory changes in existing markets, assesses PV requirements for entry into new countries, and drives the development and implementation of processes that enable ongoing compliance and operational readiness.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Review and interpret applicable international and regional pharmacovigilance regulatory requirements and assess their impact on company procedures, processes, and outsourced activities.
  • Continuously monitor changes to pharmacovigilance requirements in countries where the company operates and coordinate timely assessment and implementation of necessary changes.
  • Assess pharmacovigilance requirements for new countries and develop operational readiness plans, including required procedures, responsibilities, and implementation timelines.
  • Conduct and document gap assessments comparing regulatory requirements with existing SOPs, work instructions, and operational practices.
  • Lead the development and revision of pharmacovigilance procedures, working with Regulatory, Quality, Medical Safety, Risk Management, QST, other cross-functional stakeholders, and service providers, as applicable to ensure requirements are appropriately addressed.
  • Collaborate with the Qualified Person for Pharmacovigilance (QPPV) and local country pharmacovigilance responsible persons to assess country-specific requirements, confirm their operational impact, and ensure appropriate incorporation into company procedures and processes.
  • Translate regulatory requirements into clear operational steps, defined ownership, and actionable timelines.
  • Coordinate procedure review and implementation, and verify that required changes have been incorporated into operational practice.
  • Maintain a centralized record of applicable requirements, identified gaps, action owners, implementation status, and supporting documentation.
  • Regularly evaluate SOPs and processes to identify compliance gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with the Head of Pharmacovigilance Operations and PV Quality Services & Training to periodically assess adherence to established procedures through targeted, routine process checks. Identify gaps and coordinate appropriate follow-up, including procedure clarification, training, or process improvements.
  • Escalate compliance risks and overdue actions to PV leadership and recommend practical solutions.

Aikaisempi kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä ei ole välttämätöntä, sillä perehdytämme sinut työhön.
