title: Burger King Orkanger søker renholder 3-4 dager i uken, kveld/natt
description:
Burger King Orkanger søker renholder 3-4 dager i uken, kveld/natt

Arbeidstider vil være 5,5t per vakt, hvor man hovedsaklig jobber alene.
22:00-03:30, turnus med annenhver helg. Full opplæring vil bli gitt.

Obs! Jobben inkluderer skittent arbeid og noen løft.

Gode gjesteopplevelser i Burger King begynner med rene restauranter og et rent kjøkken. Derfor er stillingen som renholder en av de viktigste rollene i restaurantene våre. Som renholder i Burger King arbeider du i hovedsak utenom restaurantens åpningstid. Du har ansvar for å rengjøre gjesteareal, kjøkken og kjøkkenutstyr.

For å lykkes i jobben er det viktig at du er selvstendig, grundig i din arbeidsutførelse og effektiv.

Vi ser etter deg som er pålitelig, nøyaktig og som har et øye for detaljer. Har du også godt humør og stor ansvarsfølelse, vil du med stor sannsynlighet passe inn hos oss.

Det er en fordel å snakke godt norsk, men engelsk går også bra. Du må gjerne ha erfaring fra renholdsarbeid fra før, men dette er ikke et krav da du vil få full opplæring og kontinuerlig oppfølging hos oss.

Hvem er du?

I våre restauranter er vi ikke opptatt en fancy CV, men hvem du er og hva du kan tilføre, og (viktigst av alt) at du vil gi 100% hver dag for å behandle hver eneste gjest som en konge gjemmom ditt bidrag til renslighet!

Vil du bli en del av vårt team? Ta kontakt med oss i dag!

title: Budget Director
description:
About EpicWorks

EpicWorks provides movement organizations with the values-aligned infrastructure and services they need to fulfill their missions with confidence. We help strengthen the core of their operations by providing essential, dependable services related to people practices, financial management, legal compliance and organizational health. EpicWorks sets up organizations to achieve greater impact.
EpicWorks team members specialize in finance, human resources, compliance, legal services, organizational culture and labor relations. Each team member brings years—often decades—of experience supporting organizations fighting for justice.
This role will work directly for EpicWorks and will not be employed by Working Families Party or Working Families Power.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, the Budget Director is responsible for helping EpicWorks Participating Organization leaders understand their financial position, plan effectively, and make sound financial decisions. The ability to translate financial data into clear choice points and implications for leaders is essential to success in this role.

The Budget Director will support the CFO at an enterprise level across all Participating Organizations. A significant focus of this role will be providing extensive support to department heads at Working Families Party and Working Families Power (our largest and most complex Participating Organizations). The leaders of our Participating Organizations require support developing and managing budgets, identifying risks, evaluating tradeoffs, and monitoring spending, cash reserves, and forecasts in order to make informed decisions about their resources. The Budget Director will work in close partnership with the Working Families Party and Working Families Power Director of Management & Budget, who owns the budget process, strategy and decision process for those organizations. The Budget Director will lead the technical financial work necessary to complete those processes.

The Budget Director will also provide financial guidance to a portfolio of EpicWorks Participating Organizations. The role requires an ability to translate complex financial information into clear, practical guidance and build trusted relationships with leaders with varying levels of financial expertise. The Budget Director will work in close partnership with the Director of Participating Organization Services who is responsible for the overall experience of these additional leaders.

The Budget Director will supervise finance staff and balance strategic leadership and relationship management with hands-on financial analysis and problem-solving.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Financial Partnership & Budget Management

  • Serve as a financial partner to department heads and senior leaders at Working Families Party and Working Families Power.
  • Lead the technical financial work needed for annual budgeting and regular forecasting to support department leaders and budget managers.
  • Review budgets, actual spending, forecasts, staffing assumptions, and financial commitments with leaders on a regular basis.
  • Identify significant variances, emerging risks, and financial trends and help leaders understand their possible implications.
  • Model financial scenarios and help leaders evaluate staffing, programmatic, and operational decisions.
  • Translate financial information into clear, actionable information for non-finance audiences.
  • Provide hands-on support to departments of particular priority as identified by the CFO and Director of Management and Budget.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the accounting system and the revenue and expenses underlying budget-versus-actual reports, including fundraising revenue projections and actual results.
  • Support the development of financial dashboards tailored to the reporting and decision-making needs of Working Families' department and division directors.

Participating Organization Support

  • Provide financial guidance to our portfolio of Participating Organizations and fiscally sponsored projects, including budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, reporting, and financial planning.
  • Meet regularly with organizational leaders to review financial performance, identify risks, and support sound decision-making.
  • Develop training, tools, dashboards, templates, and written guidance that strengthen financial management across organizations.
  • Support the financial onboarding of new Participating Organizations, including workflows, expectations, and financial systems.
  • Collaborate with other EpicWorks teams to provide coordinated and responsive support.

Financial Planning, Systems & Team Leadership

  • Develop and continuously improve budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting tools and methods, and enterprise level financial planning processes.
  • Partner with the Controller and accounting staff to ensure management reporting is timely, accurate, and grounded in sound accounting practices.
  • Support improvements to NetSuite and other financial systems and identify opportunities to streamline or automate reporting and analysis.
  • Supervise and develop finance staff, setting clear priorities and expectations and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and excellent service.
  • Step into detailed financial analysis and operational work when needed.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • 7–10 years of progressive nonprofit finance experience, including leadership or supervisory experience.
  • Significant experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis, cash flow management, and management reporting.
  • Experience serving as a strategic financial partner to executives, department heads, or other organizational leaders.
  • Experience working in complex, multi-entity nonprofit environments, including 501(c)(3) and 501(c)(4) organizations.
  • Strong understanding of GAAP, internal controls, and nonprofit financial management.
  • Exceptional ability to translate complex financial information into practical guidance for non-finance leaders.
  • Strong relationship-building and service orientation, with excellent communication and follow-through.
  • Commitment to EpicWorks values of Accountability, Justice, Resilience and Collective Responsibility.
  • Experience improving financial processes, reporting tools, dashboards, and systems.
  • Experience supervising and developing finance staff.
  • Experience with NetSuite or similar financial management systems.
  • Experience with fiscally sponsored projects and grant-funded organizations strongly preferred.
  • Experience in political, advocacy, movement, or other mission-driven organizations preferred.
Applicants must be currently authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor, or take over sponsorship of, employment visas at this time.
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
EpicWorks is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to economic and social justice. Women, people of color, LGBTQ people, people with disabilities, and members of other historically disenfranchised populations are strongly encouraged to apply. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to apply for or perform the essential functions of the job should contact us at jobs@workingfamilies.org with the subject line "Application Accommodation" to request such an accommodation.
This role will work directly for EpicWorks and will not be employed by Working Families Party or Working Families Power.

location: Remote - Argentina; Brazil; Colombia; Costa Rica; Mexico
description:
Why you’ll love this role:

As a Full Stack Engineer supporting the Marketing department at Newsela, you will keep our websites fast, reliable, and fresh, and build the integrations and programs that help them perform. Marketing relies on its web presence to tell our story, generate demand, and measure what works, and you will be the engineer who makes that possible.

This is a hands-on role for an engineer who wants to deliver high-quality work, build strong habits around velocity and craft, and grow alongside experienced teammates. You will own assigned features from implementation through release, with guidance on scoping and design from senior engineers, and you will use AI tools as a standard part of how you build, test, and troubleshoot.

You will partner closely with Marketing, Engineering, Product Management, and Product Design to turn real business needs into clear, actionable work, and then ship it.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Deliver High-Quality Work, On Time: Write high-quality, well-tested code across our marketing websites and campaign landing pages using AI-assisted development practices to maintain high velocity and standard-setting execution.
  • Own Features from Implementation to Release: Own assigned web features, interactive tools, and campaign landing pages through build, testing, and launch, with guidance on architecture and scoping from senior engineering partners.
  • Maintain and Improve Our Websites: Handle the ongoing maintenance, updates, and enhancements that keep our marketing sites accurate, secure, and performing well for visitors and for the Marketing team.
  • Build Integrations, Data Pipelines, and MarTech Connections: Help build, integrate, and maintain connections between Webflow, Marketo, Salesforce, and internal APIs to ensure accurate lead flow, data hygiene, and robust analytics tracking (GA4, GTM, RedTrack, Pendo, and DataGrail).
  • Write Well-Tested Software: Meet the team’s quality bar with thoughtful automated and manual testing, incorporating AI-assisted development practices as part of your standard workflow.
  • Help Validate AI-Integrated Features: Contribute to the testing and validation of AI-integrated features, with support from senior engineers on evaluation approach.
  • Turn Ambiguity into Action: Partner with Engineering, Product Management, and Product Design to understand requirements and raise the questions that sharpen ambiguous work into clear, actionable tasks.
  • Contribute to Reliable Systems: Follow best practices for observability and quality, and use AI tooling to help troubleshoot and resolve issues quickly.
  • Support Privacy & In-App Ops: Assist with user onboarding and event tracking in Pendo while supporting automated compliance, consent management, and privacy workflows via DataGrail.
  • Support Smooth Production Releases: Follow established deployment practices and monitor system stability after release so launches land cleanly.

Why you’re a great fit:

  • 2+ years of professional experience in software engineering, ideally with exposure to marketing websites, web applications, or similar customer-facing products.
  • Full Stack & Webflow Foundation: Hands-on experience developing within Webflow supported by strong foundational front-end skills (HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript) and back-end integration capabilities.
  • Analytics & Tagging Expertise: Demonstrated experience configuring tags, triggers, variables, custom event listeners, and data pipelines in Google Tag Manager (GTM), RedTrack, and Google Analytics (GA4).
  • MarTech Ecosystem: Exposure to or experience working with enterprise marketing platforms (Marketo, Salesforce) and product analytics/experience tools (Pendo).
  • Quality-Minded: Experience writing well-tested software, using version control and code review, and following established deployment practices.
  • AI-Fluent Builder: Enthusiasm for using AI tools in your daily workflow for development, testing, and troubleshooting, along with good judgment about when to trust and when to verify their output.
  • Privacy & Compliance Awareness: Knowledge of privacy/consent operations (such as DataGrail) and web compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA).
  • Collaborative Communicator: Clear written and verbal communication in English, and the ability to ask sharp questions, work with non-technical partners, and turn loosely defined requests into well-scoped tasks.
  • Self-Directed Contractor: Reliable, organized, and comfortable owning your work in a remote, asynchronous environment, with the ability to overlap with our team during Eastern Standard Time (EST) core working hours.

Additional Role Details:

  • This contract position is paid a monthly rate (USD).
  • This person must be located in one of the following countries: Argentina; Brazil; Chile; Colombia; Costa Rica.
  • Please note that given the nature of the position, this role will not be eligible to participate in company-sponsored benefits.
  • The contract is estimated to last 12 months with the potential for extension, though an extension is not guaranteed.

All offers of employment are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check as part of our pre-employment process.

Why you’ll love working at Newsela:

  • Work From Home: We are a fully remote company!
  • Make A Difference: No matter your role or department, the work you do each day helps share the future of education and improves the lives of students and teachers!

About Newsela:

Newsela is a leading education technology company dedicated to meaningful classroom learning for every student. We deliver integrated, AI-powered solutions designed to unlock student engagement, empower teachers, and drive meaningful learning outcomes. Our suite of products supports knowledge and skill development, writing practice, daily instruction, assessment, and data-informed decision-making across K–12 classrooms. Grounded in learning science research, Newsela’s solutions integrate content, assessment, and analytics to help educators track progress, understand student outcomes, and deliver high-impact instruction that supports every learner.

title: Raskaan kaluston mekaanikko
description:
Liiketoimintamme kasvun myötä etsimme nyt useampaa raskaan kaluston mekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Liedon korjaamollemme.

Voit olla jo kokenut ammattilainen tai urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva mekaanikko. Tärkeintä meille on tekninen kiinnostus, halu oppia uutta sekä innostus työskennellä raskaan kaluston parissa.

Tässä tehtävässä vastaat perävaunujen sekä muun raskaan kaluston huolloista, vikadiagnostiikasta, korjauksista ja tarkastuksista. Olet tärkeässä roolissa asiakkaidemme kaluston turvallisuuden, käyttövarmuuden ja liikennekelpoisuuden varmistamisessa.

Jos sinulla on kokemusta ajoneuvojen huolloista ja korjauksista tai vahva kiinnostus mekaaniseen työhön sekä haluat työskennellä osaavassa ja mutkattomassa työyhteisössä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Tehtäväsi

Työssäsi vastaat perävaunujen ja muun raskaan kaluston huolloista, korjauksista ja tarkastuksista, kuten:

✔️ Määräaikaishuollot ja tarkastukset
✔️ Vikadiagnostiikka, vianmääritys ja korjaustyöt
✔️ Jarru-, sähkö- ja hydrauliikkajärjestelmien huolto- ja korjaustyöt
✔️ Kaluston turvallisuuden, käyttövarmuuden ja liikennekelpoisuuden varmistaminen
✔️ Tarvittaessa muut korjaamon huolto- ja korjaustyöt
✔️ Yhteistyö asiakkaiden sekä oman tiimin kanssa

Mitä tuot mukanasi

✔️ Teknistä kiinnostusta ja halua oppia uutta
✔️ Käytännönläheistä työotetta ja kiinnostusta mekaanisiin korjaus- ja huoltotöihin
✔️ Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä
✔️ Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
✔️ Kykyä työskennellä huolellisesti myös kiireisissä tilanteissa
✔️ Positiivista asennetta sekä oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista työotetta

Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen raskaan kaluston, perävaunujen, työkoneiden tai muiden ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustöistä, kokemuksen perävaunutekniikasta, jarru-, sähkö- ja hydrauliikkajärjestelmistä, hitsaustaidot sekä C-ajokortin.


Miksi TIP?

Meillä pääset työskentelemään kansainvälisessä ja vakaassa yrityksessä, jossa osaamista arvostetaan ja ammattitaidon kehittämiseen panostetaan. Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työnkuvan, nykyaikaisen työympäristön sekä ammattitaitoisen tiimin tuen. Osaamisen kehittämistä tuemme koulutusten ja käytännön työn kautta.

Työskentelet osana kokenutta korjaamotiimiä, jossa arvostetaan yhteistyötä, osaamisen jakamista ja yhdessä onnistumista. Arjessamme yhdistyvät vahva ammattitaito ja hyvä tekemisen meininki.

Tarjoamme mm.:

✅ Vakituisen työsuhteen kasvavassa kansainvälisessä yrityksessä
✅ Tukea ammattitaidon kehittämiseen ja osaamisen ylläpitämiseen
✅ Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen
✅ Kattavan vakuutusturvan, joka on voimassa myös vapaa-ajalla
✅ ePassi-edun
✅ Globaalin työntekijöiden tukiohjelman
✅ Hedelmiä työpaikalla
✅ Kannustavan, ammattitaitoisen ja käytännönläheisen työyhteisön

Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan pitämään asiakkaidemme kalusto liikkeessä!

Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikka täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

title: Technical Communications Specialist
description:
We have an opening for a Technical Communications Specialist to support the Livermore Information Technology Program (LivIT), with a focus on Super Intelligence (SI), previously referred to as artificial intelligence (AI). You will interact with administrative, management, technical, and IT staff to develop technical communications, knowledge-management content, user education materials, and service-adoption communications for diverse technical and non-technical audiences. This position is in the Technical Information Department within the Business Directorate and will be matrixed to LivIT.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional responsibilities will be assigned at the higher level.

This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence, with flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

You will

  • Edit, organize, and develop technical and nontechnical content for web and other media platforms, including ServiceNow. Develop original content for internal audiences.
  • Work with service owners, business units, and project groups to coordinate communications projects involving multiple contributors and iterative review.
  • Interpret complex technical information and translate it into accessible web copy, newsletters, tutorials, knowledge base articles, user education materials, and other communications.
  • Coordinate moderately complex communications and user education projects, often with quick turnaround times.
  • Coordinate and evaluate multiple concurrent projects and their outcomes; lead ad hoc planning and status meetings.
  • Develop and implement project plans and schedules for moderately complex projects while meeting cost, schedule, and quality commitments.
  • Work effectively with LLNL staff members at all levels to support Laboratory communications and learning needs.
  • Assess audience knowledge gaps and communication needs; collaborate with subject matter experts to develop or adapt user education content, tutorials, job aids, demonstrations, knowledge articles, and feedback methods for IT services.
  • Deliver and evaluate user education sessions, demonstrations, tutorials, and other communication-based learning products through in-person, virtual, and digital channels to promote understanding and adoption of IT services, SI tools, and responsible technology use.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

In addition, at the G04.3 Level

  • Develop original complex technical content and provide comprehensive writing, editing, and editorial-development services for complex, multi-author communications products.
  • Serve as project manager by partnering to define technical communications strategies, messages, audiences, and key deliverables for complex and specialized products and projects.
  • Coordinate all aspects of development, schedules, planning meetings, status meetings, and review of team members’ work.
  • Independently assess audience knowledge gaps and communications needs for complex LivIT services and SI topics.
  • Develop integrated technical communications and user-education approaches, establish measures of effectiveness, and recommend improvements to support service adoption.
  • Lead delivery of sophisticated user education, demonstrations, tutorials, and communications products for critical IT topics; consult with senior leaders and subject matter experts and use audience feedback and usage data to improve service-adoption communications.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. Citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in English, communications, information technology, journalism, marketing, education, training and development, a scientific or technical discipline, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience in communications or training.
  • Experience translating complex scientific and technical information for a broad range of users through effective planning, development, organization and writing of content across multiple communication platforms, including web and digital media.
  • Experience using effective professional writing and editing techniques for varied media, with comprehensive knowledge of technical language, usage, and style conventions.
  • Significant experience with Microsoft Office and Adobe software tools, particularly templates, charts, and presentation formats.
  • Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including knowledge of and experience applying style conventions, professional principles, and technical communication practices and standards.
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills, including the ability to work independently and within a demanding team environment while meeting tight deadlines and managing competing priorities.
  • Strong understanding of the costs, processes, timelines, and specifications involved in technical communications, user-education, and service-adoption projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly through effective writing, editing, presentations, tutorials, demonstrations, and digital communications products.

In addition, at the G04.3 Level

  • Significant writing and editing experience in a wide variety of scientific or technical areas.
  • Project management experience leading complex, multi-functional communication projects and teams involving multiple technical groups.
  • Experience translating complex information into communications and user-education materials that are easily understood by business-oriented customers.
  • Experience collaborating with senior managers, clients, team members, peers, and stakeholders to meet organizational and programmatic objectives.
  • Advanced experience independently assessing audience knowledge gaps and communications needs; developing and evaluating complex technical communications and user-education products; and advising stakeholders on communications approaches for SI services and technologies.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex technical communications or user-education projects, influencing stakeholders without direct authority, and mentoring or providing technical direction to others.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Advanced degree in English, communications, information technology, journalism, marketing, education, training and development, or a related technical area.
  • Advanced knowledge of or experience working in a service center, customer service, or information technology environment.
  • Experience in knowledge management, including authoring and updating knowledge base articles and providing guidance to contributors who create knowledge content.
  • High proficiency in the IT discipline, including SI, together with an understanding of its technical and business landscape, and the ability to translate fundamental technical concepts, applications, opportunities, limitations, and responsible-use considerations into clear communications and user-education products.

Pay Range: $95,820 - $140,712 Annually

$95,820 - $117,312 Annually at the G04.2 level

$114,900 - $140,712 Annually at the G04.3 level

This is the lowest to highest salary range in good faith we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

title: PMO Manager
location: Croydon, England, United Kingdom; Manchester, England, United Kingdom
description:
Janes equips defence, government, and industry leaders with objective, accurate, and shareable data and analysis. Our experts combine advanced technology with proven tradecraft to deliver validated and contextual intelligence to assess threats, accelerate decisions, and anticipate change with confidence. We deliver our intelligence with the flexibility to fuse it with multiple sources in any system, enrich AI solutions, or access it through our portal.

Job purpose:

The PMO Manager will provide clear, accurate and forward-looking portfolio information, governance and control across major initiatives. The role will establish a reliable view of delivery performance, emerging risks, dependencies, defects and change requests, enabling informed prioritisation through the demand management process.

How you will contribute at Janes:

Planning:

  • Own and maintain an integrated portfolio plan for major initiatives, providing a clear view of scope, milestones, sequencing, dependencies, resources and target outcomes.
  • Coordinate planning across Product, Engineering, Operations and other stakeholders to ensure delivery plans are realistic, aligned and supported by clear ownership.
  • Establish proportionate planning standards and ensure initiatives have credible baselines, delivery forecasts, critical paths and agreed assumptions.
  • Support capacity and resource planning, identifying constraints, competing priorities and capability gaps that could affect delivery commitments.
  • Integrate delivery, testing, operational readiness, Acceptance into Service and non-functional requirement activities into initiative plans from the outset.
  • Lead regular planning and replanning activity, assessing the impact of changes and providing evidence-based options and recommendations to support prioritisation decisions.

Management Information and Delivery Visibility:

  • Own and manage portfolio management information, ensuring reporting is accurate, consistent, timely and decision-focused.
  • Maintain five-sprint delivery views alongside milestone-level views for all major initiatives.
  • Provide a clear look-ahead to the end of the current sprint and visibility of work planned for the next sprint.
  • Identify delivery trends, emerging risks, constraints and decisions requiring leadership attention.
  • Ensure reporting provides a single, transparent view of the current state of delivery.

Governance and Process Management:

  • Define, maintain and continuously improve proportionate portfolio and project delivery processes.
  • Coordinate dependency management across teams and initiatives, ensuring dependencies have named owners, target dates and agreed resolution plans.
  • Facilitate regular issue reviews with relevant stakeholders, including CC and Product representatives, and drive actions through to closure.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing planning, including scope, readiness, environments, resources, entry and exit criteria, defect triage and sign-off.
  • Promote consistent governance standards while avoiding unnecessary administration.

Incident Management:

  • Facilitate the incident management process from initial identification through to resolution and closure.
  • Work closely with the Service Delivery and Engineering Director’s to coordinate and drive the timely resolution of incidents.
  • Act as the driving force behind resolver groups, ensuring the right teams engage promptly, ownership is clear and actions are progressed at pace.
  • Coordinate incident triage, prioritisation, escalation, stakeholder communication and recovery activity.
  • Track incident actions, decisions, dependencies and target resolution times, escalating blockers where required.
  • Ensure significant incidents are reviewed, lessons are captured and resulting corrective or preventative actions are completed.

Operations and Service Acceptance:

  • Coordinate Acceptance into Service (AIS) activities for major initiatives, ensuring operational stakeholders are engaged from the outset and that service acceptance requirements, owners, evidence and target dates are clearly defined.
  • Maintain an integrated operational readiness plan covering support arrangements, monitoring, alerting, documentation, training, service desk readiness, resilience, continuity, security and transition to business-as-usual support.
  • Ensure non-functional requirements are identified early, agreed with relevant stakeholders, built into delivery plans and acceptance criteria, and evidenced through appropriate testing and assurance.
  • Track operational readiness risks, dependencies, actions, exceptions and service acceptance decisions, escalating gaps that could affect go-live or ongoing service performance.
  • Coordinate readiness reviews and go-live recommendations, ensuring entry and exit criteria are met and any residual risks are formally understood, owned and accepted.
  • Support effective handover into service, including early-life support arrangements, performance monitoring and completion of post-implementation actions.

Major Initiative and RAID Management:

  • Provide project management support and oversight for all major initiatives.
  • Establish and maintain clear RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues and dependencies.
  • Ensure each RAID item has an owner, impact assessment, mitigating action, due date and status.
  • Escalate material delivery concerns promptly and provide evidence-based recommendations.
  • Track agreed actions, milestones, decisions and outcomes to completion.

Backlog Ownership and Maintenance:

  • Review and clean up individual team backlogs, removing duplicates, obsolete items and incomplete records.
  • Create and maintain a single consolidated backlog of defects and change requests to provide an accurate view of the current position.
  • Apply consistent categorisation, ownership, priority, impact, status and ageing information across backlog items.
  • Run a formal backlog review every two weeks with appropriate business, Product and delivery stakeholders.
  • Analyse the backlog to identify defects or change requests that require consideration, escalation or prioritisation.
  • Provide recommendations and evidence from backlog analysis to feed into the demand management process.

Deliver the following Outcomes:

  • A clean, prioritised and actively managed consolidated backlog of defects and change requests.
  • A dependable five-sprint and milestone view that supports proactive delivery planning and decision-making.
  • Fortnightly backlog governance with clear ownership, actions and escalation routes.
  • Early identification of defects, change requests, dependencies and issues requiring leadership consideration.
  • High-quality information that informs portfolio prioritisation and the demand management process.
  • Consistent RAID discipline and improved predictability across major initiatives.
  • Major initiatives transition into service with agreed non-functional requirements evidenced, operational readiness confirmed and residual service risks explicitly owned and accepted.

The ideal skills and experience for this role are:

  • At least five years’ experience in a PMO or portfolio management role, with a track record of bringing structure, oversight and accountability to project delivery.
  • Strong project management skills, with excellent organisation, meticulous planning and close attention to detail.
  • Confident communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with stakeholders at different levels and collaborate across teams, particularly with Demand Management and Engineering.
  • Experience producing clear, accurate reporting on deliverables, outcomes, issues and risks, and using it to support progress tracking and accountability.
  • An understanding of service and customer needs, operational security and incident management, including the ability to coordinate and facilitate incident management.
  • A proactive, self-starting approach, with the confidence to raise concerns and challenge others directly and professionally. You are open, honest and mature in how you handle difficult conversations.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience in software development, with a general understanding of Agile ways of working and the software development lifecycle.
  • Significant infrastructure programme experience may also be relevant, particularly if you have less direct software development experience.

Benefits:

  • 27 days of annual leave
  • Healthy half (0.5 day leave every 6 months for wellbeing)
  • Leave- study/ volunteer/ reserve forces
  • Pension plan (6% employer contribution)
  • Private medical insurance – BUPA
  • Maternity (100% of basic salary for the first 26 weeks followed by Statutory Maternity Pay)
  • Paternity (100% of basic salary for 6 weeks)
  • Life cover
  • Access to LinkedIn Learning
  • Access to an on-site gym (Only in Croydon)

Life at Janes

We believe Janes is truly a great place to work. Our values and leadership code drive everything we do, and we understand that the right behaviours and culture will always result in the best outcomes for our customers, our colleagues, our shareholders, and our business. We provide a supportive, stretching, and dynamic environment with the ability for you to grow rapidly, both personally and professionally.

Janes is an inclusive and equal opportunities employer and encourages applications regardless of age, race, disability, religion / belief, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or gender.

Although this role is advertised as full time, Janes believed that flexibility at work can provide many significant benefits both to our colleagues and the business. We already work in a hybrid style across all offices and regions and can support different ways of working and offer different flexible working arrangements. title: Staff Software Engineer, ML
description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

Apptronik is seeking a Staff MLOps Engineer to own the technical direction of our MLOps platform — the system of record for datasets, experiments, model artifacts, and serving paths that connects teleoperation data collection on one side to deployed autonomy on Apollo on the other. In this role, you will set the architecture for the platform layer above the training cluster: dataset lifecycle, experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation harnesses, and the serving / packaging path that delivers trained policies to robots in the field. You will lead by influence across MLOps, Autonomy, Data Platform, and TeleOp — establishing the standards, contracts, and tooling that turn one-off research code into a repeatable, auditable pipeline from data to deployed model. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, not a management position; you will be a primary contributor while mentoring the engineers around you, and partnering closely with the Training Infrastructure engineer who owns the cluster layer beneath the platform.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform Architecture & Ownership

  • Technical Direction: Own the technical direction for the MLOps platform — define subsystem interfaces, drive architecture decisions, and establish engineering standards for how datasets, experiments, and models move through Apptronik's systems.
  • Cross-Team Authority: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for Autonomy, Data Platform, and TeleOp on all matters of model lifecycle and platform contracts.

Dataset Lifecycle & Versioning

  • Versioning & Lineage: Design and operate the dataset layer end-to-end — versioning, lineage, splits, and labeling-integration handoff.
  • Reproducibility: Ensure every trained model can be traced back to the exact data and code that produced it.

Model Registry & Artifact Management

  • Registry: Build and operate a first-class model registry — versioned artifacts, metadata, evaluation results, lineage, and approval workflows.
  • Promotion Path: Define the promotion path from "trained" to "qualified" to "deployed to robot."

Evaluation & Qualification Harnesses

  • Automated Evaluation: Define the offline benchmarks, simulation rollouts, and policy-gating harnesses that any model must pass before reaching Apollo.
  • Metrics Framework: Develop the metrics framework that the autonomy team trusts to gate releases.

Serving, Packaging & Deployment to Robot

  • On-Robot Path: Own the path from registered model to running inference on Apollo — packaging (ONNX, TensorRT, torch.compile), versioning on-robot, rollback, and observability of deployed policy behavior.
  • Telemetry Seam: Coordinate with Connect and Data Platform on the deploy-and-telemetry seam back from the fleet.

Mentorship & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Mentorship: Mentor mid-level and senior engineers on the MLOps team through code review, design review, and direct collaboration.
  • Influence: Partner with the Training Infrastructure engineer on the cluster/platform contract, and influence research workflows across Autonomy to standardize on the platform's primitives.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Deep proficiency in Python and at least one systems-level language (Go, Rust, or C++), with demonstrated ability to make and defend architectural tradeoffs in production ML platforms
  • Proven experience owning and delivering an MLOps platform end-to-end — dataset lifecycle, experiment tracking, model registry, evaluation, and serving — at a company that ships models to production
  • Expertise across the model lifecycle: dataset versioning (DVC, LakeFS, Delta, or equivalent), experiment tracking (MLflow, W&B, Determined), model registry, and policy serving
  • Strong background designing service-oriented systems on Kubernetes; comfortable with the contract between platform APIs and underlying compute infrastructure
  • Experience defining evaluation and qualification frameworks for ML models where the cost of a regression is high (robotics, safety-critical, or production-customer-facing)
  • Experience leading technical projects end-to-end: architecture, implementation, validation, and iteration
  • Demonstrated ability to lead by influence across teams — setting standards that other engineers adopt voluntarily, and mentoring engineers around you
  • Proficiency with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), Docker, Git, and modern CI/CD workflows

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field preferred; Bachelor's considered with exceptional experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience in ML platforms or related infrastructure, OR 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience owning an MLOps platform that shipped models to production.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience deploying ML models to edge or embedded targets (on-device inference, ONNX Runtime, TensorRT, robot fleets)
  • Experience with RL training and evaluation infrastructure for embodied agents (rollout workers, replay buffers, sim-eval harnesses)
  • Familiarity with humanoid robotics, dexterous manipulation, or teleoperation data domains
  • Experience with simulation-in-the-loop evaluation (IsaacSim, MuJoCo, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with policy gating, shadow deployments, or staged rollout strategies for autonomy
  • Open-source contributions to MLOps platform tooling (MLflow, BentoML, KServe, Ray Serve, etc.)

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times
  • Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen
  • Hearing and speech to communicate

The annual salary range is $285,000 - $340,000

title: AI CoE Engineer
description:
About the role
Version 1 has 98% AI adoption across the business, live agentic deployments, and a governance framework that routes each use case to self-service AI or CoE-led transformation. The AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) takes the complex, high-value use cases and turns them into production systems. Demand is growing and the CoE is taking on more production work. We are adding two AI CoE Engineers to give the team stable, senior hands-on capability.

You will work with business teams to understand their problems, then design, build and prove solutions. You will also set technical standards and help others in the CoE, including interns and early-career engineers, to build well. This is a hands-on role with an architecture element: you will shape solution designs and write the code that proves them.

Key responsibilities

  • Understand the problem. Work with business and delivery teams to turn challenges and requirements into clear, scoped AI use cases.
  • Build proofs of concept. Design and build working prototypes quickly, test them with users, and take the strongest into production.
  • Design solutions. Define the architecture for agentic and generative AI solutions, covering model choice, data, integration, security and cost.
  • Engineer for production. Build reliable, observable and maintainable AI applications, and support them once live.
  • Support and develop others. Coach CoE colleagues and interns, review code and designs, and run training sessions that raise AI skills across the business.
  • Set standards. Contribute reusable patterns, tooling and guidance, and feed lessons back into the CoE's governance model.
  • Stay current. Track new models, tools and techniques, test them, and bring forward those that earn a place in our work.

What we are looking for

Technical skills

  • Strong software engineering in Python or similar, with experience delivering working systems.
  • Hands-on experience building with large language models: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use and agentic workflows.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and of data and integration patterns.
  • Able to design a solution end to end and explain the trade-offs.

How you work

  • Hands on who takes a problem and runs with it. Startup or fast-moving product experience is a strong advantage.
  • Naturally curious and quick to learn as the technology changes.
  • Clear communicator with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Patient, practical mentor who enjoys helping others improve.

Experience

  • Typically 5 to 8 years in software or data engineering, with recent hands-on AI work. Evidence of what you have built matters more than years served.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Sellpy’s vision is to empower everyone to live circularly. We believe that every item deserves a second life, and we see huge financial, social and environmental value in making sure this happens. Join us in building technology that drives real change.

Location

You are welcome to do all these things from our office at Medborgarplatsen in Stockholm, and from home. Ideally, we’d love to see you in the office frequently, as it helps create a positive and productive environment.

Hybrid work

We work flexibly but value being together. During your first period, you’ll be on-site more often to get settled. Moving forward, we maintain a 50% office presence, with some flexibility depending on your team and tasks.

title: Systems Integration Engineer
description:
For more than 50 years, ENSCO has been providing leading-edge engineering, science and advanced technology solutions to governments and private industries worldwide.

ENSCO prides itself in creating and applying advanced technologies for mission success. We provide systems engineering, integration, and advanced technology services to transform the future safety, security, and resiliency of critical missions on the ground, in the air, in space, and in the information systems that connect these domains.

Learn more about ENSCO.

Position Description

ENSCO Inc. is a diverse engineering and technology company that provides engineering, science, and advanced technology solutions supporting mission success, safety, and security for government and commercial customers worldwide.

We are seeking a Systems Integration Engineer to work directly with Government mission leaders and independently governed program teams delivering elements of a critical space mission capability. Each participating organization may hold a different architecture vision, acquisition path, technical baseline, funding profile, and delivery schedule. This role creates trusted relationships and shared technical evidence needed to bring those efforts together.

The MILSATCOM Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (MSEIT) effort provides leading edge Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) for the Space Force’s Space System Command. We support the Space Force’s acquisition of state of the art Military Satellite Communications systems, providing global secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation’s warfighters. We seek technical individuals who will thrive in a highly collaborative work environment of small teams, using the most modern tools and methodologies to tackle the challenges of integrating complex space and ground communications systems.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement integration strategies and processes to successfully integrate satellite communication systems, segments (Ground, Space, Crypto, Terminals), subsystems, elements, and components; manage the technical baselines among different stakeholders
  • Perform analysis of the systems requirements that define the technical baseline and verification of the technical baseline
  • Apply Digital Engineering methods and modeling strategies (i.e. Digital twins) to support integration and test activities
  • Work with Government and contractor personnel to close gaps with customer requirements across the program; support major requirements reviews, design reviews, and other associated meetings
  • Lead and support Government/Contractor Working Group meetings—by developing briefings, leading discussion, and writing minutes—to address/resolve risks, issues, and action items
  • Review proposed changes to the technical baseline for impacts to enterprise capabilities and to cross-stakeholder integration concerns
  • Define and deliver alternative solutions to address different integration challenges; manage schedule impact and overall delivery of products
  • Facilitate review of contractor-developed program documents by performing technical assessments and providing comments, compiling other review team comments, and working with contractors to adjudicate the comments.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert to assess technical issues and to prepare briefings to U.S. Space Force program office personnel and other stakeholders; provide courses of actions to support Government decisions
  • Support management of risks, issues, interdependencies, identifying schedule disconnects and conflicts, developing action plans for resolution, and assisting the Government in executing selected solutions

Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, computer science, or related technical field
  • At least 8 years of engineering work experience, including at least 5 years in systems engineering involving sub-disciplines such as requirements management and technical baseline development; test planning, integration, and execution; verification; and validation.
  • Experience developing or managing requirements documents/specifications or Interface Control Documents (ICDs) for complex systems
  • Strong interpersonal skills, communication (oral and written), and presentation skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams)
  • Work is on-site in a secure facility due to customer security requirements
  • AN ACTIVE DOD SECRET SECURITY CLEARANCE IS REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION FOR WHICH, YOU MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN

Qualifications Desired

  • Master’s degree in engineering, mathematics, physics, or computer science, or related technical field
  • Experience working with/on MILSATCOM programs` such as AEHF, PTS, EPS, WGS, or FAB-T terminal programs
  • Experience working with military personnel and DoD civilians
  • Experience with ground and space systems, such as terminals and networks
  • Knowledge and experience in Agile Development and collaboration tools (Jira/Confluence)
  • Professional certifications (e.g., PMP, INCOSE CSEP/ESEP/ASEP)
  • Active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility

Work Location Type: On-Site

Required Certifications: None

U.S. Citizenship Required: Yes

Security Clearance Required: Active secret

Employment Type: Regular Full-time

Background Check Type: 7 Year Pre-Employment

Drug Screen Required: No

$1—$1 USD

title: Strategy & Business Analytics
description:
About Primordial Labs

We're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. Our core product, Anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. We’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.

The Opportunity

The Strategy & Business Analytics Lead builds and runs the analytic tools leadership uses to manage the business. The role connects data from business development, programs, product, engineering, and finance into integrated dashboards and analyses. The Lead also interprets the results and briefs leadership on what they mean for the business.

The role suits an analytical problem solver with practical data skills. The Lead works with the Head of Strategy to stand up the company's analytics capability, then owns its build-out and day-to-day operation. The role sits in the Strategy function and works directly with the executive team to inform leadership on KPIs and trajectory of the business.

What You'll Do

Data and Tools

  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytic tools, leveraging a suite of tools that may include Power BI, the CRM, customer data models, financial forecasts, and related platforms

  • Connect data across CRM, contracts, finance, and program systems into consistent, reliable views to create a single source of truth for the business

  • Automate recurring reporting and data workflows using low-code and AI-assisted tools

  • Maintain data quality and proper handling of sensitive and controlled information

Business Analysis

  • Translate open-ended leadership questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations

  • Analyze pipeline health, win rates, capture investment, and revenue forecasts

  • Model program performance, resource allocation, and operational trade-offs

  • Diagnose performance gaps and process breakdowns and recommend corrective actions to functional leads

Leadership Reporting

  • Track performance against the metrics and goals set by leadership

  • Produce the analytic content for recurring business reviews, board materials, and annual planning

  • Brief leadership on trends, risks, and performance shifts with clear interpretation

  • Refine dashboards and reporting as leadership priorities evolve

Process and Systems

  • Map core business processes with functional owners to inform tool and dashboard design

  • Recommend improvements to business systems and tools as the company scales

  • Identify where additional data or technical support would add leverage

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy and operations, business operations, finance, or a comparable analytical operating role

  • Demonstrated record of structuring ambiguous business problems and delivering recommendations to senior executives

  • Demonstrated record of building dashboards, models, or analytic tools that leaders use to run a business

  • Proficiency in Power BI or a comparable BI platform, and advanced financial and operational modeling in Excel

  • Comfort working with relational data and connecting multiple data sources; SQL familiarity a plus

  • Experience building business applications with low-code platforms or AI-assisted development tools

  • Strong executive communication, written and verbal

  • Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • Management consulting experience at a top-tier strategy firm

  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or national security, including familiarity with DoD acquisition, contracting, and program structures

  • Experience at a venture-backed company during a scale-up phase

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform or Fabric, ideally in a government cloud environment

Important Qualification Note: Due to the nature of our work and federal compliance requirements, this position strictly requires U.S. Citizenship and current residency within the United States. Please note that Permanent Residency (Green Card status) or visa sponsorship cannot satisfy these specific regulatory requirements.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a target base salary of $130,000 - $165,000 annually, with the specific figure determined by the candidate's experience level.

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation and are happy to explain how we determine our salary ranges, just ask!

Our Benefits

  • Beyond a Competitive Salary, we provide a significant equity stake, aligning your growth with ours.

  • 100% Remote: This role is fully remote, open to residents across the US. We believe that talent knows no borders (well, except for the US in this case!).

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans so you and your family can stay healthy and worry free.

  • Retirement Planning: Plan for tomorrow with our 401(k) package, complete with a generous 6% company match.

  • Generous DTO: Our generous Discretionary Time off (DTO) policy is all about helping you take the breaks you deserve and live your healthiest, most fulfilling life.

  • Elite Technology Package: Enjoy an elite technology package to make your work effortless and efficient.

Our Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to be thorough and respectful of your time. It typically includes:

  1. Conversation with the People Team: Lets get to know one another first!

  2. Manager Interview: A 45-minute discussion about relevant strategy concepts and your past experience.

  3. Team Interviews: Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. During this stage, you’ll meet your prospective peers to discuss our team dynamics, project workflows, and how we work together to win.

We are committed to a low-stress interview experience—no trick questions or brain teasers!

Primordial Labs is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone. Discrimination and harassment have no place here. We firmly believe that a diverse team enriches our problem-solving capabilities, sparks greater creativity, and ultimately leads to a better product and a more vibrant company.

We understand that great talent comes from various paths and that passion and transferable skills are invaluable. At Primordial Labs, what truly matters is your ability to make an impact, your dedication to our mission, and your capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative atmosphere. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where you can contribute your unique talents, expand your skills, and learn continuously. Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. Who you are:

Geotab is looking for entrepreneurial product and business leaders to head our domains – focused teams that each own a customer outcome and the business results that come with it. As a Head of Domain, you'll own the strategy, roadmap and results for your area, lead a multi-disciplinary team of product managers, designers and engineers, and turn customer problems into products that customers adopt and pay for.

What you'll do:

We welcome applicants nationwide! If you’re based near one of our office hubs, this role follows our hybrid model, blending the comfort of working from home with regular on-site days to connect and collaborate.

title: Hospitality Supervisor
description:
About Legends Global

Legends Global is redefining excellence in sport, entertainment and live events. With unrivalled expertise and international reach, we provide end-to-end solutions – from venue development and event programming to revenue strategy and hospitality.

We take a 360-degree, data-driven approach across Partnerships, Hospitality, Merchandise and Attractions, working with leading clients to deliver outstanding experiences that resonate worldwide.

Our organisation is committed to fostering an inclusive and forward-thinking environment where diversity drives innovation and collaboration. Guided by our values of Align, Scale, Connect, Team and Win... we create a culture where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

The Venue

A cornerstone of South Yorkshire’s entertainment scene, Utilita Arena Sheffield has been welcoming audiences since 1991. Purpose-built for world-class live events, the arena hosts an exciting mix of international music acts, major sporting fixtures, and large-scale corporate events. With a capacity of over 13,000, it stands as one of the region’s premier venues, combining a rich history with a vibrant programme that continues to attract visitors from across the UK.

The Role

As a Hospitality Supervisor, you will support the delivery of exceptional food and beverage operations, ensuring outstanding guest experiences while maintaining the highest standards of service, food safety, hygiene, and compliance. Working closely with the Hospitality Manager, you will lead frontline teams, oversee event delivery, and help drive operational excellence across all hospitality areas.

The Responsibilities

  • Lead and support hospitality team members to deliver exceptional guest experiences, maintaining the highest standards of service, presentation, and personal hygiene.

  • Supervise food and beverage operations, ensuring accurate service, strong product knowledge, and smooth execution of events and matchday hospitality.

  • Monitor operational standards including cash handling, stock reconciliation, temperature controls, equipment reporting, and completion of all required documentation.

  • Maintain excellent standards of cleanliness, food safety, HACCP, COSHH, allergen management, and health & hygiene compliance across all hospitality areas.

  • Support training, coaching, and development initiatives to ensure team members are knowledgeable, compliant, and confident in delivering service excellence.

  • Assist management with stock takes, post-event operations, venue safety procedures, and the implementation of all security and counter-terrorism measures.

What we're looking for

  • Previous experience in a hospitality, food and beverage, catering, or event operations supervisory role.

  • Strong customer service skills with a passion for delivering outstanding guest experiences in a fast-paced environment.

  • Good understanding of food safety, hygiene, HACCP, COSHH, allergen management, and compliance requirements.

  • Experience supervising teams, supporting training initiatives, and motivating colleagues to achieve high service standards.

  • Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure.

  • A proactive, professional, and detail-oriented approach, with experience handling operational tasks such as stock control, cash handling, and event delivery.

What's in it for you?

💸 Competitive Rate of Pay – Earn a strong hourly rate for your work.

⏰ Flexible Working – Choose shifts that fit around your lifestyle and commitments, helping you maintain a great work-life balance.

📅 Fortnightly Pay – Get paid every two weeks for the shifts you’ve worked.

🎉 Sociable Workforce – Join a diverse and friendly team from across the city. Our casual workforce forms the heart of what we do – it’s a great environment to meet people, make friends, and be part of exciting live events.

🚀 Opportunities to Grow – Gain valuable experience in the live events industry and access to opportunities across Legends Global.

title: Developer Advocate
description:
Yugabyte is the company behind YugabyteDB, the AI-ready, multi-modal, distributed PostgreSQL database for cloud-native apps. Trusted by industry leaders including Shopify, Paramount+, GM, Kroger, Fiserv, and NPCI, YugabyteDB has been deployed in over 100 countries and powers more than 5 million clusters worldwide.

Together, our hard-working team of experts and our industry-leading technology are uniquely positioned to meet the demands of modern workloads: geo-distributed, ultra-resilient, and built to scale without limits.

Our Yugabeings (distributed, like our database) span 12+ countries and multiple time zones, sharing expertise from diverse backgrounds and industries.

Developer Advocate, Community

Location: Remote US

About the role

Yugabyte has redefined the data infrastructure developers use for distributed Postgres applications and multi-agent AI systems. As a Developer Advocate focused on Yugabyte’s rapidly growing community, you will energize the developers building with YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP (Agentic Multitenant Postgres), and Meko, our agent-native data platform that gives multi-agent systems shared memory and knowledge.

You will own community programs end-to-end, including workshops, meetups, hackathons, partner events, and the online spaces where developers ask questions, share what they built, and help each other. Success in this role means more developers showing up, building something real, and coming back. You will work closely with product, engineering, marketing, and the rest of the DevRel team, and you will bring what you hear from the community into the roadmap. Most importantly, you will collaborate with the rest of our Developer Advocacy team to present a unified, global approach to how we work with devs. This is a fun role on a fun team at the most important (and fun) time in our company’s history. Should be fun!

What you’ll do

Grow the community
  • Build and run a community growth plan across YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP, and Meko, with goals for membership, active participation, and contribution.
  • Run and grow the Yugabyte community Slack and Discord, and build an active presence in the channels where developers already gather, including Reddit, GitHub, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, Bluesky, and X.
  • Launch programs that recognize and reward participation, such as a community champions program, contributor spotlights, and regular office hours.
  • Turn active community members into speakers, authors, sample app contributors, and meetup hosts.
Run hands-on events
  • Design and deliver workshops that take developers from first install to a working app, including labs on building agent memory with Meko and multi-tenant Postgres applications on YugabyteDB AMP.
  • Launch and scale Yugabyte-run meetups in key developer hubs, and support community-led chapters with playbooks, content, and swag.
  • Organize virtual and in-person hackathons, including AI agent hackathons built on Meko and YugabyteDB.
  • Represent Yugabyte at developer conferences such as KubeCon, PGConf.dev, Linux Foundation events, and AI engineering conferences, running demos, workshops, and booth sessions.
  • Contribute community programming to Yugabyte’s Distributed SQL Summit, such as hands-on labs, community tracks, and DevRel sessions.
Build with partners
  • Co-host workshops, meetups, and hackathons with cloud, AI framework, and open source ecosystem partners.
  • Create sample apps, integrations, and tutorials that show YugabyteDB, AMP, and Meko working alongside the agent frameworks, developer tools, and cloud platforms developers already use.
  • Build relationships with user groups and open source projects in the Postgres, Kubernetes, and AI agent communities.
Create content the community uses
  • Produce demos, tutorials, sample apps, blogs, livestreams, and webinars, both live and recorded.
  • Package workshops into reusable kits and starter templates that community leaders and partners can run on their own.
  • Hold developer-facing content, quickstarts, and getting-started paths to a high bar for clarity and accuracy.
Be the voice of the developer
  • Collect feedback from community channels, events, and hackathons, and bring it to product and engineering in a form they can act on.
  • Track and report community health, including growth, engagement, event attendance, and conversion to active usage.
  • Help shape the DevRel strategy, processes, and tooling, including community platforms and event tech stack.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in developer relations, developer advocacy, or developer community management, including programs you built from the ground up.
  • A track record of growing an online developer community on Slack, Discord, or a similar platform.
  • Experience planning and running in-person events such as meetups, workshops, or hackathons.
  • Hands-on technical skills, including building demos and sample apps and working comfortably with SQL and Postgres.
  • Familiarity with, and creative ideas for AI agent development, LLM frameworks, vector search, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed fast.
  • Experience in open source communities as a contributor, maintainer, or community organizer.
  • Confidence presenting and facilitating, both live and on camera.
  • An active social presence and following in a relevant developer community.
  • Comfort working autonomously in a fast-moving startup. B2B SaaS or infrastructure experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with distributed databases, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience running ambassador or champion programs.
  • Experience running co-marketing or joint events with technology partners.

Success in year one, in conjunction with our DevRel team

  • Community membership across Slack and other channels grows to 10X
  • Dozens of workshops, hackathons, and meetups delivered
  • At least a dozen hackathons run, focused on AI agents built with Meko.
  • Ten partner co-hosted events delivered.
  • A champions program launched with 50+ active members.

We feel strongly about equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one way to help achieve that. The cash compensation for this role is market competitive, with a range of $160,000-$215,000, as well as equity (when applicable), and benefits including health plans, retirement plans, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). Some roles also include variable/incentive compensation, or a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. The pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. The actual pay will vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, and skill level.

Regarding visa sponsorship: Due to recent changes in U.S. immigration policy, we’re currently unable to sponsor new H-1B visas for candidates outside the United States. We’re happy to consider candidates who need an H-1B transfer or extension, as well as candidates in the U.S. on F-1 status (including CPT or OPT) who would need to change to H-1B status. Candidates with other types of valid work authorization are also welcome to apply.

description:
Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer
Type: Full-time
Location: Paris
What about us?
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀
The Role
We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to drive our product development cycle. This role is built on the philosophy that the best engineers don't just write code, they build solutions. Your primary responsibility is to bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, rapidly translating high-level goals into polished, shipped features.
You will be expected to challenge requirements, bring a product-first mindset to the engineering team, and ensure every line of code adds tangible value. This role demands strong software engineering proficiency and acute product judgment to prioritize and ship high-impact features in a fast-paced environment.

What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Exceptional software engineering and system design capability, with proven experience designing, building, and shipping production-grade, scalable systems across the full stack (including C#, Python, and Typescript proficiency), always prioritizing technical clarity and maintainable architecture.
  • A "Product-First" Engineering Mindset, demonstrating the ability to analyze business needs and challenge assumptions. You don't just build what is asked; you build what is needed to move the needle for the product and the user.
  • End-to-end feature ownership, driving the entire development lifecycle from defining requirements to robust implementation, QA, deployment and monitoring, maintaining high accountability for the final user and business outcome.
  • Strategic communication skills, capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for business stakeholders and, conversely, translating complex business objectives into prioritized, elegant engineering solutions.
  • High-velocity development, leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve accelerated delivery while rigorously upholding code quality and architectural integrity.

What will you find working at INFINIT?

  • Personal Time Off: Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off as well as your birthday off.
  • Flexibility and Ownership: We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Paris office and 2 days at home.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer, Startpage
description:
Startpage is a private search engine with roots going back to Ixquick in 1998, owned by System1 (NYSE: SST) and competing with DuckDuckGo, Brave and Ecosia. We are expanding from search results into a broader set of consumer products for people who want privacy without giving up a modern experience.

You will be a senior full stack engineer on the Startpage Consumer team, a small North America-based group where every engineer works with AI coding agents as a core part of the job. You know how to run agents in loops, coordinate multiple agents on one problem, and judge their output critically. The stack is mostly Python and JavaScript. You will own features from first commit to production across the web frontend, backend services and data pipeline, shape the architecture as the product grows, and pay down the tech debt that slows us. The team ships weekly, so your work reaches millions of monthly users within days.

This position is an onsite role requiring you to work in our headquarters located at 4235 Redwood Ave. Los Angeles, CA 90066.

What you'll work on:

Expect to work across the full breadth of the product rather than one slice of it.

  • New consumer products that extend Startpage beyond the search box, on desktop and on the web

  • The search results page itself: new features for subscribers and for everyone, within the constraints of our search partnerships

  • Real-time decisioning that shapes what a user sees for a given query

  • The homepage and engagement features that bring people back

  • Traffic quality and abuse prevention for a product that attracts automated traffic

  • Data instrumentation and reporting so the team can see what is working

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build and ship features end to end, from API and data model through to the UI

  • Drive your work with AI coding agents: give them the tools, context and guardrails they need, run them in loops against a spec, orchestrate several agents in parallel on one problem, and review what they produce with a critical eye

  • Turn interactive prototypes from product into production code, keeping the intent and cutting what does not hold up

  • Own services in production on Kubernetes: deploys, monitoring, the on-call rotation, and the latency and uptime targets a search product demands

  • Shape architecture decisions and lead tech-debt reduction so the codebase stays fast to change

  • Protect user privacy in every design decision: no tracking, minimal data retention, and no third-party calls that leak queries

  • Write automated tests as a matter of course

  • Instrument features and read your own results in Sigma and Snowflake; propose the next iteration from the data

  • Work with outside partners and agencies so web and app experiences stay consistent

  • Write clear tickets, PRs and design notes; review teammates' work the same day

Requirements:

  • Daily, hands-on use of agentic coding tools: you can run agents in loops, write the evals that keep them honest, coordinate multi-agent workflows, and know when to take the keyboard back

  • 5+ years of professional web development, owning both frontend and backend in production

  • Strong Python, plus JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and modern CSS and HTML

  • Hands-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Redis

  • CI/CD and monitoring tooling, and AWS or a comparable cloud platform; comfortable being paged for what you ship

  • Solid automated testing habits

  • SQL fluency and the habit of checking your own feature's numbers after launch

  • Care for performance: you know what a 100 ms regression costs on a search results page

  • Clear written communication with a distributed team and outside vendors

Nice to have:

  • Desktop browser or mobile app experience, especially Chromium, Electron or a shipped native app

  • Prior search or privacy product experience

  • Ads or recommendations systems, especially serving ML models at low latency

  • Bot detection, fraud or abuse prevention

  • SEO-driven site generation at scale

  • Familiarity with EU privacy regulation

How we work:

  • Small North America-based team, weekly releases

  • Product work starts as a clickable prototype; engineers are expected to push back on it before building

  • Agents do the typing; engineers own the architecture, the review and the outcome

  • Data over opinion: every feature ships with instrumentation and a success metric

  • Jira for tracking, GitHub for code, Sigma and Snowflake for analytics, Slack for the day to day

What we have to offer:

  • Competitive salary + bonus + equity
  • Generous PTO + 11 company holidays
  • Open sick time
  • 100% covered Medical, Dental, Vision for employees
  • 401k with match
  • Health & Dependent Care Flex Spending Account
  • Paid professional development
  • Leadership & growth opportunities
  • Virtual company and team building events

title: Senior Project Manager & Delivery Lead
description:
