title: Materials Planner (Monday to Friday)
description:
The Materials Planner is responsible for ensuring the availability of materials required to support manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, and site operations. This position owns material planning activities, inventory optimization, shortage prevention, and planning system health to ensure operational continuity and minimize supply risk.

Standard shift (Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM)

Material Planning & Inventory Management

  • Manage assigned material portfolios and ensure sufficient inventory to support business requirements.
  • Maintain and optimize planning parameters including Min/Max levels, safety stock, reorder points, and lead times.
  • Review planning signals and execute appropriate actions to maintain inventory health.
  • Monitor inventory levels and proactively identify potential shortages or excess inventory.
  • Develop recovery plans for material shortages and drive actions to prevent stock-out events.
  • Support inventory accuracy initiatives and material disposition activities.
  • Participate in regular inventory reviews and continuous improvement activities.

Operational Support

  • Partner with engineering, maintenance, operations, and warehouse teams to understand material requirements and changing business needs.
  • Support new material introductions, engineering changes, and inventory transitions.
  • Ensure timely processing of planning actions and material replenishment requests.
  • Monitor material demand trends and adjust planning strategies as necessary.
  • Support critical spare parts and consumable inventory management programs.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze inventory, demand, and supply data to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Utilize ERP and reporting tools to monitor key planning metrics.
  • Support root cause investigations related to material shortages, inventory issues, and planning process gaps.
  • Drive improvements to planning processes, tools, and reporting capabilities.
  • Develop and maintain planning documentation and work instructions as needed.
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience in materials planning, inventory management, production planning, or supply chain operations.
  • Experience utilizing ERP/MRP systems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in semiconductor, electronics, manufacturing, or high-tech industries.
  • Knowledge of inventory management methodologies, including Min/Max planning and safety stock management.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
  • Experience leading continuous improvement initiatives.

Salary: onsemi is excited to share the base salary range for this position is $57,400 to $100,200 exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. The final pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on geographic location, skills, education, experience, and/or consideration of the internal equity of our current team members. We also offer a competitive benefits package.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

As a Forward Deployed Engineer at 8am, you embed directly with an internal business function - starting in Customer Support, Sales, Marketing, or Finance - to ship production agentic systems, not demos. You own the last mile between what's technically possible and what a specific team actually runs day to day.

You sit at the intersection of engineering, business process, and product discovery. You are judged on one thing: did the function you embedded measurably change how it works because you were in the room. You build the agent, the context, and the skills yourself — you don't just spec it out for someone else to build.

About us:

At 8am, our vision is to power a world where professionals thrive. We start every day on a mission to empower professionals with the most trusted, innovative technology to deliver world-class outcomes for their clients and exceptional financial results for their business. They count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

Founded in 2005, 8am™ (formerly AffiniPay) is the professional business platform built to help legal, accounting, and other client-focused professionals run stronger, more profitable businesses. Today, more than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. trust 8am to help them work smarter, serve clients better, and unlock their full potential. We have been recognized as one of Inc 5000’s fastest growing companies in the U.S. for 13 years in a row, and as a result, our teams continue to grow as well!

What you'll do:

  • Own technical delivery end-to-end on an internal engagement - from discovery and scoping through building, launch, and steady-state support.
  • Build agentic systems (agents, context/RAG, skills, tools, evals) that automate real workflows for CS, Sales, Marketing, Finance, or Product teams.
  • Write production-grade code (Python and/or TypeScript) and SQL to connect internal systems - CRM, support tooling, BI platforms, data warehouse - into working automation.
  • Run discovery directly with business stakeholders - understand their workflow well enough to build against it, not just automate around it.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in live deployments - reproduce problems, debug across the stack, and iterate quickly with the stakeholder team.
  • Translate what you learn into reusable playbooks, skills, and templates so one-off wins become repeatable capabilities for the next engagement.
  • Proactively build trust with the teams you support - the goal is for them to need less of your guidance over time, not more.

About you:

  • 3+ years in Forward Deployed Engineering, Applied AI, Solutions Engineering, or a comparable hands-on, stakeholder-embedded engineering role.
  • Can build agentic loops (agents, context, skills/tools, evals) yourself, end-to-end - this is a hands-on builder role.
  • Strong backend or full-stack engineering background - production-grade Python and/or TypeScript, SQL, and REST API integration patterns.
  • Has done this kind of role before - embedded delivery, translating a business process into a technical system - and can share a portfolio of shipped work.
  • Comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders in CS, Sales, Marketing, or Finance and translating their process into a technical spec.
  • Builder mindset - makes fast, sound decisions under ambiguity, and prioritizes shipping something real over a polished demo.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in fintech or financial services — payments, banking data, risk/compliance, or subscription billing.
  • Hands-on with low-code/orchestration tools (n8n, Zapier, Make) in addition to custom-built agents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, PCI-DSS, or data-security practices for regulated financial data.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), CI/CD, and observability.


Additional Information

The annual salary range for this position is $170,000 to $200,000. The salary range for performing this role outside of the US / Austin / California may differ. 8am is committed to offering competitive, fair and commensurate compensation and has provided an estimated pay range for this role. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and education.

Why 8am:

At 8am, our culture is shaped by the people who bring it to life every day. Together, we build a company rooted in continuous learning, genuine community, holistic wellness, and meaningful engagement—values that empower us as individuals and unite us as a team. Our culture is grounded in our core values: Work Smart, Win Fast; Outshine Ordinary, and We Find a Way. These values drive how we serve our customers and work with each other in a collaborative, inspiring, and empowering environment, every day.

Here’s how we support our 8Team:

  • Health Insurance Coverage: We offer our 8Team a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit your needs, including a 100% company-paid HDHP plan for employees.
  • Financial perks: We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package including annual bonuses, equity options and 401(k) or RRSP if in Canada, with a company match for all team members.
  • Time for what matters: Flexible Time Off, paid holidays, and a parental leave program for our new parents.
  • Wellness: Wellness stipends, mental health support, and one-on-one nutrition coaching.
  • Learning and Development: Continuous learning through , leadership programs, professional development funds, and individually focused talent development.
  • Giving back to the communities around us: Participate in our charitable matching gift program, paid time off for volunteer service, and company-sponsored volunteer events (both local and virtually).
  • Engagement: Virtual and in-person team-building events, quarterly award recognition through our Rise & Shine Award of Excellence Program, and our peer-to-peer appreciation platform.

At 8am, we don’t just offer benefits - we create an environment where people can thrive, grow, and make a real impact every day.

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Security advisory:

Our hiring teams at 8am are dedicated to recruiting top talent that share our passion for serving the professional services industry through innovative financial technology. As such, our Talent Acquisition Team only follows legitimate hiring practices. We will always communicate with our candidates using emails with the 8am domain and will never ask for sensitive/personal data during the application process. All interviews take place over phone call, Zoom/Google Meet or in person. All offers are communicated verbally by our Talent Acquisition Specialists with a written offer letter as a follow up.

title: Setter
description:
Position Summary:

Setter (AKA Water spider) is a Lean manufacturing concept referring to a person who is responsible for keeping the workflow uninterrupted which contributes to faster market delivery. The function aims to decrease all variation to production and bring the concentration on meaningful work and productivity. The role of the setter is to keep people’s focus on value-adding activities, help to avoid distractions, and facilitate the flow of work.

Duties and responsibilities:

The following reflects management’s definition of essential functions for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons

· Delivering supplies to workstations/area

· Transporting and replacing goods

· Retrieval of tooling and gauging

· Start up activities for Assembly lines and Test stand

· Disposal of used materials or supplies

· 7s Improvements, waste elimination, and flow improvement activities

· Updating and routing of KB cards

· Other duties as request by Supervisor

Supervisor Responsibilities

· None

· Basic verbal English communication skills

· Strong attention to detail

· Ability to count product

· Ability to learn to operate material handling equipment (forklift, wave, etc.)

· Ability to push carts with heavy loads

· Ability to be at workstation on time, every day unless otherwise authorized

· Other responsibilities as assigned

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to do the following:

· Lift and move up to 45 pounds without assistance

· Able to stand for long periods of time

· Able to walk for long periods of time

· Able to handle long period of physical activity.

Work Enviroment:

· Some of the work time is spent in a manufacturing environment where temperatures are often warm or cool, depending upon the season, and noise level can be moderate to high

Salary and Benefits

The hourly range is $18/hour - $20/hr. The range is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc. The Recruiter can share more details about the specific salary range during the interview process.

Alongside a competitive compensation package, you'll enjoy a suite of benefits designed to empower you in every area of your life! Think of it as our way of investing in your success! This includes:

  • Prioritizing Your Health: Access to high-quality medical, dental, and vision plans; Health Savings Accounts (HSA) and Flexible Spending Accounts to make managing your healthcare easier; plus wellness programs to help you stay healthy and energized.

  • Supporting Your Life: Paid time off to recharge and pursue your passions, and tuition reimbursement to invest in your professional development.

  • Must have US work authorization.

title: IT MANAGER, MERUS POWER
description:
Merus Power Oyj on suomalainen kasvuyhtiö, joka kehittää ja valmistaa omaa sähkövarasto- ja sähkönlaatuteknologiaa Ylöjärvellä. Ratkaisumme parantavat energiatehokkuutta, vakauttavat sähköverkkoja ja mahdollistavat uusiutuvan energian kasvua.

Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli noin 55 miljoonaa euroa, ja vuoden 2026 ensimmäisen vuosipuoliskon tilauskertymämme kaksinkertaistui vertailujaksosta. Markkinamme ovat vahvasti kansainväliset. Merus Power on Suomen johtavia sähkövarastoteknologian toimittajia.

Etsimme nyt Ylöjärvelle käytännönläheistä ja palveluhenkistä

IT MANAGERIA

vastaamaan operatiivisen IT:n sujuvuudesta, IT-palveluiden laadusta ja niiden kehittämisestä kasvavan organisaation tarpeisiin. Roolissa johdat päivittäistä IT-palvelutuotantoa ja ulkoisia palvelukumppaneitamme. Varmistat, että yli 160 hengen organisaatiomme työvälineet ja järjestelmät toimivat luotettavasti ja turvallisesti.

Tehtävä on käytännönläheinen: et pelkästään koordinoi, vaan tartut myös itse toimeen, kun ratkaistavana on käyttäjän ongelma tai järjestelmän ylläpito. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä liiketoimintojen järjestelmäomistajien, HR:n, esihenkilöiden ja IT & Cybersecurity -tiimin kanssa.

Olemme rakentaneet IT:lle vahvan perustan: ympäristö on auditoitu ja sertifioitu, ja uudet IT-palvelut on otettu käyttöön tänä vuonna. Olemme panostaneet vahvasti myös tietoturvaan niin IT- kuin OT-ympäristöissämme. Seuraavaksi rakennamme uuden strategiamme mukaista IT-organisaatiota ja tämä rooli on sen keskiössä. Pääset siis vaikuttamaan siihen, miltä Meruksen IT näyttää tulevaisuudessa.

Käytännössä vastaat esimerkiksi:

  • päivittäisen IT-palvelutuotannon johtamisesta sekä tukipyyntöjen, häiriöiden ja muutosten priorisoinnista

  • Microsoft 365 -ympäristön ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä, mukaan lukien Entra ID, Teams ja SharePoint

  • käyttäjä- ja käyttöoikeushallinnasta, päätelaitteista ja lisensseistä

  • ulkoisten IT-käyttö- ja tietoturvapalveluiden ohjauksesta, palvelunhallinnan käytännöistä ja palvelutason seurannasta

  • IT-hankintojen ja sopimusten valmistelusta ja toteutuksesta sovitun budjetin puitteissa

  • tietoturvan käytännön toteutuksen tukemisesta yhdessä tietoturvasta vastaavien kanssa

  • yhteistyöstä liiketoimintojen järjestelmäomistajien kanssa ja IT-kehityshankkeiden vetämisestä

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Olet toiminut muutaman vuoden vastaavissa IT-vastuutehtävissä tai kerryttänyt vahvan hands-on-kokemuksen esimerkiksi lähituessa ja haluat nyt ottaa askeleen kohti laajempaa vastuuta. Soveltuva tausta voi olla esimerkiksi tietojenkäsittelyn, tietoliikenteen, automaation tai muun teknisen alan tutkinto tai vastaava työkokemuksella hankittu osaaminen.

Tehtävässä onnistut, kun sinulla on:

  • vahva käytännön kokemus Microsoft 365 -ympäristöstä, erityisesti Entra ID:stä ja SharePointista

  • kokemusta palveluntarjoajien kanssa toimimisesta ja kyky pitää langat käsissäsi

  • palveluasennetta, pelisilmää ja rauhallinen, ratkaisukeskeinen ote

  • sujuva suomen kielen taito ja hyvä englannin kielen taito

ERP-järjestelmien tai järjestelmähankkeiden sekä ITIL-käytäntöjen tuntemus on plussaa.

Miksi Merus Power?

Merus Powerilla rakennamme puhdasta tulevaisuutta ja kestävää menestystä yhdessä, samalla taajuudella. Työyhteisömme perustana ovat merkityksellinen työ sekä aito arvostus ja luottamus toisiimme. Yhteiset tavoitteet, korkeatasoinen osaaminen ja into teknologiaan antavat meille virtaa kehittää huomisen ratkaisuja ja kasvaa yhdessä. Meillä myös sinun kädenjälkesi näkyy – tähtäämme korkealle, mutta pidämme jalat maassa.

Merus Powerilla pääset vastuulliseen ja käytännönläheiseen IT-rooliin kasvavassa suomalaisessa teknologiayhtiössä. Näet konkreettisesti, miten työsi vaikuttaa organisaation arjen sujuvuuteen ja tietoturvaan.

Tukenasi on IT & Cybersecurity -tiimi ja esihenkilönäsi toimii Chief Digital Officer. IT-organisaatiomme kasvaa ja kehittyy, joten myös roolissa on tilaa kasvaa ja ottaa lisää vastuuta osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan.

Teemme töitä joustavalla hybridimallilla, mutta tässä roolissa työ painottuu vahvasti Ylöjärven pääkonttorille. Läsnäolo on tärkeää, sillä paikan päällä opit parhaiten tuntemaan organisaation, ympäristön ja ihmiset.

Tarjoamme kattavat henkilöstöedut, joihin kuuluvat muun muassa laaja työterveyshuolto, työ- ja vapaa-ajan matkavakuutus, lounas-, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointietu sekä koko henkilöstön vuosibonusjärjestelmä. Suuntaa-antava kuukausipalkka on noin 4 500–5 500 euroa, mutta tarkempi palkka sovitaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella.

Voisiko tämä olla sinun paikkasi?

Jos tunnistit itsesi kuvauksesta ja haluat rakentaa Merus Powerin IT:tä kanssamme, kuulisimme sinusta mielellämme lisää. Valmistaudu hakemusta jättäessäsi kertomaan lyhyesti kokemuksestasi Microsoft-ympäristöistä ja IT-palveluiden johtamisesta sekä siitä, millaisessa roolissa olet parhaimmillasi.

Hae paikkaa viimeistään 26.11.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Lisätietoja paikasta antavat rekrykumppanimme Porkkana & Keppi Oy:ltä: Emppu, p. 0400 710141 (soittoaika: 12.12. klo 15:30-16:30) ja Tina, p. 050 465 7404 (soittoaika: 17.12. klo 9-10).

title: Assistant Studio Manager
description:
Be fit. Change lives. Have fun.
A little quiz: What do Batman and Robin, Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid, Hermoine Granger and Harry Potter, and Venus and Serena Williams have in common?
Answer: Each member of the pair makes the other stronger.
That’s how it is with an Orangetheory Studio Manager and Assistant Studio Manager (ASM). They’re a doublet, a duo, a dyad. And while the manager is ultimately in charge, without that able-bodied sidekick, the studio wouldn’t run nearly as smoothly.
So if you’d like to be half of such a pair, to know the ropes as well as you know your members’ names, to step in when your manager steps out, to balance each other’s strengths, to set goals and surpass them...then Orangetheory just might be looking for you.
Every day will be different but, you’ll be representing the Orangetheory brand as you share the science of this workout you want everyone to love as much as you do.
Maybe you’ll use this post as a stepping stone in your management career or maybe this is where you want to be forever. But if you’ve been at even one Orangetheory class, you feel the warmth, the enthusiasm, the genuine sense of being where you need to be — feelings you’ll be hard-pressed to find anywhere but here.
Specific job duties and selection requirements vary between Orangetheory studio locations and more details can be provided by the studio’s hiring manager if you are selected to move forward in the interview process.

title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location: Salt Lake City, UT

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

  • Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.
  • Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.
  • Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.
  • Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.
  • Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.
  • Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

  • Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.
  • Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.
  • Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.
  • Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.
  • Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.
  • Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.
  • Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.
  • Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.
  • Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.
  • Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

  • Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.
  • Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.
  • Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

  • Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.
  • Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.
  • Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.
  • Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.
  • Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.
  • Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.
  • Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.
  • Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.
  • Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.
  • Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.
  • Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.
  • Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.
  • Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.
  • Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.
  • Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.
  • Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.
  • Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & reference check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

title: Lader
description:
Als Lader speel je een belangrijke rol in het vlotte verloop van onze logistieke processen. Jij zorgt ervoor dat alles veilig, correct en op tijd geladen en gelost wordt. Je werkt in een hecht team van 6 collega’s, waar iedereen elkaar ondersteunt.

Jouw dagelijkse taken zijn onder andere:

  • Het laden en lossen van vrachtwagens met de reachtruck en heftruck
  • Het correct verwerken van goederen in het SAP-systeem
  • Vernietigd product op de juiste manier verwijderen
  • Zelf je werk zien en initiatief nemen waar nodig
  • Correct en vriendelijk communiceren met chauffeurs in het Nederlands
  • Bij afwezigheden van collega’s flexibel inspringen bij lossen en SAP-werk

We zoeken iemand die:

  • Ervaring heeft met reachtruck en heftruck
  • Communicatief sterk is in het Nederlands. Extra talen zijn steeds een plus!
  • Teamgericht is – iemand die samen wil groeien en wil bijspringen indien nodig
  • Betrouwbaar, verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel heeft en flexibel is
  • Initiatief neemt en van nature proactief is

Kortom: Iemand die mee-denkt, mee-doet en past in een sterk, betrouwbaar team!

Bij Aviko kies je voor stabiliteit én groei. Je komt terecht in een moderne productieomgeving binnen een internationaal bedrijf waar teamwork centraal staat. We investeren in jouw ontwikkeling via opleiding en coaching, en je wordt omringd door fijne collega’s die samenwerken en elkaar ondersteunen.

Daarnaast mag je rekenen op een sterk en compleet pakket aan extralegale voordelen:

  • 38‑urenweek met 20 verlofdagen
  • Je werkt telkens van 7u30 tot 16u, op vrijdag werk je tot ongeveer 14u
  • Maaltijdcheques van €10 per gewerkte dag
    Kinderopvangtoelage tot €5 per dag per kind (tot max. €1.000 per jaar, bij vaste indienstname – tot het jaar waarin het kind 12 wordt)
  • 50 minuten pauze, waarvan 20 minuten betaald
  • Anciënniteitsverlof, tot 4 dagen extra verlof na 10 jaar in dienst.
  • Groepsverzekering
  • Eindejaarspremie
  • Woon‑werkvergoeding of fietsvergoeding van €0,37 per km

Je krijgt dus niet alleen een stabiele job, maar ook een stevig voordelenpakket én groeikansen binnen een warme, no-nonsense organisatie.

Wing is on the exciting mission of redefining the future of work for companies worldwide! We are looking to be the one-stop shop for companies that are looking to build world-class teams and place their operations on autopilot.

And we’re looking for an experienced Zoho CRM Specialist & Systems Optimization Consultant to join our team!

  • Experience with custom modules, fields, layouts, validation rules, permissions, and CRM data structures.

  • Experience working with APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and implement lasting solutions.

  • Experience documenting technical systems and creating user-friendly training materials.

  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.

  • Excellent organization, follow-through, attention to detail, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.

  • Experience supporting professional-services firms, law firms, or businesses with structured intake, sales, and client-service processes is a plus.

title: Technical Product Generalist (m/w/d) - Germany remote
description:
Seeking a "Builder-in-Residence" to launch special projects in Germany (remote). Are you the person who sees a problem in the morning and has an AI-powered MVP running by dinner?
Felix, Gregor and Ivo are looking for a super hands-on, tech-savvy "Product Swiss Army Knife" to join us in our Vienna office. You don't need to be a Senior Dev, but you do need to be a master of the modern stack: AI agents, no-code/low-code, rapid prototyping, and scalable architecture.

We are building a few stealth-mode special projects and need someone who can iterate at lightning speed, work directly with the founding team, and think like an entrepreneur. The vibe: High autonomy, zero bureaucracy, pure building.

Your role:

We are looking for a Technical Product Generalist to act as the "execution engine" for a series of special projects. You will sit directly with the Co-Founders and CTO to turn raw ideas into validated products. This is not a role for someone who wants to sit in meetings; it’s for someone who wants to build, break, and ship.

What You’ll Do:

  • Rapid Prototyping: Take a concept from a whiteboard and build a functional MVP using a mix of AI tools, low-code platforms, or light coding.
  • AI Orchestration: Implement AI workflows using tools like OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, or Cursor to automate processes and enhance product features.
  • Architectural Design: Help define how different tools and databases talk to each other so our "fast" builds don't crumble when they scale.
  • Iterate & Pivot: Use user feedback to change directions in hours. You should be comfortable "killing your darlings" if the data doesn't support the idea.
  • Bridge the Gap: Act as the glue between the Founders' vision and the CTO's technical roadmap.

Who you are:

  • Your Tech "Toolbox" (Expected Proficiency). You should be a "power user" in most of these categories:
    • AI/LLMs: Cursor, Replit Agent, Claude Artifacts, Midjourney, v0.dev.
    • Automation/No-Code: Make.com, Zapier, Airtable, Bubble, or Webflow.
    • Modern Stack: Knowledge of how APIs, Supabase/Firebase, and Vercel work.
    • Product: Linear, Notion, Figma (enough to wireframe).
  • Your Personality:
    • Entrepreneurial: You’ve likely had a side hustle or tried to start a company before. You care about why we are building, not just what.
    • Tech-Fluent: You can hold your own in a conversation with our CTO about architecture, even if you aren't writing the production backend yourself.
    • Bias for Action: You prefer a "dirty" solution that works today over a "perfect" one that takes a month.
    • Vienna-Based: You want to be in the room where it happens. This is a high-bandwidth, in-person role

Why is this better than a standard Dev role?

  • Founding Team Access: You work directly with the decision-makers every day.
  • Speed: No legacy code. No technical debt. Just building new things.
  • Variety: You won't be stuck on one feature for six months; you'll be launching multiple projects.

Our Path to unlock your full potential:

  • Compensation: You can earn up to €50,000 gross base salary (full-time equivalent), complemented by an attractive team-based bonus of up to 10%, rewarding collective performance and success.
  • Flexible & Focused Work: Benefit from our hybrid work model with 2–3 flexible days per week and a Meeting-Free Friday for uninterrupted productivity.
  • Grow With Us: Advance your career through clear development paths and our Spark! Growth & Development program. Gain access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning, our Spark! Mentorship Program, and monthly learning sessions. Enjoy 30 free learning units to experience GoStudent firsthand.
  • Work Smart, Play Hard: Our regular team and office events keep the energy high. We believe in bonding, celebrating together, and having lots of fun.
  • Strength Through Community: Get involved in one of GoStudent’s Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and champion the causes that matter most to you.

How to apply:

Don't only send a traditional CV. Send us a link to something you built recently (even if it's a "scrappy" AI tool) and tell us which tools you used to get it live.

Our Commitment to full Openness:

We value your unique skills and your passion. We do not hire based on age, gender, nationality, or political views — what matters to us is your talent and your motivation. Even if you’re a unicorn — just like GoStudent — if you believe you can make a positive impact, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement.

Diversity makes us more creative, innovative, and stronger.

Want to learn more? Visit our careers page and check out „Wer wir sind“.

If you’re ready to rethink education with us, grow within an ambitious team, and create real impact, apply now! 🚀

Please upload your CV in PDF format, preferably in English, as DOC files may not be supported.

Disclose Privacy & Compliance Information

title: Data Engineer, Consultant
description:
Your Role

The Data Services team is responsible for technical design and end-to-end delivery of complex data-driven solutions and data products for the enterprise. The Data Engineer,Consultant will report to the Sr Manager, Data Solutions / Manager. This role serves as a senior individual contributor and technical leader, responsible for driving end‑to‑end delivery of complex data engineering solutions across cloud data platforms. The DE‑C partners closely with Solution Design Leads, Architects, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to translate solution designs and business requirements into scalable, secure, and production‑ready data products.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Your Work

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design and implementation of complex, data pipelines and data products from development through production

  • Translate solution designs and business requirements into detailed technical architecture and implementation plans

  • Architect and build scalable, secure, and highly available data solutions across enterprise data platforms

  • Apply advanced data modeling techniques (Data Vault 2.0, dimensional, and domain‑oriented models) to support analytics and reporting needs

  • Embed data quality, testing, security, and observability by design across data pipelines

  • Drive operational excellence, including incident analysis, stabilization, performance tuning, and deployment optimization

  • Identify and implement optimization opportunities related to performance, reliability, and cloud cost management

  • Influence and evolve data engineering standards, patterns, and frameworks used by delivery teams

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to Data Engineers and Senior Data Engineers through design reviews and code reviews

  • Work within an agile / DevSecOps pod model, collaborating closely with solution leads, data modelers, analysts, and business partners

  • Support integration of AI/ML‑ready datasets by ensuring data is well‑modeled, reliable, and governed

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

Your Knowledge and Experience

  • Requires a bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Requires a minimum of 7 years of data engineering experience.
  • Advanced hands‑on expertise in SQL, including automation and pipeline optimization
  • Strong experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and services such as ADLS, Synapse, and Data Factory
  • Extensive experience with modern data platforms including Snowflake, Databricks, and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Tidal
  • Deep understanding of data modeling, integration patterns, data architecture, data quality, and data warehousing
  • Proven experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and DataOps practices
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, and compliance requirements in regulated environments
  • Experience working with largescale, distributed data platforms and parallel processing architecture
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Proven ability to lead technically without formal people management responsibility

  • Preferred: Healthcare industry experience, including exposure to Epic or similar ecosystems

title: AI Workflows & Safety Decision Making Intern [2027]
description:
About Our Internship Program
Zoox's internship program offers hands-on experience with cutting-edge technology, mentorship from some of the industry's brightest minds, and the opportunity to make meaningful contributions to real projects. We seek interns who demonstrate strong academic performance, engagement beyond the classroom, intellectual curiosity, and a genuine interest in Zoox's mission.
Job Description
The Safety Strategy & Operations team at Zoox ensures that every strategic decision regarding vehicle deployment, operations, and policy is backed by rigorous safety data and modern computational tools.
As an intern on this team, you will focus on developing and deploying internal AI tools and agentic workflows that empower safety operators and analysts to make faster, more consistent, and data-driven safety decisions. You will work at the cutting edge where state-of-the-art AI developer tooling directly interfaces with safety-critical operational decision systems.

In this Role, You Will…

  • Develop AI-Powered Decision Tools: Design, prototype, and implement agentic workflows and AI-assisted tools that automate complex safety evaluations and triage operational signals.
  • Test & Validate Tool Reliability: Characterize the capabilities, edge cases, and failure modes of LLMs and AI workflows to ensure decision aids operate within safety-critical reliability thresholds.
  • Integrate Data Pipelines: Connect generative AI agents to structured safety databases and operational logs to automate real-time synthesis and risk reporting.
  • Collaborate Across Safety & Software: Work alongside safety strategists and software engineers to test prototypes in real operational scenarios and iterate based on user feedback.

Internship Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s degree (or advanced degree) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Data Science, or related engineering field.
  • Good academic standing and enrolled at an accredited college or university throughout the internship.
  • Expected graduation date between Fall 2027 and Summer 2028.
  • Able to commit to a full-time, 12-week internship.
  • Ability to relocate to the Bay Area, California, for the duration of the internship.
  • Interns at Zoox may not use proprietary information for thesis or publication outside of Zoox.

Technical Qualifications

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and object-oriented programming.
  • Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI tools, LLM APIs, and agentic workflows (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Claude/Cursor environments).
  • Critical understanding of the limitations, hallucinations, and verification methods required when deploying AI in decision-making contexts.
  • Experience building working prototypes, APIs, or internal web dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, FastAPI, or Flask).
  • Strong analytical problem-solving and clear written/verbal technical communication.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Prior experience applying AI/ML techniques to autonomous systems, safety analytics, or risk management.
  • Experience designing evaluation harnesses to benchmark generative AI and prompt performance.
  • Familiarity with database architectures (SQL/NoSQL) and data warehousing platforms.
Compensation
The monthly salary range for this position is $5,500 to $9,500. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level of education. Additional benefits may include medical insurance and a housing stipend (relocation assistance offered based on eligibility).Interview Process & Duration of Each Interview

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

title: Baristas
description:
QUEL EST LE TRAVAIL?

Chez Starbucks, tout est une question de connexion. Les gens sont au cœur de qui nous sommes, en particulier les gens qui font partie de notre équipe de magasin. Nous communiquons entre nous, avec nos clients et avec nos communautés pour avoir un impact positif chaque jour. Nous croyons qu’il faut travailler ensemble pour faire une différence et célébrer notre succès commun, c’est pourquoi nous nous appelons des « partenaires » Starbucks. Starbucks est un lieu chaleureux et d’appartenance, où tout le monde est le bienvenu, et nous apprécions les expériences uniques que chaque partenaire apporte à notre équipe!

En tant que barista Starbucks, vous créerez l’Expérience Starbucks pour nos clients grâce à un excellent service et à des produits conçus de manière experte. Vous serez dans un environnement de magasin dynamique où vous aurez la capacité de maîtriser votre art de la nourriture et des boissons, de travailler avec des amis et de rencontrer de nouvelles personnes chaque jour. Une tasse de café et un sourire peuvent faire beaucoup, et nous croyons que nos baristas ont le pouvoir d’être le meilleur moment de la journée de chaque client. Fidèles à notre mission et à nos valeurs, en travaillant ensemble, nous pouvons inspirer et nourrir l’esprit humain – une personne, une tasse et un quartier à la fois.

  • Bonne nouvelle! Aucune expérience antérieure n’est requise.
  • Considérez-vous comme une « personne » et aimez rencontrer les autres.
  • J’aime travailler en équipe et j’apprécie la possibilité de collaborer.
  • Comprendre comment créer une excellente expérience de service à la clientèle.
  • Concentrez-vous sur la qualité et soyez fier de votre travail.
  • Êtes ouvert à apprendre de nouvelles choses (particulièrement la dernière recette de boisson!)
  • Sont à l’aise avec les responsabilités comme la manipulation de l’argent et la sécurité du magasin.
  • Peut rester au frais et calme dans un environnement de travail dynamique et trépidant.
  • Peut maintenir un espace de travail propre et organisé.
  • Avoir d’excellentes compétences en communication.

WHAT'S THE JOB?
At Starbucks, it’s all about connection. People are at the heart of who we are, especially the people that are a part of our store team. We connect with each other, our customers and our communities to make a positive impact every day. We believe in working together to make a difference and in celebrating our shared success, which is why we call ourselves Starbucks “partners.” Starbucks is a place of warmth and belonging, where everyone is welcome, and we value the unique experiences that each partner brings to our team!

As a Starbucks barista, you’ll create the Starbucks Experience for our customers through excellent service and expertly-crafted products. You’ll be in an energetic store environment where you’ll have the ability to master your food & beverage craft, work alongside friends and meet new people every day. A cup of coffee and smile can go a long way, and we believe our baristas have the power to be the best moment in each customer’s day. True to Our Mission & Values, working together we can inspire and nurture the human spirit – one person, one cup and one neighborhood at a time.

You’d make a great barista if you:

  • Consider yourself a “people person,” and enjoy meeting others.
  • Love working as a team and appreciate the chance to collaborate.
  • Understand how to create a great customer service experience.
  • Have a focus on quality and take pride in your work.
  • Are open to learning new things (especially the latest beverage recipe!)
  • Are comfortable with responsibilities like cash-handling and store safety.
  • Can keep cool and calm in a fast-paced, energetic work environment.
  • Can maintain a clean and organized workspace.
  • Have excellent communications skills.

QUI RECHERCHONS-NOUS?

  • Maintenir une assiduité et une ponctualité régulières et constantes, avec ou sans accommodement raisonnable
  • Disposition à travailler selon des horaires flexibles qui peuvent comprendre les matins, les soirs, les fins de semaine, les soirs et/ou les jours fériés

title: Strategy Lead
description:
About Primordial Labs

We're building the next generation interface for commanding autonomous systems in the real world. Our core product, Anura, translates spoken or typed intent into structured actions across drones, sensors, and mission software—enabling faster, more intuitive control in high-stakes environments. We’re a distributed team of engineers, operators, and technologists focused on deploying reliable autonomy at the tactical edge.

The Opportunity

Primordial Labs is growing its strategy team. The Strategy Lead develops the company's view of its external environment: markets, customers, competitors, partners, and budgets. The role turns research into analysis that shapes where the company competes, which programs it pursues, and how it positions Anura. The Lead captures this work in the company's opportunity and analytic systems so it informs decisions across the business.

The role starts as a senior individual contributor in the Strategy function and works directly with the executive team. It partners with the Business Analytics Lead, who owns the company's internal reporting and analytic tools.

What You'll Do

Market and Competitive Analysis

  • Assess market size, structure, and growth across defense, government, and commercial segments

  • Track competitor products, contract awards, partnerships, and funding

  • Monitor technology trends and policy shifts in autonomy, uncrewed systems, and command and control

  • Evaluate adjacent markets and expansion opportunities

Customer and Program Analysis

  • Profile priority DoD customers, program offices, and prime contractors

  • Analyze programs of record, acquisition strategies, and requirements to identify entry points

  • Map customer organizations, decision-makers, and buying pathways

  • Support capture teams with opportunity research and customer insight

Budget Analysis

  • Analyze President's Budget requests, justification books, and appropriations to identify funded demand

  • Track funding lines, program trajectories, and Congressional marks tied to company priorities

  • Size addressable funding by customer, program, and capability area

Strategic Planning and Decision Support

  • Develop recommendations for leadership on market entry, positioning, and partnerships

  • Contribute to annual strategic planning, board materials, and investor materials

  • Produce briefings and written assessments for executive audiences

Research Integration

  • Maintain structured research and analysis in the company's CRM and opportunity database

  • Partner with the Business Analytics Lead to integrate external data into leadership reporting

  • Apply AI-assisted research tools to expand coverage and speed

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, market research, or a comparable analytical role

  • Demonstrated record of structuring ambiguous strategic questions and delivering recommendations to senior executives

  • Strong primary and secondary research skills, including synthesis of incomplete or conflicting sources

  • Ability to create polished presentations to communicate findings to leadership

  • Advanced market and financial modeling in Excel

  • Clear, concise executive writing and briefing skills

  • Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

  • Management consulting experience at a top-tier strategy firm

  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or national security, including familiarity with DoD acquisition and the budget process

  • Experience analyzing DoD budget documents and federal contract data (FPDS, USAspending, SAM.gov, DACIS, etc.)

  • Experience at a venture-backed company during a scale-up phase

  • Experience building or using AI-assisted research and analysis tools

  • Active security clearance or eligibility to obtain one

Important Qualification Note: Due to the nature of our work and federal compliance requirements, this position strictly requires U.S. Citizenship and current residency within the United States. Please note that Permanent Residency (Green Card status) or visa sponsorship cannot satisfy these specific regulatory requirements.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a target base salary of $150,000 - $185,000 annually, with the specific figure determined by the candidate's experience level.

We’re committed to fair and equitable compensation and are happy to explain how we determine our salary ranges, just ask!

Our Benefits

  • Beyond a Competitive Salary, we provide a significant equity stake, aligning your growth with ours.

  • 100% Remote: This role is fully remote, open to residents across the US. We believe that talent knows no borders (well, except for the US in this case!).

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans so you and your family can stay healthy and worry free.

  • Retirement Planning: Plan for tomorrow with our 401(k) package, complete with a generous 6% company match.

  • Generous DTO: Our generous Discretionary Time off (DTO) policy is all about helping you take the breaks you deserve and live your healthiest, most fulfilling life.

  • Elite Technology Package: Enjoy an elite technology package to make your work effortless and efficient.

Our Interview Process

Our interview process is designed to be thorough and respectful of your time. It typically includes:

  1. Conversation with the People Team: Lets get to know one another first!

  2. Manager Interview: A 45-minute discussion about relevant strategy concepts and your past experience.

  3. Team Interviews: Collaboration is at the heart of what we do. During this stage, you’ll meet your prospective peers to discuss our team dynamics, project workflows, and how we work together to win.

We are committed to a low-stress interview experience—no trick questions or brain teasers!

Primordial Labs is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a welcoming and respectful environment for everyone. Discrimination and harassment have no place here. We firmly believe that a diverse team enriches our problem-solving capabilities, sparks greater creativity, and ultimately leads to a better product and a more vibrant company.

We understand that great talent comes from various paths and that passion and transferable skills are invaluable. At Primordial Labs, what truly matters is your ability to make an impact, your dedication to our mission, and your capacity to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative atmosphere. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where you can contribute your unique talents, expand your skills, and learn continuously. If you’re driven to make a real impact, we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification.

title: Technical Product Generalist (m/w/d) - Italy
description:
Seeking a "Builder-in-Residence" to launch special projects in Italy (remote/hybrid). Are you the person who sees a problem in the morning and has an AI-powered MVP running by dinner?
Felix, Gregor and Ivo are looking for a super hands-on, tech-savvy "Product Swiss Army Knife" to join us in our Vienna office. You don't need to be a Senior Dev, but you do need to be a master of the modern stack: AI agents, no-code/low-code, rapid prototyping, and scalable architecture.

We are building a few stealth-mode special projects and need someone who can iterate at lightning speed, work directly with the founding team, and think like an entrepreneur. The vibe: High autonomy, zero bureaucracy, pure building.

Your role:

We are looking for a Technical Product Generalist to act as the "execution engine" for a series of special projects. You will sit directly with the Co-Founders and CTO to turn raw ideas into validated products. This is not a role for someone who wants to sit in meetings; it’s for someone who wants to build, break, and ship.

What You’ll Do:

  • Rapid Prototyping: Take a concept from a whiteboard and build a functional MVP using a mix of AI tools, low-code platforms, or light coding.
  • AI Orchestration: Implement AI workflows using tools like OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, or Cursor to automate processes and enhance product features.
  • Architectural Design: Help define how different tools and databases talk to each other so our "fast" builds don't crumble when they scale.
  • Iterate & Pivot: Use user feedback to change directions in hours. You should be comfortable "killing your darlings" if the data doesn't support the idea.
  • Bridge the Gap: Act as the glue between the Founders' vision and the CTO's technical roadmap.

Who you are:

  • Your Tech "Toolbox" (Expected Proficiency). You should be a "power user" in most of these categories:
    • AI/LLMs: Cursor, Replit Agent, Claude Artifacts, Midjourney, v0.dev.
    • Automation/No-Code: Make.com, Zapier, Airtable, Bubble, or Webflow.
    • Modern Stack: Knowledge of how APIs, Supabase/Firebase, and Vercel work.
    • Product: Linear, Notion, Figma (enough to wireframe).
  • Your Personality:
    • Entrepreneurial: You’ve likely had a side hustle or tried to start a company before. You care about why we are building, not just what.
    • Tech-Fluent: You can hold your own in a conversation with our CTO about architecture, even if you aren't writing the production backend yourself.
    • Bias for Action: You prefer a "dirty" solution that works today over a "perfect" one that takes a month.
    • Vienna-Based: You want to be in the room where it happens. This is a high-bandwidth, in-person role

Why is this better than a standard Dev role?

  • Founding Team Access: You work directly with the decision-makers every day.
  • Speed: No legacy code. No technical debt. Just building new things.
  • Variety: You won't be stuck on one feature for six months; you'll be launching multiple projects.

Our Path to unlock your full potential:

  • Compensation: You can earn up to €50,000 gross base salary (full-time equivalent), complemented by an attractive team-based bonus of up to 10%, rewarding collective performance and success.
  • Flexible & Focused Work: Benefit from our remote/hybrid work model with 2–3 flexible days per week and a Meeting-Free Friday for uninterrupted productivity.
  • Grow With Us: Advance your career through clear development paths and our Spark! Growth & Development program. Gain access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning, our Spark! Mentorship Program, and monthly learning sessions. Enjoy 30 free learning units to experience GoStudent firsthand.
  • Work Smart, Play Hard: Our regular team and office events keep the energy high. We believe in bonding, celebrating together, and having lots of fun.
  • Strength Through Community: Get involved in one of GoStudent’s Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and champion the causes that matter most to you.

How to apply:

Don't only send a traditional CV. Send us a link to something you built recently (even if it's a "scrappy" AI tool) and tell us which tools you used to get it live.

Our Commitment to full Openness:

We value your unique skills and your passion. We do not hire based on age, gender, nationality, or political views — what matters to us is your talent and your motivation. Even if you’re a unicorn — just like GoStudent — if you believe you can make a positive impact, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement.

Diversity makes us more creative, innovative, and stronger.

Want to learn more? Visit our careers page and check out „Wer wir sind“.

If you’re ready to rethink education with us, grow within an ambitious team, and create real impact, apply now! 🚀

title: Product Manager - AI Platform (m/f/x)
description:
As a Product Manager for the AI Platform, you will play a foundational role in defining, scaling, and operationalizing Artificial Intelligence capabilities across the entire Scalable organization. You will lead the strategy to move from siloed AI solutions to a unified, compliant, and robust internal "AI as a Platform" offering.

You will work closely with a dedicated cross-functional team of Data Scientists, AI Engineers and Software Engineers, acting as the key bridge between the technical development, internal domain teams, and regulatory stakeholders to ensure AI is integrated and leveraged effectively, securely, and ethically.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Strategy & Ownership: Define, prioritize, and own the strategic roadmap for our internal "AI as a Platform", ensuring it provides robust, scalable, and easy-to-integrate services for all internal domain and product teams, enabling them to consume AI capabilities without requiring them to integrate with external APIs.
  • Identify Opportunities: Work in close collaboration with all internal domain and product teams to identify opportunities to employ AI capabilities, focusing on:
    • Client Experience: Enhancing core client-facing product functionality through predictive modeling and personalization.
    • Operational Efficiency: Improving internal system scalability, fraud detection, and overall operational performance.
  • Use Case Implementation: Drive the implementation of strategic AI use cases across the company. Ensure efficient implementation by aligning implementation timelines across all teams involved (AI platform, domain teams, mobile,...).
  • AI Compliance & Governance: Act as the key product driver for AI compliance, regulatory adherence, and ethical usage. Define our approach to ensure all models and data usage are secure and compliant with current and emerging data protection laws.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) for AI Features: Support the planning, launch, and post-launch monitoring of new client-facing AI features and capabilities, ensuring smooth coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and Compliance.
  • Team Collaboration & Product Leadership: Lead the product development process for the cross-functional AI Platform team, managing agile processes, backlogs, and planning sessions, and translating high-level business goals into actionable user stories for Data Scientists and ML/AI Engineers.
  • Data-Driven Vision: Leverage data analysis, user needs (internal and external), market trends, and insights from LLM/AI system outputs and trace analysis, including analysis of AI agent performance and user feedback, to continuously inform and evolve the AI Platform vision and product strategy.

Role Description:

We are seeking an SFN Network Development Manager to own the economic model of our third-party fulfillment network. You will build the cost-to-serve model that sits behind every partner agreement, derive and validate the rate cards we contract on, and maintain a benchmarked shadow P&L for each partner. Alongside that you will own the measurement layer that tells us whether the economics are holding, translating the commitments in partner agreements into measurable metrics and owning the reporting that goes to partners and ShipBob leadership.

This is a build role for someone who understands fulfillment operations from the floor up and can translate what happens in a building into what it costs. Comfortable moving between a cost model, a contract and a partner conversation.

This role reports to the Senior Director, Network Development, and works in close partnership with SFN Operations, Pricing, Legal and the Data team.

What you’ll do:

Modeling

  • Build and own the cost-to-serve model for SFN partner operations: labor, equipment, occupancy and overhead by activity, at site level.
  • Model the economics of proposed commercial terms before they are agreed, so we understand what a rate card delivers for both parties at the volumes we actually expect.
  • Run scenario and sensitivity analysis on the variables that move the answer and state which assumptions the conclusion depends on.
  • Model the economics of network decisions including new sites, consolidations and inventory moves, and quantify the trade-offs.
  • Establish standard cost and variance analysis across the network, so that where actual cost diverges from standard we know by how much and why.
  • Model payback on capital investments using cost of capital, IRR, and associated throughput metrics to drive recommendations.

Partner Performance

  • Serve as the validation gate on new agreements: before a commercial commitment is signed, confirm that what it obliges us to measure and enforce can be measured and enforced, and that its terms are economically viable and fair to both ShipBob and the partner.
  • Keep contractual obligations and reporting in sync as agreements evolve, so every new term has instrumentation behind it.
  • Design and own partner-facing performance reporting, including what is published, to whom, at what level of detail, and on what cadence.
  • Specify product requirements for the publication mechanism and work with Product and Engineering to deliver it.
  • Build the analytics that surface systemic insight across the network: productivity benchmarking by region and product profile, emerging risk patterns, and structural versus situational performance variance.

Shadow P&L

  • Build and own the partner shadow P&L, benchmark partner, productivity and cost against comparables, and flag deteriorating economics early, with the drivers quantified.
  • Define the financial and productivity insight shared back with partners and support the rate reviews, cost model validation, and negotiations with partner-level analysis.

Mechanisms and Escalation

  • Own the performance escalation framework with SFN Operations, including thresholds, owners, and touchpoint sequence, and automate escalation so issues reach the right level without manual intervention.
  • Supply the performance and financial inputs for Quarterly Business Reviews.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities as necessary.

What you’ll bring to the table:

  • 7+ years in operational finance, costing and pricing work, plant or site controllership, FP&A or commercial finance, within manufacturing, distribution, fulfillment or a comparable operating environment.
  • Demonstrated experience building economic and cost-to-serve models from first principles, rather than operating a model someone else designed.
  • Working understanding of fulfillment or warehouse operations and the cost drivers within them such as labor productivity, equipment utilization, occupancy, throughput and mix. You should be able to walk a floor and understand where the cost sits.
  • Comfort working with cost and industrial engineers on design engineering.
  • Excellent financial literacy. Comfortable building a P&L view, understanding cost structure and margin drivers, and forming a defensible judgement on whether a commercial arrangement is working.
  • Fluency with data at scale. SQL is expected, and experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks is strongly preferred. You should be able to get at the data you need to build a model without waiting on someone else to extract it.
  • Ability to read a commercial agreement and translate its obligations into measurable terms. Prior exposure to contracts, service levels or commercial terms is a significant advantage.
  • Experience specifying requirements to product and engineering teams and seeing a build through to delivery.
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across functions without direct authority, including with senior stakeholders.
  • Exceptional rigor. Numbers that go to partners and to leadership must be right, and this role is the last line of defense on that.
  • Solid written and verbal communication. Able to explain an analytical conclusion to a commercial audience and a commercial constraint to an engineering one.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Much of what this role will own does not exist yet.
  • Program or project management experience is a bonus.

ShipBob believes in transparency while providing a competitive total compensation package with a pay for performance approach. We are targeting a salary range of $99,150 - $132,200 for this role. The full base pay range for this position in our compensation architecture is $99,150 - $165,250. In addition to base salary, this role includes the opportunity to be eligible for participation in the Company's discretionary bonus plan based on Company's plans and in accordance with Company’s policies.
