title: Associate Director, SAS Programming
description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
Acadia is committed to turning scientific promise into meaningful innovation that makes the difference for underserved neurological and rare disease communities around the world. Our commercial portfolio includes the first and only FDA-approved treatments for Parkinson’s disease psychosis and Rett syndrome. We are developing the next wave of therapeutic advancements with a robust and diverse pipeline that includes mid- to late-stage programs in Alzheimer’s disease psychosis and Lewy body dementia psychosis, along with earlier-stage programs that address other underserved patient needs. At Acadia, we’re here to be their difference.

Position Summary

The Associate Director, SAS Programming is an exciting opportunity to take a leading role in statistical programming for an assigned compound, with accountability for the quality, CDISC conformance, and submission readiness of deliverables produced internally or by FSP and CRO partners. The role provides the opportunity to set compound programming strategy, own resource planning, and stay hands-on with complex, high-impact deliverables. In addition to leading day-to-day delivery, this individual will help drive meaningful improvement initiatives that advance programming capabilities and ways of working across the organization.

Primary Responsibilities

Deliverables and Quality

  • Serves as programming lead for an assigned compound, accountable for deliverables, timelines, and quality across its studies, and coordinates the lead programmers assigned to it.
  • Sets compound programming strategy, including standards implementation, integrated dataset design, and validation approach.
  • Develops and maintains compound resource plans and timelines, forecasts demand against study and program milestones, identifies gaps, and recommends internal and external resourcing.
  • Provides programming input into statistical analysis plans, mock shells, case report form design, annotated CRFs, and edit check and data transfer specifications.
  • Performs hands-on development and validation of SDTM, ADaM, and TLF programs for high-priority deliverables across the compound, including database lock, topline, DSMB/DMC, and submission outputs.
  • Reviews SDTM and ADaM specifications for consistency with the statistical analysis plan across studies, so derivations are interpreted the same way across the compound.
  • Designs and programs integrated datasets across studies to support integrated summaries of safety and efficacy, pooled analyses, and cross-study comparisons.
  • Defines the compound validation approach, including which outputs need independent double programming and which need code review, ensures internal, FSP, and CRO programmers apply it consistently, and oversees acceptance of define.xml, cSDRG, ADRG, and conformance reports.
  • Delivers rapid-turnaround ad hoc analyses for senior leadership, regulatory interactions, and health authority information requests.
  • Ensures deliverables for clinical study reports, submissions, and health authority responses are submission ready and compliant with GCP, ICH, 21 CFR Part 11, FDA, EMA, and PMDA requirements, and internal SOPs, and serves as subject matter expert for the compound during audits and inspections.
  • Drives use of the global macro library and departmental standards, partnering with the standards function on gaps.

Vendor Oversight

  • Performs vendor qualification for programming services and manages CRO and FSP partners for the compound against agreed quality and timeline expectations, serving as the primary programming point of contact.
  • Directs FSP, contractor, and CRO resources supporting assigned work.

Collaboration, Initiative, and Growth

  • Collaborates closely within the SAS Programming team, across Biometrics, and with other R&D cross-functional teams to align on priorities, timelines, and deliverables.
  • Communicates proactively and transparently on status, risks, issues, and decisions, adapting the message for technical and non-technical audiences and escalating early when needed.
  • Keeps current with industry developments, regulatory guidance, and emerging tools through conferences, professional forums such as PHUSE, PharmaSUG, and CDISC, and continuous self-learning, and shares insights with the team to drive continuous improvement.
  • Provides technical guidance to FSP programmers, contractors, and CRO partners, contributes to departmental standards, SOPs, and training, and serves as an escalation point for complex programming problems.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

Education/Experience/Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in statistics, biostatistics, computer science, mathematics, or a related field; master's degree preferred. SAS certification at the Advanced Programmer level preferred. An equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be considered.
  • Targeting 8 years of progressively responsible experience in statistical programming with clinical data, preferably in a pharmaceutical or biotech environment, including lead programmer experience on more than one study or program and oversight of CRO or FSP deliverables.
  • Expert-level SAS programming, including Base SAS, SAS/STAT, SAS Macro, ODS, SAS/GRAPH, and SQL.
  • In-depth knowledge of CDISC standards, including SDTM, ADaM, controlled terminology, define.xml, and reviewer guides, and the ability to write detailed dataset specifications.
  • Detailed knowledge of clinical trial data, the drug development process, and regulatory requirements, including GCP, ICH, 21 CFR Part 11, and FDA, EMA, and PMDA electronic submission requirements.
  • Experience constructing integrated datasets across multiple clinical trials to support integrated summaries of safety and efficacy.
  • Experience with Pinnacle 21 or equivalent conformance tooling and resolution of conformance findings.
  • Demonstrated ability to set programming strategy across multiple studies, plan resources, and guide lead programmers.
  • Experience supporting NDA, BLA, or MAA submissions, including submission data packages and health authority responses, is preferred.
  • Working knowledge of R is preferred.
  • Practical use of generative AI tools to improve programming productivity and quality, with an understanding of their limitations and the validation expectations for AI-assisted outputs in a regulated environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated initiative: recognizes what needs to be done, acts without waiting to be asked, follows through to results, and identifies opportunities for improvement and efficiency.
  • Brings competence and care to the work: high technical standards and ownership of quality, combined with genuine care for colleagues, partners, and the patients behind the data.
  • Balances competing priorities and deadlines, ensuring timely and high-quality execution.
  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedules or business needs.

title: Servicedesktekniker till Teracom
description:

Teracom är statens bolag för säker kommunikation. I våra nät når informationen fram opåverkad. Vår styrka ligger i att alltid vara redo, i hela landet, alla dagar, dygnet runt. Med ständig beredskap ska vår kommunikationsinfrastruktur stå emot allt från naturkatastrofer till cyberhot och krig. Om rollen

Som Servicedesktekniker blir du en del av Teracoms interna servicedesk, som är den första kontaktpunkten för alla IT-relaterade frågor i organisationen. Du tar emot ärenden från hela bolaget och driver dem till lösning, vid behov tillsammans med systemägare, specialister och ingenjörer. Tillsammans skapar ni en stabil och säker IT-miljö för alla medarbetare.

Du tillhör enheten Användarstöd inom avdelningen Nätteknologi. Här finns goda möjligheter att utvecklas i rollen och hitta egna fokusområden.

Arbetet sker på plats på kontoret, som ligger på Lindhagen i Stockholm.

Du kommer bland annat att:

  • Hantera ärenden via Jira, telefon och e-post samt säkerställa snabb och professionell återkoppling.

  • Installera, konfigurera och felsöka datorer, mobiltelefoner, mötesrumsutrustning och tillhörande programvara.

  • Administrera konton och behörigheter, bland annat i Active Directory, samt säkerställa att nyanställda får en bra start.

  • Hantera och felsöka abonnemang och mobila tjänster samt ha kontakt med operatörer vid behov.

  • Ansvara för kommunikationen till organisationen vid incidenter och driftstörningar.

  • Bidra till att utveckla ärendehanteringssystemet och förbättra servicedeskens arbetssätt och rutiner.

  • Hantera inköp av IT-utrustning och kontorsmateriel samt delta i interna IT-projekt.

Mer om dig

För att trivas i rollen är du tekniskt nyfiken och tycker om att felsöka och hitta lösningar. Du är prestigelös, ansvarstagande och har en stark servicekänsla. Du trivs med att samarbeta och hjälper gärna till där det behövs. Du har också lätt för att förklara tekniska frågor på ett pedagogiskt sätt, oavsett vem du pratar med.

Vi tror att du har:

  • Minst två års erfarenhet från servicedesk, IT-support eller liknande supportfunktion.

  • Grundläggande kunskaper i Active Directory, Windows och Microsoft Office.

  • Grundläggande förståelse för IT-miljöer och molnteknologi.

  • Goda kunskaper i svenska, i både tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har god förståelse för IT- och informationssäkerhet.

Teracom erbjuder

Du får marknadsmässiga villkor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas i din roll. Förmåner inkluderar:

  • Friskvårdsbidrag.

  • Rikskort eller subventionerat SL-kort.

  • Arbetstidsförkortning.

  • Två friskvårdstimmar i veckan.

Mer information finns på Teracoms hemsida.

Bra att känna till

För anställning krävs godkända drog- och alkoholtester samt godkänd bakgrundskontroll och säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll. Detta eftersom tjänsten är säkerhetsklassad. Du behöver därför vara svensk eller nordisk medborgare.

Ansökan

Låter det här som en roll för dig? Då vill vi gärna höra från dig! Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

Har du frågor är du välkommen att kontakta Sara Åkerlund på sara.akerlund@ants.se.

Om du inte redan känner Teracom

Teracom Samhällsnät bidrar till ett tryggare samhälle genom att se till att information och kommunikation fungerar för de allra viktigaste samhällsfunktionerna, även i kris och krig.

Våra uppdrag omfattar utsändning av public service-kanalerna för radio och tv, kommunikationslösningar och beredskapsuppdraget. Vi utvecklar och levererar också allt fler beredskapstjänster samt olika typer av kommunikationslösningar till totalförsvarsviktiga aktörer.

Vi är ett statligt bolag med cirka 500 medarbetare på ett 50-tal orter i Sverige. Vår vision är att, tillsammans med våra uppdragsgivare, göra Sverige tryggare där det behövs, när det behövs.

title: Embedded Systems Engineer – Super Intelligence Integration
description:
We are seeking an Embedded Systems Engineer, Super Intelligence (SI) Integration, to support an architecture that connects commercial scientific, laboratory, and manufacturing equipment to orchestration and SI platforms. You will focus on device integration, firmware-adjacent engineering, and reliable machine interfaces that enable real equipment to be safely monitored and operated through software-driven workflows. This position is in the Materials Engineering Division (MED) within the Engineering Directorate.

This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

  • Bring up new devices, interfaces, and embedded systems used in laboratory and manufacturing environments.
  • Build and maintain software connectors that link equipment, telemetry, and command pathways to orchestration and SI platforms.
  • Implement and document machine-interface contracts, including command semantics, telemetry fields, units, timestamps, device states, and error conditions, so that orchestration and SI platforms can reliably use equipment capabilities.
  • Write protocol-level integrations and supporting code for hardware-software interfaces rather than relying solely on vendor tools.
  • Implement appropriate command validation, interlocks, approval points, and fallback behaviors for connected equipment in partnership with senior engineers and equipment owners.
  • Develop test harnesses, diagnostic utilities, and debugging tools for hardware-in-the-loop workflows.
  • Help standardize telemetry and command interfaces across hardware and software systems.
  • Partner with senior engineers to address reliability, safety boundaries, and deployment readiness for connected equipment.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the SES.2 level

  • Design and debug complex device integrations involving multiple protocols, hardware components, and orchestration and SI platform services.
  • Independently define and improve reusable interface patterns, including device contracts, safety-aware command paths, test harnesses, and diagnostic tools, to increase reliability across connected equipment.
  • Diagnose integration failures involving device states, protocol layers, intermittent connectivity, and orchestration and SI platform services, and recommend practical corrective actions.
  • Coordinate technical approaches with equipment owners and software partners, and provide informal guidance to less experienced contributors.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • Experience with firmware, drivers, or hardware-software integration through coursework, projects, research, internships, or professional work.
  • Familiarity with microcontrollers, embedded Linux, real-time operating systems, or comparable embedded environments.
  • Experience writing code for hardware-protocol integrations using Python, C, C++, Rust, or similar languages.
  • Familiarity with one or more hardware-communication protocols, such as CAN, Modbus, serial, I2C, or SPI.
  • Ability to troubleshoot device bring-up, interface issues, and system-integration problems in a structured manner.

Additional qualifications at the SES.2 level

  • Ability to independently define or improve device-interface contracts and safety-aware command or control pathways for connected equipment.
  • Ability to diagnose issues spanning multiple hardware components, protocol layers, and orchestration and SI platform services.
  • Ability to independently develop and troubleshoot embedded or hardware-software integrations involving device protocols, telemetry, and control pathways.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Experience with MQTT, NATS, or similar messaging technologies.
  • Exposure to ROS or ROS 2.
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Background in robotics, mechatronics, industrial equipment, or laboratory instrumentation.
  • Familiarity with edge-system considerations, such as latency, intermittent connectivity, remote diagnostics, or device lifecycle management.

Pay Range

$121,830 - $185,544 Annually
$121,830 - $154,500 Annually for the SES.1 level
$146,340 - $185,544 Annually for the SES.2 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

title: Lead Software Engineer, Data
description:
About Bold Orange:

Bold Orange (BOCO) is a customer experience company. We believe authentic human connections are the single most important driver of business and societal progress. We exist to create these connections across the customer lifecycle, from acquisition to engagement to retention. Our culture is one of curiosity, collaboration, proactivity and always bringing the outside, future focused perspective to our clients.

Lead-level, hands-on data engineering role centered on Snowflake. You will own the technical solution for your accounts end to end, from discovery and requirements through architecture, build, and production, and you will be the person clients and internal teams look to for the answer on how the data platform should work.

Leads at Bold Orange take on the most critical and complex engineering work and are expected to be prolific contributors to the team's code, while also setting technical direction, establishing engineering practices, and multiplying the effectiveness of the engineers around them.

Snowflake powers a SaaS platform we operate and a growing share of our client data work, and it is where we are investing to get stronger, so deep and demonstrable Snowflake expertise is central to this role. We also work with Redshift and Databricks, both internally and on behalf of clients.

You will work alongside solution architects, other data engineers, project managers, and client teams across multiple concurrent engagements.

Position Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical solution and provide overall technical oversight for your accounts, from discovery through production and ongoing support
  • Lead discovery, intake requirements directly from clients, and present solutions and trade-offs to client stakeholders yourself
  • Lead the architecture and own the system design for your engagements, including the data models, warehouses, and ELT/ETL pipelines that result
  • Evaluate and estimate work confidently and accurately at the system and project level, not only at the component level
  • Architect, build, and maintain data models, warehouses, and pipelines in Snowflake, optimizing for performance, scalability, and cost
  • Take on the most critical, complex, and time-sensitive engineering work, and remain a prolific contributor to the team's code
  • Develop and tune complex SQL, stored procedures, and transformations in Snowflake and supporting relational databases such as SQL Server and PostgreSQL
  • Apply native Snowflake capabilities where they earn their place, including Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, dynamic tables, and external and stage integrations for near-real-time data flows
  • Own Snowflake performance, governance, and cost management across accounts, including warehouse sizing, clustering, role-based access control, and data security
  • Design, build, and maintain back-end APIs and services in Python and C#/.NET that feed and consume the Snowflake platform
  • Design and own integrations with client and internal marketing, CRM, and analytics platforms, including the authentication, error handling, and monitoring that keep an integration reliable once it is in production
  • Own the CI/CD and deployment path for the systems you build, across cloud and on-premise environments
  • Establish, socialize, implement, measure, and iterate on engineering practices for the data practice, and raise the bar through code review, design review, and written architecture decisions
  • Delegate effectively and multiply the team: set technical direction, review designs before code is written, pair on hard problems, and grow depth on Snowflake and back-end development
  • Create and lead training for both internal teams and client teams on the solutions you build
  • Act as the technical escalation point for production issues in a multi-client environment, and own the fix and the follow-up so the same failure does not recur
  • Own the majority of project-level technical communication with senior internal stakeholders and with clients, and guide the team on how to communicate well
  • Participate in new business scoping and pursuits in your area of expertise
  • Contribute to the agency's technical reputation through internal knowledge sharing and external representation such as writing, industry events, and panels
  • Evaluate new platform capabilities and AI-assisted development tooling, and bring the ones that hold up into how the team works

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with the majority of it in data engineering
  • Demonstrated technical leadership: owning the technical solution for an account, engagement, or team, and being accountable for work beyond your own
  • Deep hands-on Snowflake expertise: production experience designing data models and warehouses, building ELT/ETL pipelines, and writing performant SQL on the platform
  • Demonstrated ownership of a data model or data platform design from requirements through production, not just implementation of someone else's design
  • Experience leading discovery and shaping a technical solution directly with clients or business stakeholders, not only delivering against a specification handed to you
  • Ability to estimate and plan work accurately at the system and project level
  • Working knowledge of Snowflake performance tuning, cost optimization, and security and governance, including warehouse sizing, clustering, and RBAC
  • Strong proficiency in Python and C# for back-end development, with recent hands-on work in both
  • Hands-on experience with relational SQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL
  • Proven experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs
  • Practical DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and server configuration
  • Comfort in both Windows Server and Linux environments
  • A track record of establishing engineering standards or practices that other engineers followed
  • Ability to manage and context-switch across multiple concurrent client projects
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including technical communication with non-technical stakeholders and the confidence to lead a design conversation with a client

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Agency, consultancy, or client-services experience, with multiple concurrent clients and client-facing scoping and delivery
  • Active SnowPro certification, Core strongly preferred, Advanced (Data Engineer or Architect) a significant plus. We support and pay for certification, so a strong engineer without it is not ruled out
  • Working fluency with AI-assisted development tools, applied with engineering judgment about where they help and where they do not
  • Experience with recent Snowflake platform capabilities, including CoCo, CoWork, Horizon Catalog, and Horizon Context (Semantic Views)
  • Redshift and/or Databricks experience, both of which are in use at Bold Orange
  • Azure DevOps, Azure App Services, or other Azure services
  • HubSpot CMS, HubSpot APIs, or marketing automation platforms
  • IIS, .NET deployment, or Windows service management

Benefits That Matter:

Our benefits are designed to support life’s many stages—expected and unexpected. Eligible employees can access:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Virtual mental health support
  • Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts (including dependent care)
  • Infertility and critical illness benefits
  • 401(k) with generous 6–10% employer contribution
  • Paid parental leave
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Free parking and commuter support

Note: Some benefits apply only to full-time employees.

Who We Are:

Our tone is professionally sassy. We embrace meat raffles, hot seats, and the occasional Jell-O shot. We like staff meetings that are informative, educational, and at times, damn funny. We believe in no hierarchy, no bullshit, no politics. Just honest, hard work and great fun.

Important to note: While we value AI as a tool, AI is not invited to Bold Orange interviews. We want to meet the wonderfully talented human you! Any suspected use of AI to inform or assist, while actively in an interview with Bold Orange, will result in exclusion from consideration for the role to which you applied or were referred.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We are an equal opportunity employer, dedicated to a policy of nondiscrimination in employment on any basis including race, color, creed, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, national origin, marital status, familial status, ancestry, status as a veteran, status with regard to public assistance and any other characteristic protected by law. Bold Orange does not and will not discriminate against employees, prospective employees, clients, or vendors.

title: Water or Wastewater Treatment Operator
description:
Woodard & Curran is an employee-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.


Build a Career That Makes a Difference!

Whether you’re an experienced operator or looking to build a career in the water industry, we’d like to hear from you. We provide training, support for operator certification, and opportunities to grow your skills and advance your career.

We’re looking for a Water/Wastewater Operator or Operator Trainee to join our team at the Englewood, Ohio Water & Wastewater Treatment Facilities. You’ll work alongside experienced team members to help operate and maintain critical treatment systems. Depending on your experience, you’ll have the opportunity to learn on the job, develop your technical skills, and work toward your Ohio operator license.

  • Troubleshooting operational issues and supporting reliable plant performance

title: Technical Product Generalist (m/w/d) - UK remote
description:
Seeking a "Builder-in-Residence" to launch special projects in UK - remote. Are you the person who sees a problem in the morning and has an AI-powered MVP running by dinner?
Felix, Gregor and Ivo are looking for a super hands-on, tech-savvy "Product Swiss Army Knife" to join us in our Vienna office. You don't need to be a Senior Dev, but you do need to be a master of the modern stack: AI agents, no-code/low-code, rapid prototyping, and scalable architecture.

We are building a few stealth-mode special projects and need someone who can iterate at lightning speed, work directly with the founding team, and think like an entrepreneur. The vibe: High autonomy, zero bureaucracy, pure building.

Your role:

We are looking for a Technical Product Generalist to act as the "execution engine" for a series of special projects. You will sit directly with the Co-Founders and CTO to turn raw ideas into validated products. This is not a role for someone who wants to sit in meetings; it’s for someone who wants to build, break, and ship.

What You’ll Do:

  • Rapid Prototyping: Take a concept from a whiteboard and build a functional MVP using a mix of AI tools, low-code platforms, or light coding.
  • AI Orchestration: Implement AI workflows using tools like OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, or Cursor to automate processes and enhance product features.
  • Architectural Design: Help define how different tools and databases talk to each other so our "fast" builds don't crumble when they scale.
  • Iterate & Pivot: Use user feedback to change directions in hours. You should be comfortable "killing your darlings" if the data doesn't support the idea.
  • Bridge the Gap: Act as the glue between the Founders' vision and the CTO's technical roadmap.

Who you are:

title: Senior Android Developer (Contract, Outside IR35)
description:
Contract status: Outside IR35
Start date: ASAP
Contract length: Three months
Location: Remote first
Office days: Once or twice a year (London)

Why this one

You’ll work on the security-critical parts of a UK government Android app, including login.

If you know mobile security properly and want to use it, this contract will test it.

What’s in it for you

You’ll work in native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on a live government app.

You’ll see how features from several teams come together in one app, and help shape how they fit.

You’ll work from home most of the time.

Who you’ll be doing it for

You’ll join the mobile platform team on a UK government app. The team builds and maintains the common parts of the app, brings in features built by other teams, and manages releases.

You’re engaged through hedgehog lab, a digital product consultancy that’s B Corp and Great Place to Work certified.

You’ll build and improve the common parts of the Android app, such as login, in Kotlin with Jetpack Compose.

You’ll work on how features from other teams fit into the app.

You’ll review code, including for security issues, and put your own up for review.

After a release, you’ll watch Crashlytics and fix anything that’s crashing.

What you’ll need to be considered

Several years of commercial experience in native Android development, with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

Hands-on mobile security experience, such as authentication, secure storage or certificate pinning.

Working knowledge of the OWASP Mobile Top 10 and MASVS.

You can explain the risk each security measure you’ve built protects against, and why it works.

Experience using Crashlytics to keep an app stable.

You’re comfortable in a small, fast-moving team and happy to say what you think in a code review.

You must be eligible for SC clearance, which means you’ve lived in the UK continuously for the last 5 years. Ideally you’ll already hold it.

title: Product Line Manager - Si IGBT

The IPD division product portfolio includes: bare-die and power-module solutions for IGBT-based traction inverters used in hybrid and electric vehicles; IPMs for high-voltage power supply units in AI data centers; automotive intelligent power modules; industrial intelligent power modules; and discrete IGBT products.

As a Technical Marketing Engineer, you will own the assigned product lines. Key responsibilities include analyzing markets and customers, defining products and roadmaps, developing strategic pricing, initiating and executing new product projects, and driving sustainable business growth.

  • Develop product concepts and target specifications using input from customers and system, applications, development, electrical, and packaging engineering teams, and present the resulting proposals to customers.

title: Leadership Development Facilitator
description:
Idaho National Laboratory’s (INL) Talent Development group is seeking professionals interested in exploring a career as a Leadership Development Facilitator.

You will work a 9/80 schedule located out of our Idaho Falls facility with every other Friday off. You will report to the Deputy Director of Talent Development Programs.

The Leadership Development Facilitator is responsible for delivering learning experiences and development support that build leadership capability across INL. The role translates leadership development content and individual needs into engaging classroom and virtual facilitation, combined with additional development support—such as development coaching, assessment debriefs, and individual development planning (IDP) support—that strengthens leaders' and managers' self-awareness, skills, and growth.

Responsibilities:

Facilitation & Program Delivery (70%)

  • Deliver leadership development training courses, using a variety of instructional techniques, including role play, simulations, team exercises, group discussions, case studies, and experiential activities.
  • Facilitate in-person and virtual leadership cohorts, workshops, and leadership offsites.
  • Partner with Program Design Leads and Learning Experience team to provide subject matter and audience insight that informs course design and give feedback on materials prior to rollout.
  • Evaluate training delivery effectiveness, using participant feedback and performance data, and share insights with Program Design Leads to inform ongoing program refinement.
  • Adapt facilitation approach and pacing in real time to meet the needs of the specific leader audience in the room.

Individual Leadership Development Support & Development Coaching (30%)

  • Partner with managers and leaders to create and refine Individual Development Plans (IDPs), helping translate assessment results and performance feedback into actionable growth goals.
  • Administer and debrief personality and competency assessments (e.g., Workplace Big 5 and TalentTelligent Competency Assessments) with individual leaders and managers, helping them interpret results and identify development priorities.
  • Provide one-on-one development coaching to managers and leaders, supporting goal-setting, accountability, and behavior change between formal training sessions.
  • Provide team development support, acting as a thought partner to leaders navigating team or interpersonal challenges in partnership with HR Business Partners.
  • Track and report on individual and cohort development progress, flagging trends that may inform broader talent or organizational initiatives.

Relationship & Professional Development

  • Build and maintain constructive, trust-based relationships with leaders, managers, and HR partners across the organization and with the broader Talent Development team.
  • Stay current on leadership development, facilitation, coaching, and OD best practices through ongoing professional reading, certifications, and industry engagement
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Level 3: Bachelor's degree in Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Human Resources, or a related field and 5 years of experience or a Master’s degree and 3 years of experience.
  • Level 4: Bachelor's degree in Organizational Development, Industrial-Organizational Psychology, Human Resources, or a related field and 9 years of experience or a Master’s degree and 6 years of experience.
  • Experience facilitating leadership or management development programs for adult learners.
  • Experience coaching individuals on development goals, commensurate with the level of leaders supported.

Preferred

title: Homecare Supervisor - Kildare
description:
Care Supervisor – Kildare

Location: Newbridge, Co. Kildare
Salary: €34,000–€36,000 per annum
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

About Right at Home

Right at Home is an award-winning home care provider committed to improving the quality of life for those we serve.

We are currently recruiting an experienced and motivated Care Supervisor to join our team based in Newbridge, supporting the delivery of high-quality home care services to clients across Kildare and surrounding areas.

This is an excellent opportunity for a healthcare professional who is passionate about delivering exceptional care, supporting care teams and making a positive difference in the lives of others.

The Role

As Care Supervisor, you will play a key role in maintaining high standards of care while providing ongoing guidance and support to our Healthcare Assistants.

The position involves a combination of office-based responsibilities and visits to clients in their homes, ensuring that care is delivered safely, effectively and in line with individual client needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct client assessments, care reviews and regular home visits.

  • Carry out staff supervision, spot checks and competency assessments.

  • Provide ongoing support, guidance and mentoring to Healthcare Assistants.

  • Monitor the quality of care delivered and ensure compliance with company policies and procedures.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client and staff documentation.

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with clients, families and care teams.

  • Identify and address concerns relating to care delivery, escalating matters where appropriate.

  • Work closely with the Business Manager and office team to support the effective delivery of care services.

  • Assist with the induction, training and ongoing development of Healthcare Assistants.

  • Promote a person-centred approach to care at all times.

Requirements

  • QQI Level 6 qualification in Healthcare or a relevant equivalent.

  • Previous experience working in healthcare, ideally within a home care setting.

  • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience is desirable.

  • Strong understanding of care standards, safeguarding and confidentiality.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Good organisational and time management skills.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Full, valid driving licence.

  • Flexibility to travel to clients across Kildare and surrounding areas.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary of €34,000–€36,000 per annum.

  • Weekly fuel card.

  • Full-time, permanent employment.

  • Supportive and experienced management team.

  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression.

  • Access to a shared pool vehicle for work-related client visits, including rural locations across Kildare and surrounding areas. The vehicle is available for business use only.

Why Join Right at Home?

At Right at Home, we believe that excellent care starts with supporting the people who deliver it.

You'll be joining a welcoming and dedicated team where your experience, ideas and contribution are valued. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference to the lives of our clients while supporting Healthcare Assistants to deliver the highest standards of care.

Company Values – Play Your PART

At Right at Home, our PART values – Personable, Accountable, Real and Thrive – guide everything we do.

Equal Opportunities & GDPR

Right at Home is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and are committed to protecting applicants' personal information in accordance with GDPR and applicable data protection legislation.

title: Salgssjef (Oslo)
description:
Om BrightAnalytics

BrightAnalytics er en ambisiøs, internasjonal scale-up innen fintech, støttet av private equity-investorer. Siden 2014 har vi hjulpet bedrifter med å gjøre sin økonomiske rapportering raskere, bedre og mer visuell, med et særlig fokus på mellomstore selskaper.

Vi har hovedkontor i Roeselare i Belgia og opererer fra fem internasjonale salgskontorer: Rotterdam, Oslo, Stockholm, København og Paris.

Vår ambisjon er å bli den ledende aktøren i det europeiske markedet.

Om plattformen vår

BrightAnalytics er en brukervennlig, pålitelig og rask plattform for ledelsesrapportering, som dekker finansiell, operasjonell, konsolidert og ESG-rapportering.

Med vår BrightSync-teknologi og over 450 integrasjoner mot ERP-, CRM- og regnskapssystemer omgjør vi automatisk rådata til sanntidsdashbord.

Ved å erstatte manuell rapportering gir vi CFO-er og beslutningstakere bedre forutsetninger for å ta raskere, datadrevne beslutninger.

Personal- og kompetanseutvikling

  • Du har en mastergrad innen økonomi, administrasjon eller tilsvarende.

  • Du har dokumenterte gode resultater fra minst fem års erfaring innen forretningsutvikling og/eller salg, eller erfaring fra en finansiell rolle og et ønske om å gå over til en entreprenøriell utfordring innen salg og forretningsutvikling.

Fordelene ved å bli en del av denne fintech-scale-upen

  • Vi er et økonomisk solid scale-up-selskap med internasjonale vekstambisjoner.

  • Vi har en åpen bedriftskultur med stor frihet til å ta initiativ.

  • Du blir en del av et engasjert, dynamisk og entusiastisk team, og kan se frem til en variert arbeidshverdag.

  • Afterwork på fredager, legendariske teambuilding-arrangementer og en årlig helgetur med hele BrightAnalytics-teamet.

Er du klar for å bli en del av et av de raskest voksende og mest bærekraftige fintech-selskapene i Belgia og Europa?

Søk i dag, og ta fatt på neste kapittel i karrieren din!

title: Senior Systems Engineer
description:
For more than 50 years, ENSCO has been providing leading-edge engineering, science and advanced technology solutions to governments and private industries worldwide.

ENSCO prides itself in creating and applying advanced technologies for mission success. We provide systems engineering, integration, and advanced technology services to transform the future safety, security, and resiliency of critical missions on the ground, in the air, in space, and in the information systems that connect these domains.

Learn more about ENSCO.

Position Description

ENSCO Inc. is a diverse engineering and technology company that provides engineering, science, and advanced technology solutions supporting mission success, safety, and security for government and commercial customers worldwide.

We are seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to work directly with Government mission leaders and independently governed program teams delivering elements of a critical space mission capability. Each participating organization may hold a different architecture vision, acquisition path, technical baseline, funding profile, and delivery schedule. This role creates trusted relationships and shared technical evidence needed to bring those efforts together.

The MILSATCOM Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (MSEIT) effort provides leading edge Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) for the Space Force’s Space System Command. We support the Space Force’s acquisition of state of the art Military Satellite Communications systems, providing global secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation’s warfighters. We seek technical individuals who will thrive in a highly collaborative work environment of small teams, using the most modern tools and methodologies to tackle the challenges of integrating complex space and ground communications systems.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain requirements for mission planning systems supporting MILSATCOM resource allocation, access scheduling, and payload configuration
  • Support engineering of mission planning tools for satellite access planning, terminal-to-satellite resource assignment, and frequency/bandwidth allocation
  • Analyze and model satellite coverage, link availability, and communications resource conflicts across MILSATCOM constellations (e.g., AEHF, WGS, MUOS)
  • Support development and refinement of scheduling and deconfliction algorithms for competing mission planning requests
  • Develop and maintain Interface Control Documents (ICDs) between mission planning systems, satellite control networks, and terminal segments
  • Support integration of mission planning software with satellite command and control (C2) and TT&C systems
  • Perform trade studies evaluating mission planning tool architecture, automation approaches, and system performance
  • Support Verification & Validation (V&V) of mission planning software and algorithm updates
  • Evaluate and document system risks associated with mission planning capabilities, coordinating mitigation strategies with government stakeholders
  • Support technical reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR) related to mission planning system upgrades and sustainment
  • Coordinate with RF engineering, flight dynamics, and satellite operations teams on link budget, orbital geometry, and resource availability inputs to mission planning
  • Support cybersecurity compliance for mission planning systems, including RMF/ATO documentation as applicable
  • Prepare technical documentation, briefings, and reports for government program office review
  • Collaborate with prime contractors, other support contractors, government civilians, and members of the U.S. Space Force

Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, mathematics, physics, or related technical field
  • At least 10 years of systems engineering experience, including at least 5 years in mission planning, satellite resource allocation, or scheduling systems engineering.
  • Deep understanding with satellite communications concepts (link budgets, frequency/bandwidth allocation, terminal-satellite access)
  • Ability to coordinate with numerous stakeholders and customers
  • Strong interpersonal skills to enable working and interfacing with diverse personnel and working in a dynamic team environment
  • Possess strong written and verbal communication skills, including public speaking
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • ABILITY TO OBTAIN AND MAINTAIN A DOD TOP SECRET SECURITY CLEARANCE IS REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION FOR WHICH, YOU MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN

Qualifications Desired

  • Master's degree in a technical field such as engineering, mathematics, physics, or computer science
  • Certifications in Systems Engineering (INCOSE ASEP, CSEP)
  • Experience with MILSATCOM programs such as AEHF, EPS, WGS, PTES, PTS, and FAB-T terminal programs
  • Experience with mission planning or scheduling software tools and algorithm development (e.g., optimization, deconfliction, or constraint-based scheduling)
  • Knowledge of orbital mechanics and satellite coverage analysis tools (e.g., STK)
  • Programming/scripting experience (Python, MATLAB, or similar) for planning tool support and automation
  • Knowledge and experience in Jira and Confluence
  • Experience working with military and DoD civilian clients
  • Experience and familiarity working on a government space systems program
  • Experience working on a Systems Engineering and Integration (SE&I) contract
  • Active Secret security clearance or higher

Work Location Type: On-Site

Required Certifications: None

U.S. Citizenship Required: Yes

Security Clearance Required: Ability to obtain top secret

Employment Type: Regular Full-time

Background Check Type: 7 Year Pre-Employment

Drug Screen Required: No

title: Medewerker Campus | Tijdelijke kerstbaan 🎄
description:
Ben jij gek op koken, houd je van gezelligheid en steek je graag je handen uit de mouwen? Dan hebben wij een leuke kerstbaan voor jou!

De gezelligste én drukste periode van het jaar staat voor de deur bij YourSurprise! Terwijl onze collega's volop bezig zijn om duizenden mensen blij te maken met persoonlijke cadeaus, zorgen wij op onze Campus voor een fijne sfeer, een warm welkom en natuurlijk heerlijk eten!

We zoeken een enthousiaste collega die ons Campus team in november en december komt versterken. Het liefst start je zo snel mogelijk en ben je 40 uur per week beschikbaar.

Samen met onze chefkok Leopoldo zorg jij ervoor dat onze collega's iedere dag kunnen genieten van een lekkere lunch. Maar er is meer! Je helpt mee om onze Campus tijdens de kerstdrukte gezellig, schoon en gastvrij te houden.

Tijdens de kerstperiode is het bij YourSurprise extra bijzonder. Er wordt hard gewerkt, veel gelachen en natuurlijk samen genoten van de gezellige kerstsfeer.

We helpen elkaar waar nodig, houden van aanpakken en maken er samen een mooie periode van!

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt ervaring in de horeca of keuken en vindt het leuk om voor grotere groepen te koken.

  • Je hebt kennis van de HACCP richtlijnen en werkt hygiënisch.

  • Je bent enthousiast, gastvrij en krijgt energie van een gezellige, drukke werkomgeving.

  • Je bent een echte aanpakker en ziet zelf waar hulp nodig is.

  • Je werkt graag samen, maar kunt ook zelfstandig aan de slag.

  • Je bent flexibel en vindt het geen probleem om af en toe in de avond te werken.

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar.

  • Je kunt zo snel mogelijk starten en bent beschikbaar in november en december.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • Een afwisselende baan in een enthousiast en gezellig team.

  • Een fijne werkomgeving waar je helemaal jezelf kunt zijn.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding voor zowel de auto als het openbaar vervoer.

  • Iedere werkdag een heerlijke lunch tegen een kleine vergoeding en vers fruit.

  • De kans om de bijzondere kerstsfeer bij YourSurprise van dichtbij mee te maken.

  • Gezellige vrijdagmiddagborrels en leuke activiteiten met collega's.

Zin om samen met ons de kerstperiode onvergetelijk te maken?

Kun jij niet wachten om de handen uit de mouwen te steken, samen met Leopoldo de lekkerste lunches te bereiden en onze collega's een fijne werkdag te bezorgen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

Solliciteer snel en wie weet sta jij binnenkort samen met ons te knallen tijdens de gezelligste periode van het jaar bij YourSurprise!

Let's make people feel special this Christmas! 🎁

title: Software Engineer III | Security
description:
At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running.

Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you.

Position Summary

An ideal candidate will have strong software engineering, networking, and cybersecurity fundamentals. This position works with security researchers and developers, developing systems to make them more efficient and effective. You'll deliver impactful solutions that empower research and development, as well as working directly with network data to emulate adversary behavior.

ExtraHop offers an exciting, high-energy, and versatile environment in which people are encouraged and supported to collaborate on industry-leading technology and create a world-class engineering team while they develop and enrich their individual growth. And we're doing it with creativity, intellectual curiosity, and deep critical thinking.

ExtraHop R&D supports fully-flexible work options that include full-time onsite, hybrid, and fully remote working arrangements. Except for a few roles that require physical access, we believe in supporting you in making the choice that works best for you and makes the team successful.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Threat Research and Detection Engineering teams by providing tools and automation to accelerate Research & Development.
  • Develop and support internal systems, including:
    • Software deployment pipelines supporting continuous delivery
    • Pipelines for ingestion of new network identifiers to enable fingerprinting of device, software, and cloud services
    • Threat Intelligence acquisition and sharing
    • On-demand threat research labs using modern Infrastructure-as-Code and Cloud-based technologies
    • Continuous Testing and Validation pipelines
  • Work with a collaborative, dedicated and seasoned team of engineers
  • Actively participate in code review to ensure quality and uplevel other engineers

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering
  • Excellent engineering chops
  • Solid knowledge of Python
  • Experience developing and deploying code for enterprise software applications with emphasis on code quality and maintainability
  • In-depth knowledge of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model and excellent working knowledge of the key protocols from Layer 2 through Layer 7
  • Self-starter with a strong problem-solving track record and ability to grow and learn
  • Excellent teammate and collaborator who can iterate on problems quickly.
  • Proficient at communication in both spoken and written forms, including documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with network packet-level data using tools like tshark, tcpdump, tcprewrite, and Scapy to directly interact with this data.
  • Strong understanding of TCP/IP and Layer 7 protocols

Compensation & Benefits: The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $163,000 per year, plus eligibility for an annual performance-based discretionary bonus and stock option grants. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage (effective Day 1), a 401(k) with employer match, flexible PTO, parental leave, and more.

ABOUT EXTRAHOP

ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments.

This comprehensive approach and market innovation have earned ExtraHop unique recognition as the only NDR vendor acknowledged as a leader by all major analyst firms, including the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant for Network Detection and Response™, the 2025 Forrester® Wave for Network Analysis and Visibility, the 2024 IDC® Marketscape for NDR, and the 2025 Gigamon® Radar Report for Network Detection and Response. title: Order Selector- 2nd Shift
description:
Overview

The Order Selector supports the daily operations of the Supply Chain Department by coordinating materials procurement, inventory control, and vendor communications. This position plays a vital role in ensuring that materials and finished goods move efficiently and safely through the supply chain to meet production and customer delivery requirements — all while maintaining strict adherence to safety standards and OSHA compliance.

Schedule:

Monday-Friday (2:30 pm-11:30 pm)

Key Responsibilities

Procurement & Inventory Quality Assurance

  • Pick and package orders accurately based on plant and customer requirements.

  • Prior forklift/reach truck experience required.

  • Oversee product and packaging quality to guarantee consistency, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

  • Source, order, and track raw materials, supplies, and components.

  • Process purchase orders and related documentation.

  • Manage raw material levels and communicate needs to the Supply Chain Manager.

  • Monitor inventory levels and reconcile discrepancies between physical counts and system records.

  • Collaborate with warehouse and production teams to maintain optimal inventory levels.

  • Support and uphold inventory control procedures, cycle counts, and safety stock requirements.

  • Ensure all inventory handling complies with OSHA and company safety regulations.

  • Participate in bi-annual plant inventories

Data Management & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in ERP or inventory management systems.

  • Assist with forecasting and planning activities to support production and logistics.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with production, purchasing, sales, and customer service to align supply chain activities with organizational goals.

  • Participate in process improvement initiatives to improve accuracy, efficiency, and safety.

  • Foster open communication across all departments to promote a safe, compliant, and productive work environment.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all OSHA regulations, company safety protocols, and proper PPE usage in warehouse and production areas.

  • Promote a culture of safety awareness and continuous improvement.

  • Immediately report unsafe conditions, near-misses, or potential hazards to management.

  • Ensure proper storage, labeling, and handling of materials to maintain a safe and compliant workspace.

Qualifications

  • Education: Associate’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred.

  • Experience: 1–3 years in supply chain or related roles (manufacturing experience preferred).

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and WMS software.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

  • Ability to operate a high-reach lift or forklift safely and in compliance with OSHA standards.

Physical Requirements

  • Lift up to 75 lbs. safely using proper techniques and equipment.

  • Stand or walk for extended periods (up to 8 hours).

Work Environment

  • Combination of office and warehouse settings with regular cross-departmental interaction.

  • Exposure to standard warehouse conditions where adherence to safety and OSHA compliance is essential.

Benefits:

Competitive Pay

Medical insurance

Dental insurance

Vision insurance

401K with company match

PTO

6 Paid Holidays

Attendance bonus

Summary:

As a Sr. GTM Engineer within the Professional Services arm of ZoomInfo, you will serve as a technical GTM consultant, leading complex enterprise build engagements and partnering closely with the sales organization to scope, architect, and pitch technical solutions. You will guide customer organizations through sophisticated GTM builds, designing and implementing scalable workflows, integrations, and architectures that drive measurable business outcomes.

ZI Professional Services partners with ZoomInfo's most strategic enterprise customers to modernize their GTM motions through comprehensive advisory and execution services spanning enterprise GTM strategy, advanced data architecture, account intelligence, demand generation, and operational enablement. As a Sr. GTM Engineer, you combine deep technical and product fluency with hands-on solution architecture and sales leadership to secure and deliver end-to-end technical solutions.

We are looking for an experienced technical consultant and trusted advisor who excels in high-stakes enterprise environments, contributes to services bookings through sales leadership, and is passionate about delivery excellence. As a Sr. GTM Engineer you will own the technical solution on your engagements, partner with Account Executives on discovery and scoping, mentor junior engineers, and partner with GTM Consulting to ensure seamless collaboration across both sub-disciplines.

What You’ll Do:

  • Serve as a technical subject matter expert and strategic partner to Sales, participating in scoping calls, discovery, hour estimation, proposal development, and SOW creation for build-oriented engagements.
  • Lead complex, multi-phase enterprise build engagements from solution discovery and architecture through implementation, launch, and customer enablement.
  • Design and build advanced workflows, automations, audiences, data flows, agent-enabled solutions, and other technical components across the product ecosystem.
  • Architect solutions involving enterprise data strategy, multi-instance CRM integrations, workflow automation, MCP and API patterns, and advanced audience segmentation.
  • Conduct technical assessments of customer GTM environments to identify architecture gaps, process inefficiencies, and high-impact automation opportunities.
  • Act as the primary technical lead and trusted advisor on assigned engagements, maintaining solution governance, cross-functional alignment, and build quality.
  • Facilitate working sessions with business, operations, technical, and executive stakeholders to drive solution decisions, secure buy-in, and maintain momentum.
  • Establish success criteria, validation approaches, and adoption measures in partnership with the customer, and track engagement status through weekly updates.
  • Identify and cultivate expansion and cross-sell opportunities within active customer accounts, partnering with account teams and GTM Consultants.
  • Mentor and coach GTM Engineer II and III team members, sharing best practices and raising technical quality across the team.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, CX, and Sales counterparts to ensure solution feasibility and surface product gaps from the field.
  • Partner with GTM Consultants when a customer need extends into broader strategy, process, governance, or operating model transformation beyond the immediate technical build.
  • Contribute to the discipline's service catalog, solution playbooks, estimation models, reusable architectures, and technical IP.
  • Maintain accurate time tracking and project plans in the team's operating systems.

What You Bring:

  • 5-7+ years of progressive experience in solutions engineering, technical consulting, implementation, or professional services within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environments.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Economics, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • Expert-level understanding of enterprise GTM technology ecosystems including complex CRM architectures (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics), marketing automation, sales engagement, intent platforms, and cloud data environments.
  • Proven track record of delivering multiple concurrent high-value technical engagements with rigorous solution governance.
  • Deep expertise in APIs, integrations, automation, and modern solution architecture, with a track record of successful enterprise technical deployments.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including experience partnering with Sales on scoping, hour estimation, proposals, and SOW development.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for practitioner and executive audiences.
  • Extensive experience authoring technical artifacts including architecture diagrams, workflow documentation, integration specifications, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Advanced command of emerging GTM technologies, including generative AI applications, intelligent automation, and agentic workflows.
  • Collaborative mindset with a proven ability to build trusted advisor relationships from practitioners to executive sponsors.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data analysis, querying, and reporting.
  • Hands-on technical experience with cloud data warehousing platforms (Snowflake, Databricks) and enterprise data architectures.
  • Experience with MCP, CLI tools, webhooks, and other programmatic solution patterns.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience mentoring or informally leading junior practitioners.
  • Experience managing project plans in tools such as Asana.

title: Associate Director, Compliance Management System (CMS)
location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Utah
description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the Role

Flex is building a modern compliance organization designed to scale with a high-growth fintech. Our goal is not only to meet regulatory expectations but to operate a technology-forward compliance function that uses automation, data, and AI-enabled workflows to improve quality, speed, and scalability.

The Associate Director, CMS, will own and evolve key components of Flex's Compliance Management System and help shape how compliance operates across the company. This role sits at the intersection of regulatory strategy, operational execution, and technology enablement, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Legal to build compliance into how Flex builds and runs its products. This role will own policy and standards, training, program management, and audit support.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. It reports to the Director, CMS Operations.

The right candidate brings strong regulatory expertise and a systems mindset: someone who can turn regulatory expectations into operational frameworks and find ways to modernize compliance through automation and AI-enabled tools.

What You Will Do

  • Own CMS policy, standards, and training: keep policies current, approved on schedule, and mapped to regulatory requirements, and keep training complete and current.
  • Serve as the day-to-day contact for partner banks on program management questions and requests; own the calendar of recurring deliverables, checking for accuracy and timeliness before they go out.
  • Run CMS program management: the governance calendar, committee materials, and tracking of control and issue owners to closure.
  • Translate regulatory expectations into clear, durable operational frameworks and controls that keep the organization audit- and exam-ready, and write them so another person can run them.
  • Support audits led by the Director, CMS Operations: prepare CMS evidence, coordinate responses, and track remediation to closure.
  • Use reporting from Compliance Reporting and Analytics and from Testing and Monitoring to find program gaps and drive changes to policy, training, and controls.
  • Use AI tools to speed up policy, training, and documentation work, checking the output before it is relied on.
  • Partner with Engineering and internal tooling teams to embed compliance controls directly into systems, automation, and data pipelines.
  • Act as a strategic partner to Product, Risk, Legal, and Engineering to support operational initiatives and product launches while maintaining regulatory defensibility.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of experience in financial services or fintech compliance with increasing program ownership and strategic scope.
  • Strong experience building or operating Compliance Management Systems or large programmatic compliance functions.
  • Deep expertise in consumer protection regulations, including Reg E, Reg Z, UDAAP, and FCRA.
  • Experience supporting regulatory exams, external audits, or bank partner oversight in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Comfortable finding opportunities to use automation, data, and AI-enabled workflows to improve compliance operations, and in the habit of checking AI output before relying on it.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills with the ability to identify systemic risk and operational improvements.
  • Effective communicator able to influence regulators, bank partners, executives, and technical teams.
  • Builder mindset, energized by creating scalable systems rather than maintaining legacy processes.
  • Bachelor's degree required; JD or advanced degree is a plus.

description:

title: Staff Growth Technology Manager
location: Oakland, California; San Diego, California; Mountain View, California; Charlotte, North Carolina
description:
Growth Technology is the commercialization platform team for Intuit's Consumer Group (powering TurboTax and Credit Karma). This role focuses on Credit Karma's paid marketing tech stack — signals, audiences, attribution, MMP, CDP, pipelines, BigQuery, and AI-native tooling — partnering closely with Credit Karma's growth marketing team on experiment design, channel sequencing, budget scaling decisions, and ROAS analysis.

About the Role

As the Senior Growth Technology Manager for AdTech, you will serve as the technical architect for understanding how Credit Karma's paid marketing signals and audiences work — shipping pipeline changes and building the tools to allow paid media team make buying decisions faster. You will carry deep expertise in buying and optimizing paid media, including signals, audiences, attribution, MMP, CDP, experiment design, and channel sequencing.

You are primarily responsible for direct, measurable ownership in ROAS efficiency with significant influence over paid media tech roadmap, and for ensuring we have the strongest signals with ad platform partners (Google, Meta, Snap, TikTok) and MMP partners like Kochava. This is a strategic, build-oriented, and hands-on technical role: you will serve as the technical point of contact in live, revenue-impacting incidents with ad platform partners.


Responsibilities

  • Signal & Audience Strategy: Architect signal and audience strategy across the paid stack, own conversion integrity end-to-end, and diagnose attribution issues at the architecture level. Lead real-time, revenue-impacting incident response — quantifying dollar impact and troubleshooting directly with Google, Meta, and Snap.
  • Experiment Design & Scaling: Design and run paid marketing experiments end-to-end (hypothesis, test/control, budget parity, results analysis) and turn outcomes into scaling decisions, in partnership with channel owners.
  • MMP & Pipeline Architecture: Own MMP strategy and operation (postback mapping, deep-link strategy, attribution matching), and set the data flow standards connecting BigQuery, pipeline configs, the CDP, and ad platforms — shipping the underlying pipeline code yourself when needed. Define partner onboarding requirements and advise on tag management architecture.
  • AI-Native Tooling & Agentic Solutions: Build and ship internal AI tooling and agentic automation for the marketing org — pipeline health monitoring, ticket triage, tag health monitoring, and performance reporting — by independently scoping requirements from ambiguous problems to shipped solutions.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Build the process to run without escalation, and own the metrics to measure team health.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree
  • Experience: 6+ years in marketing technology, growth marketing, or a related quantitative/technical role, with ownership of technical systems — not just execution against them.
  • Data & pipelines: Advanced SQL/Python and hands-on experience architecting audience and conversion data pipelines in BigQuery or an equivalent cloud data warehouse.
  • MMP expertise: Hands-on experience with a mobile measurement platform (Kochava, Branch, AppsFlyer, or equivalent), including attribution configuration, postback mapping, and platform migration.
  • Signal & CDP architecture: Experience architecting audience and conversion signal delivery across ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snap) and a CDP (Segment or equivalent).
  • Agentic/AI delivery: Has shipped at least one production AI or agentic automation tool (not just a prototype), including driving requirements from an ambiguous problem to a working solution.
  • Tag management: Hands-on Google Tag Manager experience (client- and server-side) and container governance.
  • Experimentation track record: Has designed and run structured marketing experiments (test/control, budget parity) that led to real scaling decisions.
  • Paid media scale: >$500M/year in aggregate paid media spend managed or directly influenced across platforms (Google, Meta, TikTok, Snap), with fluency in budget allocation, pacing, and ROAS trade-offs at that scale.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. title: Affärsansvarig SYD - Svensk Fastighetsförmedling
description:
Svensk Fastighetsförmedling är Sveriges största oberoende mäklarkedja. Vi har en stark position, men för att nå nästa nivå som kedja behöver vi dig. I Region Syd finns stora möjligheter att växa, och nu söker vi en Affärsansvarig som kan leda och coacha våra franchisetagare mot fler affärer, högre lönsamhet och på sikt marknadsledarskap i varje marknad.

Om rollen

Som Affärsansvarig Region Syd blir du snabbt en viktig länk mellan Svensk Fastighetsförmedling som franchisegivare och våra franchisetagare. I rollen varvas coachning med affärsutveckling med det gemensamma målet att få varje kontor att prestera bättre.

I det löpande arbetet innebär det bland annat att:

· Coacha franchisetagare i att utveckla sin verksamhet, sitt ledarskap och sina team

· Sätta individuella mål tillsammans med varje franchiseområde och följa upp dem genom regelbundna affärsuppföljningar.

· Analysera resultat och lönsamhet mot satta nyckelta, hitta orsakerna bakom siffrorna och tillsammans med franchisetagaren ta fram konkreta åtgärder.

· Säkerställa att vårt koncept och arbetssätt används i alla kontor, så att kvalitet och kundnöjdhet håller hög nivå.

· Bära vårt varumärke och vår kultur i regionen och sprida kunskap mellan franchisetagare och franchisegivarorganisationen

Du rapporterar till Affärsområdeschef Bostad och ingår i ett team med Affärscoach och Affärsansvariga för andra regioner. Du samarbetar dagligen med People & Culture, Marknad, och vår BI-specialist.

Vi söker dig som

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi det som avgörande att du har erfarenhet av att leda och coacha människor till bättre resultat, gärna inom liknande försäljningsorganisationer eller franchise. Vi ser att din starka affärsförståelse och förmåga att prata försäljning, lönsamhet, tillväxt och ledarskap med företagare kommer att ge dig många fördelar.

Vidare ser vi det som önskvärt att du:

· Är van att arbeta datadrivet; Analysera KPI:er, se mönster och gör analys till handling.

· Har erfarenhet av franchiseverksamhet, egen företagsdrift eller affärsutveckling i nätverk, gärna inom mäkleri eller annan tjänstebransch.

· Kan påverka utan formellt mandat; Franchisetagare är egna företagare, och du når resultat genom förtroende, kompetens, samarbete och tydlighet.

Som person är du drivande, ödmjuk och positiv. Du är operativt driven och gillar att få saker att hända, du ställer de svåra frågorna och du blir glad av att se andra lyckas. Du tar stort eget ansvar och är nyfiken på hur branschen utvecklas.

Det här erbjuder vi

En central roll med stort inflytande över utvecklingen i en av våra viktigaste regioner. Du får arbeta med engagerade företagare och kollegor i en organisation där det är högt i tak, där vi brinner för att skapa ett hållbart boendeliv och där vi tycker att det ska vara kul att gå till jobbet, eftersom det ger resultat, innovation och gemenskap.

Bra att veta

Rollen innebär regelbundna resor inom regionen, så B-körkort krävs.

Låter det intressant?

Ansök redan idag, vi intervjuar löpande. Vill du veta mer är du välkommen att kontakta Affärsområdeschef Kim Langeborg på kim.langeborg@svenskfast.se. Notera att ansökan sker via denna annons.

Svensk Fastighetsförmedling är Sveriges största rikstäckande och oberoende mäklarkedja. Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team med 1250 kollegor som stöttar varandra och utvecklas tillsammans. Vi arbetar aktivt för att du ska trivas och utvecklas och har flera år i rad utsetts till en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare. Hos oss erbjuds du som medarbetare löpande utbildningar, unika verktyg och en unik plattform där alla våra anställda har möjligheten att vara delägare. Kedjan ägs av över 700 medarbetare och franchisetagare. Vårt fokus är att vara ledande idag och i framtiden. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss via ,
