title: Manager, New Verticals - In-Store Data Platform Strategy & Operations
location: New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Los Angeles, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington, DC; Chicago, IL; Tempe, AZ
description:
About the Team

New Verticals is an exciting team at DoorDash that is building and scaling new ways to delight our customers beyond restaurant delivery.

Our Central Operations team, part of New Verticals Strategy & Operations, is re-inventing how consumers shop grocery, convenience, alcohol and retail by making every store’s digital shelf match the physical shelf. We do this by onboarding new data sources that improve selection coverage, price accuracy, inventory accuracy, and the location data that helps Dashers find the store and the item. When these get better, consumers see what they want at the right price and receive it with fewer substitutions and refunds, Dashers shop and navigate faster, and merchants sell more. You will partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to build AI-enabled tooling, launch operational processes at scale, own metrics, and pull operational and product levers across our Grocery, Convenience, Alcohol and Retail businesses.

About the Role

We are looking to hire a Manager to own how we onboard new data sources, external and internal, onto our ecosystem. Externally, you will bring on inventory and syndicated data providers, CPG branded data, in-store robotics companies, and other software and technology partners. Internally, you will find new ways to leverage the data we already have. Together, these sources align the physical inventory of brick-and-mortar stores with the digital inventory. You will also explore how these assets could grow into an inventory-as-a-service solution. You will partner with Machine Learning, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and Commercial teams. You will sit in the Central Operations group within our New Verticals Strategy & Operations organization and report into a Senior Manager. You will manage a team of two.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build from zero. You’ll take new data sources from ideation to production: sizing opportunities, structuring partnerships, running pilots, and scaling the winners across Convenience, Grocery, Alcohol, and Retail.
  • Think big. You’ll imagine what’s possible with new sources and new commercial models, including inventory as a service, and turn bold ideas into roadmaps.
  • Close the physical-digital gap. You’ll connect real-world signals from retailers, syndicated data, CPGs, robots, and software partners to improve selection coverage, price accuracy, inventory accuracy, and Dasher navigation.
  • Own the economics. You’ll define the commercial and business metrics that show when a source works and when it doesn’t, and weigh the lift against the cost to make clear scale, iterate, or stop decisions.
  • Lead. You’ll partner with Engineers, Data Scientists, Product Managers, and Commercial teams to integrate sources and drive measurable impact.

We’re excited about you because…

  • You think 0 to 1. You’re energized by ambiguity, think boldly and unconstrained about what new sources could unlock, and resist “this is how it’s always been done” thinking.
  • You’re creative about business models. You can see how data becomes a product, and help shape the strategy behind it.
  • You understand the interplay of commercial and business metrics. You know how selection, price, and inventory accuracy translate into conversion, retention, and cost, and you can tell when a data source is worth what it costs.
  • You’re analytical. You can extract and communicate meaningful insights from data to drive strategic decisions, and you are comfortable with SQL and data visualization tools.
  • You’re an operator and a partner. You’re comfortable in the details of data quality and store-level operations, and you can build and negotiate relationships with external vendors, CPGs, and technology companies.
  • You have 6-8+ years of experience. You’ve succeeded in high-performing cultures (tech, supply chain, operations, strategy, business development, consulting, banking, startups or a related experience), ideally with data partnerships, vendor management, or retail data.
  • You have a completed Bachelor’s Degree, and MBA is a plus.

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

title: Technical Trainer Lead, Design (Contract)
description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges. As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. We bill for our time, offering our expertise and problem-solving approach to help our government partners enhance their digital products and services. People are at the heart of our work, from members of the public who rely on benefit programs to government agency staff. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

Position type: Hourly, Full-time

Contract type: 1099 Independent contractor

Location: On-site at the client's state capital, monthly or as needed. Otherwise, Remote (U.S.based)
Contract duration: 12 months
Reports to: Design Hiring Lead
Start date: Contingent upon contract award, but soon after

This position is contingent on contract award.

Position summary

The Technical Trainer Lead prepares staff at a state workforce agency for each major launch milestone of Nava's paid family and medical leave benefits solution. They design and deliver role-based train-the-trainer sessions for the agency's claims adjudicators, appeals judges, contact center agents and supervisors, product owners, and leadership. The role also manages the training environment and assesses staff readiness ahead of each milestone. It bridges the agency's business operations and Nava's technology teams to ensure the program works in practice for the people who use it.

The role has no direct reports and succeeds through influence rather than authority. It establishes training standards and templates for product managers and designers to follow, evaluates quality through readiness checks and accessibility and plain-language reviews, and escalates gaps to the Program Manager and Senior Program Manager. The role does not own the materials individual teams develop for their respective solutions, the Knowledge Base, the release calendar, or release go/no-go decisions.

What you'll do

  • Design and deliver role-based train-the-trainer sessions built on real job scenarios, co-led with agency super-users from the first milestone.
  • Run a training sandbox (with a Nava engineer, using synthetic data) and run scripted readiness checks before each milestone. Report readiness to Program Leadership on a metrics dashboard they design.
  • Set the templates and content standards (plain language, Section 508) that product managers and designers follow; update training after every release.
  • Hand over editable materials so the agency can keep training after Nava leaves.

Required skills

  • 10 to 15+ years designing and delivering role-based training, including train-the-trainer, for government or other regulated operations staff.
  • Adult-learning instructional design built around real job tasks and scenarios.
  • Experience keeping training in step with agile releases or milestones.
  • Plain-language writing, plus training or certification in Section 508 accessibility.
  • Facilitation and influence skills; has led without direct authority.
  • Client-facing: bridges business operations and technology teams and represents the employer to stakeholders.

Please note: Consultants/Contractors are not eligible for Nava benefits unless hired in a full time capacity.

Compensation is in hourly rate

title: Revenue Enablement Lead
description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your impact on our Mission:

Zocdoc’s mission is to give power to the patient. As a Revenue Enablement Lead, you’ll help our revenue teams build the product knowledge and customer insight they need to create better conversations and deliver more value to healthcare providers.

You’ll own enablement for assigned Zocdoc products and healthcare domains—from launch readiness through ongoing learning. You’ll also partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Revenue leaders to turn complex information into practical, scalable experiences that improve seller readiness and business outcomes. In this highly visible role, you’ll shape how teams learn, adapt, and bring new products to market, thereby helping Zocdoc deliver more value to providers and the patients they serve.

You’ll enjoy this role if you are...

  • Energized by turning complex product and healthcare concepts into clear, useful learning experiences.
  • Comfortable owning programs from strategy and planning through hands-on execution.
  • Curious, collaborative, and motivated by building trusted partnerships across teams.
  • Interested in using feedback, data, and experimentation to improve how people learn and perform.
  • Excited to help revenue teams connect product knowledge to meaningful customer and business outcomes.
  • Adaptable when priorities evolve, and thoughtful about balancing quality, speed, and scale.

Your day to day is…

  • Leading enablement plans for product launches, enhancements, and new capabilities.
  • Translating complex product, business, and healthcare concepts into clear, actionable learning experiences.
  • Building and maintaining scalable programs using a mix of self-paced learning, live training, practical exercises, assessments, and reinforcement.
  • Partnering with onboarding teams to help new hires develop the product and domain knowledge they need to succeed.
  • Defining readiness goals and using learner feedback, assessments, and business data to measure and improve program effectiveness.
  • Developing trusted partnerships across Product, Product Marketing, Revenue Leadership, and subject matter experts.
  • Ensuring educational content is accurate and relevant as products, processes, and priorities evolve.

You’ll be successful in this role if you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in Revenue Enablement, Sales Enablement, Product Enablement, Learning & Development, or a related field.
  • Experience developing and delivering enablement or learning programs that support product launches, seller readiness, or ongoing capability development.
  • Strong instructional design and learning skills, with the ability to make complex topics easy to understand and apply.
  • Experience managing multiple projects, balancing priorities, and delivering high-quality work in a changing environment.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership, stakeholder management, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • A data-informed approach to connecting learning goals with seller behavior and business outcomes.
  • Experience with LMS platforms, e-learning authoring tools, Salesforce, Gong, or similar enablement technologies is helpful.
  • Familiarity with healthcare, provider needs, or healthcare technology is a plus—not a requirement.

  • 401(k) with employer funded match
  • Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
  • Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)

  • Cell phone reimbursement

title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location: Texas - San Antonio (onsite at project locations)

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

  • Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.
  • Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.
  • Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.
  • Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.
  • Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.
  • Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

  • Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.
  • Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.
  • Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.
  • Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.
  • Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.
  • Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.
  • Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.
  • Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.
  • Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.
  • Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

  • Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.
  • Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.
  • Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

  • Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.
  • Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.
  • Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.
  • Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.
  • Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.
  • Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.
  • Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.
  • Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.
  • Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.
  • Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.
  • Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.
  • Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.
  • Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.
  • Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.
  • Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.
  • Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.
  • Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & reference check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

title: Level 3 Business Administration Apprentice
description:
1.0 General Role Responsibilities

Support the smooth day-to-day running of the Social Housing team through accurate administration, responsive client communication and effective management of information. Assist with issuing bond terms, reviewing development plans and maintaining client records in Salesforce, while gradually developing the knowledge and confidence to manage a small number of lower-stakes client accounts under appropriate supervision. Contribute to a consistently professional client experience and build the skills required to progress towards an Account Manager or Bond Officer role.

2.0 Role Specific Responsibilities:
Level 3 Business Administration Apprentice

2.1 Overview

Working within the Social Housing team, the successful candidate will provide essential administrative and operational support across client accounts and bond-related activities. The role combines correspondence, record keeping, document preparation and coordination with opportunities to learn about bond terms, development plans and client account management. With training and guidance, the apprentice will progressively take on more responsibility, including a small portfolio of lower-stakes accounts, with the longer-term aim of developing into an Account Manager or Bond Officer.

2.2 Role Specific Tasks

Key responsibilities, undertaken with training and supervision appropriate to the apprentice’s experience, include:

· Handle incoming calls and emails, responding professionally, progressing routine queries and referring more complex matters to the appropriate colleague.

· Organise inbound and outbound correspondence, ensuring documents and digital files are accurate, accessible and appropriately stored.

· Maintain accurate client, development and bond-related records, including filing, checking and updating information.

· Use Salesforce CRM to enter and update client information, record communications, track actions and support the administration of accounts.

· Assist with preparing and issuing bond terms, ensuring relevant information and documentation are complete and checked through the appropriate approval process.

· Review development plans and supporting documents, identifying relevant information and raising questions or discrepancies with experienced colleagues.

· Support the day-to-day administration of Social Housing client accounts, monitoring outstanding information and following up agreed actions.

· Gradually manage a small number of lower-stakes client accounts under supervision, providing timely updates and maintaining a positive client experience.

· Prepare reports, letters, spreadsheets and meeting materials, ensuring accuracy and consistency.

· Coordinate meetings, calls and appointments, keeping clear notes and tracking follow-up actions.

· Handle confidential information in line with GDPR and company data protection policies.

· Undertake wider administrative duties and participate in training to develop commercial, technical and relationship-management skills.

The responsibilities outlined are representative of the principal duties associated with the role. Colleagues are expected to work flexibly and undertake other appropriate duties as required.

3.0 Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a reliable, enthusiastic and organised individual who is keen to begin or develop a professional career. This is an entry-level apprenticeship, suitable for school or college leavers as well as those seeking a new direction. Previous office, CRM or housing-sector experience is not required. We value a positive attitude, attention to detail, good communication and a genuine willingness to learn. The successful candidate will receive training and support while gradually developing responsibilities within the Social Housing team.

· Reliable and punctual, with good time management and a commitment to the role.

· Eager to learn new skills, accept guidance and engage with training.

· Positive, motivated and willing to support colleagues.

· Careful and accurate when completing tasks and following instructions.

· Friendly, approachable and able to communicate clearly.

· Organised in managing tasks, paperwork and information.

· Basic IT confidence and a willingness to learn how to use Outlook, Word, Excel, Salesforce and other business systems; prior experience with these systems is not essential.

· Ambitious and interested in progressing towards an Account Manager or Bond Officer position as skills and experience develop.

4.0 Additional Desirable Attributes

Some experience of administration, customer service or organising information would be an advantage, whether gained through part-time work, work experience, volunteering or education. However, no previous employment or office experience is necessary. We welcome applications from candidates at the start of their careers who demonstrate enthusiasm, reliability and potential. Full training will be provided, including on Salesforce, bond processes and the social housing sector.

5.0 Indevor Group Introduction

Indevor Group is the UK’s leading provider of Infrastructure Support Services to the Housebuilding and Built Environment Sectors. Indevor prides itself on providing innovative solutions to serve our clientele, with a focus on delivering vital ancillary services to housebuilders.

Our clients include some of the UK’s leading FTSE 100 companies and leading New Homes Warranty Providers, including the National House Building Council.

We have built a culture that balances ambition with support. Our commitment to our people has earned us Gold accreditation from Investors in People, a Construction News Best Place to Work 2026 nomination, and recognition in The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026).

We are looking for people who want to become part of our evolving story, embrace challenges and contribute to our ambitions.

6.0 Company Specifics Introduction

The position is based in Euxton, Chorley, within the Social Housing team, reporting to the Housing Sector Lead. The role is initially office-based, with potential for hybrid working following induction. The apprentice will receive structured training in administration, Salesforce, client communications, bond terms and development plan reviews.

Responsibility for a small number of lower-stakes accounts will be introduced progressively, according to capability and supervision, supporting future progression towards an Account Manager or Bond Officer role.

title: Lead Product Manager, Salesforce (Hybrid)
description:
We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas or take over sponsorship at this time.

About the Role:

We are currently seeking a highly capable and experienced Salesforce Product Manager to join our Product Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the strategy, development, and management of our Salesforce platform, including Sales Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Sales Engagement, and integrations with AWS and contact center systems. You are expected to bring your Salesforce expertise and lead the evolution of Enova’s current Salesforce implementation. This position calls for a leader who is innovative, decisive, and focused on delivering exceptional products. As a leader you will collaborate with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, engineering, and operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for our Small Business Salesforce platform: Sales Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Sales Engagement.
  • Tie each initiative to measurable outcomes such as sales productivity, conversion, and customer retention, and report results after launch.
  • Partner with Salesforce architects and developers on solution design, including data model, Flow vs. Apex, integrations, and security, while managing tech debt.
  • Write clear user stories with testable acceptance criteria, and own backlog priority and sprint readiness.
  • Manage integrations and dependencies between Salesforce and connected systems, including AWS services, contact center telephony, marketing automation, and our data warehouse.
  • Explain technical decisions and trade-offs to sales, operations, and executive leaders in terms of cost, risk, timing, and impact on their teams.
  • Run discovery with sales reps, managers, and operations teams to map processes and turn their needs into requirements.
  • Lead adoption of AI and agentic capabilities in Salesforce, such as Agentforce and Einstein, for sales and operations teams.
  • Plan for Salesforce seasonal releases and feature retirements, and run launch communication, training, and adoption tracking.
  • Build features that meet lending and communication regulations (TCPA, consent, data privacy) in partnership with Legal and Compliance.

Requirements:

  • 7+ years in Salesforce product management, business systems analysis, or consulting, including in-house ownership of an enterprise Salesforce org
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model, automation, and security model, with the ability to read Flow and Apex well enough to evaluate trade-offs with engineers
  • Experience with Salesforce integrations (REST APIs, Platform Events, Change Data Capture, middleware), including diagramming end-to-end data flows
  • Understanding of platform limits (governor, API, storage) and how they shape solution design
  • Familiarity with the Salesforce development lifecycle: sandboxes, source control, CI/CD, and release management
  • Ability to query and analyze data using SOQL or SQL and Salesforce reports
  • Experience on Agile/Scrum teams using Jira, including writing acceptance criteria
  • Track record of explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical executives, in writing and in person
  • Shipped products with measurable results in sales or customer operations
  • Experience leading cross-functional work across sales, operations, and engineering

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Salesforce Financial Services Cloud experience
    • Background in lending, fintech, or another regulated industry, including consent management
    • Contact center and CTI integrations, and conversation intelligence tools
    • Sales Engagement cadences, and Marketing Cloud Engagement or Account Engagement
    • Agentforce, Einstein, or Data Cloud implementation
    • AWS integration patterns (Lambda, API Gateway, event-driven architecture)
    • Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Business Analyst, Sales Cloud Consultant, or Agentforce Specialist

Compensation:

The budgeted annual salary range for this position is $120,000 - $160,000. Actual annual salary will be determined based on qualifications, skills, experience, and level assessed during the hiring process and may fall outside of the range shown. Additional compensation for this role may include a bonus. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in Company benefits, described in more detail here.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance including mental health benefits

Enova International is a leading financial technology company that provides online financial services through our AI and machine learning-powered Colossus™platform. title: Resource Management Manager
description:
Resource Management Manager

Role summary

The Resource Management Manager runs CFGI's day-to-day staffing engine. This person administers Retain, keeps scheduling processes standard across locations, and matches staffing requests to available capacity. They also report utilization and flag capacity gaps so that practice leads and senior leadership can make deployment decisions with better data.

The role works closely with IT, Operations, Onboarding, Learning & Development, Recruiting, and department and regional leadership. It is built to carry the function today and to become the foundation of a larger Resource Management team as CFGI grows.

Key responsibilities

Staffing platform ownership

  • Owns Retain administration: user access, roles, and permissions across the employee lifecycle (onboarding, transfers, promotions, leaves, departures).
  • Owns configuration, routine upkeep, bug resolution, and enhancement planning with IT and the vendor.
  • Owns data integrity and the accuracy of forecasts and reports pulled from the system.

Staffing requests and capacity

  • Runs the intake and matching of staffing requests to available resources across departments and locations, using the bios and skills repository and the availability check-in list.
  • Partners with Practice Leads, Engagement Managers, Recruiting, and regional leaders to understand demand and availability.
  • Builds and maintains a rolling capacity view that shows upcoming staffing gaps; supports business development conversations with availability information.
  • Supports final deployment decisions on large or sensitive engagements, which stay with leadership.

Utilization and reporting

  • Monitors utilization, bench time, and deployment rates, and identifies imbalances between demand and capacity.
  • Produces regular reporting for department leaders and prepares the executive-level workforce metrics package; supports leadership in presenting it.

Process, SOPs, and governance

  • Owns standardized scheduling processes, SOPs, and job aids, and keeps them current as Retain and the process change.
  • Drafts staffing workflows and playbooks designed to scale as headcount and engagement volume grow.
  • Ensures changes to Retain and the scheduling process are communicated and adopted consistently; supports system implementations and related initiatives.

Training and onboarding

  • Leads new-hire scheduling training with Onboarding and Learning & Development; develops and maintains training materials.
  • Coordinates pre-planned PTO and leaves for new hires so teams and the back office are aware.

Cross-functional coordination and global scope

  • Serves as the central point of coordination for scheduling, staffing requests, utilization, and Retain.
  • Clarifies roles and responsibilities for system ownership, access approval, and request handling.
  • Sets consistent global standards while accounting for local practices, and keeps global, regional, and local leaders informed.

What you must have

  • 3–7 years of experience in resource management, staffing operations, scheduling, or workforce planning.
  • Hands-on administration of a staffing or scheduling platform.

What sets you apart

  • Working knowledge of consulting project lifecycles and role hierarchies.
  • Knowledge of billable vs. non-billable utilization.
  • Experience building and interpreting utilization reports and capacity forecasts.
  • Experience writing SOPs, training others, and driving consistent process adoption.

Nice to have

  • Experience in professional services or consulting, ideally within a Big 4, national consulting, or high-growth advisory firm.
  • Retain experience preferred; Salesforce PSA/resource modules a plus.
  • Experience supporting a system implementation or process rollout preferred.
  • PMP, CSM, or similar certification preferred.

Who thrives here

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally with leaders across departments, regions, and locations.
  • Brings strong analytical skills and process discipline.
  • Comfortable creating structure where little exists, and tolerant of ambiguity as the function grows.
  • Builds trust quickly with practice leads and engagement managers who have competing staffing priorities.

title: Medical Monitoring Director
description:
Let’s build the future of medicine - together.

Remote | Full-time | $280,000 - $330,000

YOUR ROLE

As a Medical Monitoring Director at Enveda, you'll be a sponsor physician on our clinical trials: medical monitor on the studies you take on, the physician who oversees the consultant medical monitors on the rest, and, as trials move in house, the person who builds the in-house medical monitoring team. You'll report to the SVP, Clinical Development, work day to day with the clinical leads, Clinical Operations, Biostatistics, and our in-house Pharmacovigilance team, and be the clinical owner of the AI tools our engineers build for blinded safety monitoring. The medical decisions on your studies are yours, and the consultant monitors work to plans you sign. This is a high impact opportunity where you'll influence the medical oversight of a three-program clinical pipeline while collaborating with some of the brightest minds in the industry.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Serve as the sponsor's medical monitor on your studies, blinded where the study is blinded: eligibility and protocol questions from sites, the sponsor's causality assessment on every serious adverse event, and the medical judgment calls the protocol asks of the sponsor's physician
  • Sit on the dose-escalation safety review committees for our Phase 1 studies and chair the internal blinded safety review for each study, presenting the sponsor's update in the open session of the independent data monitoring committee where a study has one
  • Write the medical monitoring plans, own the protocol's stopping rules, dose-modification rules, and safety monitoring schedule with each clinical lead, and contribute the medical content of investigator's brochures, safety update reports, and study reports
  • Do the medical review the data needs: protocol deviations, MedDRA and WHODrug coding, SAE reconciliation, and the listings before database lock
  • Set the standard for the consultant medical monitors: onboard them, define the plans and escalation paths they work to, review their decisions, and share the 24-hour medical monitor line with them
  • Be the clinical owner of the AI tools Enveda's engineers build for blinded safety monitoring: define what a medical monitor needs to see, set the flag rules, write the acceptance criteria, and sign off on each release. The tools work on blinded data only and flag and draft for you. Seriousness and causality are assessed by you, expectedness and reportability by Pharmacovigilance, which also holds the unblinding, and none of them by a tool
  • Train investigators and sites on safety reporting and eligibility, and keep the function inspection-ready with SOPs and a searchable record of medical decisions
  • Build the in-house medical monitoring team as trials move in house: define the roles, then hire and lead as the team is approved

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • MD or DO (or equivalent) who has completed residency training and practiced clinically. Board certification and an active medical license are preferred
  • 5 or more years in industry medical monitoring or drug safety, including hands-on medical monitoring of Phase 1 and Phase 2 studies, ideally in inflammatory, immunologic, dermatologic, gastrointestinal, or metabolic disease
  • Working knowledge of ICH E6(R3), E2A and E2F, US IND safety reporting, MedDRA coding review, and SAE reconciliation, and of the early-phase safety assessments an oral small molecule needs (liver safety, QT, stopping rules)
  • Experience overseeing CRO or consultant medical monitors and pharmacovigilance vendors, and with blinded safety review committees and independent data monitoring committees
  • Data-driven judgment: you turn adverse event, laboratory, vital sign, and ECG data into clear decisions, protect the blind, and know when a participant's safety comes first
  • AI-native or AI-curious: you can say what a tool should do for a medical monitor, how you would check its output, and what it must never decide
  • Ego-lite, hands-on, and patient-first: collaborative, direct, no task too big or small, and never losing sight of who the trial is for

We hire for trajectory, not just credentials. If you meet most of the above and care deeply about this problem, we want to hear from you.

ABOUT ENVEDA

We're a clinical-stage, AI-enabled biotech discovering medicines from nature four times faster than the industry standard. We recently raised $311M in a Series E, bringing total funding to over $845M, and doubled our valuation to $2B. We now have three oral medicines in the clinic, including our lead drug, ENV-294, in Phase 2 trials for eczema and asthma. Forbes named us one of America's Best Startup Employers, and Newsweek recognized us as a Top 100 Most Loved Workplace. We're still early, and most of the best work is ahead of us.

Benefits (Starting Day 1): Medical, dental, and vision covered at 90%, 401(k) with company match, flexible PTO and a company-wide weeklong recharge break, adoption assistance

Our Process: We move fast and respect your time. Typically: a recruiter screen → hiring manager conversation → work sample, technical interview, & culture interview.

Our Values: Curiosity | Agency | Journey | Charity | Unity

Enveda is protecting Job Seekers

We care deeply about creating a safe, respectful experience for every applicant, so we wanted to share a few guidelines to help you spot anything that doesn’t feel right.

  • You’ll always meet real Enveda team members through video or in-person conversations before receiving an offer.
  • All communication from us will come from an @enveda.com or @envedabio.com email address.
  • We’ll never ask you to purchase equipment, send money, or share sensitive banking details as part of any step in our recruiting process.

If something feels off or you’re unsure whether a message is truly from Enveda, please reach out at anytime at [email protected]

At Enveda, we’re building a place where everyone can do the best work of their life. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in all its forms. Apply now and join a team committed to shaping the future of drug discovery.

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
BRPH is a technically focused, creative architecture, engineering, and construction company with over six decades of expertise in helping mission-driven clients in the aerospace, defense, manufacturing, commercial, education, entertainment, hospitality, and federal markets identify gaps in their program delivery and develop innovative solutions to their most challenging problems across the U.S. and around the world. Consistently ranked among the nation’s top firms, we take pride in solving complex challenges with forward-thinking solutions.

As an employee-owned company, BRPH is known for its collaborative culture, technical excellence, and client-focused approach, bringing together multidisciplinary teams to design and build environments that are functional, efficient, and future-ready.

SUMMARY:
The Construction Project Manager serves as BRPH/integration vendor’s day-to-day representative at the assigned site. This role coordinates with the integration vendor, the Program Management Office (PMO), contractors, designers, and technical authorities to keep construction and system installation activities aligned. The Project Manager identifies interface conflicts early, obtains direction before they affect follow-on work, and maintains field records through correction and closeout. The role supports construction, installation, testing, turnover, and final documentation.

This position requires long-term residence in the Republic of Korea for the assigned period and travel as needed for the project. Quarterly return travel to the United States will be coordinated around site coverage.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Lead daily site coordination meetings covering planned work, access, inspections, deliveries, safety constraints, decisions, and open actions.
• Review drawings, specifications, schedules, submittals, RFIs, interface documents, and known site constraints. Attend planning meetings.
• Coordinate site readiness, including access, badging, security, safety, communications, document control, reporting procedures, and the temporary site office.
• Develop and maintain an interface register for civil, structural, electrical, mechanical, communications, antenna, Radome, and security work.
• Observe infrastructure work, including foundations, ring walls, conduit, power, equipment spaces, cooling, grounding, and bonding, against approved project requirements.
• Coordinate work across contractors and technical disciplines. Identify conflicts, document their potential impact, and route questions to the appropriate decision-maker.
• Maintain RFI, issue, deficiency, inspection, escalation, and punch-list records. Track assigned actions through disposition, verification, and closure.
• Coordinate trade access, equipment movement, shared work areas, testing prerequisites, and antenna and Radome installation activities.
• Observe system interfaces, including shielding, cable separation, fiber, structured cabling, power quality, UPS, and environmental controls.
• Collect approved changes, field redlines, photographs, measurements, test information, and closeout records to support aggregate as-built drawings and turnover.
• Prepare daily site status reports and weekly progress reports. Produce inspection reports and other technical deliverables as required by the customer.
• Support readiness, testing, completion, corrective work, and turnover reviews.
• Perform other duties as assigned to support successful project execution and completion.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:
Required:
• Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, quantity surveying, or a related discipline; five years of relevant work experience may substitute for the degree.
• Minimum of five years of experience in project management, construction coordination, field coordination, or multidisciplinary integration.
• OSHA 30 or EM 385 qualification.
• Experience coordinating contractors, designers, construction organizations, and technical stakeholders.
• Working knowledge of civil, structural, electrical, conduit, equipment-space, grounding, and HVAC systems.
• Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, schedules, and interface documents.
• Strong written communication, organization, field leadership, and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to obtain required U.S. Passport, visa, base access, badging, and security credentials.

Preferred:
• Experience with antenna, Radome, RF infrastructure, mission-critical, or sensitive electronic systems.
• Knowledge of grounding, bonding, shielding, cable separation, fiber, structured cabling, power quality, and UPS interfaces.
• Experience on U.S. Government, Department of Defense, or USACE projects.


PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
• Ability to navigate and move around the construction site, which may involve walking, climbing ladders and scaffolding, and standing for extended periods on uneven surfaces.
• Ability to lift to 50 pounds.
• Ability to handle tools, equipment, and perform tasks that require coordination and manual skills.
• Manual dexterity, hearing, mental acuity, typing, reaching, repetitive motion, speaking, talking, and visual acuity.
• Ability to operate a motor vehicle.
• Ability to stand and sit for periods longer than 30 minutes but not to exceed two hours consecutively.
• Ability to produce clear, accurate, and legible written text, numbers, symbols, and drawings.
• Ability to learn complex tasks and remember how to complete tasks without assistance once trained.
• Ability to remain composed, focused, and professional while effectively managing high-pressure situations and tight deadlines. Quick thinking and decision-making ability to address issues and challenges that may arise during project execution.
• Ability to work in various weather conditions and handle the physical demands of supervising a construction project.
• Strict adherence to safety protocols and the ability to enforce safety standards on the construction site.
• Adherence to personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements when on the construction site, such as hard hats, safety vests, and steel-toed boots.

Salary range is $130,000 - $170,000, DOE

This job description may be changed to include new responsibilities and tasks or change existing ones as management deems necessary.

EOE, including Disability/Vets

title: System Performance Engineer, Senior
location: San Diego, California, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > PPT Systems Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Systems Engineer, you will research, design, develop, simulate, and/or validate systems-level software, hardware, architecture, algorithms, and solutions that enable the development of cutting-edge technology. Qualcomm Systems Engineers collaborate across functional teams to meet and exceed system-level requirements and standards. Qualcomm's System Performance Team is responsible for optimizing and validating performance for Qualcomm Snapdragon Chipsets across all business units such as Mobile, Compute, Automotive, IOT, Server and Data Center AI. In the role of System Performance Engineer, you will collaborate with software, hardware, and architecture teams to optimize power, performance, and thermal behavior of the system and be a technical lead to junior engineers across multiple projects. You will leverage your advanced systems knowledge and experience to research, simulate, and validate performance and ensure product requirements are met.

Key Responsibilities

· Enable, profile and analyze complex concurrent system use-cases in both emulation and software environments (Android/Linux/Windows)

· Define and document performance and power analysis plans for system use-cases across multiple workloads (CPU, GPU, AI/ML) as well as concurrent scenarios.

· Identify areas of performance optimization in the SoC for both Software and Hardware architectures

· Direct triage of complex performance issues to determine root-cause and present results to internal and external stakeholders

· Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product management, hardware, and software engineering, etc.) to implement optimal power, performance, and thermal solutions.

· Provide technical leadership, mentor and guide engineers to successfully execute multiple programs.

· Prepare clear and concise reports and recommendations for product teams up to senior executives to help drive business decisions and next generation architecture choices.

· Defining and developing automation for the team to operate more efficiently

Preferred Qualifications

· Master’s degree in Computer Engineering

· 4+ years of practical post-silicon experience of power and performance analysis of complex SoCs

· Strong programming and scripting skills (Python, C/C++)

· Strong communication and collaboration skills.

· Self-starter and able to work independently.

Knowledgeable in state-of-the-art workloads including AI, LLM

· Understanding of memory hierarchy, and system interconnects

· Understanding of ARM SoC concepts and architecture specifications like SMMU, GIC, Coresight-PMU, and various bus interface protocols

· Knowledge and experience in ARM v8 and v9 specifications

· Experience with Vulkan, OpenGL, DX12, or CUDA

· Understanding of industry power and performance benchmarks along with system interaction and dependencies

· System power/performance analysis tools and techniques

· Computer hardware and architecture understanding

· Knowledge of SW Power management stacks and scheduler behavior

title: Tie-, katu- ja aluesuunnittelijoita Ouluun ja Rovaniemelle
description:
Etsimme tie-, katu- ja aluesuunnittelijoita Ouluun ja Rovaniemelle

Etsimme tie-, katu- ja aluesuunnittelijoita Tie- ja katuosastolle Ouluun ja Rovaniemelle. Suunnitteluprojektimme vaihtelevat maanteiden, tieympäristöjen, liittymien, katujen ja muiden väylien suunnittelusta laajoihin alueellisiin tie-, katu- ja liikennejärjestelyihin. Projektimme kattavat koko Suomen aina pääkaupunkiseudulta Lappiin saakka.

Asiakkaitamme ovat erityisesti Väylävirasto, elinvoimakeskukset, kaupungit ja kunnat sekä yksityiset tahot. Olemme mukana monipuolisissa suurissa tie-, väylä- ja aluesuunnitteluhankkeissa eri puolilla Suomea. Lisäksi meillä on paljon kiinnostavia pieniä ja keskisuuria hankkeita, joita toteutamme useiden puitesopimustemme tai erillisten kilpailutusten kautta.

Suunnittelijana suunnittelukohteesi voivat olla yksittäisten tie- ja katukohteiden tai laajempien alueiden esi-, yleis-, tie- ja rakentamissuunnitelmia. Hankkeisiin sisältyy usein myös vesihuollon ja kuivatuksen suunnittelua. Tehtävää on mahdollista räätälöidä osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaisesti esimerkiksi pääsuunnittelijan tai projektipäällikkön roolin. Tehtävän tarkempi sisältö voidaan rakentaa osaamisesi, kiinnostuksenkohteidesi ja ammatillisten tavoitteidesi ympärille. Osaamisesi karttuessa saat mahdollisuuden kasvattaa vastuutasi ja suunnata uraasi sinua kiinnostaviin tehtäviin.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää

  • Koulutus: insinööri (AMK) tai diplomi-insinööri / vastaava korkeakoulututkinto

  • Vähintään kolme vuotta infra-alan suunnittelukokemusta

  • Kokemusta projektityöskentelystä

title: Infant Stimulation Development Specialist
description:
Infant Stimulation Development Specialist – Psychology / Early Intervention

Pay: $23.00–$29.00 per hour

  • Bachelor's Degree: $23.00–$26.00/hr

  • Master's Degree: $27.00–$29.00/hr

Compensation is based on education, relevant experience, and qualifications.

Position Type: Part-Time, with opportunities for additional hours based on client needs and availability.

About Nurture & Nature ABA

Nurture & Nature ABA is a BCBA-owned, clinician-led organization committed to providing ethical, high-quality developmental and behavioral services. We prioritize mentorship, collaboration, and individualized care that supports both families and clinicians.

Our Early Sparks Infant Stimulation Program provides play-based, relationship-centered developmental intervention to infants ages 3–16 months, supporting early learning, communication, motor development, and caregiver engagement.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking compassionate, energetic, and developmentally minded professionals with a background in Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Early Intervention, Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), or related fields.

We are especially interested in Psychology graduates with experience working with infants, toddlers, or young children in early intervention or ABA settings.

This position is ideal for professionals passionate about early childhood development who enjoy providing individualized, play-based services and collaborating with families.

Important Scheduling Information

  • Infant Stimulation sessions are typically one hour per appointment, with schedules determined by family needs and client availability.

  • This is initially a part-time opportunity, with a minimum availability requirement of 15 hours per week.

  • Candidates interested in increasing their weekly hours should be open to supporting additional ABA cases, based on qualifications, clinical needs, and case availability.

  • ABA sessions are primarily scheduled during afternoon and evening hours, typically 2:30 PM–7:30 PM.

  • Additional hours are dependent on client availability and are not guaranteed.

We encourage applicants who have flexibility across both daytime Infant Stimulation appointments and afternoon/evening ABA sessions.

Key Responsibilities

As an Infant Stimulation Development Specialist, you will:

  • Provide individualized, one-on-one developmental intervention to infants ages 3–16 months.

  • Implement play-based, naturalistic teaching strategies aligned with Denver Model/ESDM-informed principles.

  • Support early developmental milestones, including:

    • Communication, gestures, and vocalizations

    • Social engagement and joint attention

    • Sensory exploration and regulation

    • Fine and gross motor development

    • Imitation, object play, and early cognition

    • Incorporate developmental learning opportunities into everyday routines and play.

    • Support caregiver involvement through modeling and developmentally appropriate strategies.

    • Implement individualized developmental goals under clinical supervision.

    • Collect and maintain accurate developmental progress data and session documentation.

    • Collaborate with clinical supervisors and families to support consistent, family-centered services.

    • Maintain professional communication, reliability, and consistency with scheduled families.

    • Perform other duties as assigned.

      • Additional ABA Opportunities: Qualified clinicians interested in additional hours may also provide direct ABA services to children with developmental or behavioral support needs, under appropriate clinical supervision.

Required Qualifications

alifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology, Developmental Psychology, Child Development, Early Childhood Education, Human Development, or a closely related field.

  • Minimum one year of relevant experience supporting infants, toddlers, or young children in Early Intervention, ABA, Infant Stimulation, or related developmental services.

  • Understanding of early childhood developmental milestones and age-appropriate learning strategies.

  • Ability to engage children through play-based, naturalistic intervention.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with caregivers and clinical teams.

  • Reliable transportation and willingness to travel to assigned clients within a 20-mile service radius.

  • Ability to complete required background checks and TB screening.

  • CPR/First Aid certification or willingness to obtain.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology or Developmental Psychology with relevant Early Intervention or ABA experience.

  • Direct experience providing services to infants and toddlers ages 0–3.

  • Experience implementing ABA interventions under BCBA supervision.

  • Familiarity with Denver Model / Early Start Denver Model (ESDM) principles.

  • Experience with caregiver coaching and family-centered intervention.

  • Knowledge of developmental assessments, milestones, and progress documentation.

  • Experience with naturalistic teaching and play-based learning.

  • Bilingual abilities, including Spanish or ASL.

  • Interest in professional growth within Early Intervention, ABA, or infant development.

Schedule & Availability

  • Employment: Part-Time to start.

  • Minimum Availability: 15 hours per week.

  • Infant Stimulation Sessions: Typically one hour per appointment, scheduled during daytime and early evening hours based on family availability.

  • Additional ABA Cases: Primarily between 2:30 PM and 7:30 PM, Monday through Friday.

  • Service Area: In-home and community-based services within a 20-mile radius of the clinician's primary home ZIP code.

  • Scheduling Commitment: Candidates must maintain their agreed-upon availability to support continuity of care.

    • Please Note: Due to the shorter duration of Infant Stimulation appointments, candidates seeking a higher weekly caseload are strongly encouraged to have flexibility for additional afternoon/evening ABA assignments. The number of scheduled hours will vary based on client needs and availability.

Physical Requirements

This is an active, hands-on developmental role requiring the ability to:

  • Sit on the floor, kneel, bend, and participate in infant play.

  • Lift up to 30 lbs.

  • Engage in movement-based, sensory, and developmental activities.

Why Join Nurture & Nature ABA?

  • BCBA-Owned & Clinician-Led: Supportive and collaborative clinical leadership

  • Mentorship & Professional Growth: Ongoing training and development opportunities

  • Balanced Service Areas: 20-mile service radius

  • Tuition Discounts: Partnership with The Chicago School

  • Approved Practicum Site: Pepperdine University and California State University, Northridge

  • Wellness Reimbursement: Annual self-care allowance

  • Phone & Administrative Stipends: When applicable

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Health, Dental & Vision Insurance: 70% employer-paid for eligible employees

  • Paid Holidays, Vacation & Sick Time: Based on eligibility

  • Mileage & Drive Time Reimbursement

  • Employee Discounts: Access to discounts with 3,600+ companies

  • Professional Development & Conference Opportunities

Join Our Early Sparks Team!

If you have a background in Psychology, Early Intervention, or ABA and are passionate about supporting early childhood development, we would love to hear from you.

Join a clinician-led organization where you can make a meaningful impact during the earliest stages of development while continuing to grow professionally.

title: HANKINTAPÄÄLLIKKÖ, ADWATEC
description:
Adwatec Oy on vahvasti kasvava tehoelektroniikan vesijäähdytysjärjestelmiä suunnitteleva ja valmistava yritys. Olemme toimineet jo vuodesta 2000 saakka ja vuodesta 2007 olemme keskittyneet vesijäähdytyslaitteisiin. Tavoitteemme on olla johtava ja innovatiivisin vesijäähdytysalan toimija maailmanlaajuisesti. Meidät palkittiin Pirkanmaan vientipalkinnolla 2024.

Asiakkaamme ovat kansainvälisiä sähköteollisuuden ja marine-sektorin huippuyrityksiä. Laitteidemme käyttökohteet ovat absoluuttista luotettavuutta vaativia, esimerkiksi sähköverkkoasemia tai laivojen propulsiokäyttöjä. Olemme osa vakavaraista perheomisteista Helkama Emotor -konsernia, jonka liikevaihto on yli 50 MEUR ja joka työllistää yli 100 henkilöä.

Meillä pääset mukaan sähköistyvän maailman kasvutrendiin, joka mahdollistaa vihreämmän tulevaisuuden. 🌱

Etsimme nyt uuteen rooliin

HANKINTAPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ

ottamaan kokonaisvastuuta hankinnan ja toimittajaverkostomme pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä.

Hankintapäällikkönä saat vastuullesi monipuolisen kokonaisuuden, jossa yhdistyvät strateginen hankinta, toimittajasuhteiden kehittäminen, kaupalliset neuvottelut sekä käytännönläheinen yhteistyö toimittajien ja oman organisaatiomme kanssa. Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti siihen, miten hankintamme tukee Adwatecin kasvua, kilpailukykyä ja toimitusvarmuutta.

Vastaat toimittajien kilpailutuksesta, arvioinnista ja valinnasta sekä toimittajasopimusten neuvottelusta ja kehittämisestä. Suunnittelet ja toteutat toimittaja-auditointeja sekä seuraat ja kehität toimittajien suorituskykyä laadun, toimitusvarmuuden, kustannusten ja reagointikyvyn näkökulmasta.

Samalla kartoitat uusia ja vaihtoehtoisia toimittajia sekä rakennat toimittajaverkostoamme kohti pitkäjänteisiä strategisia kumppanuuksia. Tunnistat hankintaan ja toimitusketjuun liittyviä riskejä, analysoit kustannuksia ja kehität hankinnan toimintamalleja systemaattisesti.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä tuotannon, suunnittelun, laadun, logistiikan, projektien ja myynnin kanssa. Tehtävässä toimit itsenäisessä ja vastuullisessa roolissa, mutta saat ympärillesi osaavan organisaation ja tuen strategisen tason kysymyksiin.

Ketä etsimme?

Etsimme tehtävään kokenutta teollisuuden hankinnan ammattilaista, jolla on vahvaa näyttöä strategisesta hankinnasta, kaupallisista neuvotteluista sekä toimittajaverkoston tavoitteellisesta kehittämisestä. Odotamme valmiutta esihenkilötehtäviin liiketoiminnan ja roolin kasvaessa.

Tehtävässä onnistuminen edellyttää ymmärrystä teknisistä komponenteista ja valmistavasta teollisuudesta. Erityisen hyödyllistä on kokemus esimerkiksi koneistetuista osista, ohutlevytuotteista tai muusta teknisestä alihankinnasta. Tekninen koulutus antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan, mutta myös vahva teknisen hankinnan työkokemus voi rakentaa tarvittavan osaamisen.

Sinulla on vahvat kaupalliset neuvottelu- ja sopimustaidot sekä kyky tarkastella hankintaa kokonaisuutena. Ymmärrät laadun, toimitusvarmuuden, kustannusten ja toimitusketjun välisiä riippuvuuksia ja osaat tunnistaa konkreettisia säästö- ja kehitysmahdollisuuksia. Kokemus toimittaja-auditoinneista ja toimittajien systemaattisesta kehittämisestä katsotaan eduksi.

Persoonana olet käytännönläheinen ja aikaansaava. Sinulla on itseluottamusta omaan tekemiseesi ja otat luontevasti omistajuuden vastuullesi kuuluvista asioista. Olet valmis haastamaan nykyisiä ratkaisuja rakentavasti, etsimään uusia vaihtoehtoja ja neuvottelemaan tarvittaessa määrätietoisesti.

Tehtävässä tarvitset sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa sekä valmiutta matkustaa toimittajien luokse Suomessa ja kansainvälisesti.

Miksi Adwatec?

Tarjoamme vakituisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän kasvavassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan hankinnan ja toimittajaverkostomme kehitykseen. Tässä tehtävässä et tule vain ylläpitämään valmiita toimintamalleja, vaan saat mahdollisuuden kehittää niitä ja rakentaa hankinnasta entistä vahvemman osan liiketoimintamme kilpailukykyä ja kasvua.

Rooli tarjoaa myös mahdollisuuden kasvattaa omaa vastuualueesi liiketoiminnan ja organisaatiomme kehittyessä. Tulevaisuudessa tehtävässä voi avautua mahdollisuus myös esihenkilövastuuseen.

Adwatecissa noudatetaan hybridityömallia, joka mahdollistaa osittaisen etätyöskentelyn. Tehtävä sijaitsee Vehmaisissa Tampereella, missä kaikki toimintomme sijaitsevat samoissa tiloissa. Uudessa ja modernissa tehtaassamme sinulla on erinomaiset mahdollisuudet tiiviiseen yhteistyöhön yhtiön eri toimintojen kanssa.

Pääset mukaan yritykseen, joka on aidosti vihreässä siirtymässä mukana ja jonka tulevaisuudelle on näkyvissä hyvää ja maltillista kasvua. Käytössämme ovat tulospalkkiojärjestelmä ja Epassi-hyvinvointietu. Tarjoamme lisäksi mahdollisuuksia kouluttautumiseen ja ammatilliseen kehittymiseen kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä.

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle tehdään huumausainetestaus.

Miten hakea?

Jos mielenkiintosi heräsi ja tunnistat itsesi yllä olevasta kuvauksesta, juttelisimme mielellämme kanssasi lisää sinusta, Adwatecista työnantajana sekä tehtävän tarkemmista yksityiskohdista. Kerro itsestäsi jättämällä hakemuksesi oheisen linkin kautta. Haku on avoinna 23.11.2026 saakka. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Tehtävä alkaa mahdollisimman pian valitun henkilön aikataulun mukaan.
