title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location: Texas - El Paso (onsite at project locations)

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

  • Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.
  • Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.
  • Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.
  • Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.
  • Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.
  • Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

  • Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.
  • Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.
  • Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.
  • Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.
  • Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.
  • Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.
  • Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.
  • Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.
  • Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.
  • Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

  • Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.
  • Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.
  • Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

  • Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.
  • Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.
  • Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.
  • Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.
  • Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.
  • Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.
  • Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.
  • Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.
  • Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.
  • Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.
  • Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.
  • Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.
  • Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.
  • Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.
  • Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.
  • Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.
  • Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & reference check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

title: Glitter Rewell etsii 20h myyjää
description:
Pidätkö siitä, että teet jokaisesta asiakaskohtaamisesta jotain erityistä?

Glitterillä jokainen käynti on mahdollisuus luoda todella hyvä asiakaskokemus, ja se alkaa sinusta. Etsimme sinua, joka rakastat myyntityötä, olet motivoitunut saavuttamaan tavoitteita ja sydämelläsi tarjoat henkilökohtaista palvelua, täynnä tunnetta ja energiaa. Tykkäät stailaamisesta, vinkkien antamisesta ja tykkäät auttaa asiakkaitamme löytämään uusia suosikkeja tuotteistamme. Meillä työniloa pidetään itsestäänselvyytenä – kun meillä on hauskaa yhdessä, se näkyy myymälässä ja tarttuu asiakkaisiimme. Työskentelet luontevasti myös arvojemme mukaisesti: Otamme oman vastuun, olemme omistautuneita, me välitämme ja kaikki on mahdollista! ✨

Mitä tulet tekemään kanssamme?

Myyjänä Glitterillä olet tärkeä osa tiimiä ja ratkaiseva tekijä upean asiakaskokemuksen luomisessa. Päiväsi tulevat olemaan monipuolisia, täynnä energiaa ja täynnä kohtaamisia ihmisten kanssa. Tulet muun muassa:

  • Työskentelemään aktiivisesti myynnissä ja tarjoamaan markkinoiden parhaan asiakaskokemuksen

  • Varmistamaan, että myymälä on inspiroiva, hyvin täytetty ja siisti koko päivän ajan

  • Auttamaan asiakkaita löytämään oikeat tuotteet

  • Suorittamaan päivittäisiä tehtäviä, jotka liittyvät myymälän toimintaan

Onko tämä sinua? 🙋

  • Olet sitoutunut myyjä, joka rakastaa asiakaskohtaamisia ja motivoituu tulosten saavuttamisesta

  • Sinulla on intohimoa ja vahva kiinnostus muotia ja trendejä kohtaan

  • Edistät hyvää ilmapiiriä ja luot hyvää tiimihenkeä kollegojesi kanssa

  • Viihdyt nopeasti etenevässä työympäristössä ja monenlaisissa tehtävissä

  • Olet vastuuntuntoinen, joustava ja sinulla on positiivinen asenne

  • Aiempi kokemus kaupallisista tehtävistä, myynnistä tai asiakaspalvelusta on eduksi

Olet yli 18-vuotias

Tarjoamme sinulle 💚

  • Inspiroivan ja innostavan työpaikan sekä mukavat kollegat

  • Hyvän perehdytyksen työhön, haasteellisen työn ja hienot mahdollisuudet edetä urallasi

  • Hyvät työsuhde- ja henkilökuntaedut

Etsimme henkilöä, joka haluaa tehdä töitä noin 20 h/vko ja aloittaa mahdollisimman pian. Paikka on vakituinen. Meillä Glitterissä on 6. kuukauden koeaika. Palkka määräytyy kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Huomioithan, että täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Voit lukea meistä lisää kotisivuiltamme , hakemukset jätetään allaolevan linkin kautta, viimeinen hakupäivä on 15.11.26. Valitettavasti emme voi vastata yhteydenottoihin puhelimitse.

Voit erittäin mielellään jättää hakemuksesi jo tänään!

title: Business Engagement Manager-Retina-Northeast
description:
Before reading the job post, we encourage you to watch this video about our company. It gives you an inside look at how we started, the team and culture that made us successful, and where we're going. It's easy to read a job post and apply, but people often wonder about the culture and whether they would fit in. If you want to call Harrow your home and genuinely want to be part of a family and something big, then we encourage you to click this link and get to know us.

Who is Harrow?

Harrow (Nasdaq: HROW) is a leading provider of ophthalmic disease management solutions in North America. Harrow is an incredible entrepreneurial company – where we celebrate the ability of every member of the Harrow Family to be the CEO of their job. Harrow’s values have driven interest over the past decade in attracting high-performing professionals in a variety of disciplines. Members of our Harrow Family often express their pride in being a part of our commitment to (1) innovation, (2) patient access to affordable medicines, and (3) our track record of having never turned down an ophthalmologist doing mission work around the world – providing free medicines in support of mission work aimed at giving or maintaining the gift of sight to those most in need. We encourage you to learn more about Harrow and its unique culture to see if you’re the right person to help contribute as we build a truly exceptional company, one we are all so proud of!

Harrow’s ophthalmic pharmaceutical portfolio is one of the most comprehensive in the industry, including:

  • An expanding Retina Portfolio including IHEEZO®, TRIESENCE®, BYOOVIZTM, and OPUVIZTM
  • A broad Dry Eye Disease product line, led by VEVYE® and bolstered by well-known adjacent ocular surface disease products such as FLAREX® and FRESHKOTE®
  • A peri-operative Surgical product line, led by TRIESENCE®, and BYQLOVITM
  • A Rare and Specialty product line, which includes various high-need and utility products such as ILEVRO®, NATACYN®, and VERKAZIA®
  • A robust internal development pipeline with multiple late-stage candidates, including MELT-300, MELT-210, H-N08, and CR-01

Business Engagement Manager (BEM)
Harrow | Reports to: Director, Business Engagement


Position Summary
The Business Engagement Manager will be responsible for managing business in an assigned base of new and existing customers for Ophthalmology and Retina. This position reports to the Director, Business Engagement, and participates as a key member of the commercial team within their assigned region, with primary responsibilities that include obtaining various MBOs, inclusive of managing current GPO contracts and conducting quarterly business reviews with accounts in the assigned geography. The role will also include customer retention and advocacy that ensures portfolio performance achieves defined outcomes.
This role will also cultivate executive leadership relationships in assigned accounts. This individual will ideally be based in a location with relatively easy access to the base of assigned customers. The position requires travel up to 50% of the time.


Core Responsibilities
• Appropriately communicate, educate, and explain to practices/ASCs and their leadership the posterior portfolio GPO contract offerings, and any updates on such offerings, using approved messaging and materials.
• Serve as a liaison between Harrow and assigned accounts as identified by commercial leadership, in an account management role.
• Ensure appropriate utilization of the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
• Execute cohesive strategies and collaborate compliantly with Marketing, Field Sales, GPO, Market Access, and Inside Sales.
• Effectively manage the assigned operating expense budget for travel and customer training.
• Monitor Harrow’s share percentage of portfolio products within the assigned territory or accounts.
• Evaluate customer, market, and competitor activity and update the organization accordingly.
• Establish and maintain effective access and reimbursement initiatives and triage where appropriate.
• Utilize resources to enhance productivity and provide optimal customer satisfaction.
• Maintain a high level of communication and collaboration with the Area Sales Director and KAM Team on strategic initiatives and physician engagement.

Qualifications & Requirements
• 5–10+ years of strategic Retina and/or Ophthalmology sales experience; ophthalmic market experience preferred, specific to Ophthalmology and Retina.
• Bachelor’s degree, with MBA desirable (additional years of service can replace MBA).
• Experience with the execution of targeted business plans around priorities and goals.

title: Director, Market Research, Competitive Intelligence & Forecasting
description:
Definium Therapeutics is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company and our mission is to forge a new era of psychiatry by applying scientific rigor to psychedelics, with the goal of developing accessible treatments that unlock healing at scale.

Our lead product candidate, lysergide tartrate (our proprietary orally disintegrating tablet form of lysergide (LSD) D-tartrate), represents a highly differentiated, potential best-in-class opportunity for patients suffering from generalized anxiety, major depressive disorder, and posttraumatic stress disorder. Our early stage pipeline includes DT402, the R-enantiomer of MDMA and is under development to target the core symptoms of autism spectrum disorder (ASD), specifically addressing social communication challenges.

Guided by the recognition that patients deserve more than better, Definium is relentlessly advancing a new generation of therapeutics intended to address the underlying causes of psychiatric and neurological disorders. By turning evidence into impact, Definium aims to change the trajectory of today’s mental health care crisis and enable a healthier future. Headquartered in New York, Definium Therapeutics trades on Nasdaq under the symbol DFTX.

Together we are moving psychiatry forward—beyond better, into a boundless future. Join us!

The Director, Market Research, Competitive Intelligence & Forecasting will lead the development of market insights, competitive intelligence, and commercial forecasts that inform Definium Therapeutics’ commercial strategy, portfolio planning, launch readiness, and long range business planning. The individual will own the integrated process for understanding the market, anticipating competitive change, and translating evidence into patient-based demand and revenue forecasts. This role will partner closely with Finance, Marketing, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, and senior leadership and will manage the functional budget and external partners for market research, competitive intelligence, and forecasting.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the integrated market research, competitive intelligence, and forecasting strategy for assigned assets and indications
  • Develop and execute primary market research across healthcare professionals, patients, caregivers, payers, and health systems to address priority business questions
  • Integrate primary research with epidemiology, claims, electronic health record, prescription, payer, and other secondary data to generate actionable insights
  • Lead competitive intelligence monitoring and assess clinical, regulatory, scientific, access, and commercial developments that may affect strategy or market opportunity
  • Own patient-based demand and revenue forecasts, including transparent assumptions, data sources, model documentation, and governance
  • Lead Long-Range Planning, budget, Latest Estimate, and forecast-update cycles in partnership with Finance and Commercial leadership
  • Develop base, upside, downside, and strategic scenarios, with sensitivity analyses that quantify key risks, opportunities, and forecast drivers
  • Translate research and competitive developments into implications for market assumptions, launch strategy, portfolio decisions, and investment priorities
  • Communicate insights, forecast outputs, risks, opportunities, and recommendations through concise, executive-ready materials for senior leadership and the Board
  • Manage market research agencies, forecasting consultants, competitive intelligence partners, data providers, functional budgets, and internal knowledge repositories

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, life sciences, economics, analytics, statistics, public health, marketing, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of progressive pharmaceutical or biotechnology experience across market research, competitive intelligence, forecasting, commercial analytics, business insights, or related disciplines
  • Demonstrated experience independently developing or managing pharmaceutical patient-based demand and/or revenue forecasts
  • Experience with Long-Range Planning, annual budget, Latest Estimate, forecast updates, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing primary market research and integrating findings with secondary data and quantitative analytics
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. pharmaceutical commercialization process and healthcare environment
  • Experience with claims, electronic health records, prescription data, epidemiology, payer/access data, and competitive intelligence sources
  • Experience managing external vendors, projects, and functional budgets
  • Ability to travel up to 10% by air and/or car, including occasional overnight travel

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree in business, life sciences, economics, analytics, public health, or a related field
  • Experience in psychiatry, neuroscience, specialty therapeutics, or another complex specialty market
  • Experience forecasting a pre-launch asset through commercialization, including launch uptake and longer-term demand scenarios
  • Experience supporting product launch, indication expansion, lifecycle strategy, or portfolio evaluation
  • Experience integrating primary research, epidemiology, claims, competitive intelligence, analogs, and financial assumptions into commercial forecasts
  • Experience establishing or evolving a market insights, competitive intelligence, and/or forecasting capability within a small or mid-sized biotechnology company
  • Experience presenting market insights and forecasts to senior leadership or executive decision-making forums
  • Familiarity with modern forecasting, analytics, visualization, and AI-enabled insight tools

Individual compensation within the range is determined based on factors such as relevant skills, experience, qualifications, scope of the role, and other legitimate business considerations. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus and equity opportunities. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k) with company match, flexible time off and additional wellness benefits and perks. Learn more about our benefits on our Careers page.

The anticipated base salary range for this position is:
$195,000—$290,000 USD

title: Developer Relations Lead
description:
Developer Relations Lead

Zenrows is the web data infrastructure for AI. Founded in 2021, we give developers, AI agents and businesses one reliable way to access, extract and structure data from any website, at any scale, however hard the site tries to block them.

Whether it’s an agent that needs fresh web context mid-task, an LLM application grounded in live data, or an enterprise pipeline pulling millions of pages a day, Zenrows handles the rendering, the anti-bot defences and the parsing behind a single API, 10B+ requests a month. Teams at more than 10,000 companies, including Microsoft, Amazon, Dell, IBM, Slack, eBay, EY, Nokia and Clay, rely on Zenrows to turn the web into a reliable source of data for their products, workflows and AI-driven applications, across e-commerce, finance, real estate and AI.

As we continue our rapid expansion, we are now looking for our first Developer Relations Engineer to join us on a permanent basis, make an instant impact and build our DevRel function from the ground up.

The Role

Nobody has ever done this job at Zenrows and that’s the exciting part! You’ll be our founding DevRel, which means there’s no playbook or legacy processes to inherit, and nobody telling you how it should be done. You get a blank canvas, real ownership and the freedom to build and scale the function from scratch the way you think it should be built.



What You’ll do

  • Working alongside our GTM team, you’ll combine your technical advocacy and community skills to build credibility and help developers discover, experiment with, and integrate Zenrows. Ultimately adoption is the goal and success will be measured on that. We want Zenrows to be a name everyone recognises.
  • As the face of Zenrows, you’ll be out there in the real world. You’ll give talks, run technical workshops, and collaborate with relevant developer communities. You’ll also own our hackathon programme. Which ones we sponsor, where we speak, and being there on the day, talking to the people building cool things with our tools.
  • Engaging with the online community is equally as important. When you’re back at your desk, you’ll drive discussions where developers already hang out, such as Reddit, X and Discord. You’ll create videos, demo content, templates and sample apps, plus open-source projects, GitHub contributions, starter kits and developer integrations. You’ll show developers what’s possible with Zenrows and get them experimenting.
  • This role is as much about listening as it is about telling. Taking what you’ve learned, you’ll also handle the feedback loop between the community and the product and engineering teams.
  • Zenrows already integrates with hundreds of tools that developers love. Our goal is simple and ambitious: make Zenrows part of every agentic developer’s stack.

What We’re Looking For

Nobody is equally brilliant at everything. We’ll lean into your strengths and grow the function from there.

  • You’re technical, first and foremost. You don’t need to be a hard core developer but you can write Python, JavaScript or similar. You’re comfortable with APIs/SDK, AI agents and can build demos, apps and integrations with the product yourself.
  • You’ve got demonstrable technical and community-building experience. You’re confident on camera and the stage, and have a public body of work you’re proud of. We’d love to see your videos, talks, demos, repos or posts.
  • You have a track record of running events, talks or community initiatives. We want someone whose passion is clear and is active in AI/agent developer ecosystems such as GitHub, Reddit, Discord, Hacker News, Stack Overflow.
  • You’ve built developer ecosystems, open-source initiatives or technical communities from scratch, and you know how to get noticed without a big brand or logo behind you.
  • You measure success in impact, not just reach. You’re driven by API integrations, open-source adoption, and community engagement converting into active customers
  • Being the only person in the function excites you rather than scares you! In the end, this is yours to own and you’ll need to be comfortable making big decisions and running with them.
  • You’re a skilled technical writer. Documentation is mainly owned by engineering but you’ll also be expected to contribute in time


Bonus points if:

  • You already have an audience of your own. Perhaps a newsletter, a YouTube channel or a strong following on X.
  • You've done real web scraping and can talk about proxies, browser automation and anti-bots.
  • You’ve organised a hackathon (or won one!).


Why You Will Love Working Here

  • Our people crave ownership and opportunity over everything else. We offer responsibility and scope to do things in your role that you can only dream of in similar roles in larger companies.
  • We have a CEO who values world class talent over everything else. Trust and respect is earned and with it comes reward and recognition like nowhere else.
  • In a world where it feels like everyone is being called back being in an office, we operate a truly 100% remote approach that allows you to work from anywhere you choose.
  • Forget Agile, Scrum, Lean... or whatever development methodology is trendy this week. We give you a horizontal view that enables you to identify where you think you can contribute the most.
  • We have fun! The above may sound like we are all about work but we put a lot of focus on ensuring our culture is one that our people enjoy, lets you build lasting friendships and grow both personally and professionally.

Why You Might Not Fit

  • We are a small yet efficient team of 20, and our competitors are 10x our size. We manage to outperform them because everyone takes ownership of their work, holds themselves accountable and focuses on delivering meaningful outcomes. If you’re just looking for a job rather than a mission then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • We are an agentic company, and agents are an essential part of how every team works. If you aren’t excited to build, delegate to and take ownership of AI agents in your day to day, then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • We work 100% remotely and give our people the freedom to work wherever they choose. To offset this there is naturally more need to document and update workflows than in other companies. If you hate documenting then you probably shouldn’t apply.
  • Feedback is how we better ourselves every day and we foster a culture that encourages everyone to have a voice. If you don’t like being surrounded by world class talent that will always express strong opinions then you probably shouldn’t apply
  • We are a start-up and know the growth journey holds plenty of lessons to learn. If you are looking for the perfect organization, flawless processes and predictability in your day to day then you probably shouldn’t apply.


Our Rewards and Benefits

  • 100% remote work: We are a company that offers true freedom. Work wherever life takes you.
  • The salary you are worth: We never ask people what they are earning but instead what you are looking for. If your ability and experience justifies it and we think you are going to help us succeed then we will match your expectations.
  • The equipment you want: We believe in giving our people the tools they need to succeed and don’t have a default machine to give you.
  • Generous Learning & Development budget: We believe in always adding value to our top performers and helping them grow their skills in a direction that is beneficial both to them and the business
  • All Star Awards: We recognize achievements in many ways within the business but the bi-annual All star rewards allows the CEO to tailor reward packages to the person. Whether this is a holiday destination of choice, a learning course that adds value or something else.. We believe in getting to know every employee personally.
  • Charity Initiatives: We are a business that believes in giving back to the community and every year allows our employees the opportunity to give back.
  • Annual Kick-Off: We want our employees to see where Zenrows was born and enjoy all the Pintxos they can handle.
  • Share in Our Success: We want our top performers to be part of the company's success and offer opportunities for stock option allocation when people show their value.
  • Deel Benefits: As a fully remote organization we employ our people via Deel. This not only brings freedom of location but also a host of other benefits including discounts on VPNs, memberships and services.


Values

We are proud of our uniquely agile, fast paced, and autonomous environment. Our core values of Ownership, Dedication, Impact, Transparency and Agility run through everyone who works for us, and everything we do.

We are a sociable company and don’t let a fully remote model stop us from feeling connected to the place we work and the people that we work with. The atmosphere across the business is friendly and supportive, with a constant desire to improve in everything we do!


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Here at Zenrows we are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion but recognise that we can always do more. Every job description is subject to scrutiny through a gender bias decoder ensuring our roles are as inclusive and attractive as possible. Our culture is one that aims to nurture a welcoming and safe working environment for everyone with initiatives that embrace our globally diverse family. We are committed to protecting the mental health of our employees and aim to create a great place to work, whoever you are and wherever in the world you work from.


Privacy and Your Data

At Zenrows, we prioritize the privacy and security of data entrusted to us. We are committed to complying with all applicable data protection regulations and industry best practices. As part of our team, you will contribute to creating and maintaining systems that uphold the highest standards of data integrity, confidentiality, and transparency. Your role will help ensure that we continue to protect sensitive information, foster trust with our customers, and support a privacy-first culture across our organization.

Any job offer that we may make to you will be subject to you successfully passing background checks.

title: Spiritual Care Counselor
description:
Why Work for Us?
Partners In Care (PIC) is an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization and the largest, oldest provider of home health, palliative care, and hospice services in Central Oregon. Serving Deschutes, Crook, and Jefferson counties, our dedicated team of over 200 employees and 200 volunteers delivers compassionate, patient-centered care across a 10,000-square-mile area. Additionally, Hospice House in Bend, Oregon, is a specialty hospital for inpatient hospice care, creating an oasis of tranquility and comfort for patients and their families. We prioritize excellence, empathy, and collaboration, fostering a culture of kindness, respect, and learning while valuing diversity and the well-being of our employees, volunteers, patients, and families.
Status: Full-time (hourly, non-exempt), 40 hours per week.
Compensation: $27.98-$44.66 per hour based on experience.
Hours: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday-Friday. Scheduled days to be determined by department supervisor.
Location: Working in the field throughout Central Oregon in patients' homes and facilities.
Benefits:
  • We offer two medical, dental, and vision plans. Insurance starts on the 1st of the month following the hire date!
  • Generous Paid time off.
  • $25,000 life insurance policy.
  • Short and long-term disability.
  • 403b retirement savings with employer match, no vesting required!
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary benefits: Legal Shield, AFLAC & MASA Transportation.
Summary/Objective: The Spiritual Care Counselor is responsible for providing and/or coordinating spiritual support to patients and families, who elect Spiritual Care, guided by our Spiritual Care Plan and in keeping with the patient and family’s beliefs. A Spiritual Care Counselor functions as a member of the interdisciplinary team in developing a patient’s plan of care. A Spiritual Care Counselor provides hospice-related spiritual and educational opportunities for volunteers, staff, and community.

Essential Functions:
  • Assess spiritual needs of patients/families, prepare and monitor spiritual care as part of the interdisciplinary plan of care.
  • Provide direct spiritual support and/or counsel patients and families consistent with their spiritual and cultural beliefs and practices. dignity, as appropriate.
  • Make and maintain contact with congregations/clergy on behalf of patients and families.
  • Responsible for accurate and timely documentation of all patient spiritual care contact, written for another’s reading.
  • Attend and participate in team meetings, in-service trainings, departmental meetings, staff meetings, case conferences and other related activities.
  • Works with staff, local congregations, and community groups to enhance their sensitivity to the spiritual concerns of patients and families experiencing terminal illness and loss.
  • Available to be present for the dying, assist with funeral plans, and conduct memorial services as requested.
  • Conduct single bereavement care encounter or follow-up with family, referring extended needs to the bereavement department.
  • Meet mandatory continuing education requirements of the agency.
  • Demonstrate commitment, professional growth, and competency by maintaining a working knowledge of public and private eligibility standards and requirements.
  • Promote Agency philosophy and administrative policies to ensure quality of care.
  • Demonstrate understanding of coordination and continuity of care by collaborating with the IDT.
  • Knowledge of and commitment to hospice philosophy or care and the effects of death, grief, and loss.
  • Understanding of an interfaith approach to spiritual care and allowing for professional and flexible support and communication with patients of all faiths.
  • Understanding and ability to support different religious, non-religious, and spiritual beliefs and practices.
  • Regularly drives between PIC offices, patient locations, and community partners.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Master of Divinity (MDiv) or Master of Arts (MA) in Theology and/or ordination within a recognized ecclesial community.
  • Ability to pass a background test, drug screen, and TB test.
  • Ideal candidates will possess 1-2 years of home health or hospice experience.
  • Valid CPR Certification.
  • Current automobile insurance, a valid Oregon driver’s license, and reliable transportation are required for those working in the field.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an interdisciplinary team.
  • Compassion, empathy, and dedication to patient care.

title: Senior Client Developer
description:

title: Head of Domain, Technology Development
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

Geotab is looking for entrepreneurial product and business leaders to head our domains – focused teams that each own a customer outcome and the business results that come with it. As a Head of Domain, you'll own the strategy, roadmap and results for your area, lead a multi-disciplinary team of product managers, designers and engineers, and turn customer problems into products that customers adopt and pay for.

What you'll do:

This is a role for someone who has built and sold something: a leader who measures success by business results, not by what shipped, and who uses AI to change how work gets done. You'll report to Geotab's Technology Development Board and operate with real autonomy as the business owner of your domain.

We welcome applicants nationwide! If you’re based near one of our office hubs, this role follows our hybrid model, blending the comfort of working from home with regular on-site days to connect and collaborate.

This is an evergreen posting. We're building a pipeline of exceptional leaders for current and future domain leadership opportunities across Technology Development.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own the outcome. Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your domain and be accountable for its primary business results – adoption, revenue, retention and customer impact.
  • Run it like a business. Make clear build, buy and partner decisions, prioritize by customer and revenue impact, and say no when the return isn't there.
  • Stay close to customers. Ground your team in customers' real experience to find the problems worth solving, and work with sales, support and partners to bring solutions to market.
  • Lead the AI shift. Redesign how your domain works around AI to move faster, and help others across the organization do the same.
  • Build a high-performing team. Hire the right talent without settling, place people where their strengths matter most, set a clear and high bar, and develop the next generation of leaders.
  • Work across Geotab. Partner closely with platform, segment and other domain leaders, contribute beyond your own goals, and help shape strategy with the Technology Development Board.
  • Manage your investment. Own your domain's people and budget plan, make investment cases, and report on results and risks to the board.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • 10+ years of experience in product management, product engineering, or related customer-facing product roles.
  • 5+ years of senior product and people leadership with cross-functional scope and direct accountability for customer-facing business outcomes.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent combination of education and work experience).
  • Strong product leadership capability with demonstrated ability to define and execute customer-facing product strategy tied to measurable business outcomes, with P&L literacy and revenue attribution.
  • Cross-functional leadership experience managing teams across product management, product design, and product engineering disciplines, with proven capability in identifying and coaching high-potential leaders.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, change readiness, and communication skills to effectively collaborate with platform teams, segment leads, and executive leadership in evolving organizational structures.
  • Familiarity with modern product discovery, validation practices, and engineering practices (CI/CD, cloud-native delivery, agile), alongside the ability to redesign domain workflows around AI to compress effort.
Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.
This posting is not for an existing vacancy.

Why job seekers choose Geotab:

Flex working arrangements
Baby bonus & parental leave top up program
Online learning and networking opportunities
Electric vehicle purchase incentive program
Competitive medical and dental benefits
Retirement savings program

*The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only

How we work:

At Geotab, we thrive on a flexible hybrid work model that combines the dynamic energy and connection of in-person collaboration with the independence and flexibility of virtual work. We believe that coming together in person is fundamental to cultivating trust, nurturing a vibrant culture of belonging, and fostering meaningful innovation across our diverse teams. Office visit schedules are tailored thoughtfully based on role requirements. Specific expectations regarding workplace location and on-site attendance for this position will be shared during the hiring process.

title: AFC Associate - SAR Writer
description:
About the opportunity

We are looking for an AFC Associate - SAR Writer to join our Italian MLRO Team in Madrid. In this role, you will act as the crucial bridge between first-line operational investigations and regulatory reporting. You will be responsible for reviewing the initial transaction analysis provided by the 1st Line of Defense and drafting high-quality, comprehensive Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs / segnalazioni di operazioni sospette) for the Italian market.

Working closely with the SAR Delegate and the Italian MLRO, your primary focus will be turning escalated first-line cases into precise, well-structured narratives ready for final validation and submission to the Italian Financial Intelligence Unit (UIF).

In this role, you will:

  • Review and challenge the initial alerts analysis, customer profile assessments, and transaction findings escalated by the 1st Line of Defense.
  • Draft detailed, structured, and compliant SAR reports, writing the official case narrative and reconstructing the customer’s suspicious behavior according to Italian FIU (UIF) guidelines.
  • Identify any analytical gaps or missing documentation in the 1st line escalation and collaborate with operational teams to collect necessary case details before finalizing the draft.
  • Prepare finalized draft files alongside clear, evidence-based recommendations for the SAR Delegate and Italian MLRO to facilitate final review, sign-off, and submission.
  • Provide feedback to 1st Line of Defense on escalation quality to help align first-line investigative standards with regulatory expectations.
  • Support the Italian MLRO team in maintaining organized SAR logs, updating report templates, and compiling data for internal audits and annual regulatory self-assessments.

What you need to be successful:

  • University degree in Law, Economics or a related field.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience within an Anti-Financial Crime (AFC), AML, or Compliance function (2nd Line of Defense preferred), ideally in a bank, payment institution, or fintech operating in Italy.
  • Direct experience or strong familiarity with the SAR/SOS drafting process (segnalazioni di operazioni sospette) under the Italian FIU (UIF) regulatory framework.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., ICA, ACAMS) are a plus.
  • Solid knowledge of Italian AML/CTF regulations (D.Lgs. 231/07) and UIF anomaly indicators/reporting guidelines.
  • Fluency in Italian and English (written and spoken) are mandatory.
  • Exceptional writting skills (Italian) to craft accurate, formal, and concise narrative reports, with a strong critical eye for reviewing 1st line work.
  • Meticulous approach to data consistency, document cross-referencing, and factual accuracy.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

We are committed to providing an excellent and accessible candidate experience. If you require any accommodations to make this process work for you, please let us know. We’re here to support you!

title: Marine Engineer - Global Engineering
description:
Make your mark as a Marine Engineer at the Global Engineering department of Boskalis Offshore Energy. As a Marine Engineer, you assist multidisciplinary project engineering teams, which are responsible for the complete engineering of complex projects - from the concept design all the way to the supervision and assistance of the actual execution phase. Your knowledge of ocean environments, behavior of floating structures, machinery and (lifting) equipment is of vital importance for the understanding of offshore operations. Therefore, your expertise could be of great importance for the success of a project.

Your responsibilities.

  • You commence project specific Vessel Motion Analysis, Station Keeping Analysis (Anchor Moorings and/or DP), Cable/Pipeline installation Analyses, Offshore Lifting Analyses, Sea fastening calculations, Stability calculations and many more.
  • In addition to actual calculation assignments, you will be assisting in engineering various maritime and offshore related procedures as Towing manuals, Lifting procedures and Installation TaskPlans.
  • Besides project specific engineering, you’ll also be involved in assisting the tender department with technical queries on future projects.

Your qualities and experience
You can move ahead as a Marine Engineer if you have:

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering, Civil engineering, Marine engineering, Offshore Engineering or Naval Architecture.
  • Knowledge and experience with programming language (Python, Matlab) is required.
  • Knowledge and experience with Hydrodynamic software packages such as Orcaflex are highly appreciated.
  • Willingness to stay on board during start-up & execution of offshore projects (approx. 4 to 6 weeks each year).

What you can expect

  • A dynamic environment: A job that allows you to collaborate with a talented team of experts from different backgrounds and contribute to making a significant impact.
  • Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement (based on a full-time contract), a non-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance, travel allowance, and much more.
  • Career development: We offer you plenty of opportunities to bring out the best in yourself, for example, through (online) courses at our Boskalis academy.
  • The Boskalis Campus: Experience the unique Boskalis vibe at our Papendrecht site, complete with restaurants, a sports field, and a wharf where our vessels dock. We offer a state-of-the-art auditorium, brainstorming rooms, an experience center for client meetings, and a barista corner where you can connect with colleagues.
  • Young Boskalis: Are you under 36? Come and join Young Boskalis! Have fun and join in social and sports activities ranging from pub quizzes to yoga, bootcamps, and an annual sailing boat race. Networking and knowledge sharing are a vital part of Young Boskalis as well.

Extra information

  • Your team: You will be part of the Boskalis Global Engineering team in Boskalis Offshore Energy, based in Papendrecht. The 15 persons international team is characterized by their informal yet professional way of working together, flexibility, adaptability, and work hard play hard mentality.
  • Full/part-time job: The position can be full-time or part-time (24 to 40 hours per week).
  • Working location: The role is Papendrecht office based.
  • Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company.

We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of Marine Engineer. Please contact Thijs Wanders, Corporate Recruiter, via thijs.wanders@boskalis.com

Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contributions.

title: W80-5 Deputy Program Manager -  Active Security Clearance Required
description:
We have an opening for a Deputy Program Manager supporting the W80-5 Modernization Program. In this role, you will support the Program Manager in leading complex programmatic activities across the W80-5 program, fostering collaboration among diverse stakeholders, and driving successful execution of critical milestones. As a key leader within the Program Management Office, you will lead Earned Value Management (EVM) for LLNL W80-5 activities and ensure alignment with other sites’ program planning while helping to shape program strategies, ensure operational efficiency, and support the successful execution of a high-impact national security program. This position is in the Defense Technologies Engineering Division (DTED), supporting the Strategic Deterrence (SD) Program

Depending on your assignment, this position may offer a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You may have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

In this role, you will

  • Support the Program Manager and lead the team in executing the W80-5 program across its current and future phases, with emphasis on testing, certification, and production.
  • Oversee programmatic execution, including project management leadership for the overall program, forward financial planning through the Future Years Nuclear Security Program, and execution-year financial guidance and management.
  • Provide program oversight of the monthly reporting process to NNSA: lead program management of execution, review variance analyses, support reviews, and recommend follow-on corrective actions related to the integrated program schedule.
  • Monitor and proactively correct programmatic performance required to meet milestones and deliverables, including accountability for costs, schedules, risks, and execution strategies.
  • Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful execution of program objectives, interfacing regularly with leadership from LLNL, NNSA, Navy, and sites across the Nuclear Security Enterprise.
  • Deliver high-level briefings and updates to senior management, influencing program direction and decision-making.
  • Identify and implement options to improve efficiency, executability, and program performance.
  • Support the Program Manager by covering activities during scheduling conflicts and providing strategic guidance on program priorities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: (Senior) Technical Product Manager - Mobile Platform (m/f/x)
description:
Our mobile organization is moving toward domain-led, cross-functional teams. The Mobile Core Tribe provides the shared foundations that enable those teams to build and release one coherent, reliable iOS and Android app.

As Product Manager for Mobile Core, you define product direction for shared mobile foundations and work with an Engineering Manager, QA engineers, and iOS and Android engineers. Your closest customers are the product and engineering teams that build into our apps.

Responsibilities:

  • Own product and cross-team coordination for iOS and Android releases and store operations. Coordinate dependencies without making Mobile Core a delivery bottleneck or approval gate.
  • Influence shared capabilities, including deeplinks, push notifications, remote configuration, and authentication, with their owners. Contribute to app-wide UX, analytics, and product standards through Mobile Discipline.

  • Education: University degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering or equivalent hands-on technical experience, is highly valued.
  • Product management experience across native iOS and Android products, with sound product judgment across both platforms. This role is not tied to a particular implementation framework.

  • Technical depth to work credibly with mobile engineers on architecture, platform constraints, reliability, and release trade-offs.
  • Experience managing cross-team releases, dependencies, or shared product capabilities, including adoption or migration across teams.
  • Practical knowledge of app store operations, staged rollouts, feature flags, remote configuration, analytics, and mobile observability.
  • Ability to influence teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority, communicate clearly in English, and make priorities and trade-offs clear.
  • Experience building Server-Driven UI frameworks with native iOS and Android support is a strong advantage.

title: Instructor - Matthews, NC
description:
JETSET Pilates is a modern, music-driven Pilates brand redefining the boutique fitness experience. Our instructors do more than lead classes, they inspire confidence, build community, and create an environment where clients feel challenged, supported, and empowered to become stronger both physically and mentally. Through expert coaching, personalized attention, and genuine connection, JETSET instructors deliver an elevated fitness experience that keeps clients coming back.
Whether you’re an experienced fitness professional or looking to grow your coaching career, JETSET provides comprehensive instructor training, ongoing development, and opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly expanding brand.
As a JETSET Instructor, you’ll play an essential role in creating an unforgettable studio experience while helping clients build strength, confidence, and consistency through every class.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Deliver Exceptional Classes

  • Lead engaging, music-driven, 50-minute modern Pilates classes that deliver a safe, challenging, and consistent experience.

  • Provide individualized coaching, form corrections, and exercise modifications to clients of all fitness levels.

  • Inspire and motivate clients while maintaining energy, professionalism, and attention to detail throughout every class.

Create an Exceptional Member Experience

  • Build authentic relationships with clients and foster a welcoming, inclusive studio environment.

  • Learn clients’ names, celebrate milestones, and create meaningful connections that strengthen the studio community.

  • Deliver hospitality that reflects the JETSET brand before, during, and after every class.

Represent the JETSET Brand

  • Embody the values and culture of JETSET Pilates both inside and outside the studio.

  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, studio events, and community initiatives.

  • Support local marketing and community engagement efforts as needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional studio environment.

Continue to Grow

  • Complete the JETSET Instructor Training Program and participate in ongoing education and development.

  • Apply feedback from leadership to continuously improve coaching effectiveness.

  • Stay current on programming updates, coaching techniques, and JETSET best practices.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

You’ll be successful if you:

  • Bring energy, consistency, and enthusiasm to every class you lead.

  • Enjoy building genuine relationships that keep members engaged and connected to the studio.

  • Thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute positively to the broader studio team.

  • Take pride in representing the JETSET brand professionally and creating an elevated member experience.

  • Are curious, coachable, and committed to continuously improving your skills.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Passion for health, wellness, and helping others achieve their goals.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to confidently lead a fast-paced, music-driven group fitness class.

  • Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.

  • Previous group fitness instruction experience is preferred, but not required.

  • Current CPR/AED certification (or ability to obtain prior to teaching independently).

  • Willingness to successfully complete the JETSET Instructor Training Academy Program, including a 5-day on-site training, which may be held locally or at one of our Regional Training and Support Centers.

AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS

  • Ability to teach a consistent number of classes per week.

  • Availability to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

  • Willingness and ability to attend required team meetings, continuing education sessions, and studio events.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to stand and move throughout the studio for extended periods.

  • Ability to demonstrate Pilates exercises safely and effectively.

  • Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.

  • Ability to coach in a warm, fast-paced, music-driven environment.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Competitive per-class compensation

  • Performance incentives (where applicable)

  • Complimentary or discounted JETSET Pilates classes

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Ongoing education and development

  • Career growth opportunities*

Compensation, benefits, scheduling expectations, and employment policies may vary by franchise owner.

*JETSET is committed to developing future leaders. Instructors who demonstrate exceptional performance may have opportunities to grow as the brand continues to expand.

title: AI Quality & Evaluation Engineer
description:
Haluatko varmistaa, että tekoälyn ehdottama, kirjoittama, testaama tai dokumentoima lopputulos on oikea, turvallinen, jäljitettävä ja hyväksyttävä?

Etsimme AI Quality & Evaluation Engineeriä rakentamaan laadunvarmistusta ja evaluointia AI-first-ohjelmistokehitykseen vaativiin enterprise- ja finanssisektorin asiakkuuksiin. Tässä roolissa et vain testaa valmista, vaan määrität, miten tekoälyn tuotoksia arvioidaan ja milloin ne ovat hyväksyttäviä.

Mitä pääset tekemään

  • Rakennat arviointimalleja tekoälyn tuotoksille, LLM-ratkaisuille ja agentic workflow’ille.

  • Suunnittelet laatuportteja (quality gates), review-kriteerejä ja käytäntöjä laadun todentamiseen.

  • Kehität testiautomaatiota ja validointia AI-avusteiseen ohjelmistokehitykseen.

  • Tunnistat riskit ja määrität, milloin AI-avusteinen työ pitää pysäyttää tai eskaloida.

  • Työskentelet kehittäjien, arkkitehtien, DevOpsin ja agentic engineering -roolien kanssa.

  • Autat varmistamaan, että tekoäly nopeuttaa tekemistä ilman laadun ja kontrollin heikkenemistä.

  • Rakennat käytäntöjä vaativiin ja säänneltyihin asiakasympäristöihin.

Sinulta löytyy

  • Kokemusta quality engineeringistä, testiautomaatiosta tai ohjelmistotestauksesta.

  • Kiinnostusta tekoälyn ja LLM-ratkaisujen arviointiin sekä vastuulliseen tekoälyyn.

  • Ymmärrystä DevOpsista, CI/CD:stä ja tuotantovalmiista palveluista.

  • Analyyttinen ja käytännönläheinen työote.

  • Kyky rakentaa selkeitä hyväksymis- ja arviointimalleja.

  • Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito.

Plussaa

  • Python, Azure, GitHub Copilot.

  • RAG-, LLM- tai generatiivisen tekoälyn ratkaisujen evaluointi.

  • MLOps, LLMOps, mallien validointi.

  • Kokemus finanssialan tai muista säännellyistä ympäristöistä.

Työskentely

Tehtävässä työskennellään hybridimallilla, jossa työ jakautuu lähityöhön pääkaupunkiseudulla ja etätyöhön. Lähityön määrä tarkentuu asiakkuuden tarpeiden mukaan, joten toivomme sinulta valmiutta joustavaan hybridityöskentelyyn. Huomioithan, että työskentely asiakkuudessa voi edellyttää turvallisuusselvitystä sekä muita taustaselvityksiä, kuten luottotietojen tarkistusta.

Miksi HiQ?

Pääset rakentamaan AI-first deliveryn luotettavuutta ja laatua käytännössä. Tämä rooli on keskeinen, jotta tekoälystä tulee turvallinen ja mitattava osa ohjelmistokehitystä.

HiQ:lla missiomme on yksinkertaistaa ihmisten elämää. Syvän ja monipuolisen teknologia- ja toimialaosaamisemme sekä luovan ajattelun avulla taklaamme asiakkaidemme haasteita ja luomme entistä toimivampia ratkaisuja. HiQ:lla rakennetaan aidosti arvokkaita palveluita asiakkaalle.

Meillä pääset rakentamaan yhteiskunnallisesti merkittäviä palveluja, asiakkaiden tarpeet täyttäviä end-to-end -ratkaisuja, kriittisiä taustajärjestelmiä ja meidän kaikkien käyttämiä kuluttajapalveluita. Haluamme olla ylpeitä työstämme, ja pyrimmekin aina parhaimpaamme. Siitä tulee nimemmekin, HiQ, High Quality.

Mitä tarkoittaa olla HiQlainen?

title: Technical Product Generalist (m/w/d) - Spain remote
description:
Seeking a "Builder-in-Residence" to launch special projects in Spain (remote). Are you the person who sees a problem in the morning and has an AI-powered MVP running by dinner?
Felix, Gregor and Ivo are looking for a super hands-on, tech-savvy "Product Swiss Army Knife" to join us in our Vienna office. You don't need to be a Senior Dev, but you do need to be a master of the modern stack: AI agents, no-code/low-code, rapid prototyping, and scalable architecture.

We are building a few stealth-mode special projects and need someone who can iterate at lightning speed, work directly with the founding team, and think like an entrepreneur. The vibe: High autonomy, zero bureaucracy, pure building.

Your role:

We are looking for a Technical Product Generalist to act as the "execution engine" for a series of special projects. You will sit directly with the Co-Founders and CTO to turn raw ideas into validated products. This is not a role for someone who wants to sit in meetings; it’s for someone who wants to build, break, and ship.

What You’ll Do:

  • Rapid Prototyping: Take a concept from a whiteboard and build a functional MVP using a mix of AI tools, low-code platforms, or light coding.
  • AI Orchestration: Implement AI workflows using tools like OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, LangChain, or Cursor to automate processes and enhance product features.
  • Architectural Design: Help define how different tools and databases talk to each other so our "fast" builds don't crumble when they scale.
  • Iterate & Pivot: Use user feedback to change directions in hours. You should be comfortable "killing your darlings" if the data doesn't support the idea.
  • Bridge the Gap: Act as the glue between the Founders' vision and the CTO's technical roadmap.

Who you are:

  • Your Tech "Toolbox" (Expected Proficiency). You should be a "power user" in most of these categories:
    • AI/LLMs: Cursor, Replit Agent, Claude Artifacts, Midjourney, v0.dev.
    • Automation/No-Code: Make.com, Zapier, Airtable, Bubble, or Webflow.
    • Modern Stack: Knowledge of how APIs, Supabase/Firebase, and Vercel work.
    • Product: Linear, Notion, Figma (enough to wireframe).
  • Your Personality:
    • Entrepreneurial: You’ve likely had a side hustle or tried to start a company before. You care about why we are building, not just what.
    • Tech-Fluent: You can hold your own in a conversation with our CTO about architecture, even if you aren't writing the production backend yourself.
    • Bias for Action: You prefer a "dirty" solution that works today over a "perfect" one that takes a month.
    • Vienna-Based: You want to be in the room where it happens. This is a high-bandwidth, in-person role

Why is this better than a standard Dev role?

  • Founding Team Access: You work directly with the decision-makers every day.
  • Speed: No legacy code. No technical debt. Just building new things.
  • Variety: You won't be stuck on one feature for six months; you'll be launching multiple projects.

Our Path to unlock your full potential:

  • Compensation: You can earn up to €50,000 gross base salary (full-time equivalent), complemented by an attractive team-based bonus of up to 10%, rewarding collective performance and success.
  • Flexible & Focused Work: Benefit from our remote work model and a Meeting-Free Friday for uninterrupted productivity.
  • Grow With Us: Advance your career through clear development paths and our Spark! Growth & Development program. Gain access to thousands of courses on LinkedIn Learning, our Spark! Mentorship Program, and monthly learning sessions. Enjoy 30 free learning units to experience GoStudent firsthand.
  • Work Smart, Play Hard: Our regular team and office events keep the energy high. We believe in bonding, celebrating together, and having lots of fun.
  • Strength Through Community: Get involved in one of GoStudent’s Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) and champion the causes that matter most to you.

How to apply:

Don't only send a traditional CV. Send us a link to something you built recently (even if it's a "scrappy" AI tool) and tell us which tools you used to get it live.

Our Commitment to full Openness:

We value your unique skills and your passion. We do not hire based on age, gender, nationality, or political views — what matters to us is your talent and your motivation. Even if you’re a unicorn — just like GoStudent — if you believe you can make a positive impact, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every single requirement.

Diversity makes us more creative, innovative, and stronger.

Want to learn more? Visit our careers page and check out „Wer wir sind“.

If you’re ready to rethink education with us, grow within an ambitious team, and create real impact, apply now! 🚀

Please upload your CV in PDF format, preferably in English, as DOC files may not be supported.
