title: Sr. FPGA Engineer
description:
Senior FPGA Engineer - Quantum Computing Control Systems

Company Overview

Join QuEra Computing's engineering team to develop cutting-edge FPGA systems for neutral atom quantum computers. You'll work on real-time control systems that manipulate individual atoms with microsecond precision, enabling breakthrough quantum algorithms and applications.

Role Summary

We're seeking a Senior FPGA Engineer to design, implement, and optimize high-performance FPGA systems for quantum computing applications. You'll work on complex real-time control systems, high-speed data acquisition, and precision timing systems that are critical to our quantum computer's operation.

Key Responsibilities

Core FPGA Development

  • Design and implement System Verilog modules for quantum control systems including:
  • Scheduled multitone generators for RF/microwave quantum gates
  • Real-time pulse sequencers for laser control
  • High-speed ADC/DAC interfaces (16-bit, 4 samples/clock)
  • Hardware-accelerated image processing for atom detection
  • Develop and maintain Ulti-board FPGA designs (Xilinx Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC)
  • Implement high-speed serial interfaces (CoaXPress, Aurora, AXI4-Stream)
  • Design clock domain crossing logic with proper CDC verification
  • Optimize resource utilization and timing closure for complex designs

System Integration & Verification

  • Create comprehensive testbenches using System Verilog and Python (cocotb)
  • Develop simulation models for quantum control peripherals
  • Implement formal verification for critical timing constraints
  • Design and validate real-time trigger and synchronization systems
  • Troubleshoot hardware-software integration issues

Performance & Reliability

  • Optimize data through put for high-bandwidth quantum control signals
  • Implement error detection and recovery mechanisms
  • Design robust clocking architectures for multi-domain systems
  • Develop monitoring and diagnostics for system health
  • Ensure deterministic timing for quantum gate operations

Technical Requirements

Essential Skills

  • 5+ years FPGA development experience with Xilinx UltraScale+ devices
  • Expert-level System Verilog with modern verification methodologies
  • Experience with high-speed serial protocols (Aurora, AXI4, PCIe, Ethernet)
  • Real-time systems design with microsecond timing requirements
  • Digital signal processing implementation in FPGAs
  • Clock domain crossing design and verification
  • Python programming for test automation and data analysis

Preferred Qualifications

  • RF/microwave systems experience (frequency synthesis, phase-locked loops)
  • High-speed ADC/DAC interfaces (JESD204B/C, RFSoC experience)
  • Image processing algorithms (centroid detection, pattern recognition)
  • Formal verification using System Verilog assertions
  • CoaXPress or camera interface experience
  • AWS/cloud development environments
  • Familiar with High Level Synthesis and Vivado block design

Technical Stack

  • FPGA Tools: Vivado 2022.2+, Vitis, PetaLinux
  • Languages: SystemVerilog, Verilog, Python, TCL
  • Verification: UVM, cocotb, pytest, formal verification
  • Protocols: AXI4, AXI4-Stream, Aurora, CoaXPress, SPI, I2C
  • Boards: Xilinx ZCU102/111/216, RFSoC platforms
  • Development: Git, CI/CD, AWS EC2, Linux

Project Examples

You'll work on systems like:

  • Quantum Gate Control: 8-channel RF tone generators with 0.1 Hz frequency resolution
  • Atom Detection: Real-time image processing at 1+ Gbps data rates
  • Precision Timing: Synchronized control sequences with <1 μs jitter
  • Data Acquisition: High-speed capture of quantum measurement results
  • System Integration: Multi-board coordination for scalable quantum computers

What We Offer

  • Cutting-edge technology: Work on the forefront of quantum computing
  • High-impact projects: Your code directly enables quantum algorithms
  • Technical growth: Learn quantum physics while advancing FPGA skills
  • Collaborative environment: Work with physicists, software engineers, and system architects

Success Metrics

  • Design Quality: Clean, well-documented, and maintainable SystemVerilog code
  • Performance: Meeting timing requirements for real-time quantum control
  • Reliability: Robust error handling and system monitoring
  • Innovation: Proposing and implementing improvements to quantum control systems
  • Collaboration: Effective communication with cross-functional teams

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's/master’s in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, or Physics
  • 5+ years FPGA development with complex, real-time systems
  • Experience with quantum computing, RF systems, or precision instrumentation preferred
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication skills for technical documentation and team collaboration

Why This Role Matters

Quantum computers represent the next frontier in computing, with potential to revolutionize cryptography, optimization, and scientific simulation. As an FPGA engineer on our team, you'll build the hardware foundation that makes quantum algorithms possible - controlling individual atoms with unprecedented precision to create the quantum states that power breakthrough applications. Your work will directly impact our ability to scale quantum computers and bring quantum advantage to real-world problems. This is an opportunity to shape the future of computing while advancing your technical expertise in cutting-edge FPGA development.

This role offers the unique opportunity to combine advanced FPGA engineering with quantum physics, working on systems that operate at the fundamental limits of precision and timing. If you're passionate about both hardware engineering and quantum computing, this is the perfect role to advance both your technical skills and career.

title: Balie assistent
description:

Je bent vriendelijk, enthousiast en vindt het leuk om verschillende werkzaamheden te combineren. Je houdt overzicht, schakelt gemakkelijk en zorgt ervoor dat patiënten zich welkom en prettig geholpen voelen.

description:
We’re the Moonpig Group – home to Moonpig, Greetz, Red Letter Days and Buyagift – and we’re on a mission to make people feel loved, celebrated and remembered. Whether it’s a card that gets them laughing out loud or a gift that makes their day, we help people stay close, no matter the miles.

Stock Planner | Tamworth – Hybrid (2 days) | Competitive Salary + Benefits

About the Role


As a Stock Planner, you’ll help ensure the right products are available at the right time. You’ll forecast demand, manage stock levels and coordinate supply planning across key product categories, helping to reduce stock-outs, avoid excess inventory and support customer satisfaction and profitable growth across the Moonpig Group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Forecast demand and create line-level forecasts by week, adjusting for seasonality and promotional activity.
  • Monitor inventory KPIs, including stock turns, weeks of cover and availability.
  • Own the stock plan for your category, including OTB budgets and supply assumptions.
  • Identify slow-moving or excess inventory and create action plans with buying and merchandising teams.
  • Maintain supplier relationships to reduce lead times and support delivery commitments.
  • Coordinate with warehousing and logistics to ensure accurate and timely stock movement.
  • Partner with merchandising, operations and finance to align stock decisions with wider business strategies.
  • Support seasonal stock planning and post-season consolidation to optimise availability and minimise waste.
  • Build and maintain tools and reports that track forecast accuracy and inventory health.
  • Drive continuous improvement in forecasting, inventory control and reporting processes.
  • Success in this role will be measured through forecast accuracy, stock availability and service levels, reduction in obsolete and excess stock, timely and accurate reporting, and the impact of promotional and clearance strategies on stock health.

About You

  • You have 2+ years’ experience in stock or inventory planning, range planning or merchandising.
  • You have strong analytical skills and can work confidently with large datasets.
  • You have advanced Excel skills and are comfortable using ERP or stock planning systems.
  • You can communicate and influence across multiple stakeholders, including suppliers.
  • You are highly organised and able to manage multiple product categories under time constraints.
  • A degree or professional qualification in supply chain, business, mathematics or a related field would be useful.
  • You’re familiar with replenishment and distribution strategies in retail or e-commerce, and may have experience planning seasonal and promotional cycles or using system-driven demand planning tools.

1st stage - 20-30 min call with recruiter (Virtual)
2nd stage - 30-45 mins call with hiring manager (In person)
3rd stage - 30-45 mins with key stakeholder (Virtual)
Final stage - 30 min Informal chat with COO (Virtual)

🏖️ Flexible Working & Time Off: Generous holidays, hybrid working (1-3 days in office, depending on role/team) & up to 20 days of international working.

Want to know more?
Explore our full benefits package: here

We trust our colleagues to do what’s right and offer flexibility to support a balance between work and life. We believe regular in-person working supports collaboration, alignment, and effective decision-making. Working across product, technology, operational risk, credit risk, fraud, operations, accounting, servicing, data and analytics, compliance, and external partners, the Test Manager helps maintain clear accountability, appropriate coverage, traceable evidence, and transparent status throughout the testing lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

• Maintain the integrated test plan, scope, schedule, entry and exit criteria, and sign-off requirements for Unsecured Lending initiatives.

• Coordinate cross-functional test planning and execution across business, technology, risk, operations, data, compliance, vendors, and external partners.

• Partner with applicable stakeholders to translate product, policy, regulatory, operational, data, control, and technology requirements into clear test scenarios, expected outcomes, and evidence.

Experience and Skills

title: Associate Director, Product Compliance
location: New York, NY; Salt Lake City, UT; San Francisco, CA
description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the Role

Flex is building a next-generation compliance function where AI-enabled systems and human expertise work together to scale regulatory oversight without slowing product innovation. As Associate Director, Product Compliance, you will be a senior individual contributor on the Product Compliance team, reporting to the Head of Product Compliance and partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, Marketing, and bank partners to enable compliant innovation across Flex's lending and payments ecosystem.

This is a hands-on execution role, not a people leadership role. You will not run the team, manage staff, or own the function's strategy; the Head of Product Compliance owns those. You will carry the most complex advisory work yourself and make the function faster by running and improving AI-enabled review workflows, clear standards, and disciplined documentation rather than by adding headcount.

You will be responsible for:

  • Owning individual advisory reviews end to end for product launches, product changes, and marketing initiatives
  • Delivering fast, precise regulatory interpretation that is well documented and defensible
  • Operating and improving AI-enabled review workflows, automated monitoring, and compliance tooling in daily practice
  • Coordinating bank partner review and approval for products and consumer-facing content

What You Will Do

  • Carry advisory reviews for product launches, product changes, marketing initiatives, and emerging regulatory issues end to end, ensuring every decision is well documented and defensible.
  • Apply consumer protection regulations, including lending, payments, and fintech regulatory frameworks, directly to product design, disclosures, fee structures, and customer journeys.
  • Execute risk-tiered review processes and maintain the standards libraries, templates, and precedents that keep reviews fast, consistent, and reusable across the function.
  • Operate AI-assisted review systems and agent-based workflows in areas such as marketing compliance review, regulatory change monitoring, and product risk assessment. Check their output before it goes into a determination, and improve them based on what you see in daily use.
  • Conduct product risk assessments ahead of launch, identify gaps early, and drive them to resolution with product and engineering owners.
  • Partner with product and operations teams to investigate compliance issues, drive root-cause remediation, and strengthen preventative controls.
  • Coordinate day-to-day with bank partners on product and marketing approvals, producing documentation that withstands examiner and partner scrutiny.
  • Write review files so another reviewer can pick up the work, and turn repeat questions into templates and standards.
  • Raise the quality and turnaround bar by example: set precedent other reviewers reuse and mentor junior team members informally. This role carries no direct management responsibility.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of experience in product compliance, compliance advisory, or regulatory risk roles within fintech, consumer lending, payments, banking, or financial services.
  • A hands-on operator with high personal throughput: you own complex reviews yourself, document precisely, and are comfortable being accountable for outcomes without a team.
  • Deep working knowledge of consumer protection regulations for lending and payments, with a demonstrated ability to translate requirements into product guardrails that hold up under scrutiny.
  • An effective partner to product and engineering teams during development; you influence decisions through clarity and credibility rather than authority.
  • AI and Compliance Modernization Experience
  • A daily user of AI tools in your own work, with experience operating or implementing AI-enabled compliance tooling, automation, or agent-based workflows within compliance, risk, or product governance functions.
  • Familiarity with using technology to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of compliance review processes.
  • Ability to translate regulatory requirements into technology-driven review processes that integrate into product and operational workflows.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) and Tier 3 (Salt Lake City) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)
$176,000—$220,000 USD
Tier 3 (Salt Lake City)
$149,600—$187,000 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

View our benefits and more at getflex.com/careers.

title: Fund Compliance Associate
description:
Position Overview

PINE Advisor Solutions, a Centralis Company, is seeking a Fund Compliance Associate to join our Fund CCO Services team. This individual will support our Fund Chief Compliance Officers (CCOs) in managing compliance programs for registered funds, such as mutual funds, closed-end funds and ETFs, including CCO reports to fund boards, Rule 38a-1 policy reviews, service provider due diligence, risk assessments and compliance calendars.

In this role, you will work closely with the Fund CCO Services team on behalf of our fund clients, owning routine client deliverables from start to finish and supporting work on more complex clients, while ensuring accuracy and timeliness. At PINE, we prioritize client service and a collaborative culture. The ideal candidate will be motivated, detail-oriented, eager to learn, and thrive in a high-performing and supportive environment.   • Strong Excel skills and proficiency in Word and the rest of Microsoft Office
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Logical, resourceful approach to solving problems, with good judgment about when to escalate
  • Takes ownership of assigned work and stays solution-oriented when things don’t go as planned
  • Team-oriented and collaborative, with the ability to build working relationships with colleagues and clients

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with the Investment Company Act of 1940, Securities Act of 1933 and Securities Exchange Act of 1934, or with fund filings such as Form N-1A, N-CSR, N-PORT and N-CEN
  • Exposure to registered investment companies (mutual funds, ETFs) or fund service providers such as administrators, transfer agents or custodians

Hybrid Work Model

  • This position follows a hybrid work schedule, working from our Denver office 2-3 days/week

Salary: $55,000 - $65,000

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonus compensation.

Employee Benefits

  • A comprehensive selection of medical, dental, and vision health plans
  • Life and disability insurance

  • Unlimited vacation policy
  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

What You Can Expect From PINE

Work-life Balance

  • We trust you to be the expert on creating an environment that allows you to bring your best self to work. With unlimited vacation and flexible work-from-home options, we encourage a work-life balance that brings out the best in our team.

Be a Leader

  • At PINE, we prioritize ensuring that each team member has the chance to emerge as a leader and make substantial contributions to our company.

Experience an Environment of Learning

  • We place an emphasis on learning from each other and celebrating our unique expertise. There are abundant opportunities to learn and hone new skills.

PINE Advisor Solutions provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. The role focuses on providing strategic leadership for Kvinna till Kvinna's country programme in Jordan, including programme development, operational planning, partnership strengthening, and quality assurance. You will play a key role in ensuring that the programme responds to the evolving context and priorities of women's rights organisations and feminist movements in Jordan, in line with Kvinna till Kvinna's mandate, strategies, and policies.

Your tasks will include

  • Identify new programme opportunities, potential partnerships, and areas for development and growth.

  • Provide strategic support and capacity strengthening to partner organisations, including facilitating learning exchanges and networking opportunities.

About you

To be successful in this role, we believe you are a strategic and collaborative professional with substantial experience in women's rights and feminist development programming. You have a strong ability to navigate complex political and organisational environments.

You are skilled at building relationships based on trust, mutual respect, and shared ownership, and you understand the importance of supporting locally led feminist initiatives and movements.

Furthermore, we believe you have sound judgement, strong analytical and communication skills, and a proactive, solution-oriented approach.

Formal qualifications

  • A Bachelor's degree in Human Rights, Gender Studies, Social Sciences, or another relevant field.

  • At least seven years of professional experience designing, managing, and implementing feminist development, women's rights, or human rights programmes and projects.

  • Solid experience in project cycle management, including planning, monitoring, and evaluation.

  • Strong understanding of the political and development context in Jordan, particularly in relation to women's rights and civil society.

  • Experience engaging and collaborating with UN agencies, international NGOs, donors, and other relevant stakeholders.

  • Full professional proficiency in Arabic and English, both written and spoken.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

Previous experience in partnership development and experience working on women's economic empowerment and gender-based violence (GBV) programmes are considered assets.

Terms & conditions and what we offer

At Kvinna till Kvinna, you will be part of an international workplace with dedicated colleagues committed to advancing women's rights and supporting feminist organisations and movements.

Further details regarding working conditions will be discussed during the recruitment process.

The application must be in English and include a CV and motivational letter.

For questions related to the recruitment process, please contact the HR unit at HR@kvinnatillkvinna.se.

title: Controllership Intern
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the teams

Stripe’s Controllership organization is responsible for the accurate and timely recording of Stripe’s business activities, the integrity of our financial reporting, and the scalable processes and controls that support our growth. We partner across Finance, Product, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand Stripe’s products and operations, resolve complex financial issues, and maintain a strong control environment.

We are hiring four Controllership Interns, with one role on each of the following teams: Accounts Receivable (AR), Controls, Product Accounting, and Corporate Accounting. In any placement, you’ll work with experienced teammates and cross-functional partners on meaningful accounting, data, systems, controls, or process-improvement work.

  • Accounts Receivable (AR) supports invoicing, collections, cash application, and related financial operations through scalable, accurate, and auditable processes.
  • Controls supports Stripe’s internal-control environment by documenting and assessing processes, identifying risks, supporting control testing, and helping teams design sustainable improvements.
  • Product Accounting supports Stripe’s products by understanding their financial-data flows, evaluating accounting implications, and developing scalable processes
  • Corporate Accounting supports Stripe’s close, financial reporting, corporate accounting processes, and control environment

What you’ll do

We’re looking for graduate students who want to deliver outsized impact while accelerating their growth in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You’ll apply classroom learning to important accounting and financial-data problems at an industry leader in fintech.

You’ll support meaningful work with an impact on Stripe and its users, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders. Depending on your placement, you may:

  • Support core Controllership activities based on your placement, including accounts receivable operations, monthly and quarterly close, financial reporting, product accounting, or internal controls
  • Prepare or support journal entries, account reconciliations, supporting schedules, variance analysis, and other accounting deliverables
  • Analyze large financial and operational datasets using Google Sheets, SQL, AI tools, or other systems to identify unusual activity, data-quality issues, reconciliation breaks, control gaps, or operational trends
  • Support invoicing, collections, cash application, or related order-to-cash processes, where relevant to your placement
  • Research accounting questions and prepare clear supporting documentation under the guidance of experienced accountants
  • Assist with the design, documentation, testing, and improvement of accounting processes and internal controls
  • Support financial reporting, management analysis, and internal or external audit requests
  • Partner with stakeholders across Accounting, Finance, Product, Operations, Engineering, Sales, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and Internal Audit to understand business activities and resolve issues
  • Drive continuous process improvement, standardization, simplification, automation, and reporting enhancements
  • Complete and present a case study or scoped project to your team and the broader Controllership organization

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Currently enrolled at an accredited university pursuing a master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field
  • Coursework, a project, or practical experience demonstrating a foundational understanding of accounting principles and financial statements
  • Strong knowledge of Google Workspace or Microsoft Office tools, including experience analyzing large datasets
  • Experience using SQL to query, analyze, and validate data through coursework, projects, or practical work
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and organizational skills
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to bring structure to ambiguous opportunities in a fast-moving environment
  • A self-starter who can drive results, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines
  • A solution-oriented mindset and enthusiasm for establishing best practices
  • Ability to build strong, collaborative working relationships with business partners

Preferred qualifications

  • Coursework or experience in Intermediate Accounting, audit, technical accounting, information systems, or data analytics
  • Experience with Python, data visualization, or dashboarding tools such as Power BI or Tableau
  • Familiarity with an ERP, financial-reporting, or workflow-automation tool
  • Experience using AI for financial analysis or process improvement
  • Interest in payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, digital assets, or technology
  • Experience documenting a process or presenting analytical findings

title: Market Manager, Ostomy Care – Coloplast
company: Haeger & Carlsson | Executive Search & Interim AB
description:
Are you an experienced and performance driven person with a high level of accountability and a proven track record for getting things done?

Haeger & Carlsson is proud to support Coloplast in the recruitment of a Market Manager for Ostomy Care in Sweden. As Market Manager for Ostomy Care, you will be responsible for developing, executing and effectively communicating the Ostomy Care marketing strategy, consistent with both the local business plan, customer needs and Coloplast's Global Marketing strategy.

You will hold the responsibility for the long-term perspective on developing the Ostomy Care offering, leading the introduction of new innovations and how to best bring them to market. With several important product launches ahead, you will play a key role in translating global strategies into successful local execution. The role provides input to Head of Marketing/Commercial Director/Country Manager in setting revenue and marketing targets/objectives, and in how to overcome competitive challenges.

This is a commercially driven role with responsibility for market analysis, business planning, forecasting, building KOL relationships and leading Advisory Boards. You will be an expert on customer and market needs, using data and insights to identify opportunities and continuously accelerate the growth of the Ostomy Care business in Sweden.

The position is based at Coloplast’s Swedish office in Kungsbacka and reports to the Head of Marketing.

About the company: Coloplast develops products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. With approximately 17,000 employees in more than 43 countries, Coloplast is a global leader in medical technology with a strong focus on innovation, learning and improving the lives of users. The Swedish organisation has 76 employees, with its sales office and warehouse in Kungsbacka.

Key responsibilities

  • Set and continuously communicate the overall marketing direction for the Ostomy Care business in Sweden to ensure target achievement.

  • Support the Head of Marketing, Commercial Director, Country Manager and Executive Team in delivering the objectives for the Ostomy Care business and evaluating performance to drive continuous improvement.

  • Develop, review and execute the Swedish pipeline of product innovation launches, with a long-term perspective on new generation innovations.

  • Take active ownership of the Annual Business Planning process, forecasting and regular analysis of the financial performance of the Ostomy Care business.

  • Continuously monitor customer needs, market trends and competitors to identify new opportunities for growth.

  • Initiate and develop relationships with KOLs, professional bodies and Advisory Boards.

  • Ensure the marketing strategy is effectively implemented together with Sales.

  • Provide input to Market Access activities and strategic market analysis to Global Marketing and other HQ functions.

  • Deliver Ostomy Care product launches, projects and initiatives within agreed budgets and timelines.

Your background

We are looking for an experienced marketing professional who combines strong commercial understanding with analytical skills and a proven ability to take ownership and drive projects forward. We believe you have:

  • 5+ years of relevant marketing experience, preferably within MedTech, diagnostics or another healthcare-related industry.

  • Experience of independently leading product launches and complex commercial or marketing projects.

  • Strong experience in analysing sales and market data and translating insights into actions.

  • Experience of business planning, forecasting and working towards commercial KPIs.

  • Experience of working cross-functionally, preferably in an international organisation and with global stakeholders.

  • A relevant academic degree in marketing, business, health sciences or a related field.

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets; experience with Power BI is an advantage.

  • Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English.


To succeed in the role

You bring a strong commercial mindset and a proactive approach, with the confidence to take ownership and drive initiatives forward. title: Senior Organizational Effectiveness Consultant
description:

title: Photographer
description:
Inventory Photographer / Videographer

About the Role

Leachman Buick GMC Cadillac is looking for a dependable, detail oriented Inventory Photographer / Videographer to help our vehicles stand out online. This person will photograph and film our new and preowned inventory, highlighting each vehicle’s condition, features, and overall appearance.

You’ll work closely with our marketing, sales, and detail teams to ensure vehicles are captured promptly and presented accurately. Photography and inventory videos are the primary focus of this position, with occasional assistance on the lot during downtime.

If you enjoy photography, working around vehicles, and staying active throughout the day, this could be a great fit.

Job Responsibilities

  • Photograph new and preowned vehicles, capturing consistent, high quality interior, exterior, and feature photos.

Qualifications

  • Basic photography and video skills, with an eye for lighting, framing, and consistency.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage daily priorities and complete tasks with minimal supervision.

  • Comfortable safely driving and parking a variety of vehicles.

  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions and stay active throughout the workday.

  • Dependable attendance, a positive attitude, and clear communication with team members.

  • Previous automotive photography, videography, or dealership experience is a plus.

title: Burger King Sveberg søker renholder 2-3 dager i uken (kveld/natt)
description:
Burger King Sveberg søker renholder 2-3 dager i uken (kveld/natt)

Arbeidstider: 22:00 - 02:00/02:30 (4 til 4,5time varierende fra hvilken dag i uken).
Arbeidstidspunktet er fleksibelt på natten mtp å kombinere med en annen jobb, så lenge jobben er ferdig til 07:30.
Oppgi i din søknad hvilke dager det passer for deg å jobbe.

Obs! Denne jobben innebærer renhold av store maskiner, som inkluderer noen løft og skittent arbeid.

Gode gjesteopplevelser i Burger King begynner med rene restauranter og et rent kjøkken. Derfor er stillingen som renholder en av de viktigste rollene i restaurantene våre. Som renholder i Burger King arbeider du i hovedsak utenom restaurantens åpningstid. Du har ansvar for å rengjøre gjesteareal, kjøkken og kjøkkenutstyr.

For å lykkes i jobben er det viktig at du er selvstendig, grundig i din arbeidsutførelse og effektiv.

Vi ser etter deg som er pålitelig, nøyaktig og som har et øye for detaljer. Har du også godt humør og stor ansvarsfølelse, vil du med stor sannsynlighet passe inn hos oss.

Det er en fordel å snakke godt norsk, men engelsk går også bra. Du må gjerne ha erfaring fra renholdsarbeid fra før, men dette er ikke et krav da du vil få full opplæring og kontinuerlig oppfølging hos oss.

Hvem er du?

I våre restauranter er vi ikke opptatt en fancy CV, men hvem du er og hva du kan tilføre, og (viktigst av alt) at du vil gi 100% hver dag for å behandle hver eneste gjest som en konge gjemmom ditt bidrag til renslighet!

Vil du bli en del av vårt team? Ta kontakt med oss i dag!

title: Backend Engineer, Internationalisation
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Internationalisation team builds the platform that helps Stripe products work naturally across languages and markets. We create and operate the infrastructure that enables Stripe teams to localize product interfaces, services, and written communications while delivering consistent, high-quality experiences to users around the world.

We work closely with our sister Localization team and its language experts, as well as with product and service engineering teams integrating localized content. Together, we combine engineering, automation, and linguistic expertise to help Stripe build products that feel native to each market.

What you’ll do

You will design, implement, and maintain Stripe’s internationalisation platform at scale, including the developer and user experiences around it. You’ll help teams continuously localize their products while improving the quality, speed, reliability, and efficiency of Stripe’s localization processes.

This role combines backend and platform engineering with emerging LLM technology. Depending on the project, you may build end-to-end functionality for internal customers, evolve production LLM systems, develop quality-evaluation capabilities, improve platform reliability and observability, or lead migrations from legacy localization infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build internationalisation infrastructure that supports diverse content surfaces, including backend services, product interfaces, and written communications.
  • Integrate localization into Stripe’s software-development and content-production workflows, enabling teams to ship translated experiences continuously and safely.
  • Build and maintain integrations with translation-management systems, LLM services and external localization providers.
  • Evolve Stripe’s existing production LLM capabilities to improve translation quality, market relevance, turnaround time, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop automated quality checks and human-evaluation workflows that combine LLM-driven automation with expert linguistic judgment.
  • Maintain a high bar for reliability through effective testing, monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.
  • Own ambiguous, high-impact initiatives end to end—from research and experimentation through implementation, launch, measurement, and iteration.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job so our interview process is language agnostic)
  • Experience developing reliable infrastructure, platform, or backend-service solutions.
  • Strong product judgment and a commitment to building high-quality user and developer experiences.
  • Ability to own ambiguous work end to end and make progress through research, experimentation, and iteration.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building or operating production LLM or machine-learning systems.
  • Experience evaluating LLM output or combining automated systems with expert human review.
  • Familiarity with internationalisation, localization, translation, or content-management workflows.
  • Experience with CI/CD systems, developer platforms, or workflow infrastructure.
  • Backend engineering experience building services using programming languages such as Java, Ruby, or Go.
  • Experience building internal platforms that ultimately support customer-facing products.

title: Product Analyst, Digital Banking
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION: Forbright is a nationwide full-service bank and commercial lender focused on helping to build a brighter future for our clients and the communities we serve. Forbright is committed to exceptional client service by providing seamless, innovative personal banking services to depositors and creative financing solutions to visionary middle market businesses and investors in healthcare, technology, financial services, real estate, and other industries.
COMPANY CULTURE: We are a dynamic, high energy, fun, and fast-paced organization that has an exciting growth trajectory, meaningful mission, and embedded responsible practices into our daily interactions. We offer our team members a culture of collaboration, inclusion, flexibility, recognition, and giving back. We look to hire individuals that are passionate about our mission, and who are motivated, customer and results-oriented, innovative, adaptable, and thoughtful.
COMPANY MISSION: We are a mission-driven institution. We operate a sound dynamic institution that is well capitalized, liquid, profitable and uses best practices to manage risk and assure compliance with laws and regulations. We use Forbright’s capital, capabilities, innovation, and expertise to help our clients succeed and contribute broadly to building a brighter future.

JOB SUMMARY: The Product Analyst supports the development, implementation, optimization, and ongoing management of Forbright Bank's digital banking products, promotions, and customer experiences. This role works across Product, Operations, Marketing, Compliance, Technology, Customer Care, and external partners to translate business needs and customer insights into well-defined, executable solutions. The Product Analyst manages promotional initiatives through the full lifecycle, researches operational exceptions, analyzes Voice of Customer feedback, and helps maintain the product roadmap and backlog.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Support the day-to-day management and continuous improvement of digital banking products, services, and customer experiences

  • Support promotion development and implementation activities and coordinate required tasks across stakeholders, including proposing promotion structures, eligibility rules, customer journey, operational requirements, controls, and success measures

  • Create and maintain clear product and operational documentation for assigned initiatives, including requirements, business rules, process flows, decision documentation, implementation materials, and supporting artifacts. Ensure documentation remains current as requirements and decisions evolve

  • Drive assigned initiatives and workstreams from definition through implementation, proactively tracking dependencies, decisions, risks, open questions, and required stakeholder actions and escalating when necessary

  • Work with leader to assess whether proposed promotions can be supported by existing technology and related operational processes; identify constraints, dependencies, and potential solutions

  • Assist with promotion configuration within the promotional engine and coordinate testing, validation, launch readiness, monitoring, and issue resolution

  • Partner with Marketing and other stakeholders to ensure promotional creative, customer communications, disclosures, and launch activities remain on track

  • Research customer and transaction exception cases; gather relevant system and account information; document findings and applicable business rules; identify recurring patterns; and escalate cases requiring Product decisions or approvals

  • Analyze Voice of Customer feedback, complaints, contact drivers, and operational trends to identify customer pain points and enhancement opportunities, and propose enhancement recommendations for product leadership review

  • Analyze customer feedback, complaints, and competitive/market trends and provide summaries and recommendations to support product roadmap decisions

  • Assist with gathering and documenting business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications for product and process enhancements

  • Support user acceptance testing, defect validation, implementation planning, release readiness, and post-production monitoring

  • Collaborate with internal teams across Compliance, Marketing, Technology, and Operations to advance product objectives and resolve issues

  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Information Systems, Marketing, Data Analytics, or a related field required

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in product management, product operations, business analysis, banking operations, digital banking, fintech, project management, or a related field required

  • Experience supporting consumer banking products, deposit products, digital banking platforms, payments, cards, promotions, or customer engagement programs preferred

  • Experience gathering business requirements and translating business needs into product or process enhancements preferred

  • Experience working in a regulated financial services environment preferred

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel).

  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

  • Outstanding problem-solving and time management skills

  • Self-motivated, self-directed, and results-oriented

  • Adaptable and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment

  • Can work independently and within a team; solution-oriented with a collaborative approach

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to translate data, customer feedback, and operational information into practical recommendations

  • Experience managing backlogs, user stories, requirements, and prioritization processes preferred

  • Experience with Voice of Customer programs, customer feedback analysis, or customer journey mapping preferred

POSITION REQUIREMENTS: We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are capable of performing their job position. Work is primarily conducted in an office setting while certain positions may allow for remote work through the use of technology at management discretion. The functions described below are representative of those to successfully perform duties of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable employees to perform the essential functions. While performing duties of this job, the employee may be regularly required for extended periods of time to:
• Remain in a stationary position
• Use hands and fingers
• Utilize a computer monitor with visual acuity
• Operate technology or other office machinery such as printers, scanners, etc.
• Communicate clearly verbally and/or in writing with others
ADDITIONAL DUTIES: For Forbright Bank to remain efficient and nimble as a growing organization, team members are expected to exhibit a high level of flexibility regarding any duties that may be situationally assigned outside of this job description.
PERKS/BENEFITS:
• Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
• 4 weeks PTO
• 401k + company match
• Metro SmartTrip benefits ($50/mo)
• Remote or hybrid (4 days per week in-office) work schedules for most positions
• Incentives for purchasing solar panels, electric vehicles, biking to work, etc.
• Paid subscriptions to Veterans Compost, Capital Bikeshare, Imperfect Foods reimbursement, and more!
• The Washington Post Top Workplaces winner for four consecutive years (2023-2026)
CORE PRINCIPLES:
• Excellence: Excellence is not a goal, but a standard, reflected in the precision of our work and the quality of our decisions. Excellence is a discipline that compounds over time and creates lasting value; it must be measured and managed.
• People: Our people are our greatest strength. We foster a culture of respect, inclusion, and ambition - where everyone matters. We celebrate collaboration and teamwork and prize loyalty - to one another, the company, our mission, and values.
• Innovation: We invest boldly in technology, harnessing innovation not for its own sake but to make banking and lending better, faster, and smarter for our clients, more efficient for our team, and more profitable for our shareholders. By combining human insight with technological excellence, we strengthen our ability to serve, to adapt, and to succeed in a changing world. Innovation is a continuous investment in new ideas.
• Sound Practices: Our foundation rests on prudence, care, integrity, and discipline. We manage credit and business risk with rigor and fundamentals-based judgment, act with transparency, and uphold the highest standards of corporate governance and regulatory compliance to ensure sustainable growth and enduring financial strength.
• Distinct Value: We focus our energy where we add value. We avoid the commoditized and the ordinary, choosing to compete through insight, specialization, technology and service. By concentrating on areas where expertise matters and relationships endure, we create differentiation that is defensible and lasting.
• Clients: We exist to advance our clients’ success and to help them grow. We listen deeply, think creatively, and deliver solutions that solve problems, drive impact and add value. Every client relationship is built on partnership, performance, and purpose.
• Shareholders: We are committed to creating exceptional value for our shareholders. We invest for the long term and view our shareholders as partners – not observers - in value creation. We allocate capital wisely, execute with precision, and continuously adapt our business model to pursue the most attractive, risk-adjusted returns. We work to make rational decisions, avoid unnecessary complexity, maintain strong liquidity and capital, and communicate with clarity and honesty. We measure success both by current performance and by the durability and quality of the long-term value we build.
• Communities and the Environment: We believe prosperity and responsibility go hand in hand. We invest in inclusive opportunity and environmental stewardship. Our goal is simple - to do our part build a brighter, more sustainable future for the communities we serve and the world we share.
It is the policy of Forbright Bank to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals and to administer all aspects and conditions of pre-employment and employment without regard to protected characteristics.
Employment with Forbright Bank is at-will, which means that either you or the Company may terminate the relationship at any time.
By applying, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our CCPA Privacy Notice.

title: AI Content Engineer
description:
🌱 About us

Greenly was founded in 2019 by Alexis, Matthieu and Arnaud with one mission: make carbon management as essential as financial management. In 2026, Greenly joined forces with the Nordic-founded company Normative.

Today, we are a global leader in carbon accounting, proudly B-Corp certified and part of the French Tech 120. Our climate suite combines smart data collection with intuitive automation, helping companies measure, reduce, and report their emissions with ease — supported at every step by our in-house climate experts. 💚

More than 4,000 companies in 30+ countries use Greenly to manage their climate strategy: from carbon assessments and life-cycle analyses to SBTi trajectories and compliance with CSRD and CBAM.

We are now a team of 200+ people from 40+ nationalities, based in Paris, Stockholm, London, Barcelona, and New York. 🌎

To date, we’ve tracked over 200 million tons of CO₂ through our platform. Our next milestone: 10,000 clients and one billion tons of CO2 under management.

🌱 Our Values

  • Ambition for climate: Minimize GHG emissions, maximize climate impact

  • Deliver with agility: Work in small increments: fail fast, learn fast, win fast

  • Own your opportunities: Achieve outstanding results by showing initiative and accountability

  • Feedback paves the way: Succeed as a team by helping others progress

  • Be one Team: Everyone is included and needed - work together with transparency and respect

Curious to know more ? Check out our Culture Book, blog , and youtube channel 🎥

🌱 About the role

Our buyers no longer discover their suppliers only on Google. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini. This role exists so that Greenly is the answer those AIs give, and the brand people remember.

🚀 The mission

You build and run the engine that makes Greenly visible wherever our customers look for answers: in AI engines, on Google and on YouTube. You define the GEO strategy, scale content production with AI workflows, and turn that content into videos that make people want to follow Greenly.

This is not a copywriter or video editor role. It's a builder role: you design the processes, connect the tools, measure, and hold a high creative bar on everything that goes out.

Your first deliverable is your 90-day roadmap. You tell us what we should be doing, including what we haven't thought of yet. GEO and AI video change every three months: we expect you to propose, test and make the call.

You report to the VP Marketing and work with the Content & Brand, SEO, Product Marketing, Ads and Web teams.

🤝Your responsibilities

1. Define the GEO strategy and lead the audits 📈

  • Audit Greenly's visibility in AI answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews) and on Google, in FR, UK and US.

  • Identify the prompts and queries that matter to our buyers, offer by offer and industry by industry, and track our share of citations against competitors.

  • Analyse which sources AIs cite and why, then turn that into priorities: pages to create, pages to refresh, third-party sites to be present on.

  • Identify technical blockers to our AI visibility and prioritise them with our web developer, who implements them.

  • Set the GEO KPIs and produce a monthly report that leadership can read at a glance.

2. Get cited where AIs look 🤖

  • Build our presence on the sources AIs cite most: comparisons and listicles, review sites (G2, Capterra), Reddit, Wikipedia, specialist media, analyst reports.

  • Turn Greenly's proprietary data into original studies and figures, the best citation magnets.

  • Monitor what AIs say about Greenly (false or outdated information, positioning against competitors, sentiment) and correct course.

  • Measure the traffic coming from AIs and its impact on pipeline in HubSpot.

3. Rethink SEO and scale production with AI workflows ⚙️

The challenge in the AI era: rework our SEO strategy to sharply increase weekly output and drive impressions, without sacrificing click-through rate. We want real growth, not artificial gains driven by pages nobody opens. You draw on the best article production and optimisation models in the world to build ours.

  • Design and maintain workflows in AirOps, connected to Peec AI, Ahrefs and our CMS, to industrialise article research, briefing, writing and optimisation.

  • Put quality guardrails in place: verified sources, E-E-A-T, brand voice, expert review on regulatory topics.

  • Refresh the existing article library at scale, with the internal linking and structured data that help AIs cite us.

  • Document every workflow so the team can use it without you.

4. Turn articles into YouTube videos for Leaf 🌱

  • Build the process that converts our best articles into videos for Leaf's two YouTube channels: script, voice, visuals, editing, publishing.

  • Cut every long-form video into short formats (Shorts, Reels, LinkedIn).

  • Optimise titles, thumbnails, chapters and descriptions, and track retention, subscribers and traffic generated.

  • Use YouTube as a citation source: AIs increasingly rely on videos.

5. Launch the brand video strategy 📹

  • Set up the process for creating ads built to spread: a hook in the first three seconds, variant testing, fast iterations with the Ads team.

  • Create videos that give Greenly a face and a voice (experts, customers, behind the scenes, points of view) using the latest AI creation tools: Higgsfield for multi-model cinematic video, FLORA for team ideation and storyboarding, Veo, Kling, Seedance or Sora models for generation, HeyGen and ElevenLabs for avatars and voices. You keep a close watch on the market, as these tools change every three months.

  • Test AI video generation tools and decide what is brought in-house, automated or outsourced to freelancers.

🤖 Your stack

You'll start with a stack already in place and the freedom to evolve it.

  • AI visibility: Peec AI, Ahrefs Brand Radar

  • SEO and content analysis: Ahrefs, Google Search Console

  • Content workflows: AirOps, Claude and other LLMs

  • Publishing: Prismic, Notion

  • Video: Arcads, vidIQ, AI video editing and generation tool

  • Business measurement: HubSpot

🔥 What we expect from you

At 3 months. Your roadmap is approved. The full GEO audit is delivered, with priority prompts tracked in Peec AI and a citation-share baseline. A first AirOps workflow produces articles routinely, and the article → video process is running on both Leaf channels.

At 6 months. Article and video production has scaled up with no drop in quality. The first ads are being tested with the Ads team, and monthly GEO reporting is in place.

At 12 months. title: Instructor  - Merrick
description:
JETSET Pilates is a modern, music-driven Pilates brand redefining the boutique fitness experience. Our instructors do more than lead classes, they inspire confidence, build community, and create an environment where clients feel challenged, supported, and empowered to become stronger both physically and mentally. Through expert coaching, personalized attention, and genuine connection, JETSET instructors deliver an elevated fitness experience that keeps clients coming back.
Whether you’re an experienced fitness professional or looking to grow your coaching career, JETSET provides comprehensive instructor training, ongoing development, and opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly expanding brand.
As a JETSET Instructor, you’ll play an essential role in creating an unforgettable studio experience while helping clients build strength, confidence, and consistency through every class.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Deliver Exceptional Classes

  • Lead engaging, music-driven, 50-minute modern Pilates classes that deliver a safe, challenging, and consistent experience.

  • Provide individualized coaching, form corrections, and exercise modifications to clients of all fitness levels.

  • Inspire and motivate clients while maintaining energy, professionalism, and attention to detail throughout every class.

Create an Exceptional Member Experience

  • Build authentic relationships with clients and foster a welcoming, inclusive studio environment.

  • Learn clients’ names, celebrate milestones, and create meaningful connections that strengthen the studio community.

  • Deliver hospitality that reflects the JETSET brand before, during, and after every class.

Represent the JETSET Brand

  • Embody the values and culture of JETSET Pilates both inside and outside the studio.

  • Participate in team meetings, training sessions, studio events, and community initiatives.

  • Support local marketing and community engagement efforts as needed.

  • Maintain a clean, organized, and professional studio environment.

Continue to Grow

  • Complete the JETSET Instructor Training Program and participate in ongoing education and development.

  • Apply feedback from leadership to continuously improve coaching effectiveness.

  • Stay current on programming updates, coaching techniques, and JETSET best practices.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE

You’ll be successful if you:

  • Bring energy, consistency, and enthusiasm to every class you lead.

  • Enjoy building genuine relationships that keep members engaged and connected to the studio.

  • Thrive in a collaborative environment and contribute positively to the broader studio team.

  • Take pride in representing the JETSET brand professionally and creating an elevated member experience.

  • Are curious, coachable, and committed to continuously improving your skills.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Passion for health, wellness, and helping others achieve their goals.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to confidently lead a fast-paced, music-driven group fitness class.

  • Ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly, and continuously improve.

  • Previous group fitness instruction experience is preferred, but not required.

  • Current CPR/AED certification (or ability to obtain prior to teaching independently).

  • Willingness to successfully complete the JETSET Instructor Training Academy Program, including a 5-day on-site training, which may be held locally or at one of our Regional Training and Support Centers.

AVAILABILITY EXPECTATIONS

  • Ability to teach a consistent number of classes per week.

  • Availability to work mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays as business needs require.

  • Willingness and ability to attend required team meetings, continuing education sessions, and studio events.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to stand and move throughout the studio for extended periods.

  • Ability to demonstrate Pilates exercises safely and effectively.

  • Ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 30 pounds.

  • Ability to coach in a warm, fast-paced, music-driven environment.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

  • Competitive per-class compensation

  • Performance incentives (where applicable)

  • Complimentary or discounted JETSET Pilates classes

  • Flexible scheduling

  • Ongoing education and development

  • Career growth opportunities*

Compensation, benefits, scheduling expectations, and employment policies may vary by franchise owner.

*JETSET is committed to developing future leaders. Instructors who demonstrate exceptional performance may have opportunities to grow as the brand continues to expand.

title: Homeless Outreach Counselor Case Manager
description:
Please answer the following questions and submit your responses along with your resume.

Submissions without responses to these questions will not be considered:
  • Are you registered or certified as a SUD Counselor in the State of California?
  • Are you familiar with Electronic Health Records and online data collection?

Job Summary:
Center Point Inc. seeks a Counselor/Case Manager for its Men, Woman’s and Children Residential Substance Use Disorder Programs in San Rafael, Marin County. The person in this position will be providing outreach, counseling, and case management services to individuals experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness.

Overview of the position:
Under the direction of the Program Manager, the Outreach Counselor/Case Manager acts as the lead community services liaison and ensures the delivery of comprehensive case management and therapeutic services for individuals experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness.

The Outreach Counselor/Case Manager assists in identifying needed services and ensuring that these services are provided for and/or referrals are facilitated. The Outreach Counselor/Case Manager is responsible for the initial contact, engagement, assessment of needs, and enrollment into the identified assessed services.

The Outreach Counselor/Case Manager provides day-to-day case management activities of the identified individuals experiencing homelessness or at risk of homelessness, addressing linkages to other necessary systems of care (e.g., housing, SUD services, primary medical care, Mental health services, educational and vocational needs).

The Outreach Counselor/Case Manager must demonstrate the ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with staff, colleagues, administrators, and community contacts. Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with community constituents from ethnically diverse populations are essential to the position. Ability to plan, coordinate, and implement events, programs, and activities. Demonstrated strong organizational and time management skills and the ability to initiate and problem-solve.

Duties:
  • Assists with establishing eligibility and making applications for public benefits.
  • Responsible for coordinating and implementing outreach and referral services to recruit and secure appropriate treatment placements.
  • Develop case management plans for participants and record in the state and federal electronic records.
  • Make appropriate referrals to internal programs and outside agencies based on the client’s needs.
  • Monitor participants' progress relative to their case management plan.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Have a minimum of two (2) years of experience working with homeless populations experiencing Substance use and or Mental Health disorders.
  • Certified or registered as an AOD Counselor or Peer Support Specialist with a certification recognized by DHCS.
  • Familiarity with Electronic Health Records and online data collection is preferred.

The agency offers a range of benefits and a competitive salary based on experience and level of certification.

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply.

Pay: $27.00 - $33.00 per hour

  • Health insurance.
  • Paid time off.
  • Vision insurance.

San Rafael, CA: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required).

title: Senior Industrial Designer
description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

Apptronik is building robots for the real world to improve human quality of life and to help solve the ever-increasing labor shortage problem. Our team has been building some of the most advanced robots on the planet for years, dating back to the DARPA Robotics Challenge. We apply our expertise across the full robotics stack to some of the most important and impactful problems our society faces, and expect our products and technology to change the world for the better. We value passion, creativity, and collaboration to help us overcome existing technological barriers in the industry to create truly innovative products. You will join a team developing state-of-the-art general-purpose robots designed to operate in human spaces and with human tools. It is designed to work alongside humans, mobilize to human spaces, and manipulate the world around it.

We’re seeking highly creative Industrial Designers to help shape the future of robotics. We’re looking for individuals with a multidisciplinary skillset, who’re passionate about working at the forefront of an entirely new industry. As an integral part of a growing design team, you’ll collaborate with departments from across the organization to set a precedent for what a humanoid robot should be, who it should serve and execute on a collective vision.

  • Create 3D printed prototypes of concepts for evaluation, critique and further development.
  • Produce high-quality renders and/or sketches that aid in decision-making, as well as expressing your vision to the team and wider business.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Design, Product Design, or equivalent field of study.
  • Proven experience in Industrial Design with a strong portfolio showcasing tasteful, innovative and user-centric designs.
  • Excellent concept generation and ideation skills.
  • A deep appreciation for aesthetics, as well as a keen interest in how things work and how they’re made.
  • Ability to adapt to new design philosophies and principles.
  • Proficiency in CAD software such as Fusion, Solidworks, Alias or equivalent.
  • Strong 3D rendering skills (in tools such as Keyshot, Blender or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and their implications on design.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience working alongside engineers on complex electromechanical products.
  • Experience in VR and/or AR visualization.
  • A self-starter with experience working in fast-paced, ever-changing startup environments.
  • Experience working in the robotics industry.

Compensation and Perks:

  • Professional development opportunities.

title: Senior MTS, Applications
description:
We are seeking a Senior Member of Technical Staff (MTS), Applications Engineering – Product Definition to drive system-level product definition and new product development for onsemi’s SiC JFET (SJD) portfolio.

This senior technical role will bridge customer applications, system requirements, device technology, and new product development. The successful candidate will identify emerging application requirements, translate system-level needs into actionable semiconductor product requirements, and work closely with Applications Engineering, Product Marketing, Product Engineering, Technology Development, Design, Packaging, and Quality teams to define differentiated next-generation SJD products.

The role will have particular emphasis on applications where efficiency, power density, robustness, reliability, and protection capability are critical. Experience in circuit protection, automotive power electronics, or automotive electrical/electronic systems is highly preferred.

Product Definition & Technology Roadmap

  • Lead application-driven definition of next-generation SiC JFET products and solutions
  • Drive clear differentiation and product value propositions based on application and system-level benefits.
  • Translate customer and system requirements into device-level specifications and product requirements, including voltage/current ratings, RDS(on), switching behavior, SOA, short-circuit capability, avalanche capability, thermal performance, reliability, package requirements, and other application-critical parameters.
  • Identify product and technology gaps through customer feedback, system analysis, competitive benchmarking, and emerging application trends.
  • Support SJD technology and product roadmap decisions

New Product Development

  • Serve as the Applications Engineering technical lead/product definer for SJD NPD programs from concept through product release.
  • Define application requirements, application validation plans, characterization requirements, use conditions, and product success criteria.
  • Provide system/application input to product requirement documents, technical specifications, success criteria, datasheets, validation plans, and NPD technical reviews.
  • Participate actively in NPD design and gate reviews, identifying application risks and ensuring appropriate validation prior to product release.
  • Work cross-functionally to resolve gaps between customer/application requirements and device capabilities.

Application & System Engineering

  • Lead system-level analysis to understand how SJD device characteristics affect efficiency, power density, reliability, protection, thermal performance, and overall system design.
  • Define representative application test conditions and validation platforms.
  • Guide characterization in areas such as switching performance, SOA, short-circuit robustness, avalanche capability, thermal behavior, dynamic operation, and application-specific stress conditions.
  • Establish meaningful competitive benchmarks connecting device characteristics to actual system performance.
  • Support development of reference designs, evaluation platforms, application notes, technical presentations, publications, and other technical collateral where needed to demonstrate product value.

Customer & Market Engagement

  • Engage with strategic customers, FAEs, marketing, and business teams to understand current and future system requirements.
  • Convert customer problems and application trends into new product concepts and measurable engineering requirements.
  • Provide technically authoritative support during early product engagement and adoption.
  • Represent SJD Applications Engineering in customer technical discussions, design reviews, and internal product-definition forums.

Technical Leadership

  • Act as a senior technical authority for SJD applications and product definition.
  • Mentor junior application engineers in system analysis, product definition, characterization, and NPD execution.
  • Establish best practices for translating application requirements into device specifications and validation criteria.
  • Influence cross-functional teams through technical expertise and data-driven recommendations.
  • Build technical knowledge across the organization through training, application documentation, and technical publications.

Required Qualifications

  • BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a closely related discipline; PhD is a plus.
  • Extensive industry experience in power semiconductor applications, power electronics, or semiconductor product development.
  • Strong understanding of power semiconductor device behavior and its interaction with system-level performance.
  • Demonstrated experience translating system/application requirements into semiconductor product specifications.
  • Strong knowledge of power conversion topologies, switching behavior, thermal design, device characterization, and reliability considerations.
  • Experience supporting or leading new product definition and NPD activities.
  • Ability to work effectively across Applications, Product Marketing, Product Engineering, Device/Technology Development, Design, Packaging, Quality, and customer-facing organizations.
  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to influence both engineering teams and senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in circuit-protection applications and architectures is highly preferred, including solid-state circuit breakers, eFuse/hot-swap, electronic protection, high-current switching, fault interruption, or related protection functions.
  • Experience in automotive power electronics or automotive electrical/electronic systems is highly preferred, particularly applications requiring high reliability, robustness, functional protection, or high-voltage power semiconductor solutions.
  • Experience with SiC JFET, SiC MOSFET, silicon MOSFET, IGBT, or other wide-bandgap power semiconductor technologies.
  • Experience with high-voltage DC power distribution, AI/data-center power, industrial power conversion, energy infrastructure, or other high-power-density applications.
  • Hands-on experience with device characterization, switching evaluation, SOA, short-circuit testing, avalanche testing, thermal characterization, and system-level validation.
  • Experience developing technical requirements for new semiconductor products and supporting products from concept through qualification and release.

title: Capital Markets Head Trader

As the Head of MBS Trading, you will oversee the pricing, hedging, trading, and execution of our mortgage portfolio.
