title: Client Operations Process Analyst
description:
De beste resultatene kommer sjelden av å gjøre som alle andre

I Formue har vi aldri hatt som mål å passe inn i en bransje. Vi har hatt som ambisjon å flytte den fremover.

Vi utfordrer tradisjonell Wealth Management fordi vi mener kundene fortjener mer. Det er dette vi kaller Pioneering Wealth.

Formue er en ledende uavhengig formuesforvalter i Skandinavia. Vi bistår privatpersoner, familier, organisasjoner og stiftelser i Norge, Sverige og Danmark med personlig og fremtidsrettet formuesforvaltning, der global investeringskompetanse innen private og børsnoterte markeder kombineres med prisvinnende teknologi og rådgivning. Alltid med et tydelig prinsipp: På kundens side.

Vi har høye ambisjoner for videre vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil være med og forme det neste kapittelet.

Vil du være med og utvikle fremtidens kundeprosesser i Formue?

Vi søker en Client Operations Process Analyst som vil jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom kundeprosesser, analyse og teknologi.

Du blir en del av Client Operations og vil jobbe med sentrale prosesser gjennom hele kundereisen, fra onboarding og løpende kundeadministrasjon til endringer og offboarding.

Rollen kombinerer operativt arbeid med analyse og forbedring. Du vil jobbe hands-on med dagens kundeprosesser, samtidig som du analyserer hvordan de kan bli enklere, mer effektive og skalerbare. Du vil også utforske hvordan teknologi, automatisering og AI kan brukes til å redusere manuelt arbeid, styrke kvaliteten og redusere operasjonell risiko.

Dette vil du jobbe med

Som Client Operations Process Analyst vil du blant annet:

  • delta i den daglige driften og håndtere operative kundeprosesser

  • analysere og kartlegge arbeidsprosesser, risiko og forbedringsmuligheter

  • følge opp kontroller og operative avvik, identifisere rotårsaker og bidra til varige forbedringer

  • identifisere manuelt arbeid og flaskehalser og bidra til mer effektive og digitale arbeidsprosesser

  • bidra til testing, kvalitetssikring og implementering av nye og forbedrede løsninger

  • bidra til å utvikle hvordan Salesforce og andre relevante systemer støtter kundeprosessene

  • utforske hvordan data, automatisering og AI kan brukes til å forbedre kvalitet og effektivitet

Du vil samarbeide tett med kollegaer i Client Operations og relevante fag- og teknologimiljøer på tvers av Formue.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som er analytisk, nysgjerrig og strukturert, og som liker å forstå hvordan prosesser, data og systemer henger sammen. Du trives med å være tett på driften, setter deg raskt inn i nye problemstillinger og motiveres av å finne bedre måter å jobbe på.

Rollen passer godt for deg som er tidlig i karrieren. Du kan være nyutdannet eller ha noen års relevant erfaring. Det viktigste er at du har lyst til å lære og utvikle deg.

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • relevant høyere utdanning, gjerne innen økonomi, finans, teknologi, informasjonssystemer eller dataanalyse. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning

  • gode analytiske ferdigheter og en strukturert tilnærming til problemløsning

  • interesse for hvordan prosesser, data og systemer henger sammen

  • interesse for digitalisering, automatisering og AI

  • gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

  • god muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne på engelsk og et relevant nordisk språk

Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med ett eller flere av følgende områder:

  • operative kundeprosesser eller prosessforbedring

  • testing eller implementering av nye systemer og løsninger

  • Salesforce eller andre CRM- og workflow-systemer

  • Excel, Power BI eller andre analyseverktøy

  • automatiserte arbeidsprosesser eller AI-verktøy

  • finansielle tjenester eller annen regulert virksomhet

Erfaring fra finansielle tjenester eller formuesforvaltning er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste er at du er analytisk og lærevillig, og nysgjerrig på hvordan teknologi kan brukes til å løse reelle forretningsbehov.

Hvorfor Formue?

Hos Formue får du muligheten til å lære kundeprosessene fra innsiden og samtidig være med på å utvikle hvordan vi skal jobbe fremover. Du får kombinere praktisk erfaring med analyse, teknologi og prosessforbedring i et ledende nordisk kompetansemiljø innen formuesforvaltning.

Vi tror på samarbeid, kunnskapsdeling og kontinuerlig utvikling, og på at gode ideer kan bli til konkrete forbedringer for både kunder og kollegaer.

Kontaktinformasjon

For spørsmål om Formue eller stillingen, ta kontakt med:

Christina Grandal, Head of Client Operations & Reporting
📞 +4745695335 | 📧 christina.grandal@formue.no

title: Seller Engagement & Growth Professionals
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

Uber Eats Trendyol Go, originally founded as the instant delivery arm of Trendyol, one of Turkey’s leading e-commerce platforms, was acquired by Uber to join forces in accelerating the future of local commerce and on-demand delivery. Born from a dynamic startup spirit, Uber Eats Trendyol Go connects local merchants, couriers, and customers in real time to meet everyday needs with speed and reliability.

Our on-demand platform offers instant delivery for food, groceries, and more, bringing convenience and choice right to the doorsteps of millions. As part of Uber, the world’s largest mobility and delivery technology platform, we combine local market expertise with cutting-edge technology to redefine urban delivery.
We are committed to powering seamless experiences that enable customers to get what they want, when they want it, while creating flexible earning opportunities for couriers. With a mission to strengthen local commerce and foster positive impact on merchants and couriers, Uber Eats Trendyol Go is evolving rapidly, expanding its offerings and reach, innovating with technology, and delivering exceptional service every step of the way.

JOIN US AND

title: Electronic Test Technician
description:
Since 1994, Microdata Due has been a trusted leader in advanced fire safety technologies for the marine industry. As part of Consilium Safety Group, we develop innovative safety solutions that protect lives, assets, and operations worldwide.

Backed by Antin Infrastructure Partners, a leading private equity firm, Consilium Safety Group is on an ambitious growth and transformation journey. With strong financial support and a clear strategic direction, we continue to invest in innovation, operational excellence, and talented people who want to make a difference.

This is an exciting opportunity to join an international company where you can grow professionally, take on new challenges, and contribute to cutting-edge technology development.

We are now looking for an Electronics Test Technician to join Production and Testing Department.

About the role

As an Electronics Test Technician, you will play an important role in ensuring the quality, reliability and performance of our electronic products. Working closely with colleagues in production and engineering, you will carry out testing, troubleshooting and verification activities throughout the manufacturing process.

Main responsibilities

  • Perform functional testing of electronic boards, including fault finding and diagnosis of failures and anomalies.

  • Verify wiring and cable harnesses against electrical drawings and technical specifications.

  • Integrate equipment and sub-assemblies into finished systems.

  • Conduct final product testing to ensure compliance with quality requirements before delivery to customers.

  • Prepare and maintain test documentation and technical reports.

Your profile

We are looking for a structured and quality-oriented individual with a genuine interest in electronics and testing. You are methodical, accurate and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.

To succeed in this role, you have:

  • A technical diploma in electronics, electrical engineering or an equivalent qualification.

  • The ability to read and interpret electrical and electronic schematics.

  • Good practical knowledge of laboratory instruments, including oscilloscopes, multimeters and function generators.

  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and Excel.

  • A structured approach to problem-solving and strong attention to detail and quality.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively while taking responsibility for your own tasks.

Additional qualifications and experience

The following qualifications and experience would be considered an advantage:

  • Knowledge of English, particularly for reading and understanding technical documentation.

  • Previous experience in a similar position.

  • Practical experience in THT and SMD component soldering on printed circuit boards (PCBs).

  • Experience in manufacturing wiring harnesses, including soldering, crimping and wire-wrap connections.

  • Experience in preparing production and quality documentation, such as Test Reports, Process Flow Charts and Certificates of Conformity (CoC).

Join us and make a difference

At Consilium Safety Group, you will become part of an international organisation committed to innovation, quality and safety. We offer the opportunity to contribute to products and technologies that make a real difference in protecting people and critical infrastructure.

Ready to put your technical skills to work in an organisation shaping the future of SafetyTech?

Apply today and become part of Consilium Safety Group!

title: LIA inom Redovisning hos Kleer
description:
Redovisningsyrket förändras snabbt, och hos oss syns det redan i vardagen. Allt mer av rutinarbetet sköts av plattformen och AI, och våra redovisningskonsulters roll flyttar från att utföra till att granska, göra bedömningar och ge kunden råd. Som LIA-student hos oss får du vara med mitt i det skiftet, med riktiga kunder, riktiga bokslut och kollegor som gärna delar med sig.

💜 Mer om Kleer

Kleer är ett framåtlutat FaaS-bolag som kombinerar marknadens mest automatiserade ekonomisystem med en tjänsteleverans som stöttar kunderna med det bara en människa kan göra. Vi har fått utmärkelsen DI Gasell 8 gånger och är ett värderingsstyrt bolag där våra värdeord är Driven by passion, It's fun to succeed, Stay Curious & Shine bright together. Vi är ca 200 kollegor med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg och Malmö.

💼 Så ser din LIA ut

Du blir en del av ett av våra konsultteam inom Consulting, där vi är runt 120 redovisnings- och lönekonsulter som tillsammans är ekonomifunktionen för våra kunder. Våra kunder är allt från konsultbolag och snabbväxande SaaS- och AI-bolag till stiftelser.

Under praktiken får du bl.a:

  • Jobba med redovisning. Du hanterar leverantörsfakturor, gör bankavstämningar och arbetar med månadsbokslut. Du har också möjlighet att stötta konsulterna i teamet med årsbokslut.

  • Se hur AI och automatisering används på riktigt. Du lär dig hur systemet tolkar och konterar underlag, och hur du kontrollerar det som har bokförts.

  • Använda AI i vardagen, till exempel Claude för att reda ut en klurig redovisningsfråga, förstå en kunds siffror eller skriva ett första utkast till ett mejl.

  • Komma nära kunden. Du får ta del av kunddialogen och se hur en konsult blir kundens bollplank och rådgivare.

  • Vara en del av teamet. Du är med på gruppmöten och case och lär dig av kollegor på alla nivåer.

🌟 Därför ska du välja Kleer

  • En LIA där du verkligen lär dig. Strukturerad onboarding, en dedikerad handledare och löpande stöttning av både teamledare och kollegor.

  • En inblick i framtidens redovisningsyrke. Du lär dig grunderna ordentligt och får samtidigt jobba med AI och automatisering, något som blir allt viktigare i branschen.

  • Kollegor som hjälps åt. Hos oss är det prestigelöst, och ingen fråga är för liten.

🎯 Vem är du?

Du studerar en relevant utbildning, till exempel redovisningskonsult, och ska göra LIA under våren 2027 (LIA 1 eller LIA 2).

Vi tror att du:

  • Har ett stort intresse för redovisning och vill förstå varför siffrorna blir som de blir, inte bara hur.

  • Är noggrann. När systemet gör mer av utförandet blir granskningen och bedömningen ännu viktigare.

  • Är nyfiken och öppen för nya sätt att jobba. Du testar gärna nya verktyg och har samtidigt en sund kritisk blick för vad AI är bra på och vad det inte bör användas till.

  • Är kommunikativ och lösningsorienterad, och gillar tanken på att jobba nära kunder.

  • Trivs i team men tar egna initiativ och driver dina uppgifter framåt.

  • Är motiverad att lära dig, och ställer hellre en fråga för mycket än en för lite.

Du behöver inte kunna något om AI sedan tidigare. Nyfikenheten räcker, resten lär du dig hos oss.

📌 Övrigt

📍 Ort: Praktiken utgår från vårt kontor i Stockholm
🗓 Period: enligt din utbildnings LIA-period, [våren 2027]

Vi genomför bakgrundskontroll i slutskedet av vår rekryteringsprocess.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Vårdbiträde till hemtjänsten på helgen - Åkersberga
description:
Aleo Omsorg är ett familjeägt företag som erbjuder hemtjänst, boendestöd och hemservice. Vår vision är att skapa trygghet och självständighet för våra kunder, med omsorg från hjärtat. Hos oss får du arbeta i ett engagerat team med nära stöd, kollektivavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och moderna arbetsverktyg.

Vi söker nu personal till vårt team i Österåker som vill arbeta Varje eller varannan helg. På Aleo får du ett meningsfullt arbete där du gör skillnad, varje dag.

Tjänstgöring och anställningsvillkor

Tjänstgöring: Lördag & söndag
Arbetstider: 07.00 - 15.30 eller 15.30 - 22.30
Anställningsform: Behovsanställning
Startdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
Arbetsplats: Du utgår från vårt kontor i Österåker och arbetar inom Österåker kommun

Arbetsuppgifter – Vad kommer du att göra?

Hos oss arbetar du i kundernas hem med varierande insatser utifrån individuella behov:

  • Personlig omvårdnad – stöd vid hygien, på- och avklädning samt förflyttningar

  • Socialt stöd & samtal – skapa trygghet genom närvaro och gott bemötande

  • Stöd i vardagen – hjälp vid måltider och enklare hushållssysslor

  • Tillsyn & trygghet – uppmärksamma behov och bidra till säker omsorg

  • Dokumentation – dokumentera enligt genomförandeplan

  • Trygghetslarm – snabbt bemöta akuta behov hos kunder som larmat. Vi arbetar på uppdrag av Österåker kommun och ansvarar för både sedvanliga hemtjänstuppgifter och hantering av trygghetslarm mellan kl. 07.00 - 22.30. Det innebär ett omväxlande uppdrag med både planerade och mer akuta insatser.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är engagerad och vill bidra till en trygg och professionell hemtjänst:

  • Undersköterskeutbildning (Mycket meriterande) – du har en godkänd utbildning, gärna med erfarenhet

  • God svenska i tal och skrift – du kan kommunicera tydligt och dokumentera korrekt

  • B-körkort (Krav) – du är en trygg och van bilförare

  • Cykelvan (Krav) – du känner dig bekväm med att ta dig mellan kunder på cykel

  • Ansvarstagande, flexibel och lösningsorienterad – du tar initiativ, arbetar självständigt och behåller lugnet i olika situationer samtidigt som du samarbetar väl med kollegor och möter människor med empati, respekt och förståelse.

  • Digitalt van – du använder mobil i ditt dagliga arbete

Vi tar ej emot ansökningar per mejl.

title: FinOps Engineer III
description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.

The Infrastructure Engineering group (IE) at ZoomInfo is responsible for the innovation, scaling, and automation that powers our global platforms. Within this group, the Cloud Financial Governance function serves as the strategic architect of our technology investment.

We are seeking a FinOps Engineer to join the centralized FinOps team of our enterprise-scale, multi-cloud organization. In this role, you will play a crucial part in optimizing our core GCP and AWS spend, as well as our global suite of third-party tech stacks by driving financial accountability and implementing best practices. Getting hands-on with our infrastructure, you will identify, build, and automate cost-saving opportunities. You will work directly with engineering teams to optimize cloud architectures, implement robust tagging frameworks, and deploy the automated guardrails needed to keep our environments highly efficient

What You'll do:

  • Drive cloud and AI cost optimization across GCP and AWS by identifying, quantifying, and implementing savings opportunities spanning compute, storage, networking, and data services. Track AI usage and costs across multiple providers such as Anthrophic, OpenAI, and others.
  • Build and automate guardrails - including budget alerts, anomaly detection, and rightsizing recommendations to keep multi-cloud environments efficient by default.
  • Design and enforce tagging and allocation frameworks that enable accurate cost attribution, showback/chargeback, budgeting & forecasting, and unit-economics reporting across teams and products.
  • Manage commitment-based discounts (Committed Use Discounts, Savings Plans, Reserved Instances) by analyzing usage patterns and optimizing coverage and utilization.
  • Partner directly with engineering teams to review and re-architect workloads for cost efficiency, embedding FinOps principles into design and deployment practices.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and forecasts that give stakeholders clear visibility into spend trends, drivers, and the ROI of optimization efforts.
  • Govern third-party SaaS and tech-stack spend, partnering with engineering to evaluate, right-size, and consolidate vendor costs.
  • Establish and evangelize FinOps best practices, standards, and self-service tooling that scale financial accountability across the organization.

What you bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or FinOps, with a strong focus on cost optimization and governance.
  • Hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud provider (GCP or AWS); experience with both in a multi-cloud environment strongly preferred. Solid understanding of cloud architecture, services, and pricing models across compute, storage, networking, and managed services.
  • Proven experience building and managing automated FinOps alerting: anomaly detection, budget and forecast thresholds, and alert routing and tuning
  • Familiarity with tracking AI model usage and spend across multiple LLM providers, including token-based pricing, provider usage and billing APIs, and attribution of AI cost to teams or productsProficiency with cloud cost-management tooling (e.g., GCP Billing/BigQuery billing exports, AWS Cost Explorer/CUR, CloudHealth, or equivalent third-party platforms).
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Python preferred) for data analysis and automation
  • Experience building dashboards and reports in Looker, Looker Studio, Tableau or similar tools
  • Clear communication skills, and the ability to influence engineering and finance stakeholders without direct authority
  • FinOps Certified Practitioner certification and/or relevant cloud certifications are a plus.
  • Financial and engineering fluency - able to translate technical architecture decisions into financial impact, and financial goals into technical action.
  • Analytical rigor - comfortable working with large datasets to surface insights, quantify opportunities, and prioritize by impact.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration - able to influence engineering, finance, and procurement stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Bias for automation - instinctively builds repeatable, scalable solutions rather than one-off manual fixes.
  • Clear communication - able to present complex cost data and recommendations to both technical and non-technical teams.

#LI-Remote

ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. title: Senior Front end developer
description:
Join Cafeyn: Where Innovation Meets Inspiration

Cafeyn is more than a platform— it is transforming the way people access and experience content. Since 2006, we’ve grown in a fast-evolving market, adapting to become a leading digital reading service with over 2 million users worldwide. Cafeyn gives readers unlimited, personalized access to thousands of newspapers and magazines, curated to fit their tastes and delivered seamlessly across devices.

Our mission?
To empower individuals with access to trusted, high-quality content that fosters personal growth and discovery. Whether it's through the comprehensive collection of news and features on Cafeyn, the digital publishing solutions of Milibris, the fun and educative content for children on Kidjo, or the collections for manga lovers by Mangas.io, Cafeyn stands at the forefront of digital content experiences.

Your team & responsibilities

As a Senior Front-End Web Developer, you will join Cafeyn's Integration Team, where you will contribute to the development and evolution of the Cafeyn End User application.

Working primarily with Vue.js 3 and TypeScript, you will build new front-end features, develop reusable UI components, and ensure a seamless, high-performance user experience.

You will collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Back-End teams, taking ownership of your developments while contributing to technical decisions, front-end architecture, and engineering best practices.

Your Missions

  • Develop and maintain front-end features for the Cafeyn End User application using Vue.js 3 and TypeScript.

  • Design, build, and maintain reusable and shared UI components.

  • Collaborate with Product and UX/UI teams to translate requirements and designs into polished, responsive interfaces.

  • Contribute to front-end architecture and technical decisions.

  • Leverage Nuxt.js when relevant, particularly for Server-Side Rendering (SSR).

  • Ensure high standards of performance, SEO, accessibility, and code quality.

  • Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code following best practices.

  • Implement and maintain unit and end-to-end tests.

  • Participate in code reviews and collaborative development workflows through GitHub.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve cross-browser compatibility and performance issues.

  • Stay up to date with modern front-end technologies, frameworks, and web development trends.

  • Actively contribute to team knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and technical collaboration.

What We're Looking For

Technical Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in front-end development.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.

  • Excellent knowledge of Vue.js 3 and its ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with Nuxt.js, particularly its Server-Side Rendering (SSR) capabilities.

  • Knowledge of Vuetify is a plus.

  • Proven experience building reusable components and scalable front-end applications.

  • Solid understanding of front-end architecture, clean code principles, and development best practices.

  • Experience with unit testing and E2E testing methodologies.

  • Comfortable working with GitHub and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong attention to detail and a genuine focus on product quality.

  • Genuine interest in AI

Soft Skills

  • Autonomous and proactive, with the ability to take ownership of projects and deliverables.

  • A strong team player who enjoys collaborating and supporting others.

  • Able to communicate effectively and provide constructive feedback.

  • Curious and eager to learn, with an interest in new technologies and digital culture.

  • Aligned with a culture of knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and collective ownership.

Hiring process

  1. HR Interview with one of our Talent Acquisition Manager (30’)

  2. Hiring manager Interview with our Lead Integration & Lead front end.

  3. Case study that you will present to our Lead front end & senior front end developer

  4. Peer Interview with our team product

  5. Last Interview with our Director of Engineering & Acting CTO

Perks & benefits of working at Cafeyn

  • Classic package 🎓

We provide a Swile card for your meal vouchers, Sidecare health insurance, and a mobility package to reimburse your transport subscription.

  • Sports 🏃

We have a partnership with Wellpass that gives you access to fitness classes and wellness activities for both exercise and relaxation as you want.

  • Mental Health 🧠

You have an access to our mental health platform teale, where you can book appointments with your psychologist or monitor your mental health.

  • Hybrid policy 🏠

We allow you to work remotely two days per week.

  • Cafeyn’s access 🗞️

We provide you with a VIP code for Cafeyn, giving you unlimited access to all content on our platform.

  • Team life 🪅

We organize four office meet-ups per year. These occasions allow us to gather with our international offices, celebrate company updates, and spend quality time together.

You don’t have to match all the requirements, if you feel this offer could be a great opportunity for you, reach out anyways! We hire based on talent and we promote inclusivity inside Cafeyn and strongly believe that our culture is strongest when it is the most diverse.

title: Member Services Representative (Part Time)
description:
Job Summary

title: Iekārtu operators/e
description:
Dinair Filton ir viens no Dinair grupas gaisa filtru ražošanas uzņēmumiem, un ietilpst pasaules lielākajā gaisa filtru ražošanas uzņēmumā AAF (American Air Filter).

Dinair Filton ražo gaisa filtrus kopš 2006.gada, un šo 20 gadu laikā esam izauguši par starptautisku uzņēmumu, kas nodrošina vairāk, kā 270 darba vietas Olainē.

Tev patīk darbs ar iekārtām, proti lasīt rasējumus un nebaidies strādāt patstāvīgi? Ja esi atbildīgs, precīzs un Tev ir tehniskā domāšana, pievienojies mūsu komandai kā iekārtu operators/e.

Tavi galvenie pienākumi:

  • Vadīt un uzraudzīt ražošanas iekārtu darbību;

  • Veikt iekārtu sagatavošanu, iestatīšanu un regulēšanu atbilstoši ražošanas vajadzībām;

  • Lasīt un izprast darba uzdevumus, rasējumus un tehnisko dokumentāciju;

  • Sagatavot un nodrošināt ražošanas procesam nepieciešamos materiālus;

  • Nodrošināt stabilu un efektīvu ražošanas procesa norisi;

  • Veikt saražotās produkcijas kvalitātes kontroli;

  • Identificēt un novērst vienkāršas tehniska rakstura problēmas savas kompetences ietvaros;

  • Nodrošināt darba uzdevumu izpildi noteiktajos termiņos.

Sagaidām, ka Tev ir:

  • Augsta atbildības sajūta, precizitāte un pašdisciplīna;

  • Spēja efektīvi strādāt komandā;

  • Gatavība strādāt maiņu darbu (06:15-15:00, 15:00-23:45, nepieciešamības gadījumā darbs var tikt organizēts nakts maiņā);

  • Prasme lasīt un izprast rasējumus un tehnisko dokumentāciju;

  • Spēja pieņemt lēmumus un risināt problēmsituācijas savas kompetences ietvaros;

  • Vēlama iepriekšēja darba pieredze iekārtu operatora vai līdzīgā amatā;

  • Angļu valodas zināšanas, kas tiks uzskatītas par priekšrocību;

  • Vēlama tehniskā izglītība.

Mēs Tev piedāvājam:

  • Iespēju iegūt unikālu pieredzi starptautiskā ražošanas uzņēmumā;

  • Iespēju apgūt jaunas prasmes mūsdienīgā un drošā darba vidē;

  • Atalgojumu sākot no 1500 EUR bruto mēnesī, atkarībā no kandidāta pieredzes, izglītības, zināšanām un profesionālajām kompetencēm. Atalgojums tiek pārskatīts pēc pārbaudes laika, izvērtējot darba sniegumu un apgūtās kompetences;

  • Ērtu darba apģērbu un tā profesionālu kopšanu pēc pārbaudes laika;

  • Darba apavus jau no pirmās darba dienas;

  • Veselības apdrošināšanas polisi pēc pārbaudes laika;

  • Bezmaksas kafiju un tēju ik dienu;

  • Atsaucīgus un profesionālus kolēģus;

  • Dāvanu dzimšanas dienā;

  • Iespēju saņemt prēmijas par sasniegtajiem darba rezultātiem;

  • Iespēju piedalīties uzņēmuma organizētajos komandas saliedēšanas pasākumos;

  • Uzņēmuma nodrošinātu transportu maršrutā Jelgava - Ozolnieki - Jaunolaine - Olaine uz darbu un pēc darba.

Tu esi tikai viena klikšķa attālumā, lai kļūtu par daļu no Dinair Filton lieliskās komandas.

Spied "Pieteikties" un tiekamies drīz, darba intervijā!

Richelieu is a leading North American distributor, importer, and manufacturer of specialty hardware and complementary products. Our products are targeted to an extensive customer base of kitchen and bathroom cabinet, storage and closet, home furnishing and office furniture manufacturers, door and window, residential and commercial woodworkers, and hardware retailers including renovation superstores. Richelieu offers customers a broad mix of high-end products sourced from manufacturers worldwide. With over 150,000 product offerings, 112 locations in North America, and a state-of-the-art field force that passionately serves over 110,000 customers, Richelieu continues to stand in the forefront of a dynamic and ever-changing industry.

Since 1968, Richelieu has understood the significance and impact of a strong set of Core Values. Richelieu stands behind these Five Core Values that serve as the guiding principles of everything we do: Customer Focus, Innovation, Performance, Respect/Integrity/Ethics, and Ownership.

title: Senior Manager, Systems Engineering
description:
Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle.

As Senior Systems Engineering Manager for avionics, you will lead the organization responsible for translating customer and business needs into safe, certifiable, and supportable aircraft systems. You will guide systems architecture, requirements, interfaces, safety, integration, verification, and certification across the product lifecycle for commercial, military, rotorcraft, and emerging air mobility platforms.

You will shape systems engineering strategy, workforce capability, processes, tools, and execution priorities. Working across hardware, software, program management, product management, quality, manufacturing, airworthiness, customers, and regulatory authorities, you will ensure technical integrity while delivering to cost, schedule, quality, and performance commitments.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary systems engineering team, including systems architects, requirements engineers, integration and verification engineers, and technical leaders.
  • Build a high-performing engineering culture through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, workforce planning, performance management, and employee engagement.
  • Own systems engineering execution for new product development, product enhancements, certification programs, and sustaining engineering across the full lifecycle.
  • Provide technical oversight of system architectures, requirements decomposition, interface definitions, trade studies, design reviews, integration, verification, validation, and certification evidence.
  • Ensure effective application of SAE ARP4754A and ARP4761A principles, including development assurance, functional hazard assessment, system safety assessment, and requirements-based verification.
  • Establish and improve requirements management, configuration control, traceability, review, and change-control practices using tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, or equivalent platforms.
  • Advance model-based systems engineering practices using SysML and architecture tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler or equivalent solutions.
  • Partner with hardware and software leaders to align system requirements and assurance activities with RTCA DO-178C, DO-254, DO-160, and applicable FAA, EASA, and customer expectations.
  • Drive system integration and verification planning, including test strategy, test readiness, laboratory and aircraft integration, anomaly resolution, and objective evidence closure.
  • Partner with senior leaders, program managers, customers, suppliers, and functional stakeholders to resolve technical risk and deliver successful program outcomes.
  • Support proposals, product roadmaps, basis-of-estimate development, technical planning, and customer or regulatory technical engagements.
  • Own systems engineering process health, metrics, lessons learned, and continuous improvement, balancing rigor with efficient program execution.
  • Use AI-enabled engineering workflows responsibly to improve requirements quality, traceability, review efficiency, knowledge reuse, and team productivity.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Systems, Electrical, Computer, Software, Mechanical, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 12+ years of engineering experience in aerospace, avionics, defense, or another safety-critical industry.
  • 5+ years of engineering leadership or management experience, including responsibility for direct reports and technical leaders.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex avionics systems development through requirements, design, integration, verification, certification, production, and field support.
  • Strong working knowledge of systems engineering methods, requirements management, interface control, verification and validation, and technical risk management.
  • Experience with aircraft or avionics certification and development assurance practices, including SAE ARP4754A and system safety processes aligned with ARP4761 or equivalent.
  • A people-first leadership record that includes talent development, coaching, performance management, organizational planning, and building inclusive, accountable teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to lead through influence in a matrixed, multi-site organization.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Engineering Management, or an MBA.
  • Commercial or military avionics product development experience, particularly with integrated surveillance, communications, navigation, flight display, or aircraft connectivity systems.
  • Hands-on familiarity with RTCA DO-178C, DO-254, DO-160, SAE ARP4754A, SAE ARP4761A, MIL-STD-810, and related FAA or EASA certification guidance.
  • Experience with IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Cameo Systems Modeler, MATLAB/Simulink, or comparable requirements, MBSE, and analysis tools.
  • Experience leading system safety, reliability, cybersecurity, human factors, environmental qualification, or aircraft integration activities.
  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and engineering partners, including outsourced or international development organizations.
  • INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP) or Expert Systems Engineering Professional (ESEP) certification.

Why this role:

  • Significant organizational impact and broad responsibility for systems engineering across complex, safety-critical avionics products.
  • Ownership of systems engineering strategy, capability, processes, culture, and execution for a growing portfolio.
  • Opportunity to develop future technical and people leaders while advancing modern MBSE, digital engineering, and AI-enabled workflows.
  • Visibility with senior leadership, customers, and regulatory stakeholders, with direct participation in growth and transformation initiatives.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Acron Aviation is proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity and to maintaining a workplace free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Additional Information:

Acron Aviation maintains a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where allowed by law. Acron Aviation is an E-Verify employer.

U.S. Person Requirement

This position may require access to information, technology, software, or hardware that is subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations. To comply with these requirements, applicants must qualify as a US Person.

title: Testing & Advisory Lead
description:
Make your mark at BRE!

BRE is a world-leading global organisation for innovation, science and data in the built environment. For over 100 years, we have supported governments, businesses and industry with pioneering research, testing and expertise. We are focused on growth, scale and expanding our global impact with products, services, standards and qualifications that address the challenges of a changing world. Driven by our purpose of helping everyone, in every building, everywhere, we are creating a safer, more sustainable built environment for people and planet.

Your role at BRE

Reporting to the Deputy Managing Director for Assurance, the Testing & Advisory Lead is responsible for the strategic, operational and commercial leadership of BRE's testing and advisory portfolio. You'll oversee laboratories, testing facilities and technical teams, ensuring services are safe, efficient, accredited and commercially successful.

This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll balance operational excellence with long-term growth. You'll lead technical capability development, oversee investment in facilities and equipment, drive innovation in testing and advisory services, and build strong relationships with customers, regulators and industry stakeholders. You'll also hold accountability for financial performance, resource planning and the continued growth of the function.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the safe and effective operation of laboratories, testing facilities and technical resources.

  • Ensure compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements and accreditation frameworks, including UKAS and ISO/IEC 17025.

  • Drive technical excellence, governance and risk management across testing activities.

  • Develop and grow new testing capabilities, methodologies and advisory services.

  • Own financial performance, including budgets, pricing strategy and P&L management.

  • Oversee laboratory capacity, equipment investment and long-term technical capability planning.

  • Build and develop high-performing teams through workforce planning, succession planning and leadership development.

  • Partner with commercial teams to strengthen customer relationships, win new business and grow revenue.

  • Represent BRE with customers, regulators, trade bodies and technical committees.

  • Provide regular performance reporting and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

What we are looking for

We're looking for an accomplished senior leader with experience leading testing, laboratory, engineering or technical service operations in a regulated environment.

You'll bring:

  • Significant leadership experience within commercial laboratories, testing organisations, engineering operations or similar technical environments.

  • A strong track record of managing operational performance alongside commercial and financial responsibility, including budgets and P&L ownership.

  • Experience leading accredited testing, quality management systems, technical governance and compliance activities.

  • Strong knowledge of laboratory operations, technical equipment, facilities management and resource planning.

  • Experience developing new technical services, capabilities or customer-focused solutions.

  • Proven ability to lead, coach and develop technical teams through change and growth.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with experience building relationships across customers, leadership teams and external partners.

  • Strong strategic thinking, commercial awareness and decision-making capability.

  • Experience with ISO/IEC 17025, UKAS-accredited testing environments, laboratory investment programmes, technical advisory services, or working with regulators and industry bodies would be particularly beneficial.

BRE Benefits

At BRE, we offer a competitive salary, reviewed annually, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial security, well-being, and career development.

Financial & Security Benefits

  • Pension scheme – 5% employer-matched contribution

  • Life assurance – 4x your basic salary

  • Enhanced maternity package

Health & Wellbeing

  • HealthPartners cashback scheme – Reclaim costs on prescriptions, physiotherapy, dental care, and more

  • Onsite facilities – Restaurant, nursery, and free parking, including at-cost EV charging points

Career Development

  • Learning & development – Free access to BRE Academy and our online learning platform

  • Professional membership reimbursement

For full details on our benefits, visit: BRE Employee Benefits

Work Location Options

Hybrid – This role offers a mix of home and office working. You will need to be within commuting distance of our Watford office, as you will be expected to attend in person (3 - 4 times per week depending on business needs).

Our Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process we will be conducting 10-30 minute phone screening calls via an AI recruiter called Ryan with all shortlisted candidates. The information gathered from this screening will be used to help assess your suitability for the position.

Note to Employment Agencies

At BRE, we value the relationships we have built with our preferred recruitment partners. We do not accept unsolicited CVs from employment agencies. Any CVs submitted directly to a BRE employee or hiring manager without a signed BRE Employment Agency Agreement and an active engagement for the specific role will be considered unsolicited. In such cases, no fees will be payable should the candidate be hired through this or any other means.

Equal Opportunities Statement

title: Senior Primary Engineer (Electro mechanical)
description:
Role summary

The Senior Primary Engineer will play a pivotal role in delivering effective engineering solutions across both project execution and tendering phases. This position involves leading the primary design scope, ensuring seamless integration across all technical interfaces.You will be an integral part of our skilled, multidisciplinary primary and secondary engineering teams in Sweden and Norway, working closely with colleagues across both countries and contributing to a diverse portfolio of international Transmission & Distribution (T&D) substation projects.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Primary engineer for tenders and projects, you will ensure that the relevant tasks are performed in accordance with the internal and external requirements that apply at the time:

  • Responsible for leading the electro-mechanical design of Medium Voltage (MV) and High Voltage (HV) Air-Insulated (AIS) and Gas-Insulated (GIS) Substation projects, ensuring high-quality, compliant, and efficient engineering solutions throughout all project phases.

  • Develop substation layout designs, associate detailed drawings and document in accordance with applicable standards, established processes, and customer specifications. This will be achieved through coordination with allocated resources both locally and across other business units.

  • Develop Technical Concepts, specifications and select components and connection materials with consideration of cost-efficiency, quality, international standards, and material suitability.

  • Prepare technical calculations, procurement specifications, and equipment schedules for primary substation components, ensuring alignment with project requirements and utilities standards.

  • Support Civil Design and Interface Coordination. Provide essential input for civil design activities and coordinate interfaces between construction planning, steel structure engineering, and component suppliers to ensure alignment and integration across disciplines.

  • Cost Estimation and Documentation: Prepare Bills of Quantities (BoQ), cost estimates, and manage deviations and clarifications to support project planning and tendering.

  • Supplier Coordination and Testing: Review supplier designs and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) plans. Participate in factory and site testing activities to ensure compliance with technical requirements and quality standards.

title: Senior Planner / Strategist
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. SENIOR PLANNER / STRATEGIST

Working in direct partnership with a leading European pet care client (part of a major international food group), the Senior Planner / Strategist will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction for four leading pet care brands.

Embedded within our dedicated on-site agency hub in Barcelona, you will collaborate closely with the client's Global Brand Teams on high-impact global briefs. Your focus will be upstream and conceptual: uncovering transformative consumer and cultural insights, authoring inspirational creative briefs, defining brand and communication strategies, and building comprehensive global master toolkits.

This is an exceptional opportunity for an ambitious, culturally attuned, and insight-driven strategist to establish foundational strategic frameworks, elevate creative ambition, and influence the global trajectory of major pet care brands.

WHAT IS REQUIRED

  • Partner directly with the client's Global Marketing Leads and Brand Managers to define overarching brand, communication, and campaign strategies across cat and dog portfolios.

  • Interrogate client challenges to uncover the real commercial and cultural problems strategy needs to solve, converting complex business goals into clear, actionable creative propositions.

Audience Insight & Cultural Intelligence

  • Dig deep into pet owner (pet parent) behaviours, motivations, and cultural trends using qualitative discovery, social listening tools, and audience data platforms (e.g., GWI, category research).
  • Translate data and category trends into rich, inspiring human insights that ignite breakthrough creative ideas.
  • Help clients stay at the forefront of modern marketing, championing audience-first and culturally resonant thinking across all touchpoints.

  • Collaborate with the Strategy Director and cross-functional leads to establish best-practice strategic frameworks, briefing templates, and workshop methodologies for the account.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

title: Renholder
description:
I Eir vet vi at et rent arbeidsmiljø gjør mer enn å se bra ut. Det skaper trivsel, trygghet og bedre arbeidsdager. Godt renhold bidrar til både helse og produktivitet, og er en viktig del av hverdagen på enhver arbeidsplass.

Hos oss er renhold mer enn rutiner. Vi jobber grundig og systematisk, fra gulvvask og støvtørking til søppeltømming, sanitærvask og møbel- og tepperens. Samtidig tilpasser vi løsningene til hver enkelt kunde, slik at de får det som passer best for sitt miljø og behov.

Hvorfor jobbe i Eir?
Hos Eir får du en jobb med mening. Her handler det ikke bare om renhold, men om å skape et godt sted å være, for tusenvis av mennesker hver dag.

Du blir en del av et lag som bryr seg, både om hverandre og om jobben vi gjør. Med fokus på bærekraft, kvalitet og folk, får du utvikle deg, bli sett og bidra til noe viktig, uansett hvilken rolle du har.

Eir søker nå en renholder til varierte oppdrag i Alta område. Hovedsakelig dreier det seg om tidsavgrensede jobber som rundvask, men vi har også faste renholdsoppdrag i området. Vi ønsker en som kan jobbe fleksibelt, og omfanget av stillingen avtaler vi sammen etter hvert. Hvis behovet hos kundene er der, kan det på sikt bli aktuelt med fast (full) stilling.

Hvem er du?

For å trives i denne rollen må du like å jobbe selvstendig, og ta ansvar for ditt eget arbeid. Ettersom du vil benytte bil på jobb, er det krav om førerkort. Du vil også være i kontakt med kunder, og det er derfor viktig at du kan uttrykke deg godt på norsk eller engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig. Viktigst av alt har du et ønske om å yte god service og levere et skinnende resultat – hver eneste gang.

Hva vi kan tilby:

  • Et inkluderende og trivelig arbeidsmiljø

  • En fleksibel tilkallingsvikar stilling, med mulighet for fast kontrakt i framtiden

  • Lønn iht. tariff

  • Grundig opplæring og muligheter for videreutvikling

Hvis dette høres ut som noe for deg håper vi å motta din søknad snarest. Søknader vil behandles fortløpende.

title: Developer Advocate
description:
Yugabyte is the company behind YugabyteDB, the AI-ready, multi-modal, distributed PostgreSQL database for cloud-native apps. Trusted by industry leaders including Shopify, Paramount+, GM, Kroger, Fiserv, and NPCI, YugabyteDB has been deployed in over 100 countries and powers more than 5 million clusters worldwide.

Together, our hard-working team of experts and our industry-leading technology are uniquely positioned to meet the demands of modern workloads: geo-distributed, ultra-resilient, and built to scale without limits.

Our Yugabeings (distributed, like our database) span 12+ countries and multiple time zones, sharing expertise from diverse backgrounds and industries.

Developer Advocate, Community

Location: Remote US

About the role

Yugabyte has redefined the data infrastructure developers use for distributed Postgres applications and multi-agent AI systems. As a Developer Advocate focused on Yugabyte’s rapidly growing community, you will energize the developers building with YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP (Agentic Multitenant Postgres), and Meko, our agent-native data platform that gives multi-agent systems shared memory and knowledge.

You will own community programs end-to-end, including workshops, meetups, hackathons, partner events, and the online spaces where developers ask questions, share what they built, and help each other. Success in this role means more developers showing up, building something real, and coming back. You will work closely with product, engineering, marketing, and the rest of the DevRel team, and you will bring what you hear from the community into the roadmap. Most importantly, you will collaborate with the rest of our Developer Advocacy team to present a unified, global approach to how we work with devs. This is a fun role on a fun team at the most important (and fun) time in our company’s history. Should be fun!

What you’ll do

Grow the community

  • Build and run a community growth plan across YugabyteDB, YugabyteDB AMP, and Meko, with goals for membership, active participation, and contribution.
  • Run and grow the Yugabyte community Slack and Discord, and build an active presence in the channels where developers already gather, including Reddit, GitHub, Stack Overflow, LinkedIn, Bluesky, and X.
  • Launch programs that recognize and reward participation, such as a community champions program, contributor spotlights, and regular office hours.
  • Turn active community members into speakers, authors, sample app contributors, and meetup hosts.

Run hands-on events

  • Design and deliver workshops that take developers from first install to a working app, including labs on building agent memory with Meko and multi-tenant Postgres applications on YugabyteDB AMP.
  • Launch and scale Yugabyte-run meetups in key developer hubs, and support community-led chapters with playbooks, content, and swag.
  • Organize virtual and in-person hackathons, including AI agent hackathons built on Meko and YugabyteDB.
  • Represent Yugabyte at developer conferences such as KubeCon, PGConf.dev, Linux Foundation events, and AI engineering conferences, running demos, workshops, and booth sessions.
  • Contribute community programming to Yugabyte’s Distributed SQL Summit, such as hands-on labs, community tracks, and DevRel sessions.

Build with partners

  • Co-host workshops, meetups, and hackathons with cloud, AI framework, and open source ecosystem partners.
  • Create sample apps, integrations, and tutorials that show YugabyteDB, AMP, and Meko working alongside the agent frameworks, developer tools, and cloud platforms developers already use.
  • Build relationships with user groups and open source projects in the Postgres, Kubernetes, and AI agent communities.

Create content the community uses

  • Produce demos, tutorials, sample apps, blogs, livestreams, and webinars, both live and recorded.
  • Package workshops into reusable kits and starter templates that community leaders and partners can run on their own.
  • Hold developer-facing content, quickstarts, and getting-started paths to a high bar for clarity and accuracy.

Be the voice of the developer

  • Collect feedback from community channels, events, and hackathons, and bring it to product and engineering in a form they can act on.
  • Track and report community health, including growth, engagement, event attendance, and conversion to active usage.
  • Help shape the DevRel strategy, processes, and tooling, including community platforms and event tech stack.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in developer relations, developer advocacy, or developer community management, including programs you built from the ground up.
  • A track record of growing an online developer community on Slack, Discord, or a similar platform.
  • Experience planning and running in-person events such as meetups, workshops, or hackathons.
  • Hands-on technical skills, including building demos and sample apps and working comfortably with SQL and Postgres.
  • Familiarity with, and creative ideas for AI agent development, LLM frameworks, vector search, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed fast.
  • Experience in open source communities as a contributor, maintainer, or community organizer.
  • Confidence presenting and facilitating, both live and on camera.
  • An active social presence and following in a relevant developer community.
  • Comfort working autonomously in a fast-moving startup. B2B SaaS or infrastructure experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

  • Experience with distributed databases, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience running ambassador or champion programs.
  • Experience running co-marketing or joint events with technology partners.

Success in year one, in conjunction with our DevRel team

  • Community membership across Slack and other channels grows to 10X
  • Dozens of workshops, hackathons, and meetups delivered
  • At least a dozen hackathons run, focused on AI agents built with Meko.
  • Ten partner co-hosted events delivered.
  • A champions program launched with 50+ active members.

We feel strongly about equal pay for equal work, and transparency in compensation is one way to help achieve that. The cash compensation for this role is market competitive, with a range of $160,000-$215,000, as well as equity (when applicable), and benefits including health plans, retirement plans, and unlimited paid time off (PTO). Some roles also include variable/incentive compensation, or a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. The pay range for this position is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. The actual pay will vary based on factors including experience, qualifications, and skill level.

Candidates with other types of valid work authorization are also welcome to apply.

title: Research Program Manager

title: Lead Software Engineer - Enterprise AI Services & Agents
description:
As a Lead Software Engineer on Wellmark’s Enterprise AI Services & Agents team, you will lead the design and delivery of reusable enterprise assistants, agents, AI services, skills, and agentic workflows. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that combines solution design, software engineering, customer engagement, and end-to-end accountability for secure, scalable, and supportable AI solutions.

You will partner with engineers, customers, product leaders, architecture, security, and governance stakeholders to translate business needs into production-ready solutions. You will also help establish enterprise blueprints and engineering standards for assistants, agents, agentic workflows, and AI evaluation, while building reusable frameworks and components that reduce duplication and accelerate governed AI delivery across Wellmark.

The team’s focus is to build business-facing AI capabilities once, harden them for enterprise use, and make them reusable across products, channels, portfolios, and business areas.

Preferred

  • Experience integrating models, enterprise tools, data, and services through APIs or standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Experience with AI observability and operations, including OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, prompt and response telemetry, quality monitoring, regression detection, audit evidence, usage measurement, and cost tracking.

  • Experience delivering solutions in healthcare, health insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, including familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, privacy, compliance, or responsible AI practices.
  • Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and communication skills, with experience working in an Agile product-delivery environment.
  • AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Developer, Solutions Architect, or Machine Learning Engineer are a plus.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, or related field of study and at least 5 years of development experience (ex. Angular, NodeJS, TypeScript, C++, .NET, Java, SQL) OR 9 years of related and applicable experience.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills. Accuracy and high attention to detail. Previous experience troubleshooting and developing creative technical solutions. Ability to provide innovative solutions to complex issues.

title: Sr. Engineer, System Level Test
location: San Diego, California, United States of America
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.

Job Area:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements.

OR

OR
PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field.

title: Senior UX Researcher – Pharma (m/f/d)
description:
About your tasks

  • Own and shape UX research priorities across our Pharma domain, identifying knowledge gaps, challenging assumptions and aligning research initiatives with customer needs and strategic product priorities.
  • Lead end-to-end UX research, from defining research objectives and selecting appropriate methodologies through to participant recruitment, fieldwork, analysis and communicating actionable insights.
  • Improve the end-to-end prescription and pharmacy experience, exploring how customers discover our services, redeem prescriptions, navigate pharmacy processes and receive medication, identifying opportunities to simplify complex or unnecessary steps through digital solutions.
  • Translate research into measurable product improvements, collaborating with Product Management, Design and Product Analytics to combine qualitative insights with behavioural data, funnels, segmentation and experimentation to influence product decisions and customer outcomes.
  • Advance our research practices through AI and knowledge sharing, leveraging tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and Codex to support research preparation, synthesis and insight sharing, while ensuring research quality, responsible data handling and supporting colleagues in applying effective research methods.

About you

  • Extensive experience in UX Research or Product Research, with a proven track record of independently leading research initiatives within complex e-commerce, digital healthcare or health-tech environments.
  • Strong expertise across qualitative and quantitative research methodologies, including user interviews, usability testing, surveys, exploratory research, behavioural analysis and research synthesis, with the ability to select the most appropriate methods for different business challenges.
  • Experience working closely with Product Analytics, combining research findings with product performance data to inform decisions. Familiarity with tools such as Contentsquare or FullStory is an advantage.
  • A proven ability to influence product strategy and decisions, translating complex research findings into clear, actionable recommendations and demonstrating measurable impact on product or customer outcomes.
  • Practical experience using AI tools within research workflows, such as ChatGPT, Claude or Codex, with an understanding of how to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and use these tools responsibly.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, present findings and influence cross-functional Product teams.
  • Native or equivalent German language proficiency, enabling you to conduct nuanced research with customers on sensitive healthcare topics, alongside fluent professional English for collaboration in an international environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience within e-health, e-pharmacy, telemedicine or other digital healthcare services.
  • Experience conducting research involving sensitive personal information, vulnerable participants or regulated products.
  • Knowledge of inclusive research practices, accessibility and health literacy.
  • Experience with longitudinal research or diary studies.

Why join us?

At Redcare Pharmacy, your research will help shape how people access and manage their healthcare, making important customer journeys easier, clearer and more accessible.

You'll have the opportunity to influence both immediate product improvements and the longer-term direction of our Pharma experience, working alongside multidisciplinary teams in a growing, technology-driven organisation.

We value curiosity, methodological expertise and a strong customer focus, and we're looking for someone who can challenge existing thinking and help us make better product decisions through meaningful research.

About your Benefits:

In order to provide our employees with the best possible support for their individual needs, we offer a wide range of benefits:

  • Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
  • Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.

  • Sports & Health: Your well-being is our top priority. Therefore, we offer you a range of opportunities to improve your health. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, providing a variety of sports offers tailored to your interests.

While this is a remote position based in Germany, it may require occasional on-site collaboration at our offices in Sevenum or Cologne, depending on business and team requirements.

title: Studio Central Product Designer
location: San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; New York, NY
description:
About the Role

At DoorDash we are redefining what it means to be a designer. We are building toward a team of makers, builders, and doers. Between 2005 and 2015, "web designer" became "product designer" and the scope widened. The same shift is happening now, as LLMs expand that scope again, toward strategy on one end and direct execution on the other. As a Staff Visual Designer, you'll practice this build-first way of working with real autonomy: using AI-native tools and code to move from idea to shipped work quickly, and owning craft decisions end to end rather than checking each one against a brief.

You'll join Studio Central, a net-new Product Design team sitting at the intersection of product, brand, and innovation. Studio Central is a global team within Studio, DoorDash's Product Design organization, supporting DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms. We own how brand shows up in the product experience, partnering closely with Marketing and Product teams to shape cohesive, high-quality work and to help define the foundations, vision, and future state of design across our portfolio. Our work spans major brand moments, merchandising, and the systems that connect it all.

Studio Central's systems and standards are still being built, and everyone building here, regardless of level, has real input into what they become. You'll have full ownership over your own craft and projects, and a real voice in the standards, rituals, and craft bar the whole team ends up working from, not reacting to a framework someone else already finished, but helping shape it as it forms.

We operate in a hybrid working model, 1-2 days out of one of our Design Hubs, the rest working from home.

Your primary impact is craft and output: shipping high-quality, on-brand work across the campaigns, seasonal moments, and merchandising pushes Studio Central owns, with less oversight than earlier-career roles and more responsibility for getting it right yourself. Your secondary impact is revenue, in the same way: the work you ship well, and the craft feedback you give to the designers around you, is part of what raises the expression bar across DoorDash, Wolt, Deliveroo, and 7Rooms as a whole.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

  • Own end-to-end visual craft on brand moments, campaigns, and merchandising pushes, from concept through shipped, production-ready work, with less oversight than earlier-career roles
  • Mentor other designers as needed, sharing craft feedback and helping them build range, without formal authority over their work
  • Help build and pressure-test the design systems, component libraries, and AI-powered tooling as a team, whether that's proposing the first version or stress-testing someone else's, and speak up early rather than reacting to a finished one
  • Practice influencing without authority: bring a strong point of view into rooms with Product, Marketing, and creative stakeholders, and back it up with working prototypes rather than title
  • Build real range across the full workflow, from rough concept to production-ready execution, and hand off cleanly to engineering so nothing gets lost in translation

We're excited about you because you have...

  • A portfolio that shows strong, considered visual craft, systems thinking, or brand work at a senior level, even if you haven't yet led an org-wide initiative
  • Comfort moving between art-direction tools like Figma and Illustrator and shipping in code, or you're closing that gap quickly
  • A habit of treating a new tool or technique as an experiment worth running, not a decision you need to get right the first time, you'll ship a handful of rough attempts in something you picked up last week before you'd sit through a training on it
  • Experience giving craft feedback to other designers, even informally, and helping them get sharper
  • A track record of shipping ambiguous briefs to a high bar without heavy oversight

title: Scientist II - LC/MS Bioanalytical
description:
At BioAgilytix, we are passionate about premier science and the impact it has on our world. Our team of highly experienced scientists and professionals deliver tailored services for supporting new medicine breakthroughs with best-in-class bioanalytical services. We are tirelessly committed to our customers by being solution-oriented and deadline-driven. . . and we are growing. Our culture is fast-paced, fun and never boring. Because we work across numerous clients and drug modalities, your career can develop rapidly. You’ll gain experience with a variety of challenges all while you enable life-changing, life-saving therapeutics to the patients who need them.

In this lab-based, hands-on Scientist role, you will design, develop, and execute bioanalytical experiments that support the advancement of new therapies to market. You’ll spend much of your time in the lab generating and analyzing data, working with cutting-edge bioanalytical technologies, and evaluating assay performance within the intended context of use. This role is especially exciting due to our wide variety of clients and therapeutic areas, giving you exposure to multiple disease states and modalities. You’ll work in a milestone-driven, highly regulated environment where data integrity, quality, and compliance are foundational to how we operate.
We’re looking for scientists who are energized by hands-on laboratory work and solving complex scientific challenges. The ideal candidate is curious, driven to continuously learn, and experienced working under GxP expectations where data integrity is expected and upheld. You’ll thrive through collaboration with a network of expert scientists while managing multiple projects, sponsors, and timelines. If you’re adaptable, scientifically rigorous, and motivated by producing high-quality data at the bench, you’ll feel right at home at BioAgilytix.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, validation, and sample analysis of large molecules such as ADCs, monoclonal antibodies and other proteins, peptides, oligonucleotides, biomarkers, and small molecules using various techniques including chromatographic (LC-MS/MS) in support of preclinical and clinical PK/PD studies.
  • Set up studies in LIMS system
  • Drive bioanalytical projects to align with client timelines
  • Author documents (methods, SOPs, reports)
  • Statistical analysis of bioanalytical data
  • Review of documentation
  • Analyze & Interpret data
  • Peer review raw data
  • Prepare reagents
  • Troubleshoot assays
  • Design assay runs independently
  • Responsible for prompt identification and notification of deviations
  • Write plans/reports for sample analysis
  • Order and keep accurate inventories of supplies for laboratory needs and forecast future needs based on projected project needs
  • Perform assays according to GLP guidance or SOPs

Additional Responsibilities

  • Other duties as needed

Minimum Preferred Qualifications: Skills

  • Ability to perform routine laboratory tasks accurately while following established methodologies, including sample preparation, operation and maintenance of standard laboratory equipment.
  • Experience with chromatographic assay development, validation, and execution for PK, PD (biomarker), ADME, and other small molecule assays.
  • Experience developing chromatographic assays using LC-MS/MS, HPLC, UPLC, and/or UPLC-HRMS, including protein binding, CYP inhibition, CYP induction, or CYP phenotyping assays.
  • Strong data analysis, statistical analysis, and data visualization skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and scientific software such as Sciex OS/Analyst, MassLynx, Chromeleon, Watson LIMS, JMP, and GraphPad Prism.
  • Experience working in a GxP environment preferred
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and adapt to changing priorities while taking direction effectively.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Preferred Qualifications: Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, biology, immunology, or related field with not less than eight (8) years’ experience in a scientific laboratory environment; or
  • Master’s degree in chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, biology, immunology, or related field with not less than six (6) years’ experience in a scientific laboratory environment; or
  • PhD in chemistry, biochemistry, biotechnology, biology, immunology, or related field with not less than four (4) years’ experience in a scientific laboratory environment
  • Knowledge of regulatory guidance and industry best practices for PK, ADME, LC/MC/MC, and other small molecule assays is preferred

Supervision Received

  • Infrequent supervision and instructions
  • Frequently exercises discretionary authority

Working Environment

  • Primarily laboratory environment
  • Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms
  • Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, toxic materials, and hazardous waste
  • Personal protective equipment required, such as protective eyewear, garments, and gloves
  • Routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets

Physical Demands

  • Ability to work in an upright and/or stationary position for up to 8 hours per day
  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment
  • Frequent mobility needed
  • Frequent crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck
  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including laboratory equipment, laboratory supplies, and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 20 pounds
  • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software
  • Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand, with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences

  • Ability to perform under stress and multi-task
  • Regular and consistent attendance

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

  • Some flexibility in hours is allowed, but the employee must be available during the “core” work hours as published in the BioAgilytix Employee Handbook

  • Occasional travel required

Medical Insurance (HDHP with HSA; PPO), Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Flexible Spending Account (medical; dependent care), Short Term Disability | Long Term Disability Life Insurance, Paid Time Off (4 weeks per year), Parental Leave, Paid Holidays (9 scheduled; 5 floating), 401k with Employer Match, Employee Referral Program
