title: Product Designer (1099 Contract) | Active Secret Clearance Required
description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About the Role

We're hiring a mid-level Product Designer to own end-to-end design on one or more product areas. You will work directly with engineers, product, and subject-matter experts to turn ambiguous operational problems into interfaces that are dense, fast, and legible. This is a hands-on role: you will be in Figma, in the design system, and in code review conversations, not just in strategy decks.

You will work in a small team with a short distance between design and shipped software and direct contact with the people who use what we build. Designers have meaningful ownership of their product areas and are expected to bring informed opinions to the work.

This is a 1099 contract opportunity, with expected 40 hours per week. A Secret Clearance is required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the design of features from discovery through shipped implementation — problem framing, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity UI, and design QA.
  • Design for complexity: data-dense tables, map and timeline views, simulation outputs, and multi-role workflows where information hierarchy is the whole job.
  • Contribute to and extend our design system (@defcon/ui) — build components in Figma, define tokens and variants, and partner with engineering on the React/TypeScript implementation.
  • Run lightweight discovery with SMEs and end users, working within the access constraints of government environments. Translate what you learn into shared artifacts the team actually uses.
  • Design the unglamorous but critical parts of government software: authentication flows (CAC/PIV), role-based access control, permissions, empty and error states, and audit-friendly interactions.
  • Meet accessibility requirements as a baseline, not a cleanup pass — WCAG 2.1 AA and Section 508 compliance.
  • Give and receive critique. Present work clearly to non-designers, including customers and program stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 4–5 years of product design experience shipping software, supported by a portfolio that demonstrates your process and decision-making, not just final screens.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, auto-layout, and variables.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system, including defining tokens and component APIs, documenting usage, communicating version changes, managing deprecations, and keeping the design library aligned with its coded implementation.
  • Experience designing complex, information-dense applications, such as enterprise, analytics, logistics, or operational tools. Portfolios focused exclusively on consumer products may be less aligned with this role.
  • Working knowledge of front-end concepts, including component structure, state, responsive behavior, and design tokens, with the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and identify implementation drift.
  • Experience using discovery, user research, or competitive analysis to inform design decisions and solve product problems.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to translate business goals into functional design solutions, explain trade-offs, and respectfully challenge decisions when needed.
  • Ability to work independently through standard design challenges while recognizing when to seek guidance on complex architectural or system-scaling decisions.
  • Strong storytelling, presentation, written, and asynchronous communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and build alignment across teams, time zones, and security boundaries.
  • Active Secret clearance and U.S. citizenship required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A clearance above Secret (Top Secret or TS/SCI).
  • Prior work on defense, government, or other regulated or compliance-heavy products.
  • Experience contributing code to a design system or front-end codebase (React, TypeScript, CSS).
  • Familiarity with map-based interfaces, scheduling and timeline UI, or simulation and modeling tools.
  • Experience designing for classified or air-gapped environments, or working within FedRAMP and IL5 constraints.

Compensation: This is a 1099 independent contractor position. Compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, scope of work, and anticipated level of effort.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.
  • Unlimited PTO, with management approval.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available.
  • Mental health benefits are available through Tara Mind.
  • Cost effective GLP-1 solutions available through Crux.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

title: Planning Lead
description:

Vector: Powering Auckland. Shaping the future.

At Vector, we're delivering the infrastructure, technology and services that will support a smarter, more connected and increasingly electrified Auckland.

Our Vector31 strategy sets a clear direction for the future. As we continue to evolve the way we serve customers, manage our network and enable business performance, Digital & Data plays a critical role in connecting strategy, technology and delivery.

To support this transformation, we're establishing a new Digital & Data operating model designed to strengthen business alignment, improve delivery outcomes and accelerate value creation across the organisation.

Strong delivery starts with good planning.

That means understanding priorities, making informed trade-offs, identifying dependencies early and ensuring work is sequenced based on value, readiness, capacity and strategic outcomes.

That's where you come in.

The opportunity

You might come from portfolio planning, PMO, programme management, delivery operations, portfolio management, business planning or resource planning. What matters most is your ability to bring clarity to complexity and help people make better decisions.

This is a newly created role within Digital & Data and an opportunity to help shape how planning, prioritisation and mobilisation work across the portfolio.

You'll lead integrated portfolio planning across Digital & Data, connecting Vector31 priorities, the AMP process, Digital Roadmap commitments, investment decisions, delivery capacity and business outcomes. You'll help create visibility of what we're doing, what we can realistically deliver, which dependencies matter most and where trade-offs need to be made.

The role sits at the centre of planning conversations, working with Delivery Partners, Programme Managers, Business Analysts, Finance, D&D Operations and business stakeholders to ensure decisions are informed by evidence rather than assumptions.

This isn't simply about maintaining plans.

It's about helping Digital & Data build the planning discipline, transparency and delivery confidence needed to successfully execute its strategy.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead integrated planning across Digital & Data portfolios, programmes, domains and delivery teams.
  • Facilitate annual planning activities, ensuring AMP requirements, Digital Roadmap priorities, investment timelines, dependencies and business commitments are aligned.
  • Support quarterly and ongoing prioritisation by providing visibility of value, capacity, readiness, dependencies, delivery constraints and trade-off options.
  • Work with Delivery Partners, Programme Managers, Business Analysts, Finance and business stakeholders to gather, validate and connect planning inputs.
  • Maintain clear planning views and prioritisation information that support evidence-based sequencing and investment decisions.
  • Create visibility of committed and in-flight work, capacity, delivery constraints and portfolio flow across Digital & Data.
  • Identify and escalate planning risks, dependency conflicts, capacity challenges and delivery pressures early.
  • Support mobilisation readiness by ensuring initiatives have clear outcomes, sponsorship, scope, funding, dependencies, resource requirements and planning assumptions before delivery commitments are made.
  • Coordinate planning and dependency information across internal teams and external delivery partners.
  • Establish and maintain planning standards, tools, governance rhythms, artefacts and reporting that improve consistency and transparency.
  • Continuously improve planning maturity, prioritisation quality and portfolio visibility across Digital & Data.

What you'll bring

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret demand, capacity, readiness, dependency and delivery information.
  • The ability to turn complex information into practical planning insights and recommendations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain trade-offs and planning decisions clearly.
  • Confidence supporting prioritisation, sequencing and investment discussions with senior stakeholders.
  • Experience working across multiple initiatives while maintaining clear and reliable planning information.
  • A practical mindset focused on transparency, accountability, value and delivery flow.
  • Strong attention to detail when managing planning artefacts, assumptions, registers, calendars and decision records.
  • Experience working with spreadsheets, planning tools, portfolio systems, dashboards and reporting artefacts.
  • A strong understanding of project, programme or portfolio delivery, including dependency management, resource planning, governance and delivery risk.

You may have experience in portfolio planning, PMO, delivery operations, resource planning, programme coordination, business planning, portfolio management or a related discipline. What's most important is your ability to help people make informed decisions and create confidence in delivery.

A little ambiguity doesn't scare you

We're building new capabilities and new ways of working across Digital & Data.

That means not every process is fully defined and not every answer already exists.

Some days you'll apply established planning practices. Other days you'll help us design better ones.

You'll work across disciplines, connect different perspectives and help create planning approaches that support better outcomes for the business.

If you enjoy bringing structure, visibility and alignment to complex environments, we'd love to hear from you.

Bring what you know. Be ready to learn. Teach us something too.

Different skills. Different perspectives. Better ways forward, together.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to help shape how planning works across one of New Zealand's largest and most important infrastructure organisations.

You'll play a critical role in creating the visibility, prioritisation discipline and delivery confidence that enable Digital & Data to successfully deliver on Vector31.

You'll work alongside talented people across the business, influence important investment and delivery decisions, and help build a more connected, transparent and value-focused planning capability.

You'll also have access to Vector's wider employee benefits, including flexible ways of working, wellbeing support, learning and development opportunities, and professional development support.

Our behaviours

Change Makers | Customer. Customer. Customer. | Walk in Others' Shoes | We, Not Me | Consider It. Done.

If you're excited by the opportunity to help turn Vector31 ambition into action and strengthen how Digital & Data plans, prioritises and delivers work, we'd love to hear from you.

We know that some people may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply anyway - your skills, enthusiasm, and unique perspective could be just what we’re looking for.

Vector values diversity in all its forms and welcomes people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities and abilities to be part of our team.

title: Material Application Specialist (Farm Machinery Operator)
description:
Highline's Vision and Values:

Passionately nourish people, the environment and the community, through embracing our core values, which include:

We do the right thing, always. We lead the way. We are fanatical about quality. We are transparent in our relationships. We always consider the human element. We embrace diversity and inclusion.

General Duties:

  • Supervising the fill/ empty team and/or tunnels team, and ensuring their tasks are completed correctly

  • Assign and delegate tasks for the team

  • Ensuring each associate doing tasks has been trained and is able to operate/ complete that task safely

  • Ensuring the quality and density of the fill

  • Ensuring the beds are properly filled

  • Coordinate with the entire growing team to update on daily process regarding fill/ empty

  • Communicating with the Tunnel Operator to ensure daily operations are met

  • Assisting the grower on scheduling of associates to ensure proper manpower

  • Set up machinery

  • Operates the Head Filler (Casing Line – W)

  • Operates Pulling Winch

  • Operates Skid Steer and Forklift

  • Operate and/or ensure proper operation of Cassette Machine to move the raw compost material from tunnel to tunnel

  • Operate and/or ensure proper operation of the Emptying Winch, pulling the compost out of the tunnel for spawning and transfer of the spawned compost to growing rooms

  • Operate the fancom system, as needed

  • Organizes the assignment of work duties to the daily crew (Farm Hand) workers

  • Training associates on how to operate machinery properly and safely, such as head filler, pulling winch, and emptying winch

  • Ensures the mushroom compost is filled into the growing beds and ensures growing beds are emptied post-harvest

  • Ensures addition of mushroom spawn to compost material

  • Ensures addition of supplements to compost

  • Washing/cleaning and proper maintenance of Tunnels machinery and premises

  • Check ammonia levels, as needed

  • Driving farm vehicles, such as wagons, casing trucks, or dump trucks

  • General hygiene practices: cleaning aisles, shovelling, squeegee, etc.

  • Scheduling and organizing the team, as needed

  • Makes decisions on operations within the tunnels when needed

  • Maintains strict hygiene at all times

  • Performs any other duties that may be assigned

  • Embrace and support the Highline culture and values, acting as a brand ambassador at all times

  • Interact with others in a manner that promotes respect, confidentiality and dignity

  • Develop and actively foster an engaged work force, displaying professionalism at all times

  • Adheres to the Safety Policies, including use of proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and other safety equipment

  • Reports unsafe conditions immediately to the supervisor, direct report or member of safety team

  • Reports all incidents, injuries and near misses to the supervisor, direct report or Safety Advocate immediately

  • Cooperates in the Early and Safe Return to Work Program if an injury or medical illness requires accommodation.

  • Follows all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP’s) as trained

  • Adheres to all quality standards per customer specifications

Qualifications:

  • Must be at least 16 years of age.

  • Must be eligible to work in Canada without restrictions.

  • No Language Requirements.

1). Core Work Experience

  • Mushroom Farm Operations: Minimum 1–2 years of experience working in a commercial mushroom cultivation facility, specifically handling Phase 3 (fully colonized) compost.

  • Filling & Casing Experience: Direct experience operating or working alongside head-filling machines, winches, and conveyor systems used to load compost and casing onto shelving nets or trays.

  • Compost Added at Casing (CAC-ing): Prior experience with CAC-ing techniques, including understanding how to properly layer, mix, or inoculate casing soil with colonized compost.

2). Technical & Machinery Skills

  • Heavy Equipment Operation: Proficiency in operating forklifts, skid steers, or telehandlers to move heavy bulk Phase 3 compost blocks or bunkers into the filling area.

  • Mechanical Aptitude: Ability to set up, calibrate, clean, and perform basic troubleshooting on filling/casing machinery to ensure even compost depth and uniform casing thickness (5–6 cm).

  • Sanitation Practices: Strong understanding of strict bio-security and hygiene protocols to prevent the cross-contamination of Phase 3 compost during the transfer process (e.g., proper tool sanitization, clean boots, avoiding pests/molds).

3). Physical Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Stamina & Strength: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs (23 kg) repeatedly and stand, bend, or pull pulling-nets for extended periods.

  • Environment Adaptability: Comfortable working in humid, dusty, or high-CO₂ environments (using proper PPE like respirators or masks during filling when dust/spores are present).

title: Communications Associate
description:
Vast is developing next-generation space stations and space infrastructure using an incremental, hardware-rich, and low-cost approach. Vast is rapidly developing its multi-module Haven Station to ensure a continuous human presence in space for America and its allies, enabling advanced microgravity research and manufacturing, and unlocking a new space economy for government, corporate, and private customers. Haven Demo’s 2025 success made Vast the only operational commercial space station company to fly and operate its own spacecraft. Next, Haven-1 is expected to become the world’s first commercial space station when it launches in 2027, followed by additional Haven modules. Additionally, the company recently announced Vast Satellite, a high-power satellite product line leveraging its space station components and the heritage of Haven Demo.

Headquartered in Long Beach, California, and with more than 1,000 employees and over a billion dollars in private capital, Vast has built the facilities required to manufacture and operate America’s next space station. The company plans to develop future habitats and systems for the Moon and Mars, dedicated space stations for government partners, and other crewed systems that will unlock the expanding long-term space economy.

Vast is looking for a Communications Associate, reporting to the Director of Communications, to support external communications and marketing across Vast’s programs including space stations, satellites, and lunar infrastructure.

This will be a fixed-term position located in our Long Beach, CA location.

The work is hands-on and includes responsibilities like project managing company announcements, pitching reporters, tracking news, and shepherding speaker submissions and award nominations. You will work with the rest of the Marketing team to ensure Vast’s external communications is cohesive, accurate and on brand.

Responsibilities:

  • Draft and send media pitches for company news
  • Build and maintain media lists and reporter relationships across space, technology, and business beats

description:

General Summary:

Qualcomm is the world’s largest fabless semiconductor company and a global leader in wireless innovation—powering the majority of 3G, 4G, and 5G devices while pioneering the future 6G era. Our hardware engineering teams build industry‑leading modem and RF transceiver solutions enabling the next generation of wireless technology.


We are seeking a highly skilled Modem Hardware Design Verification Engineer to join our advanced verification organization, focused on AI‑driven verification methodologies and next‑generation modem hardware development. This role blends traditional DV expertise with cutting‑edge GenAI, ML‑assisted flows, and agentic-AI automation frameworks to accelerate coverage closure, improve debug efficiency, and enhance overall verification throughput.


As a Wireless DV Engineer, you will define and execute verification plans, build reusable verification environments, and apply advanced verification techniques to validate complex wireless baseband and subsystem designs. You will collaborate closely with system, firmware, and RTL design teams to ensure first‑time‑right silicon for high‑performance modem products.

  • Background in wireless/wireline modem technology, DSP, or communication systems
  • Knowledge of 4G/5G 3GPP physical layer standards is a strong plus

As a Shift Lead, you will have shift responsibility for fulfilling orders in a warehouse environment and maintaining inventory, and in some locations, this involves preparing food in a light-prep kitchen.

You will be expected to engage in professional and respectful interactions with team members and customers, ensuring a positive and safe atmosphere in the warehouse while providing a high-quality experience for our customers.

We’re excited about you because…

title: Principal Product Security Engineer
description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

Cribl is looking for a Principal Product Security Engineer to serve as a hands-on technical authority at the intersection of application, cloud, and FedRAMP environment security. You will help secure Cribl’s cloud-native, customer-managed, and hybrid products as they process high-volume data for some of the world’s largest organizations.

As a Principal engineer, impact is defined by reach. You will set long-term direction across teams, resolve critical and ambiguous security problems, advise Engineering and Product leaders, and turn security requirements into secure designs, production-ready patterns, automation, and verified outcomes. This is not a documentation-only compliance role: you will work with Engineering, SRE, Cloud Operations, Compliance, and Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) partners to make regulatory commitments real in product architecture and day-to-day operations.

This is a remote, hands-on individual-contributor role within Engineering. You will lead through expertise and influence, mentor engineers and security partners, and create durable systems that reduce risk while making the secure path easier.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

  • Set long-term product and cloud security direction across multiple teams, shaping roadmaps, standards, secure-by-default patterns, and risk-informed design and release decisions.
  • Lead Product Security Reviews for distributed, multi-tenant SaaS and customer-managed products, including architecture and design review, threat modeling, abuse-case analysis, targeted secure code review, and security test planning.
  • Translate risk into concrete engineering requirements, mitigations, tests, and secure defaults; stay engaged through implementation and independently verify that the intended risk reduction was achieved.
  • Serve as a principal cloud security authority across IAM and workload identity, organization and account boundaries, network exposure, KMS and encryption, secrets, logging and detection, containers and Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure as code, hardening, and data isolation.
  • Lead the Product Security component of FedRAMP engineering. Translate FedRAMP Moderate and NIST SP 800-53 control intent into sustainable technical controls and defensible evidence, and partner on authorization-boundary and significant-change decisions, continuous monitoring, vulnerability and change management, POA&M and deviation remediation, incident response, vendor assessments, and 3PAO or assessor interactions.
  • Investigate ambiguous signals and vulnerabilities from bug bounty, application and supply-chain scanners, penetration tests, cloud detections, and internal reports; determine exploitability, exposure, and impact; coordinate remediation; validate fixes and bypasses; and hunt for variants and root causes.
  • Evolve scalable, risk-adaptive vulnerability management using exposure, exploitability, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities signals, asset criticality, customer impact, and regulatory timelines,not CVSS alone.
  • Build and operate durable security capabilities and developer paved roads across CI/CD, SAST, SCA, secrets, infrastructure as code, containers, cloud posture, and testing. Automate repeatable work while preserving explicit human judgment for consequential security decisions.
  • Scope and oversee external penetration tests, purple-team exercises, and relevant security vendors; ensure findings become owned, verified engineering outcomes; and provide evidence-based input to build, retain, replace, or retire decisions.
  • Lead multi-team work through uncertainty and high-stakes situations, making clear tradeoffs among security, reliability, delivery, customer impact, and compliance while acting with appropriate urgency.
  • Communicate complex risks, options, uncertainty, and recommendations in direct, audience-appropriate terms for engineers, senior leaders, customers, assessors, and external partners; represent Cribl credibly when needed.
  • Multiply the team by mentoring Product Security engineers, security champions, and engineering partners; create standards, runbooks, automation, and continuity plans that prevent critical capabilities from depending on one person.
  • Evaluate and responsibly apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted security engineering, with measurable outcomes, rigorous verification, secure operating boundaries, and clear human accountability.
  • This position will require stand-by, on-call, or off-hours duties.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Typically 10+ years of relevant software security, security engineering, or software engineering experience,or equivalent demonstrated scope and impact,including substantial hands-on Application Security or Product Security and cloud security work.
  • Experience securing AI or agentic systems and applying AI responsibly to security engineering workflows.
  • A Principal-level track record of setting technical direction across teams, leading multi-quarter initiatives, resolving ambiguous critical problems, and influencing senior Engineering and Product leaders without direct authority.
  • Deep, hands-on AWS and Azure security experience in production SaaS or cloud-native systems, including identity and authorization, network controls, encryption and key management, secrets, logging and detection, containers or Kubernetes, serverless services, infrastructure as code, and multi-tenant data isolation.
  • Direct experience implementing or operating product and cloud security controls in a FedRAMP-authorized or FedRAMP-bound environment. You understand NIST SP 800-53 control intent and have supported technical control implementation and evidence, continuous monitoring, vulnerability and change management, POA&M or deviation remediation, and assessor interactions.
  • Expertise leading security design reviews and threat models for complex applications, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architectures, with the judgment to turn findings into practical countermeasures and risk-informed release recommendations.
  • Strong knowledge of web and application vulnerabilities, exploit techniques, OWASP guidance, authentication and authorization protocols, cryptography, common network protocols, and secure cloud operating models.
  • Ability to read production code and build maintainable automation in JavaScript or TypeScript, Python, Go, or a comparable language; willingness to work directly with Engineering to implement and verify security improvements.
  • Hands-on vulnerability-response experience, including exploitability analysis, root-cause and variant analysis, remediation design, fix and bypass validation, stakeholder coordination, and incident support.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex risk and tradeoffs clear to engineers, executives, customers, assessors, and external partners.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
  • Preferred qualifications
    • Experience securing enterprise data platforms, observability systems, high-volume data pipelines, agents, or customer-managed and hybrid software.
    • Experience with AWS GovCloud, FedRAMP Moderate/High, NIST 800-53.
    • Experience building developer security platforms, secure-by-default libraries, policy-as-code, or automated guardrails across SAST, SCA, DAST, software supply chain, containers, and cloud posture.
    • Public security contributions such as open-source work, published research, CVE credits, standards participation, conference talks, or other demonstrated thought leadership.
    • Relevant credentials such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or OSCP; demonstrated practical impact matters more than certifications.

title: Breast Ultrasound Technologist
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Job Description

Utilizes non-ionizing, high frequency ultrasonic wave equipment to perform diagnostic and screening ultrasound exams.

Job Responsibility

Brand new outpatient site - The Goldman Pavilion - due to open early 2027!!

Shift Details: Monday-Friday, 8:30am-5pm

1.Collaborates with Physician/Radiologist to confirm required exam details and ensure optimal quality of images.

12.Monitors and maintains supply inventory in assigned areas.
13.Keeps work area and clean and organized, according to established safety standards
14.Collaborates with healthcare team to ensure seamless continuity of care and optimal patient safety.
15.Participates in performance improvement and quality control activities.
16.Performs related duties, as required. All responsibilities noted here are considered essential functions of the job under the Americans with Disabilities Act. Duties not mentioned here, but considered related are not essential functions.

Job Qualification

1.Graduate from accredited Ultrasound or related program, required
2.One (1) of the following credentials required:
Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer (RDMS),
Registered Diagnostic Cardiac Sonographer (RDCS),
Registered Cardiac Sonographer (RCS),
Advanced Cardiac Sonographer (ACS),
Registered Vascular Technologist (RVT),
Registered Vascular Specialist (RVS),
Registered Technologist in Sonography (R.T.(S)).
3.Prior imaging experience, preferred.

Breast Ultrasound experience, highly preferred.

title: Security Engineer (Microsoft Defender)
description:
Make a difference here.

UltraViolet Cyber is a leading platform-enabled unified security operations company providing a comprehensive suite of security operations solutions. Founded and operated by security practitioners with decades of experience, the UltraViolet Cyber security-as-code platform combines technology innovation and human expertise to make advanced real-time cybersecurity accessible for all organizations by eliminating risks of separate red and blue teams.

By creating continuously optimized identification, detection, and resilience from today’s dynamic threat landscape, UltraViolet Cyber provides both managed and custom-tailored unified security operations solutions to the Fortune 500, Federal Government, and Commercial clients. UltraViolet Cyber is headquartered in McLean, Virginia, with global offices across the U.S. and in India.

UltraViolet Cyber has an exciting position for a Senior Microsoft Cloud Security Engineer as we deploy, manage, and hardening our Microsoft cloud environment, including Azure, Office 365 and Microsoft 365. The Senior Microsoft Cloud Security Engineer should thrive on complexity, possess an analytical mindset, and bring deep expertise on managing and securing Microsoft's cloud platform. You'll collaborate across teams, collaborating with security engineers, cloud architects, identity teams, and incident response analysts to ensure our tenant is resilient, compliant, and always mission ready.

What You'll Do:

- Serve as the go-to, subject matter expert (SME) for securing the Microsoft cloud tenant, advising on architecture, design, and implementation of secure solutions across Azure, O365, and M365.
- Lead the development and enforcement of Conditional Access Policies, aligned with best practices for managing access control for personas, groups, and applications.
- Act as the primary SME in optimizing the Microsoft Defender suite of components (Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud, Defender for Identity, and Defender for Office 365)
- Implement Microsoft Purview, including data classification and sensitivity labels, Data Loss Prevent (DLP), and eDiscovery workflows.
- Design, run and optimize Kusto Query Language (KQL) queries for Azure Sentinel, Defender, and log analytics.
- Review and remediate security controls through vulnerability assessments, penetration tests, and red/blue team engagements.
- Guide cross-functional teams on security controls, compliance requirements, policy, and governance best practices

What You've Have:

- Ability to Obtain DHS EOD Public Trust Clearance
- Master’s Degree + 10 years’ experience OR Bachelor’s degree + 13 years OR 19 years total experience
- Expert-level hands-on experience deploying, managing, and securing Azure, Entra, Defender, Purview, Office 365, and Microsoft 365 in large enterprises.
- Deep understanding of Conditional Access Policies (CAPs), Azure AD/Entra, and Zero Trust principles.
- Proven Track record implementing and managing the full suite of the Microsoft Defender ecosystem and Microsoft Purview (DLP, sensitivity labels, eDiscovery)
- Advanced proficiency writing KQL for detection, investigation, response, and reporting
- Active, expert-level certification such as Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MSCE), Microsoft 365 Admin Expert, Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect Expert, AZ-900, AZ-500, SC-900, SC-100, SC-200, SC-300, SC-400, SC-401
- Cybersecurity certifications: Security+
- Strong networking, firewall, VPN, and segmentation knowledge as it relates to cloud deployments
- Exceptional time management, written and communication skills.
- Participate in rotating on-call schedule across the team, to provide incident response or support during outages.

Desired:


- CISSP, OSCP, GCIH
- ITIL, Agile, or PMP familiarity/certification
- Experience with SOAR platforms (e.g. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel)
- Hands-on exposure to third-party cloud security tooling (CASBs, CNAAPs, SD-WANs)
- Previous consulting or client-facing delivery experience

UltraViolet Cyber maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect our company's differing products, services, industries and lines of business. Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors.

We sincerely thank all applicants in advance for submitting their interest in this position. We know your time is valuable.

UltraViolet Cyber welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.

If you want to make an impact, UltraViolet Cyber is the place for you!

title: Senior Product Designer – Pharma (Growth) (m/f/d)
description:
About your tasks

  • Own the end-to-end Product Design process, from discovery and problem definition through ideation, prototyping, validation and delivery, ensuring solutions address genuine customer needs and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Improve customer activation and onboarding, identifying barriers that prevent customers from getting started with our prescription services and designing intuitive experiences that help them successfully complete their first prescription order.
  • Drive customer retention and engagement, understanding why customers return or disengage and designing meaningful experiences that support repeat prescriptions, ongoing healthcare needs and long-term customer relationships.
  • Lead customer-centred discovery and experimentation, using interviews, journey mapping, usability testing, behavioural insights and A/B testing to challenge assumptions, validate solutions and continuously improve the customer experience.
  • Translate insights into impactful design solutions, partnering with Product Management and Analytics to define hypotheses, success metrics and opportunities, balancing customer needs, business impact, technical feasibility and long-term scalability.
  • Deliver high-quality, accessible digital experiences, applying strong interaction design, visual design and UX writing principles to simplify complex healthcare journeys, including error handling, recovery states and sensitive customer interactions.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering and Product teams, involving technical stakeholders early, communicating design decisions clearly and ensuring solutions are feasible, implementation-ready and delivered to a high standard.
  • Influence Product direction and stakeholder decisions, using research, data, storytelling and clear design rationale to challenge assumptions, navigate competing priorities and build alignment across cross-functional teams.
  • Contribute to the growth and maturity of our UX team, acting as a role model for high-quality Product Design, sharing expertise, mentoring fellow designers, providing constructive feedback and helping evolve our design system and ways of working.

About You

  • Extensive experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a proven track record of independently leading complex, customer-facing digital products within an established e-commerce or large-scale consumer technology organisation.
  • Strong end-to-end Product Design expertise, demonstrating the ability to frame problems, conduct discovery, explore solutions, prototype, validate and deliver high-quality experiences with measurable impact.
  • Experience improving customer activation, conversion or retention, ideally across onboarding, customer lifecycle or other complex digital journeys, supported by qualitative insights and quantitative results.
  • Excellent interaction and visual design skills, with advanced proficiency in Figma, prototyping and working with established design systems to create intuitive, accessible and scalable experiences.
  • A strong understanding of UX research and experimentation, including usability testing, customer interviews, journey mapping, behavioural analysis and A/B testing to inform design decisions.
  • A data-informed approach to Product Design, comfortable collaborating with Product Analysts to interpret conversion funnels, customer cohorts, behavioural insights and experimentation results.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions, explain design decisions and influence Product Managers, Engineers and senior business stakeholders.
  • A collaborative and proactive mindset, with a passion for raising design standards, sharing knowledge and supporting the development of other designers within a multidisciplinary UX team.
  • Native-level German language proficiency, both written and spoken, enabling you to conduct nuanced customer research and design clear, sensitive German-language experiences.
  • Fluent professional English for collaboration within our international organisation.

Nice to have

  • Experience within e-health, e-pharmacy, telemedicine or other regulated digital consumer services.
  • Familiarity with German prescription and e-prescription journeys.
  • Experience connecting digital product experiences with CRM, lifecycle communications, personalisation or customer reactivation.
  • Knowledge of accessibility standards and inclusive design practices, such as WCAG 2.2.
  • Experience using AI-assisted design tools to accelerate ideation, prototyping, research or design workflows, while maintaining strong design judgement and responsible data handling.

Why join us?

At Redcare Pharmacy, your research will help shape how people access and manage their healthcare, making important customer journeys easier, clearer and more accessible.

You'll have the opportunity to influence both immediate product improvements and the longer-term direction of our Pharma experience, working alongside multidisciplinary teams in a growing, technology-driven organisation.

We value curiosity, methodological expertise and a strong customer focus, and we're looking for someone who can challenge existing thinking and help us make better product decisions through meaningful research.

About your Benefits:

In order to provide our employees with the best possible support for their individual needs, we offer a wide range of benefits:

  • Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU.
  • Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.
  • Kindergarten Grant: We offer our employees who pay for childcare in kindergarten 100,00 € (total) per month.

title: Product Engineer, Shop
description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets.

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.

What you'll be doing

  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

What you'll need

  • 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt
  • Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture
Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

Nice to have

  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

Our stack

TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.

We offer

  • Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.
  • Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.
  • Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.
  • Pension. We contribute 6% for you.
  • Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.
  • A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.
  • Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Full Stack Software Engineer
Type: Full-time
Location: Madrid
What about us?
Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.
At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.
By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.
Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀
The Role
We are hiring a Full Stack Software Engineer to drive our product development cycle. This role is built on the philosophy that the best engineers don't just write code, they build solutions. Your primary responsibility is to bridge the gap between business needs and technical execution, rapidly translating high-level goals into polished, shipped features.
You will be expected to challenge requirements, bring a product-first mindset to the engineering team, and ensure every line of code adds tangible value. This role demands strong software engineering proficiency and acute product judgment to prioritize and ship high-impact features in a fast-paced environment.

What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Exceptional software engineering and system design capability, with proven experience designing, building, and shipping production-grade, scalable systems across the full stack (including C#, Python, and Typescript proficiency), always prioritizing technical clarity and maintainable architecture.
  • A "Product-First" Engineering Mindset, demonstrating the ability to analyze business needs and challenge assumptions. You don't just build what is asked; you build what is needed to move the needle for the product and the user.
  • End-to-end feature ownership, driving the entire development lifecycle from defining requirements to robust implementation, QA, deployment and monitoring, maintaining high accountability for the final user and business outcome.
  • Strategic communication skills, capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for business stakeholders and, conversely, translating complex business objectives into prioritized, elegant engineering solutions.
  • High-velocity development, leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve accelerated delivery while rigorously upholding code quality and architectural integrity.

What will you find working at INFINIT?

  • Competitive Salary and Equity: We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.
  • Diverse and Inclusive Team: Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.
  • Inspiring Mission: We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.
  • Flexible Benefits: Access Flexible Retribution benefits with Cobee through a convenient mobile app
  • Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance and corporate gym discounts.
  • Quality Time Together: We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.
  • Personal Time Off: Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off as well as your birthday off.
  • Flexibility and Ownership: We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of hybrid working 3 days a week in our Madrid office and 2 days at home.
Diversity and Inclusion
INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: Music Licensing Executive
description:
We're looking for a Music Licensing Executive to join our team to secure, manage and deliver the licensed music that families love on Yoto, working with major and independent labels, collection societies, publishers and rights holders to make sure every release launches accurately and on schedule.


About Yoto

Yoto is a screen-free interactive audio platform for kids. We make carefully connected audio players that kids control, with no microphones, cameras or ads. We have a catalogue of audio that inspires creative play and learning with 1,000+ titles in our card store from top creators, publishers and labels - think Disney, Marvel, Roald Dahl and Universal Music. We also create Yoto Originals like BrainBots.

  • Voted the 14th fastest-growing private software technology company in Britain in The Sunday Times 100 Tech 2025; and named the 94th fastest-growing company in Europe in the prestigious FT1000.

  • Ranked 9th in Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies in 2024; and featured in the Sifted 100 fastest-growing startups across the UK&I by revenue growth.

  • Featured in Bloomberg’s 25 UK startups to watch in 2023; and ranked second fastest growing tech company in the UK in the Deloitte Fast50.

  • Named one of TIME Magazine’s Top 100 Inventions of 2020.

  • We’re over 200 employees spread across the world... and growing!

We’re on a mission to be the soundtrack of childhood, and help families on their own unique adventures. By creating products that inspire independent play, we help families discover and grow with an inspiring world of audio - and we would like you to help us achieve it!


Yoto’s Content Team

Music is a big part of the soundtrack of childhood, and our Content team is responsible for bringing it to families on Yoto. We work with labels, publishers, artists and creators to build a catalogue that sparks singing, dancing and imagination, and we make sure every title is licensed properly, delivered accurately and launched successfully. The Music Licensing Executive is the link between our external partners and rights holders and the teams inside Yoto who turn a deal into a card in a child's hands. Reporting into the Senior Licensing Manager, you'll work closely with Legal, Finance, Content Operations, Production and Marketing, so the people behind the music are treated fairly, and families are presented with the very best audio for kids.


What you’ll be doing:

  • Support the acquisition and licensing process for music releases, from first conversation with a label, publisher or artist team through to signed agreement and delivery

  • Nurture and manage select partner relationships alongside the Music Licensing team

  • Liaise with labels, artists and their teams on artwork and asset delivery

  • Track and analyse community content requests, sales and engagement, and produce partner-facing presentations and reports based on our internal data

  • Keep accurate records of rights, territories, terms, advances, minimum guarantees and renewal dates, so the business always knows what we're licensed to release and when

  • Work with Finance on royalty set-up, statements and payments, and respond to rights holder queries on reporting and payments

  • Partner with Content Operations, Production and Marketing to make sure licensed music is delivered, approved and launched on schedule, flagging risks early and keeping release plans on track

  • Keep up to date on industry trends, scout for suitable music content and potential new licensor/label partners

  • Represent Yoto at key industry gatherings, licensing forums, and external partner events.

What you’ll bring:

  • Proven experience in music licensing, either on the label or publishing side or for a music platform, collection society or digital service, with a working understanding of master and publishing rights, territories and licence terms.

  • Hands-on contracting and negotiation experience, including agreeing commercial terms and working from licence agreements alongside legal teams.

  • A track record of managing rights holder relationships, including labels, publishers, distributors or artist management, and handling queries through to resolution.

  • Experience tracking rights, deal terms and delivery dates across multiple releases at once, using spreadsheets or rights management tools, with accuracy you can evidence.

  • Demonstrated experience working alongside Legal, Finance, Operations, Production or Marketing teams to deliver releases to a fixed schedule.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with royalty accounting or reporting for music licences, including working with Finance on statements and payments.

  • Experience licensing music for children's, family or educational audio and content.

  • Experience applying AI or automation tools to administrative or analytical work, and the judgement to know where human review is essential.


Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 based on experience

How we use AI at Yoto

We think using AI to work smarter is part of the job.

At Yoto, we use AI to help us move faster and reduce manual work so we can focus our time on creativity, problem-solving and impact. We don’t want to use AI to cut corners - it’s about smart usage that makes space for the work that really matters. Our intention is to be thoughtful about how we use AI. We treat its outputs as a starting point, not the final answer, and we take care to use it responsibly - especially given the trust families place in Yoto.

We don’t expect everyone to be an AI expert, but we do expect people to be curious, to experiment, and to keep improving how they work. If you prefer to do everything manually, you might find our pace and expectations challenging.

The magic at Yoto comes from people working here, not their prompts. AI should help us move faster, not change what makes working here great.



What you can expect from Yoto:

  • Flexibility: Hybrid working - At least 1 day a week on average in our central London office. You are welcome and encouraged to come in more than this. How you meet the minimum expectation is up to you, to ensure you're happy and productive in your role whilst also getting that vital face time with your colleagues. Take advantage of our ‘work from anywhere’ policy to work from a different location for up to 6 weeks every year. Summer Hours policy to use between the months of June and August.

  • Financial: Receive Income Protection, covering long term sickness for up to 2 years and company sick pay that increases with length of service. Life Assurance cover from day one of your service. Workplace Pension offering up to to 4% employer contributions, following probation. Generous employee referral bonus scheme.

  • Health & Wellness: Private Medical Insurance via Aviva, or a Wellbeing Allowance to be used for memberships, subscriptions, treatment or therapy. Access to 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) through WeCare. Bike to work scheme to promote healthier lifestyles.

  • Time Off: 25 days of holiday per year, plus bank holidays. On top of this, you also receive your birthday off, plus 1 extra day of holiday for every year worked after you hit your 2 year anniversary, up to 5 extra days. After 4 years of service, you are also eligible for our sabbatical policy offering up to 3 months' of unpaid sabbatical.

  • Helping Families: Variety of family-friendly leave, including enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption, fertility, pregnancy loss and carers leave. Unlock savings with our workplace nursery scheme, designed to support parents of preschool-aged children.

  • People & Planet: Up to 2 volunteer days a year. A Book Allowance of up to £50 a year to contribute to your professional development.

  • Fun Perks: You receive your very own Yoto player and starter pack of cards! Regular company socials and celebrations, including our annual YotoFest!


Equity and Diversity

At Yoto, we love creating a world where childhood is rich with discovery and joy. We’re also passionate about building a workplace where everyone can thrive - both professionally and personally. We value flexibility and give our team the freedom to balance life and work in ways that suit them.

We're committed to fostering a safe, diverse, and inclusive environment where all individuals, regardless of their background, feel valued and supported. Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion group holds bi-monthly forums to elevate diverse voices and perspectives, ensuring everyone at Yoto feels heard, respected, and appreciated.

We don’t just embrace differences - we celebrate them. We share audio content from a vibrant and diverse community of creators (check out our DEI selection), and we are building a team that reflects that same diversity. We invite candidates from all walks of life to explore opportunities with us and join a company that champions flexibility, equity, and inclusion. Take a look at our website for more information on our approach to People and Planet.



Please only apply or engage with Yoto jobs posted on our careers page ( or ). All correspondence from our Talent team will only come through Teamtailor, our application tracking system.

title: Stores Supervisor
description:
Actavo is seeking an experienced and highly organised Stores Supervisor to oversee the day-to-day operation of our stores function.

The successful candidate will supervise the Stores Person(s) and take responsibility for ensuring that all incoming and outgoing stock is accurately recorded, stored and distributed. You will ensure appropriate stock levels are maintained to support operational requirements while maintaining high standards of safety, organisation and stock control.

Working closely with the Materials & Logistics Manager and operational teams, you will play an important role in ensuring materials and equipment are available to crews when required.

Responsibilities:

  • Supervise the day-to-day activities of the Stores Person, providing clear direction and allocation of daily priorities.

  • Oversee all incoming and outgoing stock, ensuring materials are accurately received, recorded, stored and issued.

  • Maintain appropriate minimum stock levels and ensure materials are reordered in line with operational requirements.

  • Monitor stock movements and investigate any shortages, discrepancies or damaged goods.

  • Ensure deliveries are checked accurately against purchase orders and delivery documentation.

  • Coordinate the preparation and timely dispatch of materials and equipment to operational teams and crews in the field.

  • Work closely with the Materials & Logistics Manager, operational teams and other stakeholders to anticipate upcoming material requirements.

  • Ensure the stores area is maintained to a high standard and remains clean, organised, safe and secure.

  • Ensure materials, tools and equipment are stored appropriately and can be easily identified and located.

  • Identify potential stock shortages or supply issues and escalate these before they impact operational delivery.

  • Identify opportunities to improve stores processes, stock accuracy and operational efficiency.

  • Promote a strong culture of safety, accountability and teamwork within the stores function

Requirements:

  • CSCS accredited for operating a forklift truck

title: Counterintelligence Analyst - Active Clearance Required
description:
We're looking for a Counterintelligence (CI) Analyst within the Counterintelligence Program to conduct counterintelligence and counterterrorism research, analysis, reporting, collaboration, training, and information management to identify threats and support national security stakeholders. You will report to the Supervisory Analyst.

This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one day per week on non-Alternate Work Schedule work week.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

  • Conduct research and analysis supporting diverse counterintelligence and counterterrorism investigations under direction of senior staff.
  • Collect, analyze, and fuse information from open and secure sources to identify threats and assess foreign capabilities.
  • Provide analytical support to threat assessments and tactical and strategic intelligence products for local and national stakeholders.
  • Support or prepare briefings, debriefings, and presentations concerning foreign nationals, foreign travel, and CI/CT risks.
  • Support DOE data calls, programmatic initiatives, plans, and proposed policy changes.
  • Contribute to collaborations with Laboratory organizations, DOE, national laboratories, the U.S. Intelligence Community (USIC), and law enforcement.
  • Contribute to and deliver counterintelligence awareness and training materials.
  • Enter, retrieve, and manage information in Laboratory and USIC analytical and investigative systems.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the K02.2 level

  • Independently conduct comprehensive research and complex counterintelligence analysis with limited direction.
  • Produce complex threat assessments and intelligence products.
  • Participate in and, as appropriate, lead collaborative analytical projects.
  • Provide general direction to support staff and junior analysts.
  • Assist senior staff in developing recommendations on programmatic and policy matters.
  • This position requires an active Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance or active Top Secret clearance issued by another U.S. government agency at the time of hire.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) access. Please note that any current active Q or Top Secret clearance with DOE does not guarantee DOE SCI access approval; if you are denied access, you may be subject to reinvestigation of your existing Q or Top Secret clearance.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience/training.
  • Core knowledge of analytic principles, procedures, methodologies, and intelligence-information dissemination.
  • Fundamental understanding of national-security issues related to the USIC.
  • Familiarity with classified and unclassified databases, software applications, and intelligence research tools used to identify and assess foreign capabilities.
  • Core training in areas such as espionage, counterproliferation, weapons systems, and/or foreign intelligence services.
  • Familiarity with hardware, software, and network-system fundamentals.
  • Ability to interpret and apply governmental and Laboratory policies, procedures, orders, and regulations.
  • Sufficient written, verbal, briefing, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to exercise tact, diplomacy, sound judgment, and discretion with highly sensitive information.

Additional qualifications at the K02.2 level

  • Related intelligence-field experience and applied knowledge of analytic principles, procedures, methodologies, and intelligence-information dissemination.
  • Knowledge and experience addressing national-security issues related to the USIC.
  • Experience using classified and unclassified databases, software applications, and intelligence research tools to identify and assess foreign capabilities using conventional intelligence disciplines.
  • Specialized training in espionage, counterproliferation, weapons systems, and/or foreign intelligence services.
  • Experience interpreting and applying governmental policies, procedures, orders, and regulations.
  • Strong written, verbal, briefing, and interpersonal communication skills.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Experience supporting CI/CT investigations, threat assessments, DOE data calls, or USIC coordination.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly in written products and briefings.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Joining Collibra’s AI Product Management team

Collibra’s AI Product Management team sets how we build AI into our platform and how we help customers govern and trust their own AI systems. You will work with the Director of AI Engineering to shape our AI strategy and roadmap, and with Product and Engineering leaders to ship AI features customers use. You will report directly to the Vice President, Product Management. This role is needed now because AI is central to Collibra’s strategy, and you will help define what responsible, enterprise-grade AI looks like in data governance.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York office. Our hybrid model means you’ll work from the office at least two days each week. This setup helps us stay connected, work more closely together, and keep making progress as a team.

Staff Product Managers, AI at Collibra are responsible for

  • Defining Collibra’s AI product strategy and 12-month roadmap with the Director of AI Engineering and Product and Engineering leaders, so AI investments stay focused on where customers and the market are heading.
  • Co-authoring customer-facing AI features from problem framing through launch and adoption, working directly with customers on challenges such as data management restrictions and custom AI models, so features solve real problems and get used.
  • Leading evaluation of AI models and approaches with Engineering, for both internal use and the customer platform (central model evaluation, platform AI testing, emerging AI paradigms), so Collibra builds on the most capable and appropriate foundation.
  • Setting responsible AI standards with Engineering, Legal, and Security, including a pre-launch review for AI features, so what we ship meets our standards for quality, transparency, and compliance.

You have

  • 5+ years of product management experience.
  • Experience working on AI or ML-powered software, including taking an AI or ML feature from design to launch with engineers.
  • Experience presenting product strategy to senior or executive leadership.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.
  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience.
  • This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

You are

  • A product leader with strong AI/ML technical fluency, who weighs model and provider options on cost, latency, quality, and data-handling constraints and questions technical claims directly
  • An owner who defines what “good” means for an AI feature before it is built, including evaluation criteria, guardrails, and applicable data restrictions
  • A problem-first prioritizer who separates real customer problems from impressive demos and is comfortable saying no to AI work that won’t pay off
  • A clear communicator who explains the same tradeoff to Engineers, Legal, Sales, and executives, adjusting the framing while keeping the substance the same
  • A fast mover in a changing field who holds the line on governance and security standards

Measures of success

  • Within your first month, you will learn Collibra’s platform, AI roadmap, and current AI releases, and meet the Director of AI Engineering, Product and Engineering leaders, and Legal and Security partners.
  • Within your third month, you will draft the AI strategy and 12-month roadmap with a named owner for each initiative, and document key platform architecture decisions (such as the MCP gateway and proxy hosting path) with their tradeoffs.

title: Senior Manager Engineering, Sustainability and Decarbonization - [Hybrid/Atlanta]

Serves as a key technical resource for internal IHG Teams to support building-system, engineering and energy conservation measure issues and questions.

  • Develop and deliver educational content for internal partners on existing and emerging ECMs.
  • Develop and deliver educational content for IHG Owners, General Managers and Construction Partners on opportunities for energy conservation in new development, renovation and conversion hotels.

title: Director, Tax
description:
Definium Therapeutics is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company and our mission is to forge a new era of psychiatry by applying scientific rigor to psychedelics, with the goal of developing accessible treatments that unlock healing at scale.

Our lead product candidate, lysergide tartrate (our proprietary orally disintegrating tablet form of lysergide (LSD) D-tartrate), represents a highly differentiated, potential best-in-class opportunity for patients suffering from generalized anxiety, major depressive disorder, and posttraumatic stress disorder. Our early stage pipeline includes DT402, the R-enantiomer of MDMA and is under development to target the core symptoms of autism spectrum disorder (ASD), specifically addressing social communication challenges.

Guided by the recognition that patients deserve more than better, Definium is relentlessly advancing a new generation of therapeutics intended to address the underlying causes of psychiatric and neurological disorders. By turning evidence into impact, Definium aims to change the trajectory of today’s mental health care crisis and enable a healthier future. Headquartered in New York, Definium Therapeutics trades on Nasdaq under the symbol DFTX.

Together we are moving psychiatry forward—beyond better, into a boundless future. Join us!

In this role, you will develop and execute Definium's tax strategy as we transition from a development-stage to a commercial-stage company. As our primary internal tax resource and trusted advisor to Finance leadership, you will oversee tax accounting and planning, coordinate compliance through external advisors, and build the infrastructure to support commercial operations. The ideal candidate pairs strong technical expertise with a practical, business-oriented approach and is comfortable leading strategy and executing hands-on.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead Definium's tax strategy and planning, including the tax impact of financings, equity compensation, corporate structure changes, and strategic transactions
  • Own ASC 740 tax accounting, including quarterly and annual provisions, deferred tax assets, valuation allowances, and uncertain tax positions, in support of SEC reporting and audits
  • Oversee federal, state, local, and international compliance performed by external providers, and coordinate responses to tax authority inquiries
  • Lead tax readiness for commercialization, including state and local, sales and use, franchise, and nexus considerations for a growing field-based and commercial workforce
  • Manage tax attributes and credits, including Section 382 analyses, NOL preservation, and federal and state R&D credit studies
  • Support business development, licensing, and collaboration transactions, plus transfer pricing and legal entity planning as needed
  • Serve as principal liaison to external tax advisors, managing workstreams, budgets, and deliverables, and challenging recommendations as needed
  • Partner with Accounting, FP&A, Treasury, Legal, Payroll, HR, Commercial, and Executive Leadership, and build scalable tax processes, policies, and documentation

Qualifications:

  • Minimum bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, Tax, or a related field required; Master's in Taxation (MST) or advanced tax credential preferred
  • CPA certification required
  • Minimum 10 years of progressive tax experience required
  • Strong knowledge of ASC 740 and U.S. corporate taxation required
  • Experience supporting public company reporting and managing external tax service providers required
  • Strong project management, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to balance strategy and hands-on execution
  • Up to 10% travel will be required based upon business needs

Preferred:

  • Big Four or national public accounting experience
  • Biotech, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare industry experience
  • Experience supporting organizations transitioning from development-stage to commercial operations.
  • Experience with Section 382, NOL planning, R&D credits, multi-state taxation, equity compensation, and capital markets transactions

onsemi is seeking an experienced Product Line Manager to support and grow the SiC bare die business.   • Design-Win Execution: Support customer projects from early promotion through evaluation, qualification, nomination, ramp, and production.

  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across global teams, including Europe, US, and Asia.

This position offers the opportunity to work with financial institutions on core system enhancements, technology modernization, and operational improvements.

You will partner closely with our clients' business and technical teams to evaluate existing core applications, identify opportunities for improvement, and design solutions that support business objectives. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with Fidelity core banking applications, system integrations, technical requirements, and application implementation within banking or credit union environments.

This is an On-Site, Full-Time position.

  • Partner with business and technical teams to evaluate core banking applications, identify operational challenges, and recommend system enhancements.
  • Analyze current-state business processes and application functionality to develop future-state requirements and technical solutions.

  • You have 8+ years of experience working with core banking applications or enterprise technology systems within a bank, credit union, or financial services organization.
