title: Director - Software Engineering
description:
Director, Software Engineering

Position Summary

The Director of Software Engineering is responsible for leading multiple software engineering teams in the design, development, delivery, and ongoing evolution of scalable, secure, and high-performing enterprise software solutions.

This role combines people leadership, technical depth, Agile execution, and strategic thinking. The Director will lead and develop engineering managers and software engineers while partnering closely with Product, Architecture, Data Engineering, Security, and business leaders to translate business priorities into effective technical solutions.

The ideal candidate has experience leading engineering organizations in an Agile/Scrum environment and a strong understanding of modern cloud-based application and data architectures. Experience leading teams that develop solutions utilizing Snowflake, cloud technologies, APIs, data integration, and modern software engineering practices is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead, develop, and mentor engineering managers, technical leads, and software engineers across multiple teams.
  • Establish and execute engineering strategies that align technology investments with product and business objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership across complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams and technology domains.
  • Maintain sufficient technical depth to effectively participate in architecture, application design, data architecture, security, scalability, and engineering discussions.
  • Partner with Product Management, Architecture, Data Engineering, Security, and business stakeholders to define technical priorities and delivery roadmaps.
  • Drive technical decision-making while balancing scalability, maintainability, performance, security, cost, and speed to market.
  • Establish meaningful engineering metrics and use them to improve delivery predictability, software quality, team effectiveness, and operational performance.

Agile Software Development

  • Lead engineering teams operating within an Agile/Scrum product development environment.
  • Promote effective Agile practices, including sprint planning, refinement, estimation, daily collaboration, retrospectives, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Product leaders and Product Owners to maintain alignment between product priorities, technical requirements, engineering capacity, and delivery commitments.
  • Create accountability around commitments and the definition of done while encouraging teams to continuously improve development practices.
  • Identify and remove organizational or technical barriers that impact engineering velocity and delivery.
  • Use Agile and engineering metrics to identify trends, improve predictability, and support data-driven decision-making.

Software Architecture & Development

  • Provide technical oversight for the design and development of scalable enterprise and SaaS applications.
  • Champion modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, source control, CI/CD, observability, DevOps, and secure software development.
  • Partner with architects and senior engineers to establish engineering standards, reusable patterns, and technical best practices.
  • Guide teams in addressing technical debt and balancing short-term product needs with long-term platform sustainability.
  • Ensure solutions meet appropriate standards for availability, performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Cloud, Data & Snowflake

  • Lead software engineering teams building applications and services that integrate with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Provide leadership around the integration of application, data, API, and analytics architectures.
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering and Analytics teams on data accessibility, application integration, data quality, performance, and governance.
  • Develop teams capable of effectively working with modern data technologies such as Snowflake, SQL, dbt, Azure Data Factory, APIs, and cloud-native services.
  • Understand the architectural considerations involved in building software applications that consume, process, and interact with large-scale cloud data platforms.
  • Promote effective performance, security, access-control, and cost-management practices across cloud and data solutions.

People & Organizational Leadership

  • Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing engineering talent.
  • Build leadership capability among engineering managers, technical leads, and senior individual contributors.
  • Establish clear expectations and accountability for technical quality, execution, collaboration, and professional development.
  • Conduct regular performance and development discussions and create opportunities for career growth.
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.
  • Help design engineering team structures that support current business priorities while positioning the organization for future growth.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

title: Senior Security Architect
description:
🎯 About the role

Quinyx is looking for a senior Security Architect to own security day to day across our product, our cloud platform and our information security management system (ISMS). You set the security requirements, review what Engineering and Platform build, run our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 programmes and follow findings through to closure. You report to the CIO and work with Engineering, Platform, SRE, IT and Legal. Security at Quinyx owns assessment, requirements, validation and follow-through.


This is a hands-on individual contributor role that bridges cloud security engineering and continuous assurance. You work directly in cloud environments, containerized workloads, CI/CD pipelines and identity architecture, and you own the ISMS that proves the controls work.

📝 What you’ll do

  • Cloud and architecture security. Run security architecture reviews and threat modelling for product and infrastructure changes. Assess our AWS and GCP environments across IAM, networking, storage, databases, secrets and logging. Set the requirements and validate what Platform and SRE build.

  • SDLC and application security. Embed security into CI/CD: IaC scanning, SAST, DAST, SCA and secret scanning. Review web and API security against OWASP ASVS and the Top 10, including authentication and authorisation (OAuth 2.0, SAML, OIDC).

  • AI security. Threat-model and review AI features, LLM integrations, agents and connectors in our product and internal tooling against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the OWASP AI Exchange. Maintain the security requirements in our AI Building Policy and check that builders follow them, covering prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, model and tool supply chain, and access to customer data.

  • Vulnerability management. Own the process end to end across applications, cloud infrastructure and endpoints. Prioritise by attack path and asset context, and track pentest findings and risk exceptions through to verified closure.

  • Detection and incident response. Define the security telemetry we collect, tune SIEM detections against MITRE ATT&CK techniques, and lead incident triage, containment and post-incident reviews.

  • ISMS and audits. Run the ISMS for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 day to day. Keep policies, the Statement of Applicability and the risk register current. Coordinate internal and external audits, collect evidence and automate control monitoring in our GRC platform.

  • Vendor and customer assurance. Assess third-party risk before we onboard a vendor and at renewal. Answer customer security questionnaires and assurance reviews with accurate, reusable evidence and keep our Trust Centre current.

✅ What we’re looking for

  • Several years of hands-on security work in a multi-tenant SaaS company, covering cloud security engineering and GRC.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and working knowledge of the other: IAM, networking, workload security, KMS and audit logging.

  • Securing CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and containers, with practical use of SAST, DAST, SCA and secret scanning tools.

  • Web and API security: OWASP ASVS and Top 10, and authentication and authorisation protocols (OAuth 2.0, SAML, OIDC).

  • AI and LLM security: the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and the OWASP AI Exchange, and practical experience with the risks of LLM integrations, agents and connectors (prompt injection, data leakage, excessive agency, supply chain).

  • Detection engineering: writing and tuning SIEM detections with MITRE ATT&CK as the reference.

  • Operating ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II controls: evidence collection, auditor coordination and a formal risk register.

  • Reads code and Terraform, writes automation in Python, Bash or PowerShell, and analyses telemetry with SIEM queries or SQL.

  • Has led incidents and written the post-incident review.

  • Turns a security finding into an action an engineer will take, and a risk into a sentence a leadership team will act on.

✨ Nice to have (but not required)

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC, AWS Certified Security - Specialty or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor.

  • Experience with a GRC platform such as Vanta or Drata.

  • Experience with GDPR from the data processor side.

  • Experience applying the EU AI Act to a SaaS product.

💡 Desired personality traits

  • Pragmatic risk judgement. You judge risk by material exposure and real exploitability, and you can explain why a critical tool score is a medium for us.

  • Ownership. You follow findings and risk exceptions through to verified closure.

  • Clear communication. You translate security concepts into practical actions for engineers, product teams and senior leadership.

💙 Why Quinyx?

Quinyx is a leading workforce management platform, helping businesses simplify scheduling, optimize staffing, and engage their frontline teams. We empower organizations across the globe, ranging from retail and hospitality to logistics and healthcare, with smart, mobile-first solutions. Here, you’ll find:

  • A truly international team with colleagues from all over the world

  • A flexible and hybrid-friendly work culture

  • Opportunities to grow, take ownership, and make a real impact

  • An open, inclusive, and fun environment where your ideas matter

🎁 What we offer

  • Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup with at least 2 days per week from the office.

  • Enhanced vacation allowance, gym membership contribution, health insurance, and a pension plan.

  • On-market pay.

📬 How to apply & Our process

Ready to join the team? Submit your application below, and we’ll be in touch as soon as possible. What our hiring process looks like:

  • Fill out a short application.

  • Complete our psychometric and objective assessments through Alva Labs.

  • Screening call with our Talent team.

  • Meet the hiring manager (Deep Dive).

  • Complete a role-specific technical case.

  • Final interview (in-office).

  • Offer, references & background checks.

🙌 Quinyx is an equal opportunity employer

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees - no matter your background, identity, or experience.

When work just works!

title: Building Envelope & Historic Preservation Consultant
description:
Help Preserve the Past. Shape the Future of Our Built Environment.

At Walker Consultants, we're looking for someone who sees more than just buildings. We're looking for someone who appreciates the craftsmanship, history, and character behind them and is passionate about ensuring they stand strong for generations to come.

In this role, you'll bring your technical expertise to a diverse portfolio of projects, from modern architectural developments to historic landmarks and iconic structures. You'll work directly with clients and collaborate with experienced professionals on building enclosure design, forensic investigations, restoration, and historic preservation. Your work will span a variety of building enclosure systems, including waterproofing, plazas and podiums, exterior walls, historic masonry and façades, fenestration systems, and roofing assemblies.

You'll have the opportunity to contribute to every stage of the project lifecycle, including condition assessments, investigations, restoration design, peer reviews, construction administration, and testing. Whether you're helping breathe new life into a historic building or improving the performance of a modern structure, you'll tackle unique technical challenges, develop creative solutions, and make a lasting impact on the buildings and communities we serve.

What You'll Do

  • Perform building envelope investigations and historic building assessments, preparing technical reports documenting findings, deficiencies, and recommendations for repair, restoration, or preservation.
  • Evaluate existing building conditions, including historic masonry, façades, roofing systems, windows, and architectural features, to develop appropriate repair and restoration solutions. Experience with historic structural systems preferred.
  • Prepare construction documents, repair recommendations, and opinions of probable construction costs for building envelope, restoration, and historic preservation projects.
  • Perform construction administration services, including RFI and submittal reviews, site visits, field observations, and punch list inspections.
  • Collaborate with architects, contractors, clients, and preservation professionals to review project findings, designs, restoration approaches, and construction progress.
  • Participate in field investigations, material assessments, and testing while supporting project quality, budgets, and schedules.
  • Support client relationships and business development efforts, including preparation of RFQ/RFP responses.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What You'll Bring

  • Education Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Engineering or Architecture from an accredited institution.

Additional Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in building envelope consulting, waterproofing, restoration, or related services.
  • Strong knowledge of exterior building systems and materials, including façades, roofing, waterproofing, windows, and masonry.
  • Experience with new construction and the investigation, evaluation, and restoration of existing structures.
  • Experience with historic preservation, historic building assessments, or restoration of historic structures is preferred.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) or Registered Architect (RA) license preferred.
  • SPRAT Level 1 certification is a plus.
  • Project management experience, including coordinating project teams, managing budgets and schedules, and maintaining client relationships, is preferred.
  • Ability to coordinate with project teams, clients, and outside consultants while maintaining strong working relationships.
  • Strong technical communication skills, including preparation of reports, repair recommendations, and RFQ/RFP responses.
  • A collaborative, client-focused mindset with an interest in business development.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs., including hoses, testing equipment, and other field materials.
  • Willingness to travel as needed.

We offer a robust total compensation and rewards package designed to support our employees’ well-being, growth, and diverse needs, including:

  • Annual discretionary bonus program

  • Opportunity to purchase Walker stock – Walker is 100% employee-owned!

  • Medical, dental, vision, company-paid life insurance

  • Mental wellness benefits

  • Health Savings Account with company contribution

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid community involvement hours

  • Tuition and licensure reimbursement and sponsorship of professional memberships

  • Internal conferences and professional development opportunities

  • Employee Resource Groups and Affinity Groups

Why Walker Consultants?

Walker offers various comprehensive services spanning structural integrity and building performance, encompassing forensic investigations, building envelope analysis, and restoration. Our forensic specialists excel in pinpointing the underlying causes of intricate issues, be it structural complexities, architectural hurdles, or building envelope uncertainties. Leveraging thorough investigations, meticulous assessments, and advanced analyses, we deliver enduring solutions.

The building envelope's significance transcends protection; it profoundly influences energy efficiency, occupant comfort, and aesthetic allure. Our building envelope experts ensure continuity, durability, and performance, maintaining project integrity from inception to a structure's lengthy service life. With a broad geographic footprint across the United States, Walker's extensive presence allows swift responses to local demands while harnessing the proficiency of our adept designers and practitioners.

Join Us!

We know that great talent comes in many forms. If you're excited about this role but don’t meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply! You might just be the right person for this role—or another opportunity on our team.

title: Enviromental Data Specialist
description:
What if your work could shape the materials that power everyday life — from the cities we live in, to the healthcare we rely on, to the technologies driving our future?

At Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials (OF&EM), this is exactly what we do. Count on a welcoming environment where purpose meets impact. Here, we collaborate across the Americas, Europe and Asia to develop, manufacture and supply fluoroproducts that play a fundamental role in advancing life around the world.

We foster a culture where diverse perspectives are valued, where you can contribute authentically, and where innovation and well-being go hand in hand. We encourage our people to grow, explore new solutions and become the best version of themselves. You will join an international, professional team and benefit from a competitive compensation package.

Main Purpose

Provide environmental analysis, data management, and coordination for Orbia’s water and energy optimization programs, carbon accounting, environmental disclosures, audits, nature-related analysis, and supply chain initiatives. The role ensures data integrity, supports compliance requirements, and tracks program delivery across Business Groups.

Main Responsibilities

Water & Energy Optimization Action Plans

· Analyze site-level energy consumption, cost, tariff, water, and operational data to identify performance gaps and optimization opportunities.

· Support the assessment and quantification of energy efficiency, demand management, tariff, electricity procurement, and water efficiency opportunities based on cost, savings potential, environmental impact, and implementation requirements.

· Maintain optimization action plans and datasets, track savings and performance against baselines and targets, and consolidate progress across Business Groups.

· Support carbon accounting and reporting for water and energy optimization initiatives, including emissions baselines, conversion factors, and greenhouse gas reductions, ensuring consistency with Orbia’s corporate inventory.

· Analyze water, biodiversity, and nature data to quantify Orbia’s impacts and dependencies and support methodologies aligned with recognized approaches.

Supply Chain Risk Sustainability Programs

· Track supply chain environmental metrics and monitor regulatory requirements related to sustainability practices in the value chain.

· Coordinate Orbia-level supplier assessment programs, including EcoVadis, in collaboration with Procurement and Business Groups.

· Support deployment and improvement of the Scope 3 inventory across Business Groups to strengthen data quality and compliance readiness.

Environmental Disclosures, Reporting & Audits

· Coordinate environmental data assurance and audit readiness, including evidence collection, delivery of final reports, and closure of corrective actions before validation deadlines.

· Coordinate environmental disclosures and assessments, including CDP, CSA, and EcoVadis, ensuring consistency, traceability, and timely submission.

· Serve as the main backup for administration and configuration of environmental data collection platforms.

· Contribute to quarterly environmental performance reporting and related management materials.

Knowledge/ Experience Required

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical, Electrical, Environmental, or related Engineering discipline.

Language(s) and level of proficiency: English and Spanish

Knowledge/Experience: At least 3-4 years of experience in environmental performance, sustainability, energy, or resource efficiency within a global corporation or consulting firm.

Demonstrated experience analyzing environmental and operational data, maintaining datasets and calculation methodologies, developing performance baselines and indicators, and supporting data assurance or audit processes.

Proficiency in advanced Excel and data visualization tools such as Power BI, with working knowledge of Python, data automation, and AI-assisted tools for data processing, quality control, anomaly detection, analysis, and workflow improvement.

Ability to translate complex data into clear findings, quantify cost and environmental improvement opportunities, and coordinate deliverables across global, cross-functional teams.

Knowledge of life cycle assessment methodologies and their application to evaluate product and value chain environmental impacts is a plus.

Behaviours that can help you succeed at Orbia:

- Develop yourself & Others

- Foster Collaboration & Inclusion

- Drive Results

- Provide Vision & Direction

Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials (OF&EM) business is a global leader in the development, manufacture and supply of fluoroproducts that play a fundamental role in enhancing everyday lives and shortening the path to a sustainable, circular economy. Backed by over 38 years of experience, Orbia Fluor & Energy Materials (OF&EM) products are used in a vast range of applications including electric vehicles and energy storage, urban and rural infrastructure, indoor climate management, food and medicine refrigeration and in treating respiratory conditions through the development of healthy and innovative low-GWP propellants for metered-dose inhalers.

title: Test & Evaluation Engineer
location: Colorado Springs, Colorado, United States; El Segundo, California, United States
description:
For more than 50 years, ENSCO has been providing leading-edge engineering, science and advanced technology solutions to governments and private industries worldwide.

ENSCO prides itself in creating and applying advanced technologies for mission success. We provide systems engineering, integration, and advanced technology services to transform the future safety, security, and resiliency of critical missions on the ground, in the air, in space, and in the information systems that connect these domains.

Learn more about ENSCO.

Position Description

ENSCO Inc. is a diverse engineering and technology company that provides engineering, science, and advanced technology solutions supporting mission success, safety, and security for government and commercial customers worldwide.

We are seeking a Test & Evaluation Engineer to work directly with Government mission leaders and independently governed program teams delivering elements of a critical space mission capability. Each participating organization may hold a different architecture vision, acquisition path, technical baseline, funding profile, and delivery schedule. This role creates trusted relationships and shared technical evidence needed to bring those efforts together.

The MILSATCOM Systems Engineering, Integration, and Test (MSEIT) effort provides leading edge Systems Engineering & Integration (SE&I) for the Space Force’s Space System Command. We support the Space Force’s acquisition of state of the art Military Satellite Communications systems, providing global secure, survivable, and protected communications for our nation’s warfighters. We seek technical individuals who will thrive in a highly collaborative work environment of small teams, using the most modern tools and methodologies to tackle the challenges of integrating complex space and ground communications systems.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Developing T&E strategy, Test and Evaluation Master Plan (TEMP) Development Evaluation Framework, requirement verification and test plans, test objectives, test methodology, and evaluation criteria
  • Collecting, reviewing, analyzing, and reporting T&E data
  • Supporting implementation of common Test and Evaluation database for the program
  • Supporting development of DoD compliant deficiency reporting and resolution system
  • Supporting T&E reviews, audits, Integrated Product Teams (IPTs), Deficiency Review Boards (DRBs), Materiel Improvement Process Review Boards (MIPRBs), and Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs)
  • Position requires travel to DoD and contractor test sites (up to 25% per year)

Qualifications Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, physics, math, or related technical field
  • At least 5 years of test and evaluation experience with DoD/USAF test processes and documentation, including at least 2 years leading multifaceted tests and test project teams, with responsibility for overseeing scheduling.
  • Experience working with military or DoD civilian clients and managing professional relationships
  • Strong interpersonal skills, communication (oral and written), and presentation skills
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • AN ACTIVE DOD SECRET SECURITY CLEARANCE IS REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION FOR WHICH, YOU MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN

Qualifications Desired

  • Master’s degree in engineering, computer science, physics, math, or related technical field
  • 5+ years of test and evaluation experience on SATCOM systems
  • 7+ years of systems engineering experience
  • INCOSE CSEP or ESEP certification
  • Active Top Secret security clearance

Work Location Type: On-Site

Required Certifications: None

U.S. Citizenship Required: Yes

Security Clearance Required: Active secret

Employment Type: Regular Full-time

Background Check Type: 7 Year Pre-Employment

Drug Screen Required: No

Position Contingent Upon Contract Award: No

Salary Range
$1—$1 USD

REAL ID Requirement

This position may require the ability to access to U.S. federal facilities. In accordance with the Department of Homeland Security’s enforcement of the REAL ID Act, as of May 7, 2025, individuals must present a REAL ID-compliant form of identification or an acceptable alternative to gain entry. For a list of acceptable forms of identification, please click here.

Benefits

title: Cyber Design & Engineering Manager
description:
At Vector, we're delivering the infrastructure, technology and services that will support a smarter, more connected and increasingly electrified Auckland.

Our Vector31 strategy sets a clear direction for the future. As we continue to evolve the way we serve customers, manage our network and enable business performance, Digital & Data plays a critical role in connecting strategy, technology and delivery.

To support this transformation, we're establishing a new Digital & Data operating model designed to strengthen business alignment, improve delivery outcomes and accelerate value creation across the organisation. This is your opportunity to shape how cyber security enables secure innovation across Vector's IT, operational technology and emerging AI environments.

The role

Cyber security at Vector is shifting from reactive, manual activity to an automation-first, risk-led approach that builds security into delivery from the start.

As Cyber Security Engineering & Design Manager, you'll lead that shift across IT, operational technology, IoT and emerging AI environments. This senior people leadership role combines enterprise-wide design authority with responsibility for the team, standards, reusable patterns and investment roadmap that enable faster, safer delivery.

You'll connect security design with operational defence, using insights from monitoring, vulnerabilities and incidents to improve controls and engineer out repetitive work - strengthening resilience without adding unnecessary gates.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the cyber operating-model shift, replacing manual activity and late-stage approvals with scalable security engineering.

  • Own cyber security design authority across IT, OT, IoT and AI, setting architecture principles, standards, reusable reference patterns and practical guardrails.

  • Develop and deliver the cyber engineering and architecture roadmap, aligning investment with business growth, grid modernisation and regulatory obligations.

  • Embed secure-by-design practices and automation across software, infrastructure and operational workflows, using continuous threat modelling, approved patterns, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and automated provisioning where appropriate.

  • Build OT, IoT, AI and agentic-security capability, balancing cyber risk with critical infrastructure safety, reliability and availability.

  • Lead and develop the Cyber Security Engineering & Design team, building strong technical practice, capability and succession.

  • Connect design, implementation and operational defence through clear hand-offs and continuous improvement; assure internal and partner outputs against standards and risk appetite, and oversee reliable, scalable security platforms and services.

Who are we looking for?

You'll combine technical depth with practical judgement, acting as both an enterprise design authority and a business enabler. Your leadership will build ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning, with standards and controls that work in practice.

You'll bring:

  • Significant experience leading enterprise cyber security architecture and engineering functions within a complex organisation.

  • Deep expertise in cyber architecture, secure design and engineering, supported by strong knowledge of enterprise architecture, cloud, OT and AI security.

  • Experience establishing architecture governance, standards, reference patterns and decision frameworks across large technology environments.

  • A strong understanding of modern software and infrastructure delivery, including secure-by-design practices, continuous threat modelling, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code.

  • Experience developing long-term engineering roadmaps, managing technical debt and rationalising security technology or vendor landscapes.

  • Proven ability to lead complex technical delivery, communicate cyber risk clearly to executives and influence investment decisions and risk trade-offs.

  • Experience in critical infrastructure, energy, utilities or another safety- and reliability-sensitive operational environment.

  • Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to coach technical specialists and build a high-performing, collaborative engineering culture.

Why Vector

Help shape a newly formed cyber security design and engineering function, with genuine influence over architecture, practice and investment. Your work will span IT, operational technology, AI and emerging technology, building lasting capability that supports Auckland's future and New Zealand's energy transition.

  • A collaborative, inclusive and forward-looking culture.

  • Flexible working arrangements and market-competitive remuneration and benefits.

  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.

title: Counterintelligence Officer - Active Clearance Required
description:
We are looking for a Counterintelligence Officer in the Counterintelligence Program to perform comprehensive research and analysis, conduct interviews, and present recommendations to senior management, high-level DOE personnel, and officials of intelligence agencies on relevant counterintelligence (CI) issues, ensuring the Laboratory’s compliance with Department of Energy (DOE) Order 475.1 (CI Program).

This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one day per week on the non-Alternate Work Schedule work week.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

  • Conduct comprehensive complex, diverse, and multi-faceted CI/counterterrorism (CT) investigations.
  • Collect and review information from a variety of open and secure sources to assess and mitigate any CI/CT threats associated with foreign visits, travel, and contacts.
  • Produce detailed and accurate intelligence reports/records in appropriate intelligence databases, and investigative case files.
  • Conduct and present face-to-face briefings/debriefings and presentations to Laboratory personnel regarding hosting foreign nationals, foreign travel, and specific CI/CT risks/threats.
  • Participate in joint task forces and collaborations with internal Laboratory divisions, DOE Office of Intelligence and Counterintelligence (DOE IN), CI programs at other national laboratories, the United States Intelligence Community (USIC), and local law enforcement to address CI/CT issues.
  • Support all elements of the CI outreach program, including refining, developing, and presenting CI awareness and training material to all employees/members of the workforce.

title: Quality Control Clerk
description:
About 99 Ranch Market:
99 Ranch Market is one of the largest Asian supermarket chains in the United States. We have store locations in California, Nevada, Texas, Washington, Oregon, Maryland, Massachusetts, Virginia, New Jersey and more to come! We are passionate and honored to be shaping the Asian Supermarket culture within the grocery industry. As 99 Ranch Market expends, we have new positions open. We welcome new members to grow alongside with the family.

Summary:
The purpose of this position is to support the Shipping Department by ensuring all outbound orders are picked accurately and meet outbound quality standards before shipment. The Outbound Quality Control Clerk is responsible for verifying product quality, quantities, lot rotation, labeling, and order accuracy while identifying and documenting discrepancies. This role helps reduce shipping errors, improve customer and store satisfaction, and maintain inventory accuracy.

Responsibilities:
  • Verify picked orders against the picking ticket to ensure correct product, quantity, pallet build, and customer/store order accuracy.
  • Perform quality inspections on outbound orders before shipment, including checks for damage and temperature.
  • Ensure products meet customer specifications, company quality standards, and secure pallet configuration.
  • Verify FIFO/FEFO rotation, lot numbers, production dates, and expiration dates.
  • Confirm accuracy of labels, customer tags, pallet labels, and shipping labels.
  • Report picking errors, inventory discrepancies, damaged products, short picks, over picks, or incorrect substitutions to the Shipping Supervisor immediately.
  • Document QC inspection results and maintain accurate quality records, including photographs.
  • Coordinate with Pickers, Team Leads, Shipping Supervisors, Inventory Control, and other internal teams to resolve discrepancies before orders are loaded. Place incorrect or damaged products on hold and verify corrective action is completed before shipment.
  • Conduct random audits of completed orders to monitor picking accuracy and provide feedback.
  • Assist with investigations of customer complaints related to shipping accuracy or product quality.
  • Maintain a clean QC area while following all food safety, HACCP, GMP, and workplace safety procedures.
  • Complete inspections efficiently to achieve high verification accuracy and minimize incorrect shipments.
  • Communicate discrepancies promptly and professionally to ensure continuous improvement.
  • Perform other quality assurance or related duties as assigned by the QC Supervisor, Warehouse Manager, or management.

Minimum Qualifications:
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • Ability to accurately count products and verify quantities.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Previous warehouse or produce experience preferred.
  • Previous Quality Control or Shipping experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of produce grading and quality standards preferred.
  • Understanding of FIFO/FEFO inventory practices preferred.
  • Experience using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) or RF scanners preferred.

Physical Requirements:
  • Ability to stand and walk for up to 8 hours.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to bend, twist, reach, kneel, and squat throughout the shift.

Working Conditions:
  • Comfortable working in refrigerated warehouse environments when required.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced shipping environment.

Position Details:
  • Employment Type: Full Time.
  • Location: 2931 Faber St., Union City, CA 94587.
  • Schedule: Monday - Friday; 8-hour shift scheduled between 6:00 AM and 8:30 PM, based on business needs.

Benefits:
  • Medical, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance.
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with up to 4% Company Match.
  • Long-Term Service Award.
  • Employee Discount.
  • Paid Time Off.

Compensation:
The pay range for this job is between $19 - 22 per hour. This is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) the responsibilities of the job, your education, skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

title: Customer Enablement Manager
description:
As a Customer Enablement Manager, you will help enterprise customers turn Asana into an effective way of working across their organization. You will own a portfolio of customers, providing a variety of enablement activities, including discovery, workflow consultation, strategic enablement, and scalable education, to accelerate adoption and deliver measurable business outcomes.

You will partner closely with Customer Success, Sales, and Services to understand customer priorities, identify barriers to adoption, and recommend enablement strategies that help teams adopt new workflows and AI-enabled ways of working. Through strong facilitation, product expertise, and customer insight, you will help customers realize greater value from Asana while contributing to retention and expansion.

This role is based in our Chicago office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

What you’ll achieve

  • Trusted Advisory: Develop a deep understanding of Asana, customer business priorities, and how teams work today. Use discovery and product expertise to recommend workflows and enablement approaches that improve adoption, efficiency, and ways of working.
  • Strategic Enablement Initiatives: Independently manage time-bound customer engagements within your portfolio of customers, from discovery and planning through delivery and follow-through. Partner with CSMs and account teams to connect enablement activities to clear customer objectives and adoption outcomes.
  • Scaled Training: Facilitate workflow consultations, workshops, customer programs, and scalable learning experiences for audiences ranging from end users to champions and business leaders. Tailor the approach based on customer needs rather than relying on one-size-fits-all training.
  • Metrics/KRs: Use customer engagement, adoption, and efficacy signals to assess whether enablement is creating meaningful behavior change. Adjust your approach based on data and contribute insights that help improve CEM programs and playbooks.
  • Customer partnerships: Identify opportunities to strengthen adoption, expand use cases, and address risks. Proactively share relevant customer insights and potential growth opportunities with CSMs and account teams.
  • Support workflow and AI transformation: Help customers adopt new ways of working, including AI-enabled workflows, by translating capabilities into practical use cases and behavior change across teams.

About you

  • 4+ years of experience in customer enablement, customer success, consulting, implementation, learning and development, or a related customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS.
  • Experience leading customer engagements that combine discovery, consultation, facilitation, and enablement to drive adoption or behavior change.
  • Strong project and portfolio management skills, with the ability to independently manage multiple customer engagements, competing priorities, and stakeholders.
  • Excellent facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to engage audiences ranging from end users and champions to senior business stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving and consultative skills; you are comfortable asking thoughtful questions, synthesizing customer needs, and recommending a path forward rather than simply responding to requests.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how adoption, customer value, retention, and expansion are connected.
  • Strong product and technical curiosity, with an interest in helping organizations adopt new workflows, technology, and AI-enabled ways of working.
  • Collaborative and proactive, with the ability to work effectively across Customer Success, Sales, Services, Support, and other teams.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, taking ownership of ambiguous problems, and continuously improving how you work.
  • Customer-centered and outcomes-oriented, with a strong desire to understand whether your work is creating measurable impact.
  • Collaborative teammate who actively shares learnings, contributes to playbooks and best practices, and helps improve how the broader CEM team operates.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

What we'll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value, which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between $120,000-136,000. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

  • Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits
  • Career coaching & support
  • Inclusive family building benefits
  • Long-term savings or retirement plans
  • In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your Talent Acquisition Partner to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

About us

Asana is a leading platform for human + AI collaboration. Millions of teams around the world rely on Asana to achieve their most important goals, faster. Asana has been named to Fortune's Best Workplaces for 7+ years and recognized by Fast Company, Forbes, and Gartner for excellence in workplace culture and innovation. We offer an exceptional office-centric culture while adopting the best elements of hybrid models to ensure that every one of our global team members can work together effortlessly. title: Workplace Assistant – Part-time
description:
About TOTEME

TOTEME is a fashion house rooted in Swedish sensibilities, modern aspirations, and the notion of style.

With an appreciation for how pieces are worn in practice, we create emblematic designs with an emphasis on materiality and shape. Archetype pieces are realized in authentic materials, rich textures and graphic silhouettes. Representing a direct and decisive way of dressing, the collections are contextualized in curated edits, visuals, and spaces.

TOTEME was founded in 2014 by Elin Kling and Karl Lindman. From the atelier in Stockholm, we create women’s and men’s collections spanning ready-to-wear, shoes, bags, accessories, and jewelry.

The Role

TOTEME is looking for a Workplace Assistant to join our team in Paris part-time. In this role you will be responsible for our new Paris house, including office, showrooms and studio, in terms of employee and guest experience. You will report to the Chief People & Culture Officer and will work directly with Paris based team members and managers.

Responsibilities

  • Manage physical workplace infrastructure and operations, including technical setups, facilities maintenance, vendor relations, and office supply procurement to ensure a functional working environment.

  • Elevate the workplace aesthetic and community experience by maintaining a beautiful, tidy office, coordinating amenities like flowers, coffee and fruit, arranging meetings, and planning social events for employees and visitors.

  • Set up the necessary infrastructure for the new house, including cleaning-, recycling- and delivery- services and purchases.

  • Managing IT provisions, mobile subscriptions, and partner access during employee transitions.

  • Handling the complete lifecycle of staff members from arrival to departure.

  • Coordinating user profiles and permissions within the corporate travel agency platform.

  • Support events taking place in the Paris house including supporting the Wholesale Team in the Showroom.

Your Profile

  • A couple of years of experience in service in a related field, such as premium hospitality or office operations.

  • Tech-savvy in modern digital workplaces.

  • An eye for aesthetics and have the ability to enhance the ambiance with the details that make all the difference - from flowers to coffee arrangements to scent etc.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in French and English

  • Right to work in France

About You

  • A TOTEME ambassador who lives and breathes our culture and values

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills

  • You love to help others

This is a part-time position based at TOTEME's Paris house with an immediate start date.

TOTEME has teams in Stockholm, London, New York, and Shanghai, as well as retail spaces across Europe, North America, and Asia.

TOTEME has an internal career development and title framework and the job title used in the recruitment ad may differ from the title used internally at TOTEME.

Sustainability is an important part of how we operate at TOTEME. As a certified B Corporation, we are committed to continuously improving our social and environmental impact. We expect all employees to understand our sustainability commitments and contribute to responsible business practices within their respective roles.

Candidates progress through application, screening, interviews or case assessments, followed by final pre-employment checks and a formal offer before joining our team. We anonymize names and personal details in applications during the screening stage to support fair and skills-based hiring.

By applying to this position, I agree with TOTEME’s privacy policy and to be contacted about future job opportunities for up to two years from the submission date. Find out more about our privacy policy here.

title: Hearing Care Provider-Vista, CA
description:
WSA is a global leader in the hearing aid industry. Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

Part of WSA group, HearUSA is on a mission to reframe the world of hearing care and set the highest standard in modern hearing health. title: KIINTEISTÖPÄÄLLIKKÖ, TAMPEREEN YHTEISKOULUN LUKIO
description:
Tampereen yhteiskoulun lukio, tuttavallisemmin Tykki, on vuonna 1895 perustettu yksityinen lukio Tampereen keskustassa. Olemme valtakunnallinen ilmaisutaidon erityislukio, jossa noin 900 opiskelijaa ja yli 60 opettajaa tekevät joka päivä todeksi arvojamme sivistystä, luovuutta ja vastuullisuutta. Koulua ylläpitää Tampereen Yhteiskoulun Säätiö, joka omistaa koulun kaksi kiinteistöä: historiallisen Tykin ja sen naapurissa sijaitsevan Tyllin.

Nykyisen kiinteistöpäällikkömme siirtyessä keväällä 2027 eläkkeelle etsimme nyt joukkoomme

KIINTEISTÖPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ

pitämään huolta kahdesta arvokiinteistöstämme ja kehittämään niitä tulevaisuuden tarpeisiin.

Tässä tehtävässä päivät eivät ole samanlaisia

Kiinteistöpäällikkönä vastaat siitä, että Tykin ja Tyllin rakennukset ovat turvallisia, terveellisiä ja toimivia paikkoja opiskella ja tehdä työtä. Samalla pidät huolta siitä, että yli satavuotiaiden rakennusten arvo ja ominaispiirteet säilyvät myös tuleville sukupolville.

Rooli on itsenäinen ja vastuullinen, mutta ennen kaikkea hyvin käytännönläheinen. Yhtenä päivänä suunnittelet tulevaa korjaushanketta, käyt läpi tarjouksia ja neuvottelet kumppanin kanssa sopimuksesta. Toisena selvität ilmanvaihdon toimintaa, valmistelet tiloja koulun tapahtumaan tai tartut itse pieneen korjaustarpeeseen. Tähän tehtävään etsimme ihmistä, jolle kokonaisuuden johtaminen ja käytännön tekeminen ovat luontevasti saman työn eri puolia.

Vastuullasi ovat muun muassa:

• kiinteistöjen ylläpito, toimivuus ja talotekniikka, kuten lämmitys, ilmanvaihto, vesi- ja sähköjärjestelmät, automaatio, valaistus ja hissit

• päivittäisten vikojen, korjaustarpeiden ja muiden käytännön tilanteiden ratkaiseminen

• vuosi- ja peruskorjausten sekä kesäsaneerausten suunnittelu ja valvonta, pitkän tähtäimen kunnossapidon suunnittelu sekä hankkeisiin ja palveluihin liittyvät kilpailutukset ja sopimusneuvottelut

• yhteistyökumppaneiden ja urakoitsijoiden ohjaaminen arjessa

• kiinteistöjen kustannusten seuranta ja raportointi

• kiinteistöturvallisuus pelastussuunnitelmista kulunvalvontaan

• kiinteistötiimin esihenkilötyö. Tiimiin kuuluvat siistijät, vahtimestari, iltavalvoja ja kesäapulaiset.

Lähivuosina edessä on myös suurempia hankkeita, kuten uusi piharakennus ja alakertaan rakennettava kuntosali. Erityisesti kesä onkin kiinteistöissä tärkeää aikaa, sillä silloin toteutetaan suurempia remontteja ja saneerauksia.

Koulukiinteistö on omanlaisensa työympäristö

Tykki ei ole hiljainen toimistokiinteistö. Taloissa opiskelee päivittäin lähes tuhat nuorta, järjestetään tapahtumia ja eletään aktiivista koulun arkea. Siksi tehtävässä tarvitaan teknisen osaamisen lisäksi tilannetajua, yhteistyökykyä ja ymmärrystä siitä, että kiinteistö on ennen kaikkea ihmisiä varten.

Toivomme myös, että katsot ympärillesi kehittävällä otteella. Voisiko jokin tila toimia paremmin? Pitäisikö piha valaista toisin? Miten ilmanvaihtoa tai energiatehokkuutta voisi kehittää? Tässä tehtävässä saat tuoda ajatuksiasi esiin ja myös viedä niitä käytäntöön.

Voisit olla etsimämme henkilö, jos

Sinulla on kokemusta kiinteistöjen ylläpidosta ja kunnossapidosta sekä hyvä ymmärrys talotekniikasta. Korjaus- ja kunnossapitohankkeiden suunnittelu ja valvonta ovat sinulle tuttuja, ja pystyt ottamaan vastuuta myös kilpailutuksista, sopimuksista ja taloudesta. Odotamme sinulta myös kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä valmiutta johtaa niin omaa tiimiä kuin ulkopuolisia kumppaneita.

Kaikkea ei kuitenkaan tehdä työpöydän ääressä. Arvostamme käytännönläheistä otetta ja halua tarttua tilanteisiin itse silloin, kun sitä tarvitaan. Vasaran pitäisi siis pysyä kädessä eikä haravaankaan tarttuminen ole vierasta.

Työssä auttaa, jos olet ihmisenä ennakoiva, ratkaisukeskeinen ja helposti lähestyttävä. Ympärilläsi on päivittäin opiskelijoita, henkilökuntaa, vuokralaisia, urakoitsijoita ja muita yhteistyökumppaneita, joten erilaisten ihmisten kanssa toimimisen pitää tuntua luontevalta.

Rakennus- tai talotekniikan koulutus sekä kokemus kouluista, julkisista rakennuksista tai historiallisista arvokiinteistöistä katsotaan eduksi. Erityisesti arvostamme ymmärrystä siitä, että vanhaa rakennusta ei vain ylläpidetä, vaan sitä myös vaalitaan ja kehitetään sen ominaispiirteitä kunnioittaen.

Mitä tarjoamme?

Saat vastuullesi kaksi erityistä kiinteistöä aivan Tampereen keskustassa sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa konkreettisesti siihen, miten ne palvelevat opiskelijoita ja henkilökuntaa tulevina vuosina.

Roolissa on paljon itsenäisyyttä ja vastuuta, mutta et hoida kaikkea yksin. Tukenasi ovat oma kiinteistötiimi, koulun johto sekä vakiintuneet yhteistyökumppanit.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja alkaa 1.4.2027. Työ sijoittuu pääsääntöisesti arkipäiviin ja päiväaikaan, käytännössä esimerkiksi klo 7.30–15.30, mutta tehtävä edellyttää tilanteiden mukaan joustavuutta. Kesä on kiinteistöissä vilkkainta remontti- ja saneerausaikaa, ja erityisesti kesä–heinäkuussa kiinteistöpäällikön läsnäoloa tarvitaan. Vuosilomat ajoittuvatkin pääsääntöisesti tämän ajanjakson ulkopuolelle.

Kiinnostuitko?

Jos tässä yhdistyvät sopivalla tavalla osaamisesi ja tapasi tehdä töitä, haluamme mielellämme kuulla sinusta lisää!

Jätä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi viimeistään 25.11.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, DC Buying
location: Remote in the U.S., San Francisco, California, United States
description:
Afresh, the AI platform for grocery, began by tackling the most complex problem in the industry: fresh, and has evolved into the core AI platform for grocers.

By leveraging proprietary AI designed for high-volatility environments, we empower partners like Albertsons, Meijer, and Wakefern to drive smarter decisions across their entire enterprise.

Following record-breaking 70% revenue growth in 2025, we have scaled to 6 enterprise-grade solutions, with solutions live in over 10% of the U.S. grocery market. Our platform now orchestrates billions of decisions from the store floor to the distribution center and prevented over 200 million pounds of food waste last year alone.

If you're looking for a role where your work directly translates into massive scale and social good, and you want to be part of the team that defines how the world eats, there is no better time to join us.

About the Role

As Senior Engineering Manager for DC Buying, you'll lead engineering for Afresh's AI-powered fresh buying product. Buyers at grocery distribution centers use it to decide what to buy, how much, and when. Every order a DC buyer places determines what lands in the stores it serves. Get it right and shelves stay full and less food goes to waste across the whole network.

DC Buying is live with enterprise customers and scaling fast. Your job is to make it the tool DC buyers can't work without. You'll own engineering end to end and partner with product, design, data engineering and applied science on one roadmap. You'll also work directly with customers to make sure what we build supports buyers' daily work.

We're looking for someone who has demonstrated excellence as an engineering manager, thinks beyond their own team, and wants to own the outcome, not just the delivery.

What You'll Do

Lead engineering

  • Hire, develop and retain a senior team of product engineers. Set clear expectations, invest in their careers, and address performance directly and on time.
  • Set the technical bar. Review architecture, push back on unnecessary complexity, and be deliberate about where we take on and pay down tech debt.
  • Build strong relationships with peer engineering leaders across platform, data and AI, so DC benefits from shared tooling instead of reinventing it.

Build the roadmap

  • Own the DC Buying roadmap with product, design and science leads. Balance customer asks, technical investment and business goals.
  • Know the business deeply. Understand what matters to users, moves key metrics and how to delight customers.

Execute effectively

  • Make clean commitments, internally and with customers, then hit them. Tell people early when something is going to slip.
  • Turn broad goals into scoped plans with a sequence, a cost and a date.
  • Keep leadership and partner teams aware of what's happening, and drive decisions to clarity.
  • Own reliability, on-call health and data quality for a product buyers rely on every day.

Be a great example

  • Build a culture where engineers and scientists own problems, not tickets. Bring them in early with customers, product and design rather than handing them a predetermined solution.
  • Be creative in your problem solving.
  • Build innovative product that delights DC buyers and drives massive customer impact.

What Makes You a Great Fit

We encourage all highly qualified candidates to apply, even if they don't meet every listed qualification.

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years managing engineering teams.
  • You have experience developing, scaling and supporting mission critical products in production.
  • You have strong technical range. You have experience leading across multiple functional domains (front-end, back-end, data pipelines and applied science). You have enough depth to engage, and are excited to learn.
  • You've hired, grown and managed performance on a team, and you've built a culture where engineers own problems rather than tickets.
  • Clear, direct communication with stakeholders, executives and customers.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and growth-stage pressure. You can re-plan quickly when a customer or business priority shifts, without whiplashing the team.
  • You use AI-native development practices day to day and want your team on the leading edge of them.

Nice to Have

  • Supply chain, retail or grocery experience, especially demand forecasting, replenishment or inventory optimization.
  • You've shipped forecasting, optimization or recommendation products that operators act on every day.
  • You've taken a product from early design partners to production at enterprise customers.
  • Familiarity with our stack: Python, TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Databricks, Azure.

This position is not eligible for company sponsorship.

Salary Band in U.S. (USD): $203,745 - $275,655 + meaningful early-stage equity + benefits

Why You’ll Love Working at Afresh
At Afresh, our mission to eliminate food waste starts with investing in our people. We provide a comprehensive support system designed to help you do your best work while maintaining a healthy, balanced life.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family, with the majority of premiums covered by Afresh. We also provide dedicated mental health support and counseling services.
  • Invested in Your Future: Competitive base salary, meaningful equity (U.S. employees), and a 401(k) program with a generous company match.
  • Flexible & Modern Workspace: Whether you work from home or a local office, we support your setup with a home office stipend and "Coworking Wallets" for flexible workspace access.
  • Growth-Obsessed Culture: We believe in continuous learning. Every employee receives an annual professional development budget to master new skills and grow their career at Afresh.
  • Holistic Monthly Stipends: Beyond your paycheck, we provide monthly stipends for "Betterment" (wellness/lifestyle) and telecommunications to ensure you have what you need to thrive.
  • Time to Recharge: Flexible paid time off to take the time you need to recharge.
*Full-time U.S. employees are eligible for these benefits

About Afresh

Founded in 2017, Afresh is using AI to tackle the #1 solution to curb climate change: reducing food waste. By building AI specifically for the intricacies of grocery—from the fresh perimeter to the center store—we help grocers minimize waste and maximize sales.

Afresh sits at an incredible intersection of positive social impact, rocket ship financial growth, and cutting-edge technology. Our best-in-class AI research has been published in top journals, including ICML, and our investors include Al Gore’s Just Climate, former Whole Foods Market CEO Walter Robb, and Eric Schmidt's Innovation Endeavors.

Grocery is the past, present, and future of our food system – the waste we create today will impact our planet for years to come. Join us as we continue to build a vibrant, diverse, and inclusive team that embodies our company’s values of proactivity, kindness, candor, and humility.

Afresh provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.

Here at Afresh, many of our employees work remotely provided that they reside in one of the following states: AL, AR, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, KY, MA, MI, MT, MO, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OR, PA, TX, WA, UT, VA, WI.

title: Telehealth Engagement Officer
description:
The key responsibilities of Telehealth Engagement Officer include:

• Provide real-time or scheduled teleconsultations covering physical and mental health concerns.

• Offer diagnosis, treatment guidance, and basic psychosocial support in accordance with national and SCH clinical/MHPSS protocols.

• Contact clients referred by GPs to provide tele-consultation/counseling, arrange chest X-ray and GeneXpert investigations, coordinate referrals, follow up on laboratory results, and ensure that confirmed TB patients are linked to NTP or SCH supported PPM Scheme III treatment facilities.

• Conduct scheduled or proactive phone calls to clients enrolled in Family Health and other chronic or high-priority care programs.

• Track client treatment adherence, appointment follow-up, and medication refill needs; provide reminders and counseling support as needed.

• Coordinate with field teams to flag default cases or missed follow-ups and ensure timely intervention.

• Maintain a regular call log and case tracking sheet, ensuring that all interactions are documented securely and ethically.

• Build rapport with clients to support retention in care and reduce loss to follow-up during or after emergency disruptions.

• Support joint case discussions and care planning for patients with combined physical and emotional health needs.

• Refer severe or high-risk cases (e.g., suicide risk, psychosis, and trauma) according to SCH referral protocols or arrange mobile outreach for follow-up.

• Provide psychological first aid (PFA) and brief solution-focused interventions as needed.

• Participate in post-disaster tele-outreach or emergency mental health services, particularly in displacement or high-stress environments.

• Supervise the Telehealth Data focal person in data management and quality assurance processes, including data verification, completeness checks, and data integrity reviews to support planning and gap analysis.

• Lead weekly case review sessions with other team members, with documented action points and follow-up tracking

• Coordinate closely with Clinic Assistants and field teams to ensure that patients receive appropriate care and follow-up.

• Identify gaps in remote service delivery and contribute to improving SCH's teleconsultation and MHPSS integration model.

• Attend periodic team check-ins or remote supervision sessions to share learning and improve quality.

• Perform any other duties as assigned to support effective project implementation

Term of Agreement:

The Contractor will receive the basic daily service payment upon submission of a complete Daily Work Report to the respective Supervisor and payment will be made within 30 days after SCH receives and accepts the report. In addition, the Contractor may be eligible for a performance-based payment, which will be determined based on the verification of achievements against the Monthly or Quarterly Performance Indicator Report and the appraisal and approval of the respective Supervisor.

• Hold an M.B., B.S. degree with valid SAMA registration.

• Preferably have a minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in providing telehealth services.

• Demonstrate competent use of MS Office applications.

• Experience with NGO or donor-funded health projects is desirable.

• Prior experience in mental health counseling is preferred.

APPLICATION:

Interested applicant, please send Application Letter, Curriculum Vitae (with “Two” referees, including your last employment for reference check), copies of Qualification Documents and National ID as per following “APPLY LINK” and/or Apply Email not later than on the evening of 19 November 2026 (Thursday).

title: General QA Engineer (Remote, Contract)
description:

We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment.
  • We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team.

Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team.
  • From there on, it’s decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live.

    INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented General QA Engineer to help ensure the quality and reliability of our product. In this role, you will combine manual and automated testing, build and maintain scalable Playwright test suites, leverage AI-powered tools to increase efficiency and work closely with engineering and product teams to deliver a seamless user experience.

  • Development and maintenance of a suite of e2e/UI tests in Playwright (TS), covering critical user scenarios.
  • Use of AI in work
  • Practical use of LLM tools (e.g., ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot/Codeium) to optimize the execution of testing tasks.
  • Performing manual testing of features (planning, test design, regression, exploratory).
  • Integration and optimization of test runs in CI (parallelization, stabilization, flakiness metrics).
  • Setting up reporting and observability for automated tests (traces, video, flake analytics).
  • Collaboration with engineering and product: requirements clarification, help reproducing defects, and improving testability.
  • Maintaining the quality of test data and environments

Our ideal candidate possesses the following skills:

  • 3–5 years in QA, including 1.5+ years in automation using JavaScript/Playwright.
  • Strong Playwright:
    Test Runner, fixtures, projects, parallelization, and sharding.
    Auto-wait/locators, stable selectors, working with flakes (timeouts, retries, expect.poll).
    BrowserContext/Page, environment isolation, test data management.
    Tracing, video/screenshots, network mocking (route), APIRequestContext.
    Page Object/Screenplay patterns, project structure, reusability.

    Building test workflows in n8n, Zapier, Gumloop.
    Use of no-code tools as part of the automated test infrastructure.

    Explore AI QA tools (Testim, Diffblue, CodiumAI, Mabl).
  • JavaScript/TypeScript at advanced mid-level:
    Async/await, promises, modules, TS typing, interfaces, generics.
    NPM/Yarn, Node.js scripts, ESLint/Prettier configuration.
  • PI testing: REST, Postman/Swagger.
  • Browser DevTools: network, storage, cookies, CORS, headers, status codes.
  • Databases: solid SQL, basic work with test data.
  • CI/CD and VCS:
    Git (branching, PR, code review).
    Integration of automated tests into CI (GitHub Actions/Jenkins), artifacts, and reports.
    Running tests in containers/headless, dependency management, and caching.
  • Manual testing:
    Requirements analysis.
    Creation of all types of test documentation.
    Test design techniques.
    Types of testing.
  • English: reading documentation and written communication (Intermediate+).

What we offer:

  • A collaborative, innovation-first environment that values initiative and experimentation
  • Reduced working hours on Fridays during the summer
  • Days off on US national holidays and your birthday

Why join us?

You’ll be at the intersection of technology, process innovation, and business growth – building systems that empower our teams to work smarter, faster, and more collaboratively. If you’re a strategic thinker who loves turning complexity into clarity and ideas into scalable solutions, we’d love to meet you

title: Applied Super Intelligence Engineer, Physical Systems
description:
We are seeking an Applied Super Intelligence (SI) Engineer, Physical Systems, to help build software that enables SI agents and multimodal models to interact with real-world equipment through an existing hardware integration stack. You will focus on applied SI and perception workflows that transform operational data and equipment interfaces into safe, usable SI-assisted systems. This position is in the Material Engineering Division (MED) within the Engineering Directorate.

This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

  • Implement agent-facing tool definitions and task workflows that use documented equipment interfaces and platform services.
  • Develop multimodal perception and decision-support workflows using camera, telemetry, and process data.
  • Improve prompt logic, tool use, evaluation methods, and workflow reliability for physical-world SI applications.
  • Translate real-world operational tasks into practical SI-assisted workflows that are usable, testable, and maintainable.
  • Work with embedded, platform, and deployment engineers in a controlled environment to define safe action boundaries, human- or system-mediated approval points, and fallback behaviors using established external safety and security systems.
  • Evaluate and debug applied SI workflows through comprehensive logging, iterative refinement, and disciplined engineering practices.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the SES.2 level

  • Design and evaluate agent workflows that combine perception, tool use, and equipment actions across multiple system components, input modalities, and operational steps.
  • Improve reusable evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and failure analysis for SI-assisted workflows, using the results to guide technical decisions.
  • Coordinate with embedded and SI platform engineers to translate device capabilities, operational requirements, and workflow evaluation results into reusable agent workflows, while providing informal guidance to less-experienced contributors.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, robotics, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • Proficiency in Python or a comparable programming language for building applications, prototypes, or internal tools in collaboration with software and systems engineers.
  • Experience gained through coursework, projects, research, internships, or professional work developing LLM, multimodal, agent-based, or tool-calling applications.
  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, and debugging tool-using SI workflows that connect models to APIs, services, data sources, or operational systems, including structured tool or API contracts, such as JSON Schema or OpenAPI, error handling, logging, and evaluation.
  • Experience working with real-world data from sensors, cameras, devices, or operational systems.
  • Familiarity with sound software development practices, including version control, automated testing, and collaborative code review.

Additional qualifications at the SES.2 level

  • Ability to independently develop and evaluate multicomponent agent, multimodal, or tool-calling workflows for operational use.
  • Ability to scope and debug moderately complex workflow failures involving perception, tool use, system integration, and operational constraints.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Exposure to robotics workflows, ROS, or ROS 2.
  • Experience with vision-language models, vision-language-action models, or multimodal perception pipelines.
  • Familiarity with simulation, digital twins, or hardware-in-the-loop testing.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration, agent tracing or evaluation systems, prompt or configuration versioning, replay-based testing, or event and telemetry systems such as MQTT or NATS.

Pay Range

$121,830 - $185,544 Annually
$121,830 - $154,500 Annually for the SES.1 level
$146,340 - $185,544 Annually for the SES.3 level

This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

#LI-Hybrid

Position Information

This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.

Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?

  • Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
  • Flexible Benefits Package
  • 401(k)
  • Relocation Assistance
  • Education Reimbursement Program
  • Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
  • Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values

Security Clearance

This position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance. If you are selected, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.

Pre-Employment Drug Test

External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.

Wireless and Medical Devices

Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.

If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.

How to identify fake job advertisements

Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website.
