title: Cloud Systems Administrator
description:
Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.

The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees. This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs live.

What you'll do:

Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first)

  • Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.
  • Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.
  • Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.
  • Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.

User lifecycle and identity

  • Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.
  • Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.
  • Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.

Scripting and automation

  • Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.
  • Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.

Security incident response

  • Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.
  • Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.
  • Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.

IT support

  • Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.
  • Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.
  • Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.

Platforms you will administer

These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.

Area

Platforms

Cloud infrastructure

Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)

Identity, HR and devices

Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth

Productivity and email

Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)

Customer support and CRM

Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom

Communications

Zoom, Aircall, Twilio

Data and engineering

Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch

AI platforms

Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)

Collaboration and design

Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe

Security tools

NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)

Healthcare operations

Waystar, AdvancedMD

Marketing and recruiting

Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn

About you:

  • 3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.
  • Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.
  • Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.
  • Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.
  • Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.
  • Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.

Nice to have:

  • AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.
  • Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.
  • MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.
  • Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.
  • Prior work in a healthcare or other regulated company.
  • Experience administering API usage and keys for AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI) and setting spend and access controls.

The base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $75,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.

title: Climate Strategy Expert / Project Manager
description:
🌱 About us

Greenly was founded in 2019 by Alexis, Matthieu and Arnaud with one mission: make carbon management as essential as financial management. In 2026, Greenly joined forces with the Nordic-founded company Normative.

Today, we are a global leader in carbon accounting, proudly B-Corp certified and part of the French Tech 120. Our climate suite combines smart data collection with intuitive automation, helping companies measure, reduce, and report their emissions with ease — supported at every step by our in-house climate experts. 💚

More than 4,000 companies in 30+ countries use Greenly to manage their climate strategy: from carbon assessments and life-cycle analyses to SBTi trajectories and compliance with CSRD and CBAM.

We are now a team of 200+ people from 40+ nationalities, based in Paris, London, Barcelona, and New York. 🌎

To date, we’ve tracked over 200 million tons of CO₂ through our platform. Our next milestone: 10,000 clients and one billion tons of CO2 under management.

🌱 Our Values

  • Ambition for climate: Minimize GHG emissions, maximize climate impact

  • Deliver with agility: Work in small increments: fail fast, learn fast, win fast

  • Own your opportunities: Achieve outstanding results by showing initiative and accountability

  • Feedback paves the way: Succeed as a team by helping others progress

  • Be one Team: Everyone is included and needed - work together with transparency and respect

Curious to know more ? Check out our Culture Book, blog , and youtube channel 🎥

🌱 About the team

You'll join Greenly's Scale team, within our Climate Delivery organization — the team that makes Greenly's climate expertise efficient and accessible for all of our customers. We guide SMB & mid-market customers through their most strategic climate and sustainability challenges. 🤝

As a Climate Strategy Expert in the Scale team, our mission is simple: be the expert voice that makes ESG assessments rigorous, simple, and scalable. Concretely, we deliver high-quality climate projects — carbon assessments, life-cycle analyses (LCA), SBTi trajectories, CSRD support — and we also turn that expertise into clear playbooks and product improvements so the whole team can scale without losing quality. ⚙️

As a team, we:

  • Combine analytical rigor with a strong customer success mindset

  • Act as trusted advisors, not just technical analysts

  • Thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment, sharing methods, scripts, and lessons learned

  • Work closely with Customer Support, Customer Success Managers, Product, Sales, and Marketing to ensure our clients succeed and our methodologies stay robust 💡

It's one of Greenly's most influential client-facing teams: high expectations, high volume, and real impact on both client outcomes and product evolution. 🌍

🌱 About the role

Our Scale team is searching for a mission-driven Climate Strategy Expert who's passionate about supporting our customers with climate advisory while owning their post-sale experience. You'll combine hands-on delivery of climate expertise with account ownership — and, as you grow in the role, you'll also help turn recurring technical questions into playbooks and product feedback that make the whole team more efficient and our delivery more scalable. You'll be a key player in turning climate ambition into action, one customer at a time.

What you will do

  • 🤝 You are the trusted person for our customers, with whom you'll build long-term relationships

  • 💡 You understand the customers' carbon footprints and are a thought leader that educates them on carbon measurement, target setting, carbon reduction, and carbon investments. You guide their path towards a net-zero future.

  • 📣 You are the voice of our customers; the connection between them and our product, where you help shape the future in a fast-changing industry.

  • ✨ You help our customers understand and navigate our product; you onboard them on the platform and drive interest for additional product and service offerings. This will accelerate their journey towards net-zero carbon emissions.

  • 📈 You are proactive in customer initiatives leading to high satisfaction, retention and growth.

  • 🔍 You identify upsell and expansion opportunities in your book of business.

  • 📚 You contribute to building clear rules, playbooks and cheat sheets so the wider team can handle recurring topics independently.

  • 🔁 You flag recurring technical pain points to Product, helping turn manual work into platform features.

🌱 Skills to succeed

  • 2–4 years of experience in customer success, climate consulting, ESG strategy, or account management, with at least one year of experience in carbon accounting. 📊

  • Understanding of corporate sustainability and climate frameworks (e.g. SBTi, GHG Protocol). 🌍

  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. 🤝

  • Educational background within the sustainability or environmental field. 🌱

  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into simple, actionable guidance for both clients and internal teams. 🧩

  • Comfort balancing hands-on client delivery with process-improvement or standardization projects. ⚖️

  • Drive to learn and grow with a fast-moving mission-led team. ⚡️

  • Full fluency in English 🇬🇧 is required.

Nice to have

  • Comfortable managing US-based customers (time zones, communication style, business culture) 🇺🇸

  • Spanish-fluency is a plus 🇪🇸

title: Production Planner, 2nd Shift
description:
From Engine Bay to Payload, we protect vital structures and systems.

Hera Technologies is a premier contract manufacturer specializing in high-precision metallic and non-metallic solutions for the Aerospace, Defense, and Space sectors. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction has positioned us as an industry leader in the design, manufacturing and maintenance of thermal support systems. Our team is driven by excellence, integrity, and a passion for advancing aerospace technology.

Take the next step in your career with a company committed to excellence, where your contributions are recognized, and your potential is realized.


Role Overview

Hera Technologies is seeking Two detail-oriented and execution-focused Production Planners to support day-to-day production planning activities within our aerospace and defense manufacturing environment. Reporting to the Production Planning Manager, this role will play a critical part in translating demand signals into actionable production schedules, ensuring alignment between material availability, capacity, and customer delivery commitments.

This is an ideal opportunity for a motivated planner who thrives in a fast-paced, high-mix, low-volume manufacturing setting and is eager to contribute to building scalable planning processes from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain detailed production schedules in alignment with the master production plan
  • Release and manage work orders to support machining, fabrication, and assembly operations
  • Monitor daily production performance and adjust schedules to address delays, constraints, or priority changes
  • Ensure alignment between production schedules and material availability
  • Translate customer orders, forecasts, and program requirements into executable work orders
  • Support on-time delivery by proactively identifying risks and escalating issues
  • Assist in managing delivery dates and updating order statuses within ERP systems
  • Support capacity planning activities by analyzing work center loads and identifying bottlenecks
  • Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations teams to resolve constraints
  • Recommend schedule adjustments to optimize throughput and resource utilization
  • Work closely with Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to ensure schedule alignment
  • Coordinate with Purchasing to track material shortages and expedite critical components
  • Communicate schedule changes, risks, and recovery plans to internal stakeholders
  • Maintain accurate planning data within ERP/MRP systems (BOMs, routings, lead times, and order statuses)
  • Ensure work order accuracy and timely system updates to reflect real-time production status
  • Assist in troubleshooting planning and MRP-related issues
  • Support the development and standardization of planning processes and tools
  • Contribute to improvements in schedule adherence, planning accuracy, and production flow
  • Participate in planning cadences such as daily production meetings and capacity reviews
  • Drive performance against key operational KPIs, including on-time delivery, WIP levels, past due orders, and schedule adherence, ensuring alignment with production targets and customer commitments

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 2–5 years of experience in production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations
  • Experience working in a manufacturing environment (aerospace/defense preferred)
  • Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and production scheduling principles (JobBoss, Epicor, Oracle, SAP, etc.)
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail and problem-solving capability
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in high-mix, low-volume manufacturing environments
  • Exposure to AS9100 or other regulated manufacturing standards
  • Working knowledge of Epicor ERP
  • Familiarity with CNC machining, fabrication, or aerospace assemblies
  • APICS/CPIM certification or progress toward certification
  • Experience supporting production in a growth-stage or startup environment

Additional Requirements

  • Must have professional working proficiency reading, writing, and speaking English
  • Ability to work in office, lab, and manufacturing environments with occasional exposure to noise, chemicals, dust, industrial equipment, and temperature variations
  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working at a computer workstation
  • Frequent use of hands and fingers for data entry, keyboarding, and mouse use
  • Ability to view computer screens for prolonged periods
  • Ability to communicate effectively in person, by phone, and via email
  • Ability to use a computer to complete assignments

    • The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Management may modify or assign additional duties as needed.

Job Details

Type: Full-time

Base Salary Range: $75,000-$105,000/yr

Business Hours: 2nd shift, Monday to Friday, 2:00pm – 10:30pm. OT and weekend work may be necessary based on business demands.

Base Location: 100% on-site in Ontario, CA

Travel: None

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Total compensation will also include a comprehensive set of benefits including but not limited to: Company paid employee medical, dental and vision insurance. 401K company match (eligibility required), paid sick leave, paid vacation, paid holidays and discretionary bonuses.

title: FY27 PhD Internship: Data-Centric AI for End-to-End Autonomous Driving - 6 months, Munich, Unterschleißheim, Germany
description:
Company:

Qualcomm Technologies GmbH

Job Area:

Interns Group, Interns Group > Workstudy Intern

General Summary:

PhD Internship: Data-Centric AI for End-to-End Autonomous Driving


Location: Munich / Unterschleißheim, Germany
Duration: 6 months
Area: Autonomous Driving, End-to-End AI, Vision-Language Models, Data-Centric AI


We are looking for a highly motivated PhD student to join our AI Systems team in Munich and conduct research on automated data curation for end-to-end autonomous driving systems.

Modern end-to-end driving models depend heavily on the quality, diversity, and relevance of their training data. Large-scale driving datasets, however, contain substantial redundancy while rare and safety-critical situations remain difficult to identify systematically.

The goal of this internship is to develop data-centric AI techniques that automatically identify model weaknesses and translate observed real world driving failures into improved training datasets. The work will move beyond general data selection towards fine-grained, model-aware data curation using trajectory and action information, multimodal representations, and potentially Vision-Language Models (VLMs).


Your Profile

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Robotics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field.
  • Strong knowledge of machine learning and deep learning.
  • Experience with PyTorch and Python.
  • Experience in at least one of:
  • Computer vision
  • Autonomous driving
  • Multimodal/Vision-Language Models
  • Robotics
  • Ability to develop and evaluate research ideas independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Research experience in end-to-end autonomous driving, behavior prediction, trajectory prediction, or robotics.
  • Experience with VLMs/VLM evaluation, foundation models, or multimodal representation learning.
  • Experience working with large-scale datasets and data-selection or active-learning techniques.
  • Familiarity with closed-loop simulation or autonomous-driving evaluation.
  • Publications or demonstrated research experience at major machine-learning, computer-vision, or robotics venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, ICML, CoRL, or ICRA.

What You Will Gain

This internship offers the opportunity to conduct applied research at the intersection of autonomous driving, multimodal foundation models, and data-centric AI.

The research has the potential to contribute directly to scalable data-flywheel systems in production for autonomous driving, connecting vehicle evaluation, failure discovery, intelligent data selection, and model retraining.

title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location: Charlotte, NC (onsite at project locations)

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

  • Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.
  • Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.
  • Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.
  • Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.
  • Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.
  • Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

  • Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.
  • Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.
  • Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.
  • Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.
  • Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.
  • Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.
  • Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.
  • Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.
  • Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.
  • Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

  • Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.
  • Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.
  • Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

  • Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.
  • Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.
  • Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.
  • Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.
  • Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.
  • Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.
  • Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.
  • Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.
  • Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.
  • Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.
  • Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.
  • Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.
  • Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.
  • Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.
  • Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.
  • Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.
  • Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & reference check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

title: Care Center Communications Sr. Associate
description:
The Communications Associate will assist in the planning, development, and execution of Care Center and clinician communications initiatives.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Communications, Journalism, English, Marketing, Public Relations, or a related field

title: Product Manager - Anti Financial Crime (m/f/x)
description:
As Scalable Capital rapidly expands its product offering, we are setting up a fundamentally new, state-of-the-art Anti Financial Crime (AFC) platform. In this role, you will make critical, strategic decisions to lay the technical and architectural foundation for this greenfield ecosystem. This is a high-impact position with immense visibility: the platform is pivotal to Scalable Capital’s regulatory compliance and security posture, ensuring that every product and feature we launch is bulletproof against financial crime attack vectors.

You will collaborate closely with our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Anti Financial Crime (AFC) Operations teams. Taking functional ownership, you will be responsible for the developments of a dedicated engineering team primarily consisting of Data Engineers.

We encourage creative, proactive problem-solving: you will analyze potential attack vectors across Scalable’s platform and determine the most secure, efficient, and scalable methodologies to mitigate them. Rather than operating a legacy system, you will architect and build this platform from the beginning, acting as its overall owner. You will have access to cutting-edge technologies and a dedicated engineering team to address these complex challenges. In an era defined by AI and rapid tech acceleration, we are looking for a smart, creative problem solver who prioritizes execution speed alongside diligence to eliminate regulatory risks and automate workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Greenfield Tooling Development: Lead the functional definition and technical implementation of a brand-new, end-to-end Anti Financial Crime tooling ecosystem.
  • Product Enablement & Security: Act as the dedicated Product Manager for Scalable’s Anti Financial Crime domain. Ensure that every new product launch and feature rollout is resilient and bulletproof against financial crime.
  • Requirements Discovery & Synthesis: Work collaboratively with 2nd-line AML and AFC control functions to translate complex regulatory and threat-mitigation requirements into clear, actionable technical specifications, enabling the engineering team to execute seamlessly.
  • Threat Prevention & Detection: Partner with AML and AFC departments to continuously model, prevent, and detect suspicious or unlawful activities across Scalable’s expanding platform.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with peer Product Managers across our Broker, Wealth, Credit, and Banking offerings to ensure seamless integration of AFC controls into all user journeys and product workflows.
  • Technical Roadmap Ownership: Take full ownership of the AFC product roadmap and system architecture, working hand-in-hand with a large team of Engineers to design robust, scalable solutions on top of our data lake and newly built infrastructure.
  • Execution Speed & Diligence: Drive end-to-end product delivery, from technical evaluation to production release, balancing high execution velocity with absolute accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Agile Milestone Management: Apply agile frameworks to drive development, shifting from rigid sprint commitments to milestone steering and prioritization to maintain adaptability under changing conditions.
  • Product Management Experience: Solid background in product management, ideally with exposure to technical platforms, financial services, fintech, data engineering, or anti-financial crime and regulatory environments.
  • Creativity, Agility and Domain Expertise: Prior experience in Anti-Money Laundering, Fraud Prevention, Data Engineering, or Regulatory Technology is highly beneficial, but not mandatory. In the age of AI, we value creativity, fast learning, and intelligent problem-solving over years of domain expertise.
  • Technical & Analytical Affinity: Strong technical aptitude and analytical mindset required to collaborate effectively with a dedicated engineering team, understand complex data architectures, as well as machine learning and pattern detection basics.
  • Diligence & Velocity: Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the proven ability to dissect complex financial crime frameworks into clear, step-by-step technical requirements while executing with high velocity.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to harmonize and align a diverse group of stakeholders across engineering, operations, product management, and regulatory control functions.
  • Agile Mindset: Proficient with modern agile collaboration tools and comfortable navigating fast-paced, high-visibility task forces or firefighting environments.
  • Language: Professional fluency in English; German is considered an advantage but is not mandatory.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. We’re building a team with diverse backgrounds and would love to hear your story.

  • Work with an international, diverse, inclusive, and ever-growing team that loves creating the best products for our clients

For many of our employees, this position is the highlight of their day. You get to leave work knowing you helped a child learn something new, build confidence, solve a problem, or simply have a great afternoon.

title: Principal Mission Engineer - Full Stack (Secret Clearance Required)
description:
Principal Mission Engineer (Full Stack) (Secret Clearance Required)

The Team:

Information processing and sense-making systems are the lifeblood of national security efforts, facilitating an understanding of the global situation, strategic planning, and tactical execution. The reliability, accessibility, and sophistication of these systems can determine the outcomes of conflicts before they begin. STR’s Analytics and Command & Control (AC2) Division focuses on developing actionable, advanced technology solutions to provide asymmetric advantages within the information domain.

The Mission Applications (MA) Group within the AC2 Division specializes in ensuring the technology that STR creates produces outsized mission impact. Staff within the MA group have a deep understanding of missions and technology needs for national security with skills targeting transition of technology to operational use, including product management, UX Product implementation, software integration & mission engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, and program management. MA staff combine with other science and engineering staff from the various STR research and development groups to form dedicated product teams focused on accelerating the operational transition of cutting-edge software technologies.

The Role:

As a Principal Mission Engineer (Full Stack) in the Mission Applications Group, you will develop and deploy software essential for a specific, real-world objective or "mission" in partnership with our customers. We are looking for engineers who are high ownership and have a track record of delivering high impact work.

You have: 1) expertise in developing and deploying software solutions in complex and high-security environments, 2) deep domain knowledge in the complex missions executed across the Department of Defense, and 3) expertise in modern frameworks, building full stack applications, and integrating APIs for deployment in high-security environments.

You will work as a leader of software teams to design, develop, and maintain software systems deployed in operational use. You have experience managing customer relationships while simultaneously leading engineering teams to ensure the delivered product meets the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. This role includes:

  • Build Prototype Capabilities: Break down use cases and user-defined problems, build an MVP, and rapidly evolve a solution into a cohesive application.
  • Rapidly Scale Applications: Continue accelerated development trajectory on existing applications by building new workflows, increasing scalability and making high impact improvements, and addressing additional customer pain points in the context of existing applications and workflows.
  • Develop and Enhance Features: Create high-performance, visually appealing frontend solutions that handle complex use cases effectively. Ensure the product is fast, smooth, and intuitive to use, even under heavy load.
  • System Integration: Leading cross functional engineering teams to design, build, and deploy a cohesive system. Integrate independent capabilities into existing solutions.
  • Customer Collaboration: Working closely with end-users and customers, who are typically military or Government operators, to understand their requirements and translate them into software features. You are experienced in product discovery best practices.
  • Deployment and Field Testing: Traveling to integration sites to deploy, test, and triage software in secure operational environments. On average, travel to customer sites should not exceed one week per month.

This role will take advantage of STR’s flexible, hybrid environment – when the work does not require use of STR’s or the customer’s facilities, you are welcome to work remotely.

Who You Are:

  • Must be a U.S. citizen
  • Active US Security Clearance
  • BS in Computer Science or related technical field with at least 8 years of work experience
  • Experience deploying software for DoD or IC missions
  • High sense of ownership and a track record of delivering high impact work
  • A passion for crafting user-centric interfaces and a keen eye for design details
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge of modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, and Python
  • Knowledge of performance-focused tools and techniques for rendering large datasets and building responsive, smooth interfaces
  • A demonstrated ability to adopt new languages, libraries, and technologies
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and with an ability to work both independently and collaboratively
  • Demonstrated experience as an effective communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences

Even Better:

  • Active Security Clearance at the Top Secret level with SCI Eligibility
  • Advanced Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field
  • Prior US Military Service with experience in joint planning, large force battle monitoring, and fluidity with large force debrief best practices

Pay Information
Full-Time Salary Range: $240,000 - $290,000

The salary range listed is based on external market data. Offers are based on factors, such as but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, education, training, key skills/critical skills, security clearances, and prevailing market and business conditions.

STR is a growing technology company with locations near Boston, MA, Arlington, VA, near Dayton, OH, Melbourne, FL, Carlsbad, CA, Atlanta, GA, and Denver, CO. We specialize in advanced research and development for defense, intelligence, and national security in: cyber; next generation sensors, radar, sonar, communications, and electronic warfare; and artificial intelligence algorithms and analytics to make sense of the complexity that is exploding around us.

STR is committed to creating a collaborative learning environment that supports deep technical understanding and recognizes the contributions and achievements of all team members. Our work is challenging, and we go home at night knowing that we pushed the envelope of technology and made the world safer.

STR is not just any company. Our people, culture, and attitude along with their unique set of skills, experiences, and perspectives put us on a trajectory to change the world. We can't do it alone, though - we need fellow trailblazers. If you are one, join our team and help to keep our society safe! Visit us at for more info.

title: Telefonintervjuare
description:
Söker du ett meningsfullt extrajobb som går att kombinera med studier, annat arbete eller pension? Miljonbemanning söker nu telefonintervjuare för ett deltidsuppdrag hos en offentlig verksamhet i Örebro. Uppdraget inleds med en betald utbildning i januari eller februari 2027. Därefter arbetar du minst tre pass per vecka, huvudsakligen på kvällstid.

Om uppdragsgivaren

Vår uppdragsgivare genomför samhällsundersökningar som ger kunskap om människors livsvillkor i Sverige. Resultaten används som underlag för bland annat beslut, forskning och samhällsdebatt. Som telefonintervjuare bidrar du till att samla in information som gör skillnad. Här får du som är nyfiken på människor och samhällsfrågor möjlighet att både lära dig mer och bidra till ett viktigt arbete.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Du kontaktar utvalda personer via telefon och genomför intervjuer om olika delar av deras vardag, exempelvis hälsa, boende, ekonomi, arbetsliv och fritid. Samtalen utgår från ett fastställt frågeformulär och svaren registreras digitalt. Eftersom intervjuerna kan beröra personliga ämnen är ett respektfullt bemötande och förmågan att skapa förtroende centrala delar av arbetet.

Du arbetar på plats i uppdragsgivarens lokaler i Örebro. Arbetstiderna är främst måndag–torsdag kl. 17–21. Även pass kl. 9–15 och 15–21 samt helgarbete kan förekomma. Din anställning är hos Miljonbemanning, och arbetet utförs hos vår uppdragsgivare.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som vill kombinera ett extrajobb med studier, annan anställning eller pension. Du trivs med telefonen som arbetsredskap och har lätt för att möta människor med olika bakgrund. Du är lyhörd, behåller lugnet i känsliga samtal och arbetar metodiskt med både instruktioner och registrering av svar.

För att vara aktuell behöver du:

  • ha en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning, exempelvis studier, arbete eller pension

  • ha gymnasieexamen

  • ha minst ett års dokumenterad arbetslivserfarenhet

  • behärska svenska flytande i tal och skrift

  • ha god datorvana och kunna kommunicera tydligt

  • kunna arbeta minst tre vardagspass per vecka

  • kunna närvara under hela den betalda introduktionsutbildningen, som omfattar fyra dagar på plats i Örebro under någon av veckorna 3, 4, 5 eller 6 i 2027.

Meriterande

  • Erfarenhet av arbete med många personkontakter, exempelvis inom vård, skola, service eller handel.

  • Möjlighet att arbeta fler än tre pass per vecka.

Ansökan

Ansök via ”Här ansöker du” och bifoga ditt CV. Du behöver inte skicka något personligt brev. Urval sker löpande och tjänsterna kan tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag. Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan!

Om Miljonbemanning

Vi är ett innovativt kompetensförsörjnings- och kompetensutvecklingsföretag vars mission är att aktivt arbeta för en inkluderande arbetsmarknad där alla bedöms på lika villkor och ges samma förutsättningar. Därför präglas vår företagskultur av mångfald, respekt, värdighet och inte minst integritet.

Genom vår passion för människans förmåga till lärande och utveckling samt arbetsmarknadens potential för förändring och tillväxt hjälper vi till att skapa de rätta förutsättningarna för våra konsulter att realisera sina drömmar och för våra kundföretag att nå sina mål.

Vi letar där ingen annan letar; varmt välkommen med din ansökan till Miljonbemanning.

title: Environmental Consultant/Environmental Planner
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, self-motivated Environmental Consultant with 2 to 3 years of direct experience navigating transportation infrastructure and environmental compliance in the Commonwealth of Virginia. In this role, you will lead and support environmental clearance workflows for Locally Administered Projects (LAPs) developed under the oversight of the Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT).

You will serve as an essential technical bridge between local public agencies (cities, counties, and towns), engineering design teams, and state and federal regulatory bodies. Your primary objective will be ensuring that transportation enhancements, multi-use trails, roadway widenings, intersection improvements, and bridge rehabilitations successfully achieve environmental clearance under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), state environmental review directives, and applicable natural and cultural resource regulations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:

  • NEPA Review: Conduct NEPA review and author NEPA documents – primarily Programmatic Categorical Exclusions (PCEs), Categorical Exclusions (CE), and Environmental Assessments (EA) – in accordance with VDOT LAP Manual Chapter 15 guidelines, the VDOT NEPA Manual, and FHWA policies.
  • Agency Coordination & Consultation: Coordinate with local agency project managers, VDOT Project Coordinators, and VDOT Environmental Reviewers to ensure successful NEPA review and delivery. Coordinate with various stakeholders and reviewing agencies, including the State Historic Preservation Office (Virginia Department of Historic Resources - VDHR), Virginia Department of Environmental Quality (VDEQ), Virginia Department of Conservation and Recreation (DCR), Virginia Department of Wildlife Resources (DWR), and U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS).
  • Technical Studies & Site Assessments: Coordinate hazardous materials reviews, threatened and endangered (T&E) species habitat evaluations, desktop cultural resource screenings, and Section 4(f)/6(f) evaluations.
  • Permitting & Resource Delineation Support: Assist in preparing and securing Clean Water Act Section 404/401 permits from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) and the Virginia Department of Environmental Quality (VDEQ). Collaborate with wetland delineators and civil design teams to quantify and minimize impacts to aquatic resources.
  • Design Interfacing & Environmental Commitments: Review roadway and structural plan sets (Right-of-Way and Final Construction phases) to verify that environmental commitments, avoidance areas, and permit sketches are accurately integrated into engineering contract documents.

Skill/Requirements of a successful candidate include but are not limited to:

  • Professional Experience: 2–3 years of professional environmental consulting, regulatory agency, or local government experience directly focused on transportation infrastructure projects in the Commonwealth of Virginia.
  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Policy, Urban/Regional Planning, Biology, Natural Resources, Civil/Environmental Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
  • VDOT LAP Process Knowledge: Working knowledge of the VDOT Locally Administered Projects (LAP) Manual, the VDOT NEPA Manual, and standard VDOT project development phases.
  • Regulatory Acumen: Firm understanding of NEPA review and compliance, Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act, Section 7 of the Endangered Species Act, Section 4(f) of the Department of Transportation Act, and Section 6(f) of the Land & Water Conservation Fund Act.
  • Technical Communication: Superior technical writing, research, and interpersonal communication skills; proven ability to clearly articulate regulatory constraints and deliverable milestones to municipal clients and project engineers.
  • Field Readiness & Licensure: Valid Driver's License and willingness to travel periodically across Virginia project sites for field inspections and public meetings.

title: Poolclub Manager
description:
På Rox Resort skaber vi oplevelser, hvor atmosfære, personlig service og kvalitet går hånd i hånd. Vores Pool Club er en central del af resortet med indendørs og udendørs pool, rooftop og oplevelser, der inviterer gæsterne indenfor året rundt.

Vi søger nu en Pool Club Manager, der vil tage ansvar for den daglige drift, udvikle teamet og sikre, at gæsteoplevelsen og forretningen går op i en højere enhed.

Om jobbet

Som Pool Club Manager får du det overordnede ansvar for driften og udviklingen af vores Pool Club. Du er synlig i hverdagen, går forrest som leder og sikrer, at gæsterne møder en gennemført oplevelse, uanset om de besøger os for en dag ved poolen eller for de stemningsfulde oplevelser indendørs.

En vigtig del af rollen bliver at udvikle Rox Resorts samlede wellnessprodukt og se nye muligheder i vores faciliteter, koncepter og gæsteoplevelser. Du får derfor både en operationel og udviklende rolle, hvor du skal være med til at sætte retningen for, hvordan vi skaber et attraktivt og konkurrencedygtigt wellnessunivers.

Du får samtidig en vigtig rolle i at udvikle medarbejderne, skabe en stærk servicekultur og sikre, at vores faciliteter og koncepter fungerer optimalt. Samtidig har du fokus på omsætning, bemanding og omkostninger og arbejder løbende med at styrke både gæstetilfredsheden og forretningen.

Dine ansvarsområder

Du skaber struktur og kvalitet i den daglige drift og sikrer, at teamet har de rette forudsætninger for at levere service på højt niveau. Dine primære ansvarsområder bliver at:

  • Lede, motivere og udvikle Pool Club-teamet.

  • Sikre en velfungerende daglig drift og en høj gæsteoplevelse.

  • Udvikle oplevelser og aktiviteter på tværs af pool, rooftop og øvrige faciliteter.

  • Følge op på omsætning, bemanding, vagtplaner og omkostninger.

  • Sikre høje servicestandarder og et godt samarbejde på tværs af resortet.

Om dig

Du har erfaring med drift og ledelse fra hotel-, hospitality- eller servicebranchen og trives med ansvar, højt tempo og mange kontaktflader. Du er en nærværende og tydelig leder, der formår at motivere medarbejderne, skabe struktur og sikre en høj standard i hverdagen.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med ledelse og daglig drift i et serviceorienteret miljø.

  • Forstår sammenhængen mellem gæsteoplevelser og kommercielle resultater.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har blik for både detaljen og helheden.

  • Er hands-on, tager ansvar og går forrest, når der er brug for det.

  • Har interesse for oplevelsesbaseret hospitality og gerne kendskab til pool- eller wellnessområder.

Samtidig kan du se dig selv i vores værdier: professionel, passioneret, legesyg og personlig.

Vi tilbyder

Du får en central lederrolle på Rox Resort med mulighed for at præge udviklingen af vores Pool Club og skabe resultater sammen med et engageret team. Du bliver en del af ESS Group, hvor kvalitet, personlighed og udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi tilbyder attraktive personalevilkår og gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

Næste skridt

Send dit CV via linket og besvar to korte spørgsmål:

1. Hvordan vil du skabe en attraktiv Pool Club-oplevelse, der både får gæsterne til at vende tilbage og styrker den kommercielle forretning?

2. Hvilke erfaringer og personlige styrker vil du bringe i spil for at udvikle Rox Resorts Pool Club og skabe resultater gennem drift, service og medarbejdere?

Hvis du synes, du shiner bedre på video, er du også velkommen til kort at præsentere dig selv og fortælle om din motivation.

title: Laboratory Technologist
description:
At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.

Position Summary

We are currently seeking a Laboratory Technologist to join our Miami-based team. This individual will play a key role in molecular testing workflows that support our mission in reproductive health and genetic diagnostics. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, highly skilled in molecular biology techniques, and committed to maintaining the highest standards of accuracy and compliance in a fast-paced laboratory environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for specimen processing, test performance, and for reviewing and reporting test results, if applicable.

  • Performs high complexity tests that are authorized by the General Supervisor or Laboratory Director.

  • Adhere to laboratory's procedures for specimen handling and processing, test analyses, reviewing and maintaining records of patient test results.

  • Follow all safety and quality control protocols.

  • Be capable of identifying problems that may adversely affect test performance or reporting of test results and immediately notify the General Supervisor or Laboratory Director.

  • Document all non-conformities and corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from the laboratory's established performance specifications.

  • Register samples in the designated system, witness the procedure, and ensure proper documentation is in place.

  • Work flexible hours including overtime, weekends, and overnight shifts as dictated by operational needs.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure workflow efficiency and continuity.

  • Maintain a high level of organization and accountability to support safe, accurate, and timely laboratory testing.

  • Perform additional duties as assigned in support of laboratory operations.

Experience and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, or higher, degree in a laboratory science, or medical laboratory technology from an accredited institution; OR a bachelor’s, or higher, degree in one of the chemical, or biological sciences from an accredited institution, and, in addition, at least 6 months of acceptable supervised experience and/or relevant training.

  • Relevant molecular skill set consisting of the molecular fundamentals, RNA and DNA extraction, PCR, and gel electrophoresis will be plus.

  • Experience with real time PCR, microarray or sequencing preferred.

Key knowledge, skills and abilities:

  • Highly organized and strong work ethic.

  • Understanding of the equipment used daily, including, but not limited to centrifuges, thermal cyclers, and real-time PCR analyzers.

  • Understanding of CLIA requirements and experience with CAP inspections for compliance with Checklist requirements.

  • Demonstrate clear ability to explain experience with specific instrument platforms, including test principle(s), what controls were in place, and how results are interpreted and reported out.

  • Ability to multi-task and work in a fast-past, deadline-driven environment.

  • Communication - Proficient verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear reports and detailed laboratory procedures with correct grammar and spelling. Willingness to share and receive information and ideas from all levels of the organization in order to achieve the desired results.

  • Teamwork - Commitment to the successful achievement of team and organizational goals through a desire to participate with and help other members of the team.

  • Dependable; follow instructions, respond to management direction, complete tasks on time or notify appropriate person with an alternate plan.

  • Visual acuity and analytical skills to distinguish fine detail.

  • Manual dexterity to use common laboratory equipment and perform sterile techniques as required.

  • Must possess ability to perform repetitive motion.

Benefits:

  • Paid Time Off and 10 Paid Holidays

  • 401(k) with Employer Match

  • Medical, Dental, Vision

  • IVF Coverage to support family building needs

  • GAP Insurance

  • Basic Life and AD&D Coverage

  • Short- and Long-Term Disability

  • Optional AFLAC Supplemental Policies

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Account

An offer of employment is contingent on the successful passing of a background check. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vitrolife Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable laws.

Vitrolife Group is a global provider of medical devices and genetic services. Based on science and advanced research capabilities, we develop services and products for personalized genetic information and medical device products. We support our customers by improving their clinical practice for the patient's outcome of fertility treatment.

We are currently approximately 1 100 colleagues worldwide, with headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. Vitrolife Group's products and services are available in more than 110 countries through our own presence in 30 countries and a network of distributors. Vitrolife Group is a sustainable market leader and aims to be the preferred partner for IVF-clinics by providing superior products and services with the vision of fulfilling the dream of having a baby. The Vitrolife share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

title: Engagement Manager
description:
We're looking for a senior, client-facing Engagement Manager who owns the client's success from the first scoping conversation through final acceptance.

This is a services-led role that starts before the contract is signed. Once the work is underway, you are the person the client holds accountable for the outcome, and the person Mirantis holds accountable for delivering it.

Our solutions are highly customized, and the engagements you run will span cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and AI workloads for both enterprise clients and cloud service providers. You may run multiple engagements at once, or a single large multi-workstream program where complexity warrants it, holding Mirantis, client, and third-party teams to a common schedule while keeping the critical path clear and the commercial health of the engagement intact.

The environment is fast-evolving and frequently ambiguous. Bringing order to it is the job. You'll be the calm center of the engagement — the person who holds client confidence when the schedule slips, who escalates early rather than absorbing problems quietly, and who can move from a working session with engineers to a C-level update without changing gears.

What You'll Do

  • Own the client's success end to end — from pre-sales scoping and solution design through contract, pilot, delivery, and acceptance — across both Enterprise and Cloud Service Provider (CSP) engagements.

  • Serve as the client's primary point of contact and the senior Mirantis voice on the engagement, building trust and sustaining client confidence under delivery pressure.

  • Partner with sales, solution architects, and engineering during pre-sales to scope and estimate custom work, author the delivery sections of the statement of work, and coordinate the internal teams needed to win the opportunity.

  • Run multiple concurrent client engagements, or a single large multi-workstream program where complexity and time commitment warrant it.

  • Translate client business objectives into executable plans, holding Mirantis, client, and third-party teams to a common schedule and a shared set of commitments.

  • Deliver in line with Mirantis delivery procedures — maintaining RAID logs, integrated plans and schedules, and providing clear, concise status reporting — applying the level of rigor the engagement warrants, whether the work is phased or iterative, and actively managing the critical path to remove blockers before they affect committed dates.

  • Manage technical delivery in coordination with Product Engineering, Customer Success, and Professional Services to meet client objectives.

  • Ensure client readiness by coordinating the infrastructure, dependencies, and prerequisites the client owns, and hold third-party vendors and subcontractors to their timeline and quality commitments.

  • Own the commercial health of the engagement — scope, change, and the delivery inputs that drive its financial performance — identifying and documenting scope creep as it arises, driving the change order process, and partnering with Services Operations on measurement and reporting.

  • Identify and communicate risks early, ensuring all stakeholders have clear visibility, and drive mitigation plans across internal and client teams.

  • Report status across the full stakeholder spectrum, from project teams to Mirantis and client executive and C-level leadership.

  • Identify opportunities through ongoing delivery to expand Mirantis’ engagement with the client, and work with Sales to develop follow-on work based on client needs, emerging requirements, and evolving business priorities.

  • Improve delivery processes and collateral, and mentor the project managers on the team.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in project or program management leading complex, client-facing solution implementations in a professional services, consulting, or technology vendor environment.

  • Experience delivering enterprise infrastructure or cloud platform implementations — you understand what it takes to stand up, integrate, and get acceptance on infrastructure in a client environment.

  • Experience running multi-party delivery across client teams, third-party vendors and subcontractors, and internal product and engineering organizations distributed across time zones.

  • Pre-sales experience: scoping and estimating custom work, and authoring the delivery sections of statements of work.

  • Commercial ownership of engagements — scope control, change orders, and accountability for how an engagement performs financially.

  • Technical fluency sufficient to engage credibly with engineers and architects on tradeoffs, dependencies, and risk.

  • Demonstrated ownership of client outcomes. You have been accountable when a program succeeded or failed, not only the person tracking it.

  • A pragmatic, outcome-driven mindset - you focus on delivering value, not just managing tasks

  • Bachelor's degree in a business or technical field, or equivalent experience.

Nice to Have

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or similar.

  • Familiarity with infrastructure solutions based on Kubernetes, OpenStack, and/or hybrid cloud concepts.

  • Familiarity with AI concepts — including data pipelines, LLMs, and model lifecycle — and experience delivering projects related to them.

  • Experience delivering projects for data center environments.

  • Experience managing vendor or subcontractor relationships as part of project delivery.

  • Familiarity with using AI tools and agents to streamline process execution and reporting.

What Success Looks Like

  • Engagements deliver to scope, schedule, and quality — and where constraints emerge, expectations are managed early enough that client trust holds.

  • Engagements perform to their financial plan, with scope change identified, documented, and converted into change orders rather than absorbed.

  • Plans, RAID logs, and reporting are current and trusted, and risks reach leadership before they affect committed dates.

  • Delivered results generate follow-on work, and you help shape what comes next.

Location and Travel

This is a remote role with moderate travel, typically 10–25%, for client engagements, workshops, and internal team meetings. Travel may be international. Candidates must be willing and able to travel internationally, including to the United States, and to hold or obtain the documentation required to do so. You may support clients globally, with some flexibility in working hours to accommodate client and delivery team time zones.

Why Mirantis

  • Work with a global leader in hybrid cloud, open-source infrastructure, enterprise AI cloud, and neocloud.

  • Partner with Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers on next-generation platform and AI initiatives.

  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous growth.

  • Competitive compensation, strong benefits, and stock options.

  • Work for an established leader in the Cloud Native industry with over 800 enterprise customers, HQ’d in Silicon Valley.
  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented, and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune and Global 2000 customers implement modern open-source cloud technologies.
  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.
  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.
  • Flexible working schedule and remote / or hybrid work environment.
  • Receive a competitive compensation package.

Mirantis ranked in the top 50 of G2's Best IT Cloud Products of 2021!

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all.

As a Qualcomm Systems Engineering Team member you will research, design, develop, simulate, and/or validate systems-level software, hardware, architecture, algorithms, and solutions that enables the development of cutting-edge technology. Qualcomm Systems Engineers collaborate across functional teams to meet and exceed system-level requirements and standards.

Qualcomm's System Performance Team is responsible for optimizing and validating performance for Qualcomm Snapdragon Chipsets across all business units such as Server, Mobile, and Compute, Automotive, and IOT.

In the role of System Performance Engineering Lead, you will lead collaboration with software, hardware, and architecture teams to optimize power, performance, and thermal behavior of the system, primarily focused on Qualcomm's business unit needs. You will leverage your advanced systems knowledge and experience to research, simulate, and validate performance and ensure product thermal and electrical requirements are met. · Define and conduct thermal and limit systems testing and validation on silicon and system-level platforms

Role Overview

Qualcomm’s Connectivity functional verification team is looking for an enthusiastic new team member to assist in the pre-silicon verification of high performance RFICs for WLAN/BT/UWB radio, PMU and personal navigation applications.


Project Decription:

Develop an AI-driven verification framework that analyzes complex CoEx calibration architectures and automatically generates testbench scenarios. The goal is to improve functional and scenario coverage by identifying calibration flows, operating modes, configuration dependencies, corner cases, and interactions across RF/analog and digital subsystems.


Responsibilities may include:

  • Write behavioral Systems Verilog models of analog blocks.
  • Develop and maintain functional verification plans/coverages.
  • Writing functional verification tests for block level and radio chip level.
  • Developing and debugging behavioral models for event driven simulation.
  • Verifying functionality of radio chip level.
  • Diagnose radio chip level functional symptoms.
  • Diagnosing failed tests.
  • Tracking results, and logging bugs.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BSEE’s or BSCS’ candidate with focus in VLSI digital and/or RFA design courses
  • Application of Machine Learning algorithms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s or PhD‘s candidate in EE, ECE, CE, or CS or equivalent
  • Experience with System Verilog, UVM, testbench generation, assertions, functional coverage, stimulus generation.
  • Knowledge of WIFI/GPS/RF transceiver architectures, phase lock loops (PLLs), analog-to-digital converters, and digital-to-analog converters (ADCs and DACs) would be extremely helpful.
  • Proficient at scripting and program development (Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, RAG, C++, …).
  • Digital design or RFA design experience.
  • Modeling and verification experience.
