title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer | Build platforms. Own the delivery. See the impact.

Fully remote within Finland | Full-time | Fluent Finnish and English required

Your next role should give you room to use your experience: solve complex engineering problems, shape the architecture, and see your work make a difference.

Our client is a data infrastructure and analytics consultancy looking for a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys taking solutions from business need to production. You’ll work directly with customers, take ownership of technical delivery, and build data platforms that support analytics, AI, and everyday business decisions.

Right now, we’re particularly interested in engineers with deep Snowflake + dbt expertise or experience delivering enterprise-scale Databricks solutions.

What makes this opportunity worth exploring?

  • Ownership from architecture to production. Design the solution, build it, and establish the practices that keep it reliable.

  • Engineering with a clear purpose. Work closely with customers to understand the problem and connect technical decisions to business value.

  • A broad technical landscape. Bring your expertise across Snowflake, dbt, Databricks, and cloud platforms, with a technology-agnostic approach to solving problems.

  • Learning built into the culture. Develop your skills through recurring training, learning sessions, and knowledge sharing with colleagues.

  • Remote work within Finland. Combine a fully remote setup with a collaborative team and close customer relationships.

What you’ll work on

You’ll design and deliver scalable data platforms, ELT pipelines, and data models for complex customer environments. Depending on the engagement, this could include:

  • Shaping lakehouse, Medallion, Data Mesh, or other suitable architectures.

  • Building dimensional models or Data Vault 2.0 solutions.

  • Implementing cloud infrastructure using Terraform or similar tools.

  • Establishing CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and data quality practices.

  • Helping customers turn business requirements into practical technical solutions.

  • Recognising opportunities to improve or extend a customer’s solution and helping shape the next engagement.

This is a hands-on role with responsibility for both the engineering and the customer outcome.

What you’ll bring

You have at least five years of relevant experience and a track record of delivering data solutions at scale. You can explain your architectural choices, work through complex problems, and take responsibility for delivery.

Your experience includes:

  • Strong hands-on expertise in Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft-based data platforms, ideally across more than one.

  • Deep understanding of modern data architecture patterns and when to apply them.

  • Designing and building large-scale ELT pipelines.

  • Strong data modeling skills.

  • Solid expertise in at least one cloud: Azure, AWS, or GCP.

  • Infrastructure as code using Terraform or similar tools.

  • DevOps and DataOps practices, including CI/CD, testing, observability, and data quality.

Experience that adds to your profile

We’d also be interested in experience with data governance, lineage, metadata management, or security; streaming technologies such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Flink; and infrastructure supporting ML or GenAI, including feature stores, vector databases, and RAG architectures.

BI tools and semantic modeling—such as Power BI, Snowflake’s semantic layer, or Omni—are valuable additions too.

What our client offers

  • €5,400–€6,600 gross per month.

  • Full-time employment, fully remote within Finland.

  • An open, collaborative environment with close customer cooperation.

  • Recurring training, learning sessions, and opportunities to share expertise.

  • Social events and opportunities to connect with colleagues.

If you enjoy owning complex data engineering work and helping customers’, get real value from it, we’d like to hear from you. Apply and tell us about a data solution you’re proud to have built—and the decisions that made it work.

We know that we’ve got your attention, so state your interest by sending your CV/LinkedIn profile and we will be happy to contact you within 24 hours. During our screening and recruitment process we use only human power, not AI tools.

We treat your personal information with respect and confidentiality, guaranteed and protected by the professional ethics and the European law.

title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location: Reno, NV

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

  • Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.
  • Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.
  • Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.
  • Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.
  • Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.
  • Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

  • Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.
  • Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.
  • Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.
  • Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.
  • Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.
  • Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.
  • Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.
  • Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.
  • Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.
  • Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

  • Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.
  • Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.
  • Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

  • Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.
  • Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.
  • Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.
  • Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.
  • Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.
  • Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.
  • Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.
  • Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.
  • Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.
  • Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.
  • Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.
  • Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.
  • Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.
  • Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.
  • Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.
  • Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.
  • Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & reference check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

title: Systems Engineer 1
description:
Systems Engineer I

Managed IT Solutions | Full-Time

Role Overview

The Systems Engineer I supports customer accounts by helping keep technical systems running smoothly. Working with guidance from senior engineers, this role analyzes service tickets, troubleshoots and investigates issues to maintain and improve system performance, responds to customer requests and concerns, and installs and updates hardware and software components. This position is an entry point into the engineering team, with a focus on building hands-on technical skills and strong customer service habits.

Core Functions

Project Support: Assist senior engineers with project tasks from kickoff through completion, delivering assigned work with quality and on time.

Customer Relations: Act as a professional, responsive point of contact on assigned tickets and tasks, building trust and keeping customers updated on progress.

Technical Ownership: Take ownership of assigned duties, seek feedback, and look for ways to improve while building skills with guidance from senior staff.

Success Driver: Contribute to customer satisfaction and operational efficiency by combining growing technical expertise, dependable project support, and clear teamwork.

Key Responsibilities

Support new project deployments, both onsite and remotely, under the direction of a project lead or senior engineer.

Work alongside project team members to complete assigned tasks and meet project expectations.

Implement system upgrades and updates for customers following established procedures.

Troubleshoot customer issues thoroughly, complete customer-facing tasks with guidance from senior engineers, and escalate complex or unresolved problems when needed.

Investigate and resolve problems within customer networks and IT systems using established troubleshooting methods.

Communicate proactively with team members regarding task status, availability, and blockers.

Identify potential upsell opportunities during the lifecycle of a service ticket and pass them to the appropriate account or sales contact.

Qualifications

Foundational knowledge of computer systems, hardware, and software, with the ability to apply that knowledge to routine support tasks.

Security Solutions: Foundational familiarity with EDR and XDR; SentinelOne exposure preferred.

Cloud Productivity: Foundational familiarity with cloud administration tools; Intune, Entra ID, and Azure exposure preferred.

VoIP and Communication Systems: Basic familiarity with phone system support; 3CX and/or RingCentral exposure preferred.

2+ years of helpdesk or technical support experience preferred. We value demonstrated skills over time served.

Ability to use established troubleshooting methods to investigate routine technical issues, document findings, and resolve problems within assigned responsibilities. Recognizes when an issue requires senior engineer support and escalates it with relevant details.

Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and communicate technical information effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Ability to organize assigned deployment and support tasks, meet agreed deadlines, and communicate progress or blockers. Works with the project lead or senior engineer to prioritize competing requests.

A relentless focus on providing excellent customer service.

title: Solutions Engineer - Central
description:
About Neo4j:

Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world’s largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter.

Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business.

Our Vision:

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

At Neo4j, our Solution Engineers are pivotal to our company’s success. As a member of our regional go-to-market team, you will partner with our sales executives, working closely with clients to showcase how the Neo4j Graph Intelligence Platform addresses their critical business needs. Neo4j Solution Engineers play a central, hands-on role as clients consider and evaluate Neo4j technology, and support customers in an advisory capacity throughout their journey to value realization. SE’s work with organizations across industries such as Financial Services, Telecommunications, Technology and Life Sciences understand the business and technical value of representing data using Neo4j graph database and analytics technology. You will grow as a thought leader in graphs and solve our customers’ high-value problems beyond traditional data solutions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Developing and honing subject matter expertise to effectively discern and understand the true needs of our customers, present technology solutions that target those needs, and all in all, demonstrate thought leadership and the value of Neo4j through platform and use case demonstrations, solution architecting, workshops, and conferences.
  • Meeting and exceeding regional revenue goals, as a result of helping Sales to qualify and validate opportunities from a technical perspective and accelerate the sales cycle and adoption of Neo4j.
  • Collaborating effectively with Sales, Professional Services, Partners, Product Management, etc to deliver continuous value to customers and ensure a seamless customer experience as they embark on the graph journey.

What You’ll Do:

  • Confidently articulate the business and technical value of Neo4j to customers and prospects as a key technical advisor and advocate for our products and services
  • Actively drive and run the technology evaluation stage of the sales cycles.
  • Work across a number of opportunities in parallel and manage day-to-day activities such as opportunity qualification, technical discovery, presentations, platform and use case demonstrations, proof of value, sizing, and documentation of technical decision criteria.
  • Build and nurture rapport with customer stakeholders at all levels and be the trusted advisor to them to help them understand what they can achieve with Neo4j.
  • Co-create reference and solution architectures with our customers, including integrating Neo4j with their existing architecture and applications within a public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or on-premise environment.
  • Stay current on latest Neo4j capabilities, including but not limited to usage and integration with third-party tools and services.
  • Distill and communicate customer needs and product feedback to Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales.
  • Help drive demand through the participation in account-based marketing events as well as industry-known conferences and trade shows.
  • Lead by example and actively foster an environment of teamwork, transparency, creativity, and continuous improvement.
  • Travel as needed to assist in deal creation and closure, and provide support to your team as required.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 3-5+ years of customer-facing experience in a similar capacity (Sales/Presales/Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, etc), ideally in a similar high-growth, scaling environment.
  • Experience working with different data technologies in either of the following areas: enterprise data architecture, data analytics, data science or cloud data architecture.
  • Familiarity with graph data technology is essential. Working knowledge of Neo4j is a strong plus!
  • Hands-on experience and proficiency with relational (SQL) and/or NoSQL databases, and at least one of the following languages: Python, Java, JavaScript, Go, C#.
  • Successful track record in designing, developing, and implementing data solutions in the public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or on-premise.
  • Ability to engage and communicate ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences at all levels through presentations, whiteboarding, and platform demonstrations.
  • Technical savviness and business acumen to translate technical concepts and patterns into valuable business outcomes.
  • Passion for learning new technologies (especially graphs!), developing new ways of data modeling, and spearheading change management.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to prioritize, pivot, and problem-solve.

The annual on target earnings range for this position based in the United States is listed below. This range is an estimate, and the actual on target earnings may vary based on Neo4j’s compensation practices, job related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and trainings, in addition to geographic location. Based on the factors above, Neo4j utilizes the full width of the range.

In addition to the range below, US employees are eligible for a stock option grant and certain roles are eligible for an annual bonus. Employees in this position are also eligible to participate in the Company’s standard benefit programs, which currently include the following: medical, dental, and vision benefits, 401(k), paid time off, and certain leaves of absence.

Annual On Target Earnings Range
$200,000—$225,000 USD
Why Join Neo4j?

Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j.

  • Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years.
  • Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history.
  • 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others.
  • Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success.
  • Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform.
  • A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers.

One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, career-defining experience. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Early Careers: Technical Content DevOps Developer
description:
Early Careers: Technical Content DevOps Developer

Location: Burnaby, BC, Canada (in-office)
Experience: 0–2 years
Type: Full-time

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with more than two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. Our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are looking for a recent graduate to join us as an Early Careers: Technical Content DevOps Developer and help build the AI-powered tools and pipelines behind our technical content.

You will join the Technical Content team, which creates documentation and training for Fortinet’s cybersecurity products. Our documentation is published to the Fortinet Document Library at , and our training content is delivered through . Your job is to make that content faster to produce, easier to publish, and smarter to find, using automation, DevOps practices, and AI.

This is an entry-level role designed for new graduates. You will work on real production systems from your first months, with mentorship from senior DevOps developers and content leads.

What You Will Do

Working with guidance from senior team members, you will:

  • Build and maintain scripts, tools, and GitLab CI/CD pipelines that automate how documentation and training content is authored, built, and published, working toward single-touch publishing.

  • Develop AI agents, skills, and MCP servers that chain together research, writing, review, and publishing tasks for content developers.

  • Help build dashboards and analytics that track content metrics, such as page traffic and usage, for content teams and product managers.

  • Support the day-to-day operation of our internal AI tools and model servers, including routine maintenance, upgrades, backups, and deploying new models.

  • Add monitoring for AI token usage, GPU utilization, cost, and system performance.

  • Contribute to our knowledge framework by building workflows that ingest and curate content from internal and external sources for documentation, course blueprints, and lab scenarios.

  • Help automate lab environments used for courseware and content development.

  • Improve GitLab issue tracking and collaboration workflows across the team.

  • Troubleshoot issues in pipelines, tools, and infrastructure, and document what you fix.

  • Work with product managers, developers, QA, technical writers, and courseware developers to understand their challenges and turn them into tools that save time.

What We Are Looking For

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, MIS, or a related field, completed within the last two years or by your start date.

  • 0–2 years of experience. Co-op terms, internships, capstone projects, open-source contributions, and personal projects all count.

  • Working knowledge of Python or another scripting language, and the ability to automate tasks with it.

  • Familiarity with Git and source control workflows (branches, commits, merge requests).

  • Hands-on experience using LLMs or AI APIs in a project, such as building a chatbot, an agent, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) app, or an automation that calls a model.

  • Comfort working on the Linux command line.

  • Clear written communication and an interest in how technical content is created and consumed.

  • Curiosity, a problem-solving mindset, and eagerness to learn new tools quickly.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) or containers (Docker).

  • Experience running open-weight models locally (for example, Ollama or vLLM), or working with vector databases.

  • Exposure to agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Coursework or projects using cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or virtualization (KVM, VMware, OpenStack).

  • Familiarity with HTML, JavaScript, Markdown, or static site generators.

  • Basic networking and security knowledge (TCP/IP, firewalls, VPNs).

  • Fortinet certifications (for example, Fortinet Certified Fundamentals or Fortinet Certified Associate) or entry-level cloud certifications.

Please include a link to your GitHub, GitLab, or portfolio. Projects that show what you have built matter as much as your résumé.

What You Will Gain

  • Mentorship from experienced developers, content leads, and product managers.

  • Ownership of tools that are used every day by documentation and training teams worldwide.

  • Hands-on experience with applied AI, DevOps, and cloud infrastructure in a production environment.

  • Deep exposure to Fortinet’s cybersecurity products and access to Fortinet Training Institute courses and certifications.

Compensation and Benefits

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $59,000 - $71,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

About Our Team

Join the Fortinet team in Burnaby, BC, known for its collaborative culture and close work with global customers, internal engineering teams, and product development groups. We emphasize continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork, and innovation, and we support each other, share knowledge, and use AI to solve complex technical challenges.

Why Join Us

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support your overall health and financial well-being. Start your career with work that makes a meaningful and lasting impact for our 660,000+ customers around the globe.

Fortinet is an equal opportunity employer. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Senior Producer
description:
About Team Liquid

Team Liquid began as a StarCraft clan in 2000 and grew into a global esports and gaming organization. At our heart, we're still a community of people who love competitive gaming.

Our main quest is to forge a global fandom that celebrates creativity, mastery and kindness.

Across our teams, creators, content and Liquipedia, we bring people closer to the games they love. That takes colleagues with different skills, perspectives and backgrounds, working together across countries and disciplines.

Joining Team Liquid means helping shape what comes next. We value people who take ownership, stay curious and support those around them, and who care about how we succeed together.

About the Team

Liquid Media is a boutique creative marketing agency that builds brands through culture, creators, and community. We deliver measurable results across content and influencer marketing for partners including Riot Games, Alienware, Warner Bros, adidas, and SEGA, spanning gaming, sports, entertainment, and culture.

The Role

As the Senior Producer, you will lead a globally distributed team of production and creative professionals, overseeing creative quality, production rigor, and team performance across social, digital, and live platforms. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role where you will guide and develop Producers, lead complex productions, and ensure work is delivered to a consistently high standard.

You will work closely with Creative, Strategy, Editorial, Production, and Client Services to turn creative ideas into executable concepts, balance creative ambition with feasibility, budgets, timelines, and impact, and maintain quality across multiple campaigns and clients. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, bringing your own ideas, perspectives, and production expertise to elevate the work beyond the brief.

Location: Los Angeles, CA. Candidates must be available to work onsite at our office at least three days per week.

What You'll Own

  • Oversee production quality, timelines, budgets, and deliverables across assigned clients and projects.

  • Support the build-out of Liquid Media’s game capture, trailer, and post-production offering, from capture planning through edit, finishing, and delivery

  • Lead complex, high-impact productions end-to-end, setting standards for execution while balancing hands-on production leadership with team oversight.

  • Partner with Creative, Strategy and Editorial to shape and evaluate creative concepts, ensuring ideas are strategically sound, creatively compelling, and producible.

  • Drive creative development from a production perspective during pitches and early concepting.

  • Review work across projects to ensure it is on-brand, creatively compelling, and executed to a consistently high standard.

  • Production Management & Execution

    • Oversee production plans, schedules, budgets, and resourcing to ensure projects are feasible and efficiently executed.

    • Ensure creative concepts are aligned with production realities, timelines, and budget constraints.

    • Manage vendors, freelancers, and internal teams to ensure smooth execution across projects.

    • Set and enforce production standards, workflows, and best practices across the team.

    • Ensure consistent, high-quality execution across multiple clients, campaigns, platforms, and production formats.

    • Anticipate production risks, gaps, and blockers and implement solutions proactively.

  • Team Leadership & Development

    • Manage and develop 1–4 direct reports, providing clear guidance, feedback, and growth direction.

    • Set clear expectations for creative quality, production rigor, accountability, and individual performance.

    • Build a high-performing production team that operates with ownership and delivers without surprises.

    • Provide hands-on leadership during complex and high-pressure productions.

    • Foster strong collaboration across Production, Creative, Strategy, Editorial, and Client Services.

  • Client & Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Serve as a senior production voice in client conversations when needed, representing Liquid Media with professionalism, confidence, and sound judgment.

    • Collaborate with Creative, Strategy, Editorial, Production, and Client Services from pitch through delivery.

    • Translate creative ambition into clear and executable production approaches.

    • Build trust across internal teams, clients, vendors, freelancers, and other production partners.

    • Provide clear and proactive communication around production decisions, risks, timelines, and trade-offs.

  • Budget & Resource Management

    • Manage production budgets, schedules, and resource allocation across assigned projects, ensuring spending aligns with approved plans.

    • Balance creative ambition with budget, timeline, and resource realities.

    • Identify production efficiencies while maintaining a high standard of creative execution.

AI Fluency at Team Liquid

Using AI thoughtfully is an expectation across Team Liquid, including in non-technical roles. We’re looking for people who explore how these tools can improve their work, test ideas and share what they learn with their teams.

In this role, that could include:

  • Using approved AI tools to support production planning, scheduling, resource allocation, budget tracking, and project communications.

  • Leveraging AI to streamline pre-production and post-production workflows, including initial drafts of briefs, shot lists, capture plans, transcripts, captions, and content versioning.

  • Applying AI responsibly across client projects by checking client-specific AI policies, protecting confidential information, and ensuring creative decisions and final deliverables receive appropriate human review.

You don’t need to be an AI expert on day one. We do expect a willingness to learn, experiment and build confidence. Just as important is knowing how to check outputs, protect confidential information and recognize when human judgment is essential.

What You Bring

You have:

  • 5–8 years of experience in production roles within an agency, media, gaming, or live-event environment.

  • Proven experience leading complex, high-visibility productions and campaigns.

  • Strong understanding of multi-platform content production, including live, digital, and social content.

  • Demonstrated ability to shape and evaluate creative concepts for feasibility and impact.

  • Strong understanding of storytelling, pacing, framing, and visual composition across platforms.

  • Strong financial understanding and experience managing production budgets, forecasting costs, planning resources, and overseeing production schedules.

  • Experience managing and developing team members.

  • Familiarity with production software and tools, including project management platforms, Adobe Suite, and asset-tracking systems.

  • Strong leadership presence with the ability to guide teams and make confident decisions.

  • High level of accountability for both team output and individual performance.

  • Clear and proactive communicator across internal teams, clients, vendors, and external partners.

  • Solutions-oriented, with strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to anticipate challenges.

  • Ability to maintain creative and production rigor under pressure.

  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to build trust across creative, strategy, production, and client teams.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve production workflows, with an understanding of their limitations, confidentiality requirements, and the importance of human oversight.

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including occasional evenings, weekends, and irregular hours, based on client deadlines, live events, and production needs.

  • Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% for client projects and production needs.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience producing game capture, gameplay trailers, or post-production pipelines

  • Experience working with gaming and entertainment brands, publishers, or creative agencies.

  • Experience managing productions across globally distributed teams.

Our Values in Action

Team Liquid runs on six values. They're not posters on a wall; they're how we hire, promote, and work every day.

  • Integrity: We do the right thing, even when it isn't easy or convenient.

  • Humility: Empathy, listening, and respect matter more than being right.

  • Pursuing Excellence: We treat self-improvement as a never-ending journey, not a destination.

  • Curiosity: We have an insatiable thirst to understand ourselves and the world, including the new tools reshaping how we work. This is where our AI Fluency expectation comes from — we believe curious people build the future faster.

  • Authenticity: We welcome who you are, as you are. There's no pressure to fit in.

  • Inclusivity: We work to be an equalizing force that humanizes differences and builds safer communities.

Life at Team Liquid

Across every Team Liquid office, you'll get:

  • Game Day, once a quarter, where the whole office pauses to play games together and enjoy some friendly competition.

  • In-house chefs at every facility, serving two meals a day.

  • Three extra global holidays, one for each continent we operate on, celebrating our global presence.

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited PTO, and a 401(k) plan.

We're looking for people who are genuinely excited to build this with us, not just fill a seat.

If you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, reach out to HR@teamliquid.com. We'll work with you to make it right.

Salary Range (U.S.-based role):
The anticipated base salary range for this position is $90,000–$95,000.

Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors such as skills, experience, education, internal equity, and geographic location, where applicable and permitted by law.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Team Liquid is an equal opportunity employer. We view everyone as an individual, and we know inclusion means more than diversity — it means belonging. We celebrate what makes each of us unique; it's a core part of what makes us good at what we do.

Agencies: Team Liquid does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited candidates.

title: Citizens Banker
description:
Starting Salary: $25 / hour and up

Citizens Bankers are the face of the branch. They devote their time getting to know their customers and building lasting relationships by providing trusted advice.

What you'll do

Are you outgoing? Do you get satisfaction out of helping others and offering sound advice? If you’re a “people person” who enjoys building positive relationships with customers, then this is the job for you!

Using your strong communication and problem-solving skills — along with your broad range of financial knowledge — you’ll provide recommendations and assist customers with financial solutions, supporting spending, saving, borrowing and investing needs.

You’ll get to know customers’ personal financial goals and recommend tailored solutions to help achieve them — like planning for the future, buying a home or opening a new credit card. You’ll introduce customers to digital and mobile-first ways to handle banking transactions, like on our app or through our ATMs. You’ll collaborate with partners in Wealth Management, Mortgage and Business Banking to help customers with more complex financial needs. You’ll make outbound calls to acquire new customers and schedule financial checkup appointments, as you understand what might be a good fit for a customer now, may not be 6 months from now. All financial policies and procedures will be followed, including proper cash handling, state and local laws and regulations.

What you'll get

  • Meaningful work & relationships – You’ll help customers with important financial decisions that impact their lives like building a business, buying a house, paying for school or helping them realize their long-term financial goals. Colleagues and leadership listen to your ideas and feedback.
  • Commitment to community – Give back with 8 hours of paid time off annually for volunteering, separate from regular PTO, and have your donations to eligible 501(c)(3) organizations matched, up to $1,000 annually
  • Career opportunities, reward, and upskilling – See your hard work rewarded with promotions and opportunities to grow your career through training, coaching, career planning and development resources that enable you to branch off in any direction your talents and interests take you.

Required Qualifications

  • High School degree or GED required
  • 2 years of sales and customer service experience, demonstrating an ability to meet or exceed goals
  • Ability to effectively ask questions and identify needs to improve the customer relationship
  • Proven success with building relationships, and recommending and referring products and services through in-person and phone interactions
  • Demonstrated skills in using digital technology to support the delivery of business goals
  • Aptitude to problem solve and provide solutions to customer issues
  • Recognized ability to strengthen relationships with teammates, business partners and specialists through collaboration
  • Self-motivated, confident and ability to multitask effectively

How to prepare: Set aside 30-45 minutes for the self-guided assessment that includes games and questions. Find a quiet place to record and be camera-ready. You’ll need a smartphone, tablet, or desktop computer with your camera and microphone enabled. You’ll answer questions to share your skills and experience, and bring your personality to the interview. This step accelerates the interview process, moving qualified candidates to hiring manager interview fast.

Preferred skills/experience

Hours and Work Schedule

  • Work Schedule: Varies with branch needs and may include weekends and evenings

    The salary range for this position is $25.48 - $31.25 per hour, plus an opportunity to earn additional incentive earnings. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.
    We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. description:

As a Management Trainee, you’ll rotate through a structured, four-phase program designed to give you full visibility into how a successful business operates — from supply chain and operations to sales, leadership, and strategy.

You won’t just observe — you’ll own projects, manage accounts, build customer relationships, and make real business decisions, all with the guidance of experienced leaders across the country.

The Program: Learn the Business From the Inside Out

Phase 1: Warehouse and Customer Service (12 Months)

Get hands-on with the backbone of the business.

  • Shipping, receiving, and inventory management
  • Product knowledge and vendor coordination
  • Customer service and counter sales
  • Pricing, credit, financial statements, and logistics
  • Learn how products move from supplier to customer

Phase 2: Customer Relationships & Procurement (12 Months)

Step into problem-solving and project support.

Drive growth like an entrepreneur.

Prepare to run the show.

Benchmark of actual costs against standard costs and new reduced standard costs.

• Any other task assigned.

title: Associate Product Manager, Nutrition
description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

We are seeking an Associate Product Manager, Nutrition to improve the dietary behaviors and nutrition outcomes of Twin Health members. You will own initiatives across the nutrition product, from the foundational data and tooling that power our AI-driven content to the in-app experiences that shape what members eat.

The ideal candidate is analytical, learns quickly, and is relentlessly focused on execution. You will design and run experiments, ship improvements at pace, and measure their impact on member behavior and metabolic health outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deliver nutrition projects from discovery through launch and measurement. Scope ranges from backend investments in nutrition data and tooling to in-app features such as food logging, recipes, insights, and meal guidance.
  • Improve member nutrition outcomes: Identify the barriers that keep members from reaching their nutrition goals, and deliver product changes that drive sustained dietary behavior change.
  • Make data-informed decisions: Analyze food logs, member behavior, and outcome data to prioritize work and quantify impact.
  • Strengthen nutrition foundations: Partner with engineering, data science, clinical, and nutrition teams to raise the quality, consistency, and reliability of the data and tools behind member experiences and AI-generated content.
  • Align stakeholders: Write clear briefs and PRDs, and articulate the rationale, timing, and expected impact of each initiative.
  • Leverage AI tools: Use AI to prototype, analyze, and accelerate the path from idea to experiment to launch.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 1–3 years of experience in product management, associate product management, analytics, consulting, or a related field, or equivalent impact.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to extract, analyze, and interpret data to inform decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, operate in ambiguity, and take ownership of outcomes.
  • A track record of disciplined execution and delivering results.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Interest in nutrition, health, or behavior change.
  • Familiarity with experimentation (A/B testing) or AI-powered products is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

This role is well suited to an early-career product manager who wants to own meaningful projects, develop quickly, and see their work improve members’ eating habits and health outcomes.

Compensation and Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $105,000 - $120,000 annually.

Twin has an ambitious vision to empower people to live healthier and happier lives, and to achieve this purpose, we need the very best people to enhance our cutting-edge technology and medical science, deliver the best possible care, and turn our passion into value for our members, partners and investors. We are committed to delivering an outstanding culture and experience for every Twin employee through a company based on the values of passion, talent, and trust. We offer comprehensive benefits and perks in line with these principles, as well as a high level of flexibility for every Twin

  • A competitive compensation package in line with leading technology companies
  • A remote and accomplished global team
  • Opportunity for equity participation
  • Unlimited vacation with manager approval
  • 16 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for delivering parents; 8 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for non-delivering parents
  • 100% Employer sponsored healthcare, dental, and vision for you, and 80% coverage for your family; Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options
  • 401k retirement savings plan
Salary range for US jobs
US Salary Range
$105,000—$120,000 USD

We have been made aware of fraudulent interview requests being sent using the Twin Health's name. All communications will come from official Twin Health channels and a email address. We will never ask you to complete a text interview or request financial details during the interview process.

title: Water Resources Senior Technical Leader
description:
Woodard & Curran is an employee-owned engineering, science, and operations firm dedicated to clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. We foster an inclusive, collaborative culture that supports professional growth, flexibility, and meaningful work, empowering our employees to make a lasting impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.


Water Resources Senior Technical Leader

Woodard & Curran is a national engineering, science, and operations firm with a vision for clean water, a safe environment, healthy communities, and happy people. As an employee-owned company, we strive to cultivate teams that encourage collaboration in an inclusive culture. We seek talented individuals from all backgrounds to help us address a broad range of water and environmental issues. We prioritize our people, offering opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and flexibility. This commitment enables us to make a meaningful impact on our clients, communities, and the planet.

Who we are looking for:

At Woodard & Curran, we love a complex water management challenge. We handle a wide range of water and environmental issues, solving problems with creativity and tenacity to make a difference to our clients, people, and planet. Our company was founded on a simple concept: to provide a safe and enjoyable place to work, with opportunities, integrity, and commitment, and we will attract talented people. Those people are at the heart of our firm.

We are seeking an experienced professional to grow our Integrated Water Resources Planning Practice. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing water resources and watershed resiliency projects. This role will evaluate and lead clients through complex water resources challenges, including watershed management, natural resource management, groundwater sustainability, and programmatic funding, among other areas.

What You Will Be Doing at Woodard & Curran:

We believe that our ability to grow and succeed as a firm is a direct function of the technical expertise we develop and the client and business partnerships we cultivate. As such, the Senior Technical Leader is responsible for keeping technical proficiency and innovative project delivery at the forefront of client and business relationships. This position is highly visible inside and outside the firm. You will be responsible for overseeing integrated water resources planning projects in California and across the country. This includes providing technical expertise in integrated planning, fostering relationships with clients and regulatory agencies, supervising project teams, preparing/reviewing reports and proposals, staying current on emerging state and federal regulations, and representing the company in industry and professional organizations.

Location: Where you work best. We have California Offices in Sacramento, San Francisco, Walnut Creek, Los Angeles, Irvine, San Diego, and numerous other states across the US and flexible work arrangements including remote or hybrid options (Hybrid 1 -2 days a week in office or on site with clients).

Travel: Up to 20% of time with clients in CA. Occasional travel within the US to support national Practice strategic initiatives and attend market events (conferences, etc.).

Projects may include

  • Integrated/regional water resources planning projects
  • Watershed resiliency projects
  • Water supply planning/strategy
  • SGMA implementation & recharge planning projects
  • Strategic funding initiatives
  • Outreach & facilitation

What you will be doing at Woodard & Curran:

  • Act as a technical lead for key projects, including substantial interaction related to scoping and delivery of technical tasks.
  • Develop and maintain relationships with clients and regulatory agencies.
  • Provide technical expertise on water resources and integrated planning projects, and resource agency permit engagement/applications.
  • Support project teams, including supervision of planners, engineers, scientists, and other professionals.

description:

title: Research Scientist Intern, AI Agents and Machine Learning (PhD)
description:

title: Full Stack Product Engineer
description:
Merch that moves business needs a platform that moves just as fast.

From scattered purchases without brand control, to the magic that happens when it all clicks: merch that makes a real impact, on one global platform customized for each client, as if they built it themselves.

That’s what we’re building at Exakt. The platform is up and running, but this is only the beginning. Now comes the most advanced part, and we’re looking for an engineer with the drive and the skills to build it on a global scale.

What you’ll do

You’ll build and own our merch platform, full stack: TypeScript and React on the frontend, Node APIs in the middle and a MedusaJS headless commerce backend, all running on GCP.

It’s live with our first clients, and the codebase is still young enough that your decisions will stick. From here, you’ll:

  • Own the platform end to end, from architecture to checkout

  • Refine and develop the product logic. One t-shirt can come in 62 colors and seven sizes, from several suppliers, production partners and locations. Find new ways to make it all run even more smoothly

  • Take our client dashboard further, with the advanced features our clients didn’t know they needed, and even more transparency around orders, statistics and the environmental impact of what they buy

  • Automate the manual work, on the platform and behind the scenes, so the team can spend more time on the creative work

  • Set the technical direction with our founder, and help shape the team as we grow

Who you are

You enjoy figuring out what’s needed and making it happen without waiting to be asked. And you’re curious about the business behind the code, whether you’re shaping a feature or talking ideas through with a client, in English.

  • You’re resourceful, and happy to use a smart existing solution instead of reinventing it

  • You bring experience and an open mind. You know how to move fast, and you’re always curious about new ways of working

  • You know when speed matters more than perfection, and you make sure the quick fix doesn’t become permanent

  • You work AI-first, and take security and client data just as seriously

  • You like people, and you’d rather be at the office with the team than on mute

You’re comfortable across backend and frontend, and our designers take care of the design. Experience with e-commerce, Medusa or multi-tenant platforms is a plus, but not a must.

Tech you’ll work with

We’re guessing you already have the essentials. The limited editions are a bonus, and the rest you’ll pick up along the way.

  • The essentials: TypeScript, React, Node, PostgreSQL, Git, and GCP or a similar cloud platform

  • The limited editions: MedusaJS, Next.js, Redis, Prisma, Terraform, Clerk, Stripe

About Exakt

Exakt, the world’s boldest merch agency since 2004. Bold, but true. We start with who a brand wants to reach and what it wants to say, and help turn that into products people keep, use and remember. Our clients feel safe with us. They know they’ll get the right thing, on time and delivered to the right place.

We’ve run webshops for our clients for more than 10 years. Now we’re scaling up our platform, continuously building new processes around our clients’ needs and our own workflow efficiency, and automating more and more of what has been done by hand. The whole process, and the service and ownership we’re known for, become transparent and easy to follow.

With new print techniques, new ways of working with our print partners and years of industry know-how, we have turned our knowledge into a platform that’s unique in our industry.

Picture a company where everyone, from sales and marketing to HR and finance, gets the merch they need from one place. Always on brand and always the strongest choice for the target group, whether it’s printed on demand, custom-made or shipped from stock, with full control over costs and climate impact. Behind it sits a multi-tenant platform built around each client. There’s no off-the-shelf solution for this, so we’re building our own.

We work with brands like Samsung, Electrolux and KRY, and things are going well: we’re profitable, growing fast and have never needed venture capital. Put our merch expertise together with a platform that handles every part of it, and you get something no one else offers.

Why Exakt

You’ll have real ownership of the tech from day one, with the influence of a startup in a company that’s already on solid ground. Exakt is known in our industry for always being a step ahead, in how we work with ideas, proposals, solutions and suppliers, so you really get the best of both worlds. We’re a team of eight with zero prestige, and we’re growing, looking for the right expertise to expand our team in every area. We support each other through whatever comes our way, celebrate together, eat lunch together and take our merch-cap throwing competitions a little too seriously.

You’ll find us at our office on Lidingö, where client work happens in English and office chat in Swedish, so you’ll need to understand it.

Apply

Sound like you? We’d love to hear from you. We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no need to wait.

Curious about something first? Emelie is helping us find the right person and is happy to answer anything about the role: emelie.stjarnas@ants.se

title: Sr. AI DevOps Developer(Korean Bilingual)
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking an AI DevOps Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and support enterprise AI agents and Generative AI solutions for clients, primarily in the consumer electronics and retail industries. This role combines hands-on AI application development with DevOps and production support for AI solutions already deployed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop custom AI agents, GenAI applications, and AI-powered automation based on client business requirements.
  • Develop, test, deploy, monitor, and continuously enhance AI solutions across development and production environments.
  • Work with client stakeholders to translate business requirements into practical AI solutions.
  • Implement and maintain RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, agentic workflows, tool/function calling, and LLM integrations.
  • Provide ongoing DevOps and production support, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance optimization, upgrades, and incident resolution.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, and technologies and recommend appropriate solutions for client projects.

Core Skillsets

  • Strong hands-on experience developing applications using Generative AI and LLMs
  • Experience with AI agents / agentic AI, including multi-step workflows, tool/function calling, orchestration, and autonomous task execution.
  • Strong knowledge of RAG architecture, including document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, and context management.
  • Strong prompt engineering skills, including prompt optimization, structured outputs, few-shot prompting, and hallucination mitigation.
  • Experience with LLM platforms such as OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, or equivalent.
  • Understanding of LLM evaluation, AI application testing, model selection, token/cost optimization, latency, and scalability.
  • Experience integrating LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and business processes.

  • Strong programming experience in Python; Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C# is a plus.
  • Experience developing REST APIs, backend services, microservices, and enterprise integrations.
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker, and cloud environments such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting applications in production.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
  • 9+ years of software development, AI, cloud, or DevOps experience, with hands-on GenAI/LLM development experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in an IT consulting or client-facing environment is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple client projects and explain complex AI concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Bilingual preferred

title: Account Director
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

ACCOUNT DIRECTOR

LOCATION: Barcelona, Spain

REPORTING TO: Business Director

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM

Working in direct partnership with a leading European pet care client (part of a major international food group), the Account Director leads the dedicated agency team in delivering powerful, impactful, and globally scalable creative work.

In this role, you will champion four of the client's flagship pet care brands. You will initially partner with the client's Global Brand Teams, leading the strategic and creative delivery of high-profile global briefs. These span brand strategy, conceptual campaign development, and global master toolkits, with a long-term view toward supporting local market adaptation.

The Account Director serves as a trusted senior advisor, combining client relationship management, commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and team leadership to foster a world-class agency-client partnership.

WHAT IS REQUIRED

Client Partnership & Brand Guardianship

  • Act as the senior strategic point of contact for the client's Global Marketing and Brand leads, establishing trusted, collaborative, and consultative relationships.
  • Act as Brand Guardian across the portfolio, ensuring all work meets the highest standards of strategic alignment, brand consistency, and creative excellence.
  • Establish and champion best-practice ways of working, operational rhythms, and communication flows between the dedicated agency team and client stakeholders.

Creative & Strategic Delivery

  • Oversee the end-to-end execution of global deliverables, including brand strategy, creative concepts, hero campaign assets, and master toolkits.
  • Partner closely with the Strategy Director and Creative Director to translate business objectives into inspiring creative briefs and effective campaign solutions.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for project hurdles, managing expectations and negotiating win-win solutions that protect both creative integrity and client satisfaction.

Commercial & Operational Leadership

  • Take overall financial and commercial control of the account, managing profitability, accurate revenue forecasting, scope tracking, and fee negotiations.
  • Manage the annual Scope of Work (SOW), tracking run rates, resourcing, and team capacity to ensure on-time, on-budget delivery.
  • Identify organic new business and growth opportunities, introducing wider capabilities across digital, content, and production where appropriate.

Team Management & Development

  • Manage, mentor, and inspire the account and project management team, encouraging professional development and high team engagement.
  • Lead weekly WIPs, capacity planning, and status reviews with job owners to ensure seamless day-to-day studio execution.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

  • Proven experience: 8+ years of progressive account management experience within top-tier creative, advertising, or dedicated/in-house agency environments.
  • Sector expertise: A background in FMCG, CPG, or Pet Care/Pet Food is strongly preferred. Experience managing a portfolio of multiple brands is a distinct advantage.
  • Global creative scope: A demonstrable track record managing global campaigns, conceptual work, and master toolkits (beyond adaptation and localisation).
  • Commercial acumen: Strong financial management skills, including scope definition, burn rate tracking, P&L awareness, and staffing models.
  • Relationship & communication skills: Exceptional communication, storytelling, and presentation skills, and comfort advising and influencing senior marketing stakeholders.
  • Process & integration: A deep understanding of how to embed agency teams within client organisations while maintaining high agency service standards.
  • Languages: Professional working fluency in Spanish and English is essential, as you will work with global teams.
