title: Senior Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Cloud Platform Engineer | Circa £65,000 + excellent benefits | Permanent | Hybrid

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Platform Engineer to take a leading role in how we engineer, modernise and continuously improve our cloud platforms at Thatcham Research.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role where you’ll combine deep Microsoft Azure expertise with technical leadership. You’ll help turn our cloud architecture and strategy into practical solutions, lead complex implementations and create more automated, resilient, secure and scalable ways of working.

What you'll be doing:

Working closely with our Cloud Hosting Architect and teams across IT, Cyber Security, Data, Business Systems and Product, you’ll be at the heart of our cloud engineering capability. You'll:

  • Lead the technical activity and priorities of our Cloud Platform Engineering function, providing guidance and technical oversight to other engineers.

  • Take the lead on complex Azure implementations, from technical planning through deployment, testing and transition into operational support.

  • Identify opportunities to modernise our existing Azure environment, tackling technical debt and improving resilience, security, performance and cost efficiency.

  • Drive our use of Infrastructure as Code, automated deployment and CI/CD, using technologies such as Terraform, Bicep, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, PowerShell and Python.

  • Work across Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, security, governance and hybrid services.

  • Establish engineering standards, reusable deployment patterns, technical documentation and code review practices.

  • Share your expertise through mentoring, knowledge sharing and practical technical guidance.

  • Work with Microsoft, AWS and other technology partners to support cloud delivery and continuous improvement.

Skills & experience that will set you up for success in this role:

You’ll already be an accomplished cloud engineer with substantial hands-on experience in complex production Azure environments. We're particularly interested in your experience of:

  • Microsoft Azure, including compute, storage, networking, identity, security and monitoring.

  • Azure landing zones, subscriptions, Azure Policy, RBAC, private endpoints, firewalls and hybrid connectivity.

  • Terraform and/or Bicep and building repeatable infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code.

  • CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.

  • Leading complex technical implementations and coordinating cloud engineering activity.

  • Modernising existing Azure environments and improving reliability, resilience, security and cost efficiency.

  • Providing technical leadership, mentoring other engineers and establishing good engineering practices.

Experience with AWS and hybrid cloud environments would be a great addition, but these are desirable rather than essential.

You'll also hold Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) and at least one advanced Microsoft Azure certification.

Why this role?

For the right cloud engineer, this is an opportunity to have genuine technical influence. You won’t just be responding to tickets or maintaining what already exists. You’ll be helping to determine how our cloud engineering is delivered, improving automation and deployment practices, solving complex technical challenges and building capability across the team. The role has no direct line-management responsibility, so your leadership comes through technical expertise, direction and influence while remaining very much hands-on.

If you enjoy getting under the bonnet of Azure, challenging existing approaches and turning good architecture into secure, repeatable and well-engineered cloud solutions, we’d love to hear from you.

Did you know...

Research tells us that men are more likely to apply to jobs if they meet only 60% of the criteria, whereas women often hesitate or don't apply unless they meet all of the criteria. This difference in application behaviour can contribute to the gender gap in career advancement and opportunities.

We know the perfect candidate doesn't exist! If you think you have what it takes but don't tick every box, we'd still encourage you to apply - it could be a perfect fit!

Perks & Benefits

Salary - Circa £65,000 negotiable dependent on skills & experience.

  • 10% non-contributory pension

  • 29 days holiday (inclusive of Christmas shutdown) + public holidays

  • Group Life Assurance (equal to 4 x basic salary)

  • Group Income Protection (after 6 months’ service)

  • Salary Sacrifice schemes (cycle to work, home & tech scheme)

  • Enhanced and competitive parental leave for all parents, regardless of gender or family structure

  • Moneyhealth’s Financial Coaching & Wellbeing Platform

  • Health Cash Plan (cash back on eligible medical treatments)

  • Benenden Health Care (opt-in benefit)

  • Reward & Recognition Programme

  • Discounted gym membership

  • Sports & Social club

  • Payroll charitable giving

  • Subsidised on-site restaurant

  • Free on-site parking

When we work

Our standard working hours are 8:30 - 16:30 Monday - Thursday, early finish on Friday - 8:30 - 15:45 (Talk to us about flexible working if this doesn’t quite suit you – we take work-life balance seriously!)

How we work

We understand the benefits of remote and in-person collaboration and therefore have a hybrid working model – you’ll be expected to work from our office in Thatcham at least two days per week.

What we do

At the cutting edge of automotive research in the UK, Thatcham Research has a unique role in shaping the design of new vehicles and influencing ever higher standards of safety, security and repair. With an on-site Crash Laboratory, Repair Technology Centre and Training Academy, our research expertise is driving some of the very latest automotive developments in technology, materials and standards in this fast moving and highly technical industry.

Our Gamston facility is one of the UK’s leading sites for active safety, trialling and assessing the latest crash avoidance and driver assistance technologies.

Our Values

As an organisation that believes a strong set of Values are key to our organisational success and a sense of belonging for all colleagues, we ask that you understand, represent and apply our Values of Fearless, Inquisitive, Resourceful, Supportive and Trusted and demonstrate these Values throughout the recruitment process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging

We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace which values diversity and embraces each individual's authentic self. We are proud to champion a culture where colleagues freely share their diverse perspectives, recognising that these contribute to our innovative spirit. Our journey of growth and understanding is continuous as we actively invest in diversity training, workshops, and partnerships to ensure positive change.

Beyond our partnerships with the Automotive 30% Club and Women in Data (WiD), we collaborate with various organisations to advance equity not only in gender but also across ethnicity, age, disability, social mobility, LGBTQ+ identities, experiences, and thinking. Our aspiration is to create an environment where everyone thrives, achieves, and experiences a genuine sense of belonging.

Recruitment process

We’re proud to manage our recruitment in-house and believe this direct approach enables us to give you the best possible Employee Experience we can – which starts right here, your application! We’re continuously striving to improve the candidate journey, and transparency (or communication) is a key area of focus – yes, even with salary & benefits.

What can you expect from our recruitment process?

  • Regular updates on the progress / outcome of your application

  • An initial telephone screening call with a Talent Acquisition Partner

  • First interview with the hiring manager, usually via Teams

  • Second/Final interview, in-person at our office (we may give you a role specific task to present on!)

  • Personalised feedback following your interview – because everyone deserves that!

  • An opportunity to give us your honest feedback in a short survey on all of the above

Check out our post on using AI during your application and interview!

We’re committed to removing barriers. If there are any adjustments we can make to better support you, please let us know when you apply.

All applicants must have Right to Work in the UK.

If you experience any technical issues when completing your application, please get in touch at people.team@thatcham.org and we’ll be happy to help.

To ensure fairness and protect your data, we’re unable to accept applications or CVs via email. The best way to apply and to stay updated on your progress, is through our online application form.

title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location: Atlanta, GA (onsite at project locations)

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

  • Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.
  • Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.
  • Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.
  • Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.
  • Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.
  • Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

  • Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.
  • Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.
  • Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.
  • Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.
  • Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.
  • Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.
  • Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.
  • Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.
  • Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.
  • Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

  • Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.
  • Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.
  • Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

  • Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.
  • Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.
  • Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.
  • Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.
  • Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.
  • Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.
  • Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.
  • Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.
  • Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.
  • Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.
  • Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.
  • Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.
  • Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.
  • Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.
  • Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.
  • Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.
  • Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & reference check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

title: Environment, Health, Safety and Sustainability (EHSS) Manager
description:

title: Senior Software Developer – Embedded VOIP
description:
Senior Software Developer – Embedded VoIP Systems

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Embedded Software Developer to join our team working on VoIP telephone development as part of the FortiVoice solution.

This role involves low-level embedded Linux development as well as application-level VoIP software development. The successful candidate should be comfortable working across the embedded software stack, including bootloaders, the Linux kernel, device drivers, system software, and applications.

A strong understanding of resource-constrained embedded systems, debugging, and performance optimization is important for this role.

Key Responsibilities

Embedded Linux & System Software

  • Develop and maintain software for embedded Linux-based platforms.

  • Work with bootloaders, the Linux kernel, and device drivers, including modifying and debugging existing code when required.

  • Configure, build, and troubleshoot the Linux kernel and bootloader for target hardware.

  • Use embedded toolchains and cross-compilation environments to build system and application software for target platforms.

  • Work with real-time and performance-sensitive Linux environments.

  • Debug issues across the software stack, from bootloader and kernel-level problems to user-space applications.

  • Work with IPC (Inter-Process Communication), multithreading, synchronization, and related system-level concepts.

  • Analyze and optimize CPU usage, memory usage, startup time, and overall system performance.

VoIP & Telephony Development

  • Develop and maintain embedded software for VoIP telephone products.

  • Work with SIP and related VoIP/telephony technologies.

  • Investigate and resolve signaling, media, networking, and system integration issues.

  • Develop efficient software suitable for embedded systems with limited CPU and memory resources.

Software Development

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain software primarily in C and C++.

  • Apply object-oriented design principles where appropriate.

  • Diagnose complex software problems using effective debugging techniques and tools.

  • Work with static and dynamic libraries, including library linking and dependency management.

  • Use development environments and tools such as Eclipse, Visual Studio, GDB, and related embedded development/debugging tools.

  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to software design and architecture discussions.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Strong experience in embedded software development using C/C++.

  • Hands-on experience developing software in a Linux embedded environment.

  • Working knowledge of Linux kernel architecture and kernel-level development.

  • Experience working with and debugging Linux device drivers.

  • Experience working with bootloaders and the embedded Linux boot process.

  • Hands-on experience with cross-compilation, embedded toolchains, and target platform builds.

  • Good understanding of IPC, multithreading, synchronization, and process management.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, including the ability to troubleshoot issues across multiple layers of an embedded system.

  • Understanding of memory and performance constraints common to embedded systems.

Preferred / Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following would be an asset but is not required:

  • Telephony systems and technologies.

  • VoIP protocols, particularly SIP.

  • Real-time Linux and performance-sensitive applications.

  • Networking protocols and network programming.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Clear and effective communication skills.

  • Responsible, self-motivated, and proactive.

  • Comfortable working independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

  • Able to prioritize and deliver high-quality work under schedule constraints.

  • Willing and able to learn new technologies quickly.

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $150,000 - $183,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

title: Super Intelligence Platform Integration Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Super Intelligence (SI) Platform Integration Engineer to help build and support the shared services, integration, and automation layer that connects SI applications to internal systems, documented equipment interfaces, and approved external services. You will work across backend services, integration tooling, and operations to help SI systems run reliably and securely using established deployment and operational practices. This position is in the Materials Engineering Division (MED) within the Engineering Directorate.

This position offers a hybrid schedule, blending in-person and virtual presence. You will have the flexibility to work from home one or more days per week.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

  • Build and maintain reusable service frameworks, integration adapters, and automation components that enable agent-facing tools to connect securely to internal and approved external systems.
  • Integrate APIs, webhooks, queues, and event-driven services into reliable integrations that support agent-driven workflows.
  • Provide shared connectivity among agent services, hardware gateways, internal platforms, and approved third-party systems.
  • Implement and improve deployment workflows, secrets management, monitoring, logging, and operational reliability for agent-facing services within established organizational systems.
  • Help define and implement permission boundaries, auditability, rate limiting, and fallback behaviors for automated actions.
  • Partner with embedded, applied physical SI, security, and application engineers to troubleshoot issues and improve the reliability of integration points. Coordinate with organizational cybersecurity partners on new approaches with support from senior engineers.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional job responsibilities, at the SES.2 level

  • Design integration approaches spanning multiple services, queues, hardware gateways, and approved third-party APIs.
  • Improve shared platform capabilities by introducing reusable adapters, stronger observability, and safer operational controls based on lessons learned from operational workflows.
  • Coordinate technical decisions with embedded, applied physical SI, security, and application teams, including the adoption of new integration approaches with cybersecurity partners, and provide informal technical guidance to less experienced engineers.
  • Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and related experience.
  • Experience through coursework, projects, research, internships, or professional work building or supporting backend services, internal platforms, DevOps workflows, or integration tooling.
  • Proficiency in Go, Rust, or Python for automation, service integration, and operational tooling.
  • Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, queues, and event-driven systems.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, containers, CI/CD, and cloud-hosted services.
  • Basic networking knowledge, including service connectivity, ports, DNS, proxies, TLS, authentication, and firewall-aware troubleshooting.

Additional qualifications at the SES.2 level

  • Ability to independently design, implement, and troubleshoot integrations spanning APIs, event-driven systems, and secure service operations.
  • Ability to improve the reliability or security of shared service integrations through reusable tooling, observability, or operational controls.

Qualifications We Desire

  • Experience with observability tools for logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker Compose, Terraform, or other infrastructure automation tools.
  • Exposure to identity and access patterns such as OAuth, service accounts, and RBAC.

title: Senior Risk Partner - Digital & Cyber
description:
To find out more about the role, please click through here to find the Position Description.

Vector: Powering Auckland. Shaping the future.

At Vector, we’re delivering the infrastructure, technology and services that will support a smarter, more connected and increasingly electrified Auckland.

Our Vector31 strategy sets a clear direction for the future. As technology, data, AI and cyber security become increasingly important to how we operate and serve our customers, strong and practical risk leadership is critical to supporting good decisions and sustainable business outcomes.

Vector: Pioneering the future of energy

  • We collaborate globally, with leaders like X, the Moonshot Factory, to bring cutting-edge technologies home. From innovative AI-driven grid management to advanced renewable integration, we’re shaping the future of energy.
  • Our network isn’t just keeping up, it’s evolving, with predictive analytics, automation and digital tools that enhance reliability and customer experience.
  • We share innovation, offering technologies and business solutions across Auckland and the world to help others embrace smarter energy systems that drive sustainability and efficiency.

If you’re passionate about building a cleaner, more connected future, join us. The future isn’t waiting, we’re building it now.

The role

As our Senior Risk Partner - Digital & Cyber, you’ll provide independent second-line risk leadership and oversight across Digital & Data, Technology and Cyber Security. You’ll help ensure technology, cyber, information, AI and third-party risks are clearly identified, understood and managed within Vector’s enterprise risk management framework and approved risk appetite.

You’ll be part of the Risk & Resilience team, working alongside two other Risk Partners and a Risk Analyst. While your focus will be Digital & Cyber, you’ll contribute to broader team priorities and help strengthen risk capability and culture across the organisation.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Build trusted relationships with Digital & Data, Technology and Cyber Security leaders and specialist teams, bringing practical support and an understanding of their priorities.
  • Translate complex technical risks into clear business impacts, options and decisions.
  • Assess emerging risks associated with new technology, AI, digital platforms and evolving operating models.
  • Help integrate risk management into strategic planning, investment decisions, operational activities and delivery.
  • Design and deliver targeted second-line assurance reviews to test key controls and risk treatments, providing clear, practical recommendations for improvement.
  • Monitor key controls and ensure assurance findings and agreed actions are tracked through to completion.
  • Develop meaningful Digital & Cyber risk reporting for senior leaders, the Executive and Board.
  • Use risk data, key risk indicators and insights to identify trends, emerging issues and opportunities for improvement.
  • Contribute to the ongoing development of risk-related policies, standards and procedures.

Who are we looking for?

You don’t necessarily need to have followed a traditional risk management career path. You’ll bring strong knowledge across cyber security, digital technology, AI, data and operational risk, with the ability to understand complex environments, navigate competing priorities and help teams make sound decisions.

You’ll bring:

  • At least five years’ senior-level experience in technology, cyber security or a closely related field.
  • Experience supporting and influencing senior leaders, executives or governance bodies.
  • Experience working within or alongside risk frameworks and methodologies.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to balance operational priorities, customer outcomes and risk.
  • The confidence to provide independent and constructive challenge while maintaining trusted relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strategic thinking, sound judgement and an ability to identify the issues that matter most.
  • Experience in a regulated, critical infrastructure or similarly complex corporate environment.

Why Vector

You’ll have the scope to shape the role, strengthen risk maturity and contribute to decisions that support Vector’s long-term resilience.

You’ll have:

  • The opportunity to influence strategically important technology, data, AI and cyber decisions.
  • Exposure to senior leaders and governance forums across Vector.
  • A supportive and collaborative Risk & Resilience team.
  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Market-competitive remuneration and benefits.
  • Ongoing professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The chance to contribute to work that helps power Auckland’s future and supports New Zealand’s energy transition.

Our behaviours

Change Makers | Customer. Customer. Customer. | Walk in Others' Shoes | We, Not Me | Consider It. Done.

If you're excited by the opportunity to influence how Vector manages digital, cyber and technology risk, while supporting better decision-making and organisational resilience, we'd love to hear from you.

We know that some people may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply anyway - your skills, enthusiasm, and unique perspective could be just what we’re looking for.

Vector values diversity in all its forms and welcomes people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities and abilities to be part of our team.

title: AFC Associate - SAR Delegate
description:
About the opportunity

We are currently looking for an AFC Associate - SAR Delegate to join the Italian MLRO Team from Madrid. In this role, you will provide critical support in the execution of key operational financial crime related tasks for the Italian Branch, working under the guidance of the Italian MLRO and the AFC Senior Associate(s).

The AFC Associate will be assisting the MLRO Italy and the wider team in all their AFC control activities and will be based in Madrid (hybrid working policy).

In particular, the AFC Associate will primarily support the SAR review process, assist in various AFC control activities, and help in the coordination between the branch Compliance/AFC function and (i) the Global AFC function and (ii) the other functions working for the Italian market at the Global level, including AFC Ops, KYC Ops, Complaints Management and Prevention, Regulatory Reporting.

In this role, you will:

Support the Italian MLRO team in the following activities:

  • Initial Review and Validation Support of the SARs (segnalazioni di operazioni sospette), ensuring accuracy and completeness of the documentation before submission.
  • Assist in the preparation of communications and documentation related to the FIU and other investigative bodies concerning AFC topics.
  • Provide support in advisory and guidance to AFC Ops & KYC Ops Italy teams on standard processes and procedures.
  • Assist in the coordination efforts with other operational functions working for the Italian market.
  • Participate in the review of controls methodology, controls results, and action plans; conduct specific local controls as directed.
  • Support the Italian MLRO in various tasks, including the preparation of standard communications and the compilation of data for the annual self-assessment.
  • Participate in Global and local specific projects for the Italian branch, focusing on data gathering and execution tasks.
  • Assist in drafting and reviewing Policies & Procedures concerning AML / TF, primarily focusing on formatting and cross-referencing.
  • Support the preparation and delivery of the training plan material and assist in continuously checking the adequacy of the material used.

What you need to be successful:

  • A university degree in economics, law, business, or other relevant areas.
  • 1 to 3 years of professional experience gained in an anti-financial crime or compliance or risk management role.
  • Exposure to or basic understanding of the SARs filing process (segnalazione di operazioni sospette) with the Italian FIU is a plus.
  • A professional Financial Crime qualification (e.g., ICA, ACAMS) is welcome but not mandatory.
  • Foundational knowledge of European and Italian regulations on Financial Crime (AML/CTF, fraud, tax evasion).
  • You are fluent in English and Italian, both spoken and written.
  • Good communication skills, with an aptitude for relating clearly to internal teams.
  • Hardworking, team worker and highly attentive to detail (crucial for document review).
  • Strong analytical skills and willingness to learn quickly.
  • Basic knowledge of the Italian regulatory environment and relevant processes regarding topics such as KYC, financial crime risk assessment, and transaction monitoring.
  • You are detail oriented, diligent and reliable.
  • You have a hands-on mentality and take on ownership of assigned tasks.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Do you see yourself thriving in this role? We’d love to see your application even if you don’t meet 100% of the criteria. You may just be the right fit for this or other roles!

Equal opportunities for all

At N26, we believe our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring. We strive to build diverse teams that drive innovation and business success. We actively seek talent from all backgrounds and welcome applications from all genders, cultures, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages.

title: Tandprotheticus
description:

Jouw vakmanschap, onze praktijk: alles onder één dak.

Dat betekent snel kunnen schakelen, direct overleggen en samen zoeken naar de beste oplossing voor iedere patiënt. Geen afstand tussen praktijk en techniek, maar één team dat samenwerkt aan kwaliteit, functionaliteit én een mooi eindresultaat.


Wie zoeken wij?

Een tandprotheticus die:

  • zelfstandig en met aandacht voor de patiënt werkt;

  • kwaliteit en vakmanschap belangrijk vindt;

  • graag samenwerkt met verschillende tandheelkundige disciplines;

  • het prettig vindt om korte lijnen te hebben met het tandtechnisch laboratorium;

  • beschikbaar is voor één of meerdere dagen per week.


Wat kun je van ons verwachten?

  • Een eigen tandtechnisch laboratorium in de praktijk;

  • Een moderne, multidisciplinaire praktijk;

  • Directe samenwerking met tandtechniek, tandartsen en implantologie;

  • Korte lijnen en ruimte voor overleg;

  • Een professionele én prettige werkomgeving;

  • Flexibiliteit in het aantal dagen dat je bij ons werkt.

Interesse?

Ben jij tandprotheticus en toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging? Of heb je nog ruimte voor een extra dag en lijkt het je leuk om onderdeel te worden van ons team?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

title: Project Manager
description:
Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.
We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it?

Purpose of the role
Responsible for managing customer and internal projects to budget, schedule, and quality. Working with (remote) teams across departments and markets, this role demands timely and effective communications with Customers, Consultants, Project sponsors, technical specialists and across multiple concurrent projects.
Working closely with customers, managing their expectations, and ensuring that the right job is completed and done well. Helping the project team and colleagues in Keyloop and their customers to be successful.
The Project Manager is well organized, articulate, detail-orientated and able to work on tight deadlines with an understanding of business operations and able to plan, lead and delegate effectively. You take pride and responsibility and have the drive to make things happen to get the job done.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Establishing and maintaining relationships with stakeholders, delivery teams and customers
  • Analysing the defined scope, impact, resources, and outcomes of the project, and gaining customer agreement to these
  • Assigning work, sharing information around an order / project, delegating responsibilities, leading, and supporting the involved resources and ensure the deliverables to the customer.
  • Working closely with the project teams to ensure that commitments and deadlines are met.
  • Regularly reviewing project scope, deliverables, costs, performance and business benefits to keep the project on track.
  • Communicating project progress and outcomes to the project sponsor and the customer
  • Dealing with project issues promptly and professionally, escalating where necessary
  • Using appropriate standards, systems, resources, tools, and techniques in all project management activities
  • Maintaining and controlling project documentation and systems during, and on completion of the project
  • Closing projects to enable revenue recognition, and to review lessons learned.

Key Results Indicators & Measures of success

  • Projects deadlines, schedule, budget, and deliverables are met.
  • Positive engagement of all stakeholders as demonstrated by review meetings and feedback received.
  • Positive feedback from project stakeholders and teams from audit activities
  • Demonstrable continual improvement of all documented processes

Skills / Knowledge & Experience

  • Must be fluent in French and English
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to quickly develop effective working relationships with internal and external project teams.
  • Knowledge of project management methodology. (Ability to identify scope changes and highlight impact accordingly)
  • Ability to work with remote teams and on tight deadlines.

Objectif du rôle

  • Le ou la titulaire du poste est responsable de la gestion des projets clients et internes, en respectant le budget, l’échéancier et les exigences de qualité. Travaillant avec des équipes (souvent à distance) réparties entre différents départements et marchés, ce rôle exige des communications efficaces et ponctuelles avec les clients, les consultants, les commanditaires de projet, les spécialistes techniques, et ce, dans le cadre de plusieurs projets simultanés.
  • Le rôle consiste à travailler étroitement avec les clients, à gérer leurs attentes et à veiller à ce que le travail soit réalisé correctement et efficacement. Il ou elle soutient l’équipe projet ainsi que les collègues de Keyloop et leurs clients afin d’assurer le succès des projets.
  • La personne idéale est bien organisée, articulée, rigoureuse, capable de gérer des échéanciers serrés, comprend les opérations d’affaires et sait planifier, diriger et déléguer efficacement. Elle est fière de son travail, prend ses responsabilités à cœur et a le souci d’atteindre les résultats.

Responsabilités principales

  • Établir et maintenir des relations de collaboration avec les parties prenantes, les équipes de livraison et les clients.
  • Analyser la portée, l’impact, les ressources et les résultats attendus du projet, et obtenir l’approbation du client.
  • Attribuer les tâches, partager l’information relative à une commande ou un projet, déléguer les responsabilités, diriger et soutenir les ressources impliquées, et s’assurer de livrer les résultats attendus au client.
  • Travailler étroitement avec les équipes projet pour respecter les engagements et les échéanciers.
  • Réviser régulièrement la portée du projet, les livrables, les coûts, la performance et les bénéfices d’affaires pour maintenir le projet sur la bonne voie.
  • Communiquer l’avancement du projet et les résultats au client.
  • Gérer rapidement et professionnellement les enjeux du projet, en les escaladant au besoin.
  • Utiliser les normes, systèmes, ressources, outils et techniques appropriés dans toutes les activités de gestion de projet.
  • Maintenir à jour la documentation et les systèmes de gestion de projet pendant et après l’exécution du projet.
  • Clôturer les projets afin de permettre la reconnaissance des revenus et de tirer les leçons apprises.

Indicateurs clés de performance (ICP) et critères de réussite

  • Respect des échéanciers, des budgets et des livrables des projets.
  • Engagement positif des parties prenantes, démontré lors des rencontres de suivi et par les commentaires reçus.
  • Rétroaction favorable des parties prenantes et des équipes de projet lors des audits.
  • Amélioration continue démontrée des processus documentés.

Compétences, connaissances et expérience requises

  • Excellente maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’oral et à l’écrit.
  • Très bonnes aptitudes en communication.
  • Excellentes habiletés interpersonnelles et capacité à développer rapidement des relations de travail efficaces avec des équipes internes et externes.
  • Connaissance des méthodologies de gestion de projet (capacité à identifier les changements de portée et à en mesurer les impacts).
  • Capacité à travailler avec des équipes à distance et à livrer dans des délais serrés.
Why join us?
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
An inclusive environment to thrive
We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day.
Be rewarded for your efforts
We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.
Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.
We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.
"At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity."

title: R&D Tax Senior Consultant (Technical)
description:
You will turn complex engineering work into defensible R&D tax credit claims for projects in the UK and Ireland. You assess technical uncertainty, write the technical narrative, and work with client technical and finance teams to evidence it. You will report to the Head of R&D Tax and build the technical depth of a growing India-based team.

Key responsibilities

Claim delivery

  • Interview technical leads and analyse project documentation to identify qualifying R&D activities and expenditure.
  • Write and review technical reports and supporting documentation to a standard that withstands HMRC and Irish Revenue scrutiny.
  • Review contracts to establish eligibility, including contracted-out R&D and subcontractor arrangements.
  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent claims to agreed deadlines and quality standards, and escalate delivery risk early.
  • Maintain files and supporting evidence in line with internal quality standards and regulatory requirements.

Advisory and stakeholders

  • Advise tech leads and partners on compliant, defensible claims, including how to capture technical evidence during delivery.
  • Work with technical leads, finance teams and senior stakeholders to obtain the technical and financial information each claim needs.
  • Collaborate with Tax, Audit and Finance colleagues, and provide technical R&D tax input to business development and M&A activity.
  • Track changes to UK and Irish R&D tax legislation and guidance, and brief internal teams on their impact.

Team and continuous improvement

  • Mentor technologists and R&D consultants, giving technical guidance and review feedback.
  • Contribute to process automation, knowledge sharing and training sessions.
  • Handle client data in line with the Version 1 AI Policy, including customer consent requirements for AI use.

Essential experience

  • Degree in engineering, computer science or a related discipline.
  • 8 to 12 years of engineering experience in data, cloud or application development, preferably in R&D, innovation or technology-focused environments.
  • Ability to interpret technical architecture and low-level design documentation, and to explain it to finance and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong technical writing and analytical skills.
  • Business-level English with excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Experience engaging senior technical and finance stakeholders.

Desirable experience

  • Direct experience of UK and/or Irish R&D tax credit schemes (strongly preferred).
  • Experience at a professional services firm such as BDO, EY, Deloitte, PwC or KPMG.
  • Exposure to Australian R&D tax incentives.
  • Experience mentoring or leading technologists or consultants.
  • Working knowledge of LLMs, AI-based data models or related technologies.
  • Experience with workflow or analytics tools such as Power BI or ServiceNow.
  • A tax qualification (CTA, ATT or equivalent), or willingness to work towards one.

Professional development

  • Structured training in UK and Irish R&D tax legislation, with UK-qualified review support during ramp-up.
  • Funded certification path in R&D tax or a related discipline.
  • Regular training, seminars and industry events, with evidence of ongoing learning. AI and emerging technology training is encouraged.

Why Version 1?

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
  • Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Pension, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more. Generous holiday allowance, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
  • Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & ‘Call-Out’ platform.
  • Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer.

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at ekta.bahl@version1.com at Version 1. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: Senior Engineering Manager, Consumer / New Verticals
description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is building the payment layer for life's financial obligations, giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By offering greater choice over how and when payments are made and allowing eligible on time payments to help build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

That work brings together people with different perspectives who challenge the status quo and take ownership of solving difficult problems. For you, that means doing the best work of your career next to people who make you better, and together bringing ideas to life that make a real impact for the people we serve.

About the Job

Flex is a growth-stage, NYC-headquartered FinTech company building the payment layer for life’s financial obligations—giving households one place to see, split, and pay their bills around how they live and get paid. By giving people greater choice over how and when they pay, and helping eligible on-time payments build a positive credit history, Flex puts households back in control of their cash flow.

Building on our roots in rent, we’re expanding into a broader consumer bill management platform that helps people manage essential spend and align payments with their finances. Our Consumer engineering team within the New Verticals division is at the forefront of this expansion, building a new business line within Flex. We’re looking for motivated leaders who thrive in ambiguity, turn new ideas into products, and help shape how millions of people manage their financial lives.About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Engineering Manager to own consumer engineering teams within the New Verticals division. These teams partner closely with the product and the business to deliver high quality and delightful user experiences and the systems that power them.

You will own multiple workstreams that tie directly to critical business KPIs. You will work closely with product managers to drive delivery of their workstreams with your team of highly adaptable, AI-enabled engineers who reside in the Consumer organization but range across the entire Flex system as necessary.

You will serve as a key technical partner to Product, business leadership, and cross-functional teams (such as Lifecycle Marketing (LCM), Legal & Compliance, and Risk) to drive outcomes across your workstreams. You will also represent Consumer engineering and New Verticals in Flex-wide architecture and quality initiatives, ensuring we build solutions that scale across Flex as a whole.

Our Engineering Teams

  • Consumer Engineering: Builds the APIs and backend systems powering Flex’s consumer-facing mobile and web apps. This team focuses on delivering high quality, delightful and trustful customer experiences.
  • Partner Integrations Engineering: Owns the backend services and integrations that connect Flex to financial partners and payment networks, ensuring secure, reliable payment flows and partner-facing experiences.
  • Core Platform Engineering: Maintains the backend services and infrastructure supporting all business features, including Payments, Ledger, Identity, and Settlement, providing the foundation for all of Flex’s products.

What You’ll Do

Technical Leadership

  • Define and execute the consumer architecture supporting New Verticals’ expansion into essential spend.
  • Partner with engineering leaders across Flex to align technical decisions, reuse shared capabilities, and build systems that scale across business divisions.
  • Guide design reviews and make high-impact technical decisions, balancing speed of experimentation with long-term maintainability.
  • Ensure reliability, data integrity, and financial correctness across consumer workflows.

Execution & Delivery

  • Partner with Product and business leadership to shape initiatives and connect engineering investments to customer value and business outcomes.
  • Lead large, ambiguous projects from early exploration through launch and scale.
  • Coordinate cross-team dependencies and resolve blockers regardless of team.
  • Establish feedback loops that help the team learn from customer behavior, iterate quickly, and scale successful products.

People Leadership

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of engineers.
  • Establish strong ownership of customer outcomes, engineering quality, and operational excellence.
  • Hire and develop senior engineers and future technical lead
  • Elevate testing discipline and design rigor while helping the team navigate the uncertainty of building a new business line.

Operational Ownership

  • Own the production health and reliability of the team’s consumer services.
  • Improve observability, scalability, and incident response a
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, and platform teams to build safeguards into customer-facing financial workflows.
  • Ensure new capabilities launch with clear operational ownership, monitoring, and support readiness.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications below, you are a generalist, enabler, and problem solver who leads through engineering management. High ownership and drive are your default. When a problem falls between teams or disciplines, you help find a path forward. You pair strong customer empathy with deep technical knowledge. You translate business strategy into execution and contribute meaningfully in design reviews. You develop excellent engineers and build strong teams, but don’t shy away from opening a PR yourself.

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience spanning frontend and backend systems, and 3+ years managing engineers.
  • Experience building and scaling consumer-facing products and the APIs and backend systems that power them.
  • Strong product judgment and a track record of partnering with business and product leaders to delivery .
  • Experience leading ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from early definition through launch and iteration.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, service architecture, reliability, and data integrity.
  • Experience owning production services with high standards for uptime, correctness, and operational readiness.
  • A track record of growing engineers, developing technical l with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to influence technical direction across teams and balance the needs of a new business line with shared company-wide capabilities.

Preferred

  • Experience building or operating consumer fintech, payments, banking, or lending products.
  • Experience launching a new product or business line from early experimentation through adoption and scale.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding, bill management, payment workflows, or other consumer financial experiences.
  • Experience using product analytics and experimentation to i, engagement, or retention.
  • Experience partnering with Risk and Compliance teams in a regulated environment.
  • Background scaling high-growth consumer platforms.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, and compensation may vary depending on your primary work location. Work locations are categorized into one of three tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. The successful candidate’s starting pay will be commensurate with their experience, qualifications, and Flex’s internal leveling guidelines and benchmarks.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area, Los Angeles, Seattle)
$240,000—$300,000 USD
Tier 2 (Austin, Washington D.C. Philadelphia, San Diego, Chicago, Atlanta)
$216,000—$270,000 USD
Tier 3 (Salt Lake City, all other USA cities)
$200,000—$255,000 USD

Life at Flex

Building a successful company takes a diverse team of intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self-aware people. Our headquarters is in New York City, with employees across the US, Australia, Canada, and South America. We’re growing quickly and deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. We value the perspectives our people bring and take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

View our benefits and more at getflex.com/careers.

title: Vesikattojen korjausasentaja
description:
Etsimme Uudellemaalle kokenutta korjausasentajaa. Olisitko se sinä?

Teemme omakotitalojen ja taloyhtiöiden kattokorjauksia ympäri vuoden. Korjausasentajana työskentelet vesikattojen korjaus- ja huoltotehtävissä. Työhön kuuluu vuoto- ja vahinkokorjauksia, takuutöitä, kattoturva- ja sadevesijärjestelmien asennuksia sekä eri kattomateriaaleihin liittyviä korjausratkaisuja.

Työskentelet pääosin itsenäisesti, mutta osa kohteista tehdään työparin kanssa. Työtä tehdään arkipäivisin, ja päivän aikana kohteita on yleensä 1-3. Tehtävä sisältää fyysistä tekemistä, tarkastuksia, dokumentointia ja raportointia. Palkkaus on aikaperusteinen eli tuntipalkkaus.

Työskentely onnistuu joko Nurmijärven tai Kirkkonummen toimipisteeltä käsin, ja uuden tekijän toivomme aloittavan joulukuun aikana.

Miksi tulisit työkaveriksemme?

  • Meillä saat tehdä työsi kunnolla, sillä korjaustyössä laatu, huolellisuus ja oikeat toimintatavat ovat tärkeässä roolissa.

  • Käytössäsi ovat alan parhaat työkalut ja työtä sujuvoittavat työmenetelmät.

  • Satsaamme hyvään johtamiseen ja toimintamme kehittämiseen. Vaalimme myös hyvää ilmapiiriä yhteisössämme. Olemme samaa porukkaa ja se näkyy arjessamme.

  • Työterveytemme Terveystalossa toimii ja sopimuksemme sinne on varsin kattava.

  • Great Place to Work® -sertifioitu työpaikka jo viidettä kertaa peräkkäin.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Sinulla on aikaisempaa kokemusta vesikattotöistä sekä ymmärrystä eri katemateriaaleista. Huopa- ja konesaumakattojen huolto- ja korjausosaaminen katsotaan eduksi!

  • Tehtävässä pärjää tekijä, joka pystyy työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja tekemään teknisiä korjausratkaisuja myös omalla harkinnalla.

  • Kokemuksesi näkyy varmuutena tekemisessä, mutta myös järjestelmällisenä työskentelyotteena.

  • Työ edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

  • B-ajokorttia tarvitset työssä. BE ja C-kortit katsotaan eduksi.

Miltä vaikutti? Haluatko pukea meidän paitamme päällesi?

Jos kiinnostuksesi heräsi, olisi hienoa jutella kanssasi lisää! Tutustutaan puolin ja toisin.

Jos haluat kysyä lisää tehtävistä tai meillä työskentelystä, voit olla yhteydessä liiketoimintajohtajaamme Erikiin p. 040 036 3394 tai erik.riihimaki@kattokeskus.fi.

Voit myös hakea suoraan tähän tehtävään oheisen painikkeen kautta. Hakeminen ei kestä kauaa. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jatkuvasti ja palkkauspäätöksessäkin voimme olla ripeitä.

Hakuaika päättyy 29.11.2026.

Kuka etsii?

Kattokeskus on vuonna 1997 perustettu perheyritys, joka on vuosien myötä kasvanut yli 280 henkeä työllistäväksi ja kahdeksassa toimipisteessä toimivaksi joukkueeksi.

Tavoitteenamme on parantaa ihmisten asumisolosuhteita korkealaatuisella palvelulla ja huolehtimalla kattojen kunnosta tarjoamalla asiakkaillemme huolettomimpia ja luotettavimpia kattoremontteja, kattojen huoltoja ja aurinkopaneeliasennuksia. Visionamme on olla toimialan edelläkävijä sekä halutuin työnantaja ja kumppani asiakkaille.

Meillä avoimuus, tavoitteellisuus ja ilo ovat keskiössä. Kannustamme suoraan ja rehelliseen kommunikointiin. Tavoitteet ohjaavat työtämme, ja keskitymme järkevään ajankäyttöön ja korkeaan laatuun. Työympäristömme on positiivinen ja innostava, jossa jokainen voi loistaa. Johto näyttää esimerkkiä, kunnioittaa ja kuuntelee tiimiä, samalla kun arvostamme ja autamme toisiamme tavoitteiden saavuttamisessa.

Olemme Great Place to Work® -sertifioitu työpaikka jo viidettä kertaa peräkkäin. Great Place to Work®:n Trust Index ©-henkilöstötutkimus toteutettiin viimeksi lokakuussa 2025 ja siihen vastasi 69 % tiimistämme. Vastaajista 85 % oli sitä mieltä, että Kattokeskus on kokonaisuudessaan todella hyvä työpaikka. Kattokeskus sijoittui myös yhdeksänneksi Suomen Parhaat Työpaikat™ 2026 -listalla yli 250 henkilön organisaatioiden sarjassa.

title: Staff Customer Engineer, German speaking
description:
Aircall is a unicorn AI-powered communications platform transforming how teams win with customers.

For over a decade, we’ve believed voice builds the strongest business relationships. We bring voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and 250+ integrations together on one seamless workspace—so every customer conversation drives revenue, resolves issues faster, and builds trust. Our AI Voice Agents handle routine interactions while your team leads the conversations that matter most. Used by 24,000+ businesses worldwide.

We’re 600+ people from 40+ nationalities across Paris, London, Madrid, Berlin, New York, San Francisco, Seattle, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused—built for visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

Come join us!

We are looking for an outstanding Staff Customer Engineer (CE) to join the Customer Engineering team in an amazing tech scale up based in Paris!

As the most senior member in our Customer Engineering organization, you will provide white-glove, deeply technical, and highly strategic support to Aircall's most valuable strategic and enterprise customers, driving value from your very first day.

This role brings together advanced technical capability, consultative depth and commercial impact. Staff CEs work closely with CTOs, Heads of CX, Heads of Digital and operational leaders inside customer organizations. They ensure complex deployments, integrations and AI adoption programs are executed successfully and become drivers of long-term retention and growth.

Operating at the nexus of Customer Success and Product, Staff CEs pair directly with our Key Account Managers to ensure complex deployments, integrations, and AI adoption programs become drivers of long-term retention and growth. As a model of technical judgment, strategic partnership, and customer excellence, you will raise technical standards throughout the CE organization. You are expected to be hands-on, build executive credibility, and successfully navigate high-stakes customer environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • High-Touch, Complex Onboarding: Own onboarding for large, high-complexity customers (250+ employees, 100+ users). Lead deep discovery, map business processes, design advanced workflows and integrations, and drive technical implementation to a smooth, timely, high-quality go-live.

  • Senior Technical Partner to KAMs: Act as the day-to-day technical counterpart to Key Account Managers, working 1:1 or 1:2 to deliver a unified commercial and technical approach across technical strategy, risk assessment, renewal readiness, integration roadmaps, and adoption plans.

  • Proactive Renewal Support and Technical Reviews: Run quarterly and mid-cycle technical reviews for strategic accounts (covering renewal readiness, ROI articulation, workflow optimization, and integration stability), and help KAMs surface expansion and retention opportunities backed by technical outcomes.

  • Add-On Activation and AI Deployment: Deploy and optimize advanced AI add-ons like AI Assist Pro and AI Voice/Messaging Agent optimization (following FDE-led engagements), building customer-specific AI adoption playbooks and becoming a regional expert in AI-enabled workflows.

  • Complex Implementations and Solution Architecture: Serve as the technical architect and owner for advanced configurations, challenging integrations, and custom workflow builds, coordinating closely with Engineering, Product, and internal technical experts to deliver bespoke solutions when needed.

  • Proactive Monitoring and Advanced Troubleshooting: Review product telemetry, integration performance, and usage patterns to anticipate issues before they surface, and lead root-cause analysis on the most complex product or integration issues that fall outside standard CE motions.

  • Escalation Management for Strategic Accounts: Coordinate high-impact escalations end-to-end, driving internal alignment, providing technical direction, leading communication, and maintaining executive trust through to clear resolution.

  • Product Feedback and Technical Leadership: Identify recurring technical themes and capability gaps from strategic accounts to inform the product roadmap, mentor CEs and Scaled CEs, and elevate the technical craft across the organization through example rather than people management.

Qualifications:

  • Deep Technical Expertise: Strong command of VoIP fundamentals, APIs, integrations, webhooks, data flows, authentication models, cloud architectures, and customer tech stacks, with the ability to read and interpret code (JavaScript, Python, or similar).
