title: Senior Lead Engineer
description:
Role summary

The Senior Lead Engineer will play a pivotal role in the engineering function, contributing to the effective execution of engineering activities across projects and tenders. You will be an integral part of our skilled, multidisciplinary engineering teams in Sweden and Norway. You will lead and collaborate with teams on a wide range of transmission and distribution (T&D) substation projects and tenders. Responsibilities include technical leadership, design, design reviews, technical analysis, compliance with applicable codes and standards and coordination with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

The role is responsible for ensuring that projects are delivered in compliance with applicable processes and safety standards, on time, within budget, and in accordance with quality requirements. The role also includes identifying, capturing, managing, and resolving deviations throughout project execution.

Design & Engineering

  • Ensure inputs and manage the electrical, mechanical, and structural design aspects following the project requirements.

  • Maintains the interfaces between the different disciplines to ensure consistent solutions from a holistic perspective.

  • Participate in technical discussions with customers and suppliers, handle site queries, and take necessary actions up to as-built documentation

  • Ensure that all documents are reviewed for quality before they are submitted to customers or vendors.

  • Perform complex engineering calculations and analyses.

  • Review and approve equipment and materials.

Project Management

  • Lead engineering activities across all phases of substation projects.

  • Track project progress, schedules, and deliverables.

  • Provide cost estimates and risk mitigation strategies.

  • Customer Interaction and Site Support: Engage in technical discussions with customers, address site queries, and take necessary actions through to the completion of as-built documentation

Compliance & Standard

  • Ensure designs meet company, local, state, and national codes (IEEE, IEC, NESC, ANSI).

  • Maintain engineering documentation and quality control.

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide technical guidance to engineers and designers.

  • Mentor junior staff and support their professional development.

  • Liaise with contractors and vendors on standards and best practicesTender Support and Technical Development: Provide technical support for tendering processes, including the development of scheme options and related project scope documentation.

Qualifications and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant engineering discipline

  • 10 years, Experience with transformer substation design

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills.

  • Good knowledge in Substation design. (SLD, Layouts, Primary design & calculations, Grounding & Lightning design, Steel design inputs, transformers, HV & MV Switchgear systems)

  • Knowledge of system studies like load flow, short circuit calculation, insulation coordination, Single Line Diagrams, CT/VT calculations, Auxiliary Power Systems, and power cables.

  • Experience working with Nordic utility companies is an advantage.

Personal attributes

  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

  • Willingness to travel for site assessments and project meetings.

  • Structured and detail oriented.

  • Proactive and solution driven.

  • International travel is required.

What we offer

  • A key role in exciting, future-oriented projects within the energy sector

  • Autonomy in your work and decision-making responsibilities

  • Opportunities for continuous professional growth and development

  • A strong, collaborative, and supportive team culture

  • Long-term career prospects within a growing and forward-thinking organization

Recruitment process

We do not accept applications by email. We will review all applications and make an initial selection. Selected candidates will be invited to a first interview by phone. Final candidates will then be invited to an in-person interview at our office in Chennai.

Office location

COWRKS Rmz Millenia Business Park, 600096 Chennai Tamil Nadu, India

About Linjemontage

Linjemontage is a Swedish pure-play EPC provider within power infrastructure, enabling the modernisation and expansion of the Nordic electricity grid. The company provides turnkey solutions within substations and transmission and distribution networks, with capabilities across the entire project value chain and specialist high-voltage expertise up to 400 kV. The company currently has approximately 400 employees. Operations are primarily conducted in Sweden and Norway, complemented by a business branch in Croatia and an operation centre in India. Linjemontage was founded in Grästorp in 1993 and the company’s shares have been listed on Nasdaq Stockholm since 2026. For more information, visit

title: Client Engagement Manager
description:
We're looking for a Client Engagement Manager to join our remote team (Mirantis Customer Success Team). You'll be working closely with our clients and ensuring they get the most impact out of their solutions with us. These solutions include Mirantis Container Cloud, Mirantis Kubernetes Engine, Mirantis Secure Registry, and Mirantis Container Runtime.

You’ll be the client’s key contact, handling important conversations, keeping billing, admin, and contracts on track, and stepping in with a calm head if the unexpected happens. A big part of your role is communicating and keeping people aligned both internally and externally. Running client meetings and syncs, showing clients how their setup is performing with real numbers, and flagging potential concerns based on what the data is telling you. Internally you’ll act as the central link between our tech, product, and finance teams to make sure client onboardings, handoffs, and everyday requests are dealt with effectively.

Mirantis’ Customer Success team’s goal is to delight millions of developers and system administrators who rely on the Mirantis Container platform to build, share, and run their distributed applications all over the world. Our customer base spans from individuals to SMBs to large global enterprises. As Mirantis continues to grow and serve more and more enterprise clients globally, our team is setting our sights on finding creative ways to scale efficiency while simultaneously increasing customer satisfaction.

Working Location:

This is a fully remote position, however we do require you to be based in an Americas Time Zone
(UTC - 4 to UTC - 7)

What you'll do:

  • Own the client relationship
    Be the primary point of contact for your clients day to day. Act as the direct liaison for client escalations and negotiate client communication with tact and diplomacy. Serve as the driver of internal alignment and communication on client topics and updates, and ensure client invoicing and administration is up to date and accurate.

  • Drive client health and awareness
    Monitor Key Performance indicators, and run client "kick off" meetings, regular (monthly) update calls, and Quarterly Business Reviews. Ensure the clients are well looked after, engaged, and fully in the loop on the health of their infrastructure and hosting with data backed metrics. Use this data to keep clients up to date with concerns or future challenges - focusing on business impact and solutions.

Project lead client on and offboardings and ensure internal alignment across the onboarding teams. Ensure client feedback reaches product managers, and coordinate across Support, Engineering, Finance, Sales, and Product to ensure client requests, deliverables, and commitments move forward without getting stuck.

    Work with your clients to understand their concerns, wishes for new offerings or services, and future events or hosting changes to prepare for. Identify growth opportunities within your existing clients to further embed the Mirantis offering

  • Travel as required

What you'll bring:

  • Experience as a Project Manager or Account Manager managing enterprise clients within a cloud hosting environment.

  • A general understanding of cloud hosting concepts and infrastructure, and experience working closely with technical teams.

  • An empathetic and collaborative nature, which allows you to bring stakeholders together under common goals.

  • An ability to create your own structure - building meetings agendas, briefing cross-functional teams before meetings, tracking deliverable deadlines across Jira/ticketing tools, and methodically tracking and addressing items.

  • You communicate in an effective and clear manner, can engage technical and non technical stakeholders equally as well, and enjoy working directly with other humans and solving challenges together.

Mirantis is dedicated to providing a work environment of trust, transparency, and inclusion for everyone. We are heavily committed as an Equal Opportunity Employer, striving to maintain a work environment where we can all feel comfortable, valued, and free to achieve our best.

As a remote first company we offer flexibility when it comes to working hours and location, helping you to manage personal circumstances and work/life harmony. Here's more details on what to expect.

What we’ll bring:

  • A collaborative and open team and environment to work within, support, and learn from

  • A competitive compensation package, alongside a benefits plan that supports peace of mind and security (401(k), Healthcare, Dental, Vision, disability benefits etc.)

What’s next?:

Apply! Send us your CV and cover letter showcasing who you are, your skills and experience, and anything else you think we should know. Our team will reach out to you to let you know it’s been received, and we’ll review your application.

  • Work for an established leader in the Cloud Native industry with over 800 enterprise customers, HQ’d in Silicon Valley.

title: Staff/Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, Federal
location: Seattle, WA or McLean, VA (Preferred) or Remote (USA)
description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Trase

Trase is the operating system for high-stakes environments, providing end-to-end solutions for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI within industries where security, governance, and data sovereignty are non-negotiable.

Our HIPAA- and SOC 2-compliant platform bridges the “last mile” of AI adoption, empowering sectors like healthcare and national security to run trustworthy, predictable AI agents across any model or environment—whether in the cloud, on-prem, or at the edge—with unified policy enforcement, continuous monitoring, and fully immutable audit trails.

Trase’s suite of products includes Origin, its agentic operating system; Leagues, its marketplace for specialized, configurable, ready-to-deploy agents; and Arena, where developers build, evaluate, and package the agents that run on Origin. The company has repeatedly topped Hugging Face’s GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, placing it firmly at the forefront of AI-agent innovation.

About the Role

As a Staff/Senior Staff Technical Program Manager at Trase, you will own technical program execution dedicated to Red Cell Federal (RCF) and Red Cell Partners (RCP) incubations and portfolio companies. You will join Trase's dedicated RCF/RCP support team, with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

Red Cell Partners is an investment and incubation firm that builds and supports technology companies, including Trase. Red Cell Federal is our federal-focused partner within that ecosystem. This role helps RCF and other RCP partner companies adopt and operate Trase OS in their own environments. You will turn partner requirements into secure, reliable deployments and sustained operational support, with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

You will work with a dedicated team of full-stack software engineers and DevOps/SRE engineers, partnering closely with Trase Platform Engineering, Product, GRC, and RCF/RCP technical leaders. Your scope spans partner onboarding, integrations, environment readiness, releases, and ongoing support for RCF and RCP portfolio companies.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will drive decisions, resolve dependencies, and hold delivery commitments accountable from initial request through validated customer acceptance.

Scope of Responsibilities

  • Own RCF/RCP program delivery: translate ambiguous requests into scoped user stories, acceptance criteria, owners, dependencies, and small, testable milestones. Confirm feasibility with engineers before committing dates.
  • Establish a single intake and prioritized backlog with Product and RCF/RCP counterparts. Distinguish production blockers, security obligations, and committed customer needs from exploratory requests; keep partner-facing plans aligned with engineering execution.
  • Drive secure deployment readiness across customer-managed cloud, private-network, and on-premises environments. Track infrastructure prerequisites, access, networking, secrets, model-provider integrations, and end-to-end workflow validation.
  • Partner with GRC and security owners to incorporate applicable RMF/ATO, STIG, and impact-level requirements into delivery plans. Drive engineering remediation, evidence readiness, and approval dependencies while maintaining clear Trase/RCF/RCP responsibility boundaries.
  • Coordinate release and image handoffs, including versioning, compatibility, vulnerability scan results, software bills of materials, release manifests, deployment guides, and rollback readiness. Verify readiness before partner delivery.
  • Drive ongoing support for federal deployments, including Second Front where applicable: track patching, hardening, upgrades, security findings, and sustainment commitments with named engineering and GRC owners.
  • Coordinate partner issue triage and technical escalations across the dedicated team and shared platform teams. Drive closure of integration, performance, reliability, and observability gaps against agreed acceptance criteria.
  • Build repeatable onboarding and operational handoffs through runbooks, architecture and data-flow documentation, training, and knowledge transfer so partner teams can operate and repeat deployments.
  • Run planning, grooming, delivery reviews, and risk escalation. Give technical and executive stakeholders clear visibility into commitments, capacity, dependencies, tradeoffs, and decisions; surface reusable partner needs for the core platform roadmap.

Staff / Sr. Staff Expectations

  • Staff: independently lead complex RCF/RCP programs across engineering, security, operations, and partner teams; resolve ambiguity and drive measurable delivery and operational outcomes.
  • Senior Staff: lead a portfolio of interdependent RCF/RCP programs; shape the engagement and delivery model, influence roadmap and investment tradeoffs with senior leaders, and establish practices that scale across partner deployments.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship is required. Ability and willingness to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance, as required by assigned programs.
  • 8–10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering, or related technical delivery roles, with demonstrated Staff-level scope; broader multi-program leadership and organizational influence for Sr. Staff.
  • Track record of delivering complex software, infrastructure, or platform programs to external customers, including secure or regulated environments.
  • Strong technical judgment and experience leading cross-team execution, prioritization, risk management, and customer-facing escalations under ambiguity.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, security specialists, partner teams, and executives, including the ability to challenge unclear requirements and negotiate realistic commitments.

Technical Depth

  • Understand distributed systems, APIs, agent workflows, and integration boundaries well enough to inspect technical plans, challenge assumptions, and lead tradeoff discussions.
  • Experience with cloud and/or on-premises deployments, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, networking, identity/access, and secrets management.
  • Working familiarity with secure software delivery, vulnerability remediation, audit logging, observability, and operational readiness.
  • Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into engineering deliverables and validation evidence in partnership with GRC.

Strongly Preferred

  • Prior TPM experience supporting national security, defense, federal agencies, or other government programs, including work with government customers and delivery partners.
  • An active U.S. government security clearance.
  • Experience navigating RMF/ATO processes, STIG hardening, POA&M remediation tracking, or DoD IL4/IL5/IL6 environments.
  • Experience with Second Front or comparable federal deployment platforms, government cloud environments, and ongoing support of authorized systems.
  • Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, agent integrations, or developer tools across multiple partner organizations.

Working Style

  • High ownership, sound judgment, and proactive follow-through.
  • Comfortable moving between technical detail and executive decisions.
  • Practical, collaborative, and focused on customer outcomes and repeatable delivery.

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

Salary Range: $220,000-260,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

#LI-RCP

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.

title: Data Architect
description:
We are looking for a Data Architect to join our team of around 1,700 people worldwide to help us power up the traveller's journey for millions of holidaymakers. If you are a master at infrastructure as code and cloud solution architecture, and passionate about teamwork and knowledge sharing, keep on reading, as you might be the perfect fit for this job.

The job in brief:

Job Title - Data Architect

Working model - hybrid from Chiasso

Team - you will join the Data Platform & Architecture team within the Data department.
Level - Professional

Location - Chiasso, Switzerland

Contract - Permanent - full-time (36 h/week)

What your impact will be:

  • Lead the architecture of our modern data stack on BigQuery and dbt, setting the patterns, standards and trade-offs that new and migrated workloads follow.

  • Design and evolve the architecture of our GCP data platform (BigQuery, Cloud Composer/Airflow, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, GCS), including how we build and deploy data services and AI agents, all managed as infrastructure as code with Terraform and GitLab CI.

  • Own the data ingestion layer, from batch and CDC replication to event streams, with clear standards for reliability, freshness, cost and schema evolution.

  • Define and maintain the cross-cutting foundations of the platform: access management and security, cost efficiency (FinOps), data lineage and observability.

  • Act as the technical reference for data engineers and analysts: review designs, write architecture decision records, and turn recurring solutions into reusable assets (Terraform modules, templates, documentation, AI context).

Your expertise:

  • Proven hands-on experience designing and running data platforms on a public cloud, ideally GCP. We care more about what you’ve designed and built than about the number of years.

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills with Terraform and CI/CD (GitLab CI or similar), plus a solid grasp of cloud IAM, networking and containerised workloads (Kubernetes, Cloud Run).

  • Deep knowledge of BigQuery or a comparable cloud data warehouse: data modelling, partitioning and clustering, performance and cost optimisation.

  • Hands-on experience with dbt and Airflow/Cloud Composer, and Python for automation and lightweight services.

  • The ability to explain architectural trade-offs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders alike and to drive decisions through to completion, with fluent written and spoken English.

Desirable:

  • Experience building and deploying AI agents, and daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude), including writing the context (instruction files, skills, glossaries) that makes them reliable.

  • Experience with data integration and streaming tools in production, such as Airbyte, Debezium/CDC or Kafka.

  • Familiarity with data governance practices: data contracts, lineage, semantic or metric layers used by BI tools and AI agents.

Perks of working with us:

How we work together:

  • An inclusive, friendly, and international environment (you’ll be working with colleagues from +10 countries and over 48 nationalities)
  • Shorter working week (36h as full time), with a half working day on Fridays
  • Flexible start and end of the working day, with core hours from 10:00 to 4:00 pm
  • Possibility to work from anywhere for a period of time per year defined according to local regulations

How we learn together:

  • Fri-Yays: half a day on Friday morning with a no-meeting mandate and dedicated to deep work, personal growth, learning and training and/or focus time.
  • Professional and managerial skills development training paths, access to e-learning platforms such as O’reilly, Udemy, Coursera (depending on the department), and to our internal platform offering bespoke training content

Other perks:

  • 2 paid days off per year for volunteering purposes
  • Occasional social events to foster connections among colleagues
  • Travel industry discounts and flash exclusive staff fares
  • We support our employees through life's significant moments with leave options (e.g parental responsibilities, marriages, bereavements, relocations, etc.) in line with local laws.

Wish you were here? We do, too!

Selection process steps*:

  • HR interview (30 minutes)

  • 1st interview (Manager): soft skills

  • 2nd interview (Team): technical knowledge

  • Offer extended

(*Please note the process can slightly vary. The recruiter in charge will share more details when setting up the interview)

Our commitment to celebrate diversity and generate belonging

At the heart of our culture is a commitment to inclusion across race, gender, age, sexual orientation, religion, gender identity or expression, and accessibility. We strongly believe in an equal opportunity space, which is welcoming and celebrates the uniqueness of everyone who works here. We value different lived experiences and respect viewpoints, as we know unicity drives innovation. We want to make sure our people reflect the communities across the world we help travel.

title: Certification Lead
description:
Make your mark at BRE!

BRE is a world-leading global organisation for innovation, science and data in the built environment. For over 100 years, we have supported governments, businesses and industry with pioneering research, testing and expertise. We are focused on growth, scale and expanding our global impact with products, services, standards and qualifications that address the challenges of a changing world. Driven by our purpose of helping everyone, in every building, everywhere, we are creating a safer, more sustainable built environment for people and planet.

Your role at BRE

As Certification Lead, you'll provide strategic, operational and commercial leadership across BRE's certification and assurance portfolio. You'll be responsible for ensuring certification schemes operate effectively, fairly and in line with accreditation and regulatory requirements, while also identifying opportunities to develop new services and drive business growth.

Working closely with technical, commercial and senior leadership teams, you'll oversee certification governance, accreditation, quality systems and decision-making processes. You'll lead experienced teams, manage key stakeholder relationships and ensure certification activities maintain the highest levels of integrity, consistency and impartiality. At the same time, you'll help shape future services that meet evolving customer, market and regulatory needs.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the strategic direction and operational performance of certification and assurance services.

  • Ensure certification activities are delivered in line with accreditation requirements, industry standards and governance frameworks.

  • Maintain robust, impartial and evidence-based certification decision-making processes.

  • Oversee quality management systems, accreditation activities and compliance arrangements.

  • Drive the development and enhancement of certification schemes and assurance services.

  • Manage budgets, commercial performance and resource planning for the function.

  • Build and develop high-performing teams through coaching, succession planning and capability development.

  • Work closely with customers, regulators, accreditation bodies and industry stakeholders.

  • Support business growth by identifying new opportunities while protecting the integrity and independence of certification activities.

  • Monitor changes in regulations, standards and market requirements to inform future strategy.

What we are looking for

We're looking for a senior leader with experience in certification, assurance, compliance, conformity assessment or a similarly regulated environment who can balance strong governance with commercial and operational leadership.

You'll ideally have:

  • Significant leadership experience within certification, assurance, accreditation, compliance or conformity assessment services.

  • Experience operating within UKAS-accredited or similarly regulated environments.

  • A strong understanding of certification governance, quality systems, accreditation requirements and controlled decision-making processes.

  • Experience managing budgets, commercial performance and P&L accountability.

  • A track record of leading teams, developing capability and driving organisational performance.

  • Experience developing or improving certification schemes, assurance services or governance frameworks.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, regulators, accreditation bodies and industry partners.

  • Excellent commercial awareness, strategic thinking and change leadership capability.

  • Experience managing impartiality, governance risks and complex decision-making processes.

  • Experience with ISO/IEC 17065, ISO/IEC 17067, UKAS accreditation, certification scheme development, or working with standards bodies, trade associations and regulatory organisations would be particularly valuable.

BRE Benefits

At BRE, we offer a competitive salary, reviewed annually, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial security, well-being, and career development.

Financial & Security Benefits

  • Pension scheme – 5% employer-matched contribution

  • Life assurance – 4x your basic salary

  • Enhanced maternity package

Health & Wellbeing

  • HealthPartners cashback scheme – Reclaim costs on prescriptions, physiotherapy, dental care, and more

  • Onsite facilities – Restaurant, nursery, and free parking, including at-cost EV charging points

Career Development

  • Learning & development – Free access to BRE Academy and our online learning platform

  • Professional membership reimbursement

For full details on our benefits, visit: BRE Employee Benefits

Work Location Options

Hybrid – This role offers a mix of home and office working. You will need to be within commuting distance of our Watford office, as you will be expected to attend in person (2-3 times per week depending on business needs).

Our Recruitment Process

As part of our recruitment process we will be conducting 10-30 minute phone screening calls via an AI recruiter called Ryan with all shortlisted candidates. The information gathered from this screening will be used to help assess your suitability for the position.

Note to Employment Agencies

At BRE, we value the relationships we have built with our preferred recruitment partners. We do not accept unsolicited CVs from employment agencies. Any CVs submitted directly to a BRE employee or hiring manager without a signed BRE Employment Agency Agreement and an active engagement for the specific role will be considered unsolicited. In such cases, no fees will be payable should the candidate be hired through this or any other means.

Equal Opportunities Statement

BRE is an equal opportunities employer. We assess all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the grounds of race, colour, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Data Science Engineer
description:
Are you a data-driven engineer who wants to improve complex offshore operations through automated decision support and practical software solutions?

At DSE, we automate the boring and strengthen informed decision-making. We turn data and processes into meaningful tools that help optimise OE’s business. We excel at delivering software solutions that empower the organisation.

As a DSE-er, you will turn engineering knowledge, operational data and advanced algorithms into practical solutions for global tenders, engineering studies and offshore projects. Depending on the challenge, you will work on:

  • Data Integration & Visualisation
  • Generative AI, including LLMs, NLP & Machine Learning
  • Planning, Simulation & Optimisation
  • Engineering Business Optimisation
  • Software Engineering

You will develop Python-based models and applications using platforms such as Azure DevOps and Databricks. Working closely with our Offshore Energy business units, you will help optimise project execution, fleet deployment and the performance of offshore assets such as our Bokalift crane vessels.

We are looking for someone with a background in engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, operations research or a related field, with experience or a strong interest in data science, simulation, optimisation, generative AI or Python software development.

Experience in offshore energy or maritime contracting is an advantage, but not essential. More important are curiosity, analytical thinking and the ability to translate engineering and business challenges into reliable, transparent and usable solutions. We encourage continuous learning and provide on-the-job support to help you develop your expertise.

Your responsibilities as a data science engineer:

  • Develop and implement DSE solutions with and for the Offshore Energy business units, improving the commercial and operational performance of tenders and projects.
  • Develop our capabilities in planning, simulation, and optimization, considering factors such as fleet capacity, weather conditions, and unforeseen events.
  • Develop and improve Python models and applications in close collaboration with colleagues from the business.
  • Integrate and visualize data to create web applications and dashboards that support engineering and operational decision-making.
  • Apply generative AI, including LLMs and NLP, as well as machine learning, where these technologies add practical business value.
  • Apply professional software-engineering practices to create reliable, reusable, and maintainable solutions.

We will guide and coach you to work in our development toolchain and the Boskalis business, for you to quickly:

  • Identify opportunities for data integration and visualisation, generative AI, including LLMs and NLP, machine learning, simulation, optimization, and automation.
  • Understand the needs of multidisciplinary project teams and independently translate them into practical DSE solutions.
  • Combine engineering knowledge, data, and algorithms to improve business and operational performance.
  • Act as a knowledgeable DSE partner for other departments by sharing expertise and inspiring the effective use of data-driven solutions.

Your qualities
You can make your mark as data science engineer if you have:

  • An MSc degree in computer science, applied mathematics, econometrics, computational engineering, or a related engineering discipline, such as civil, offshore, dredging or applied physics.
  • Experience in analyzing data and developing data-driven design-decision models using methods such as machine learning, engineering optimisation, constraint programming or advanced metaheuristic algorithms, discrete-event simulation, finite-element modelling.
  • Experience in developing Python-based software is essential.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, PySpark or Databricks is an advantage, but not required.
  • A proactive attitude, the ability to collaborate effectively within the team and the wider organisation, and a strong curiosity and drive to learn.
  • A good command of written and spoken English.
  • A dynamic environment: A job where you can make an impact, in an earth-moving company, as part of a diverse, international team of experts.
  • Rewarding conditions: A competitive salary and much more, including holiday allowance, holiday entitlement of 31 days (based on a full-time contract), a non-contributory pension scheme, collective schemes such as company health insurance and travel allowance.
  • Career development: Plenty of opportunities to realize your full potential. Challenge yourself with (online) courses in our Boskalis academy.
  • The Boskalis campus: Experience the unique Boskalis Campus (6 main Buildings in Papendrecht and 1 in Abu Dhabi), complete with restaurants, sports fields, and a wharf where our vessels dock. We offer a state-of-the-art auditorium, brainstorming rooms, experience center for client meetings, and a barista corner where you can connect with colleagues.
  • Young Boskalis: Are you under 36? Come and join Young Boskalis! Have fun and join in social and sports activities ranging from pub quizzes to yoga, bootcamps, and an annual sailing boat race. Networking and knowledge sharing are a vital part of Young Boskalis as well.

Extra information

  • Your team: You will be part of small, mostly young, and diverse team of data engineers, software developers, and domain architects.
  • Where you will work: For office-based roles, in consultation with your manager and your team, you work partly at home and partly in the office. Occasionally, it is required to do short business trips abroad.
  • Full/part-time job: Depending on what you prefer the position is full-time (40 hours a week) or part-time (32 hours a week)
  • Next steps: Apply easily by completing the online application form. Interviews are held online or in the office. Once it’s clear we’re a good match, we’ll make you an offer – and look forward to welcoming you to the company.

We are more than happy to answer your questions about the position of Data Science Engineer. Please contact Thijs Wanders, Recruiter via thijs.wanders@boskalis.com

Please note: Boskalis never requests a financial contribution to arrange visas or other documents related to a job vacancy. Be wary of individuals who pretend to be our recruiters and do ask for such contributions.

Disclaimer for recruitment and selection agencies

We don’t accept any unsolicited applications or CVs from recruitment and selection agencies. In general, we don’t appreciate acquisition and this also applies to Boskalis colleagues or associated Boskalis companies.

title: Business Partner - Agder
description:
Er du vår nye Business Partner i Agder?

Er du en kommersiell leder med lidenskap for drift og utvikling?

Burger King søker en Business Partner i Agder og omegn – en nøkkelrolle for deg som ønsker å drive vekst, utvikle mennesker og sikre operasjonell kvalitet i samarbeid med våre selvstendige Partner Operators.

Som Business Partner er du bindeleddet mellom King Food AS og våre Partner Operators. Rollen kombinerer forretningsforståelse med hands-on ledelse, og du får ansvar for å sikre at Partner Operators leverer på sin forretningsplan – samtidig som merkevarens standarder og langsiktige vekst ivaretas. 🚀

Hvem er vi?

Burger King har vært en del av nordmenns hverdag siden 1988, og vi har alltid vært kjent for våre flammegrillede burgere og uforglemmelige smaker som hver dag serveres av våre fantastiske medarbeidere i våre 108 restauranter i Norge. Vi er ikke bare en QSR-kjede – vi er kongeriket av burgere, hvor innovasjon, kvalitet og en uforglemmelig gjesteopplevelse regjerer. Vi er stedet hvor Gjesten er Kongen, Whopperen er kronprinsen, og pommes frites er hoffet. Nå søker vi en Business Partner som kan hjelpe oss med å løfte samarbeidet med våre Partner Operators til nye, episke høyder. 🚀🍔👑

Din rolle

Som Business Partner i Burger King får du en sentral rolle i å utvikle og støtte våre Partner Operators i Agder og omegn. Du representerer hovedkontoret og jobber tett med partnerne for å sikre at deres restauranter leverer på både økonomiske mål og merkevarens standarder. Du leder business reviews, initierer tiltak for vekst og forbedring, og bidrar aktivt til utvikling av både drift og ledelse. Rollen kombinerer strategisk innsikt med operativ forståelse – og gir deg muligheten til å påvirke kvalitet, lønnsomhet og gjesteopplevelse i hele porteføljen.

Stillingens ansvarsområder:

  • Samarbeide med Partner Operator for å nå økonomiske og operasjonelle mål

  • Kvalitetssikre gjennomføring og oppfølging av business reviews og styremøter

  • Følge opp restaurantresultater og initiere forbedringstiltak

  • Sikre etterlevelse av Burger Kings konsept og standarder

  • Coache og utvikle lederteamet hos Partner Operator

  • Bidra til åpning av nye restauranter og investeringer i din region

Hvem er du?

Du er en resultatorientert leder med sterk kommersiell forståelse og evne til å bygge tillitsbaserte relasjoner. Du trives med å jobbe både strategisk og operativt, og har erfaring fra retail, serveringsbransjen eller QSR. Du har høy gjennomføringskraft, god økonomisk sans og evner å utvikle sterke lederteam. Du er lojal mot merkevaren og inspirerer andre til å etterleve Burger Kings verdier – hver eneste dag.

Kvalifikasjoner og erfaring

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Du har ledererfaring fra drift av flere enheter

  • Du har erfaring med økonomisk oppfølging, budsjettering og forretningsplanlegging

  • Du har god forståelse for operasjonelle rutiner og kvalitetsstandarder

  • Du har sterke kommunikasjons- og coachingferdigheter

  • Du behersker norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du behersker engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig

  • Du har høy grad av motstandsdyktighet og trives med høyt tempo

Vi tilbyr:

En nøkkelrolle i et selskap i vekst, med stor påvirkningskraft og mulighet til å utvikle både mennesker og forretning.

Du får:

  • Full opplæring og kontinuerlig støtte fra Operations teamet

  • Tett samarbeid med sentrale funksjoner som HR, markedsføring og økonomi

  • Mulighet til å jobbe med en av verdens mest ikoniske merkevarer

  • En variert og utviklende arbeidshverdag med stort ansvar og frihet

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter for de som bygger en organisasjon som er klar for videre vekst!

  • Konkurransedyktig kompensasjonspakke

Klar for å bli med på reisen?

Høres dette spennende ut for deg? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

Send inn din CV og søknad via vårt digitale rekrutteringssystem – og du vil høre fra oss så snart vi har vurdert din søknad.

Søknader sendt på e-post vil ikke bli behandlet.

title: Principal Architect
description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

Job Role: Principal Architect
Location: United States (Remote/Hybrid, client-facing travel as needed)

Experience: 11+ years minimum, 8+ years in Solution/Technical Architecture

Role Summary:

The Principal Architect is the senior-most technical authority and executive-facing owner of the overall solution architecture for the account. This is a client-facing, decision-making role accountable for technical credibility with the client's executive and engineering leadership, and for the integrity of the architecture across every workstream. Delivery on this account uses an agent-orchestrated development model — the Principal Architect is expected to direct AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) directly for spikes and validation, not only delegate to human engineers. The final technology stack is not yet finalized (it may or may not end up being Python + React), so this role is intentionally technology-agnostic rather than tied to a specific platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Own the end-to-end solution architecture for the account, ensuring alignment with business goals and enterprise architecture standards, independent of whichever technology stack is ultimately selected.
  2. Define and defend the target-state architecture and roadmap directly to client executive stakeholders and governance/Change Board forums.
  3. Drive technical design decisions across application architecture, APIs, integrations, cloud infrastructure, and non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security, reliability).
  4. Set coding standards, design patterns, and technology choices across workstreams once the stack is confirmed, and keep design options open and unbiased until that decision is made.
  5. Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs) before implementation begins; hold final sign-off authority on architecture decisions and technical design changes, including authority to block releases that violate architectural standards.
  6. Evaluate and integrate new tools, frameworks, and AI/agentic development capabilities into the delivery model.
  7. Direct and prompt AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or equivalent) directly for architecture-level proofs of concept, technical spikes, and feasibility validation.
  8. Partner with the Tech Product Manager and Delivery Lead to align architecture with delivery timelines and prioritization.
  9. Provide technical leadership and mentoring to the India-based Principal Architect and Solution Architect, ensuring one coherent architecture across delivery locations.
  10. Escalate cross-cutting architectural risks and represent the account technically to the client's engineering leadership.

Required Qualifications

  1. 11+ years in enterprise technology roles with 8+ years owning solution architecture on client-facing, multi-workstream programs.
  2. Proven experience as the client-facing architecture owner, comfortable defending design decisions to VP/C-level stakeholders and formal governance bodies.
  3. Deep, current fluency in modern application architecture, API/integration design, cloud infrastructure, and non-functional requirements — technology-agnostic, with the ability to architect confidently on whichever stack is ultimately chosen.
  4. Hands-on experience directing or prompting AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code or an equivalent agentic development tool) as part of an agent-orchestrated delivery model — required, as this engagement is delivered using AI-assisted development.
  5. Track record of resolving ambiguous, evolving requirements into a defensible, phased architecture.

Good To Have

  1. Enterprise architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF) or a cloud/platform architect certification relevant to the eventual stack.
  2. Experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare distribution or another regulated industry.
  3. Prior experience architecting within an AI-agent-orchestrated or "generative" development delivery model.

Information Security Responsibilities

  • Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

title: Senior DevOps Engineer, OpenStack Team
description:
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join the MOSK (Mirantis OpenStack for Kubernetes) product team, working at the intersection of OpenStack, Kubernetes, and product engineering. In this role, you will help design, validate, and evolve a cloud-native OpenStack platform that enables customers to build and operate enterprise-grade private clouds at scale.

As a senior engineer, you will act as a technical authority on OpenStack and MOSK behavior, contribute to architectural decisions, support complex customer scenarios, and help ensure stable, high-quality product releases.

Key Responsibilities

Feature Design & Development

  • Contribute to Product Roadmap: Actively influence the MOSK roadmap and backlog by providing technical input on feature feasibility, architectural scalability, and long-term maintainability. Evaluate incoming customer requests for specific features by analyzing upstream OpenStack code, specifications, blueprints, and community documentation to assess feature maturity, stability, limitations, and operational caveats.
  • Lifecycle Management Engineering: Design, implement, and document lifecycle management for OpenStack on Kubernetes — a core MOSK capability — with emphasis on non-disruptive upgrades, patching, scaling, rollback strategies, and feature compatibility across upgrades.
  • Feature Validation & Integration: Drive validation of enabled features by defining test scenarios, validating upstream code behavior in simulated or production-like deployments, and then integrating feature support into MOSK’s lifecycle management.
  • Technical Design Reviews: Review and refine product designs, APIs, and implementations to ensure robustness, security, and a high-quality developer experience.
  • Engineering Leadership: Lead design discussions, planning sessions, and retrospectives; help the team to uphold high standards for software quality, architectural rigor, and operational readiness.

Product Engineering & Automation

  • Frameworks & Tooling Development: Design, implement, and maintain core frameworks, libraries, and internal tools that underpin MOSK development, testing, and lifecycle operations.
  • Advanced Automation: Build and evolve automation for deploying and managing complex OpenStack-on-Kubernetes environments used in development, testing, and validation.
  • CI/CD Architecture: Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines and integrations with external systems to streamline build, test, validation, upgrade, and release workflows.

Operational Reliability

  • Tier-3 Escalation Support: Debug and resolve complex issues in customer production environments involving Kubernetes, OpenStack, networking, storage, and distributed systems.
  • Upstream Troubleshooting & Contributions: Investigate issues in OpenStack services, analyze root causes at the code level, and propose or contribute minor fixes upstream to improve product stability and supportability.
  • Performance & Scalability Analysis: Identify and analyze performance bottlenecks across hardware and software layers; provide fixes, optimizations, and tuning recommendations.
  • Operational Readiness: Manage and improve development, staging, and validation environments that closely mirror customer deployments to ensure release stability.
  • Product Knowledge Authority: Act as an authoritative technical source for MOSK and OpenStack behavior, providing accurate, engineering-level input to documentation, field, and enablement teams to ensure correctness and consistency of product documentation and guidance. Participate in technical reviews, demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions to support engineering and other customer-facing teams.

Experience & Education

  • At least 5 years of practical administration experience in Linux (CentOS, Ubuntu, RHEL) as a server platform.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Experience in software development, Systems Administration, or SRE role.

Technical Skills

  • Operating Systems: Deep understanding of the OS, ability to debug and tune underperforming systems, and troubleshoot software and hardware issues.
  • Networking: Strong knowledge of networking technologies, including protocols, firewalls, and VPNs. Experience with managing and configuring networking equipment.
  • Automation Tools: Practical experience with SaltStack, Puppet, Ansible, or Chef for medium and large environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Practical experience with Terraform.
  • Containerization: Be an expert in Docker and Kubernetes in production environments. Thorough understanding and practical experience with Kubernetes operators and Helm.
  • CI/CD: Strong experience with Jenkins and building dependable build/release pipelines.
  • Familiarity with code-review systems
  • Cloud Platforms: Understanding of principles of working in cloud environments such as OpenStack, AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Scripting & Programming: Strong scripting skills in Bash, Groovy, and Python (at least one is required). Mid-level experience with Go or C is valuable.

Preferred Qualifications (Will be a plus)

  • Deep understanding of OpenStack architecture and experience with running it in production.
  • Knowledge and experience with SDN (Software Defined Networking) solutions - Open Virtual Network, Open vSwitch.
  • Experience in managing and using Open Search, Grafana, and Prometheus stacks.
  • Contribution to open-source projects.

Soft Skills

  • English language proficiency at least at an intermediate level (spoken and written).
  • Good customer-facing communication skills and a sense of diplomacy.
  • Ability to work with geographically distributed international teams in a dynamic environment.
  • Analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

What does Mirantis offer you?

  • Work in a global, collaborative, remote-first culture that rewards initiative and execution.

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping the next era of cloud and AI modernisation.

  • Manage high-impact enterprise accounts with immediate opportunity for growth.

  • Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies.

  • Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation.

  • Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued.

  • Attend conferences and working groups.

  • Customized workstation (macOS, Windows).

  • Professional development and training.

  • Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and opportunities for advancement.

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com

title: Senior Art Director
description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences.

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results.

SENIOR ART DIRECTOR

LOCATION: Barcelona, Spain

REPORTING TO: Creative Director

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM

Working in direct partnership with a leading European pet care client (part of a major international food group), the Senior Art Director will lead the visual craft, conceptual design, and art direction for four iconic pet care brands.

Embedded within our dedicated on-site agency hub in Barcelona, you will partner closely with a Senior Copywriter to form a powerhouse conceptual creative duo. Working directly with the client's Global Brand Teams, your focus will be upstream and platform-defining: translating global strategy into arresting visual ideas, distinct brand identities, hero campaign assets, and comprehensive global master toolkits designed for worldwide impact.

This role is built for a visually ambitious, craft-obsessed Art Director who thrives on conceptual storytelling, setting high aesthetic standards, and creating campaigns that celebrate the bond between pets and pet parents globally.

WHAT IS REQUIRED

  • Conceptual campaign ideation: Partner with the Senior Copywriter to ideate, craft, and pitch big, multi-channel campaign platforms and visual territories for global briefs.
  • Global master toolkits & guidelines: Architect and design comprehensive visual master toolkits, campaign playbooks, photography and motion style guides, and design systems for global rollouts.
  • Visual craft & execution: Direct and craft high-end visual executions across the full campaign ecosystem, including brand films, digital and social activations, key visuals, print, packaging touchpoints, and retail/POS.
  • Art direction & shoot leadership: Provide visual direction on film and photography shoots, collaborating with production partners, directors, photographers, and retouchers to bring creative concepts to life.
  • AI proficiency: Comfort producing static images and videos with the help of different AI platforms is expected.
  • Client pitching & influence: Present visual concepts, design rationale, and art direction territories directly to the client's Global Brand Directors and marketing leads with clarity and conviction.
  • Brand guardianship: Ensure visual consistency, premium craft, and distinct identity separation across each of the four unique pet food brands.
  • Studio mentorship: Collaborate with and mentor designers, artworkers, and junior creatives, elevating the overall design and art direction benchmark across the studio.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE

  • Experience: 6+ years of art direction and conceptual design experience within top-tier advertising agencies, design studios, or dedicated creative setups.
  • Portfolio: An outstanding portfolio showcasing big-idea conceptual thinking, integrated global campaigns, impeccable typography, and modern digital and visual craft.
  • Sector background: Experience working on FMCG, CPG, Pet Care, or lifestyle brands is highly desirable. Experience developing distinct visual worlds for multiple brands within a single portfolio is a strong plus.
  • Global campaign scope: Demonstrated experience building global master toolkits, key visuals, and multi-market design systems (beyond local production and adaptation).
  • Technical mastery: Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma. Experience with motion graphics and video editing tools (After Effects, Premiere Pro) or 3D/AI creative tools is a distinct advantage.
  • Collaborative chemistry: Proven success working collaboratively in an Art Director / Copywriter team setup, with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
  • Languages: Professional working fluency in Spanish and English is essential, as these are the working languages for both local and global briefs, and for the day-to-day relationship with the client team in Barcelona.

Brand new outpatient site - The Goldman Pavilion - due to open early 2027!!

title: IT Systems Engineer
description:
Icarus was founded on the belief that the Stratosphere is the Forgotten Frontier and that reclaiming it will define the next era of aerospace and what is possible from the sky. The role

As an IT Systems Engineer, you will own internal IT from the laptop on a new hire's desk to the systems that keep our factory connected. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with end-to-end responsibility. You will configure hardware, administer systems, troubleshoot issues, write automation, and see projects through to a working result.

We need someone who can execute independently: understand the problem, decide what matters, get it working, and make sure it stays fixed. You should be equally comfortable helping a teammate recover access, tracing a network issue, deploying a fleet of devices, and eliminating a recurring task with a script. What you'll own

What we're looking for

title: Founding Head of Engineering - cmdr
description:
Help build the AI-native loan servicer.
Remote, U.S.

About cmdr

Servicing is the bedrock of lending. Every loan is serviced for its entire life. Someone collects the payments, tests the covenants, manages escrow, tracks insurance, spreads the borrower's financials and reports to investors. In the U.S., $5.1 trillion of commercial real estate debt needs servicing, and $1.5 trillion of it comes due in 2026 and 2027. Most of that work runs on platforms built in the 1980s and 1990s. Those platforms record what happened and leave everything else to people working from spreadsheets and inboxes. Covenant terms sit in PDFs that nobody re-reads until something goes wrong.

cmdr is building an AI-native loan servicer. We acquire servicers whole: their books, their people and their client relationships. Then we run every loan they hold on one live, sourced record. Our first acquisition, a commercial loan servicer with roughly $10 billion of loans under management, is in advanced discussions.

The record does the work that servicing depends on. We extract every term and covenant from the loan agreement, and every value carries the words it came from. AI reads, code computes, and a person confirms every exception. Each covenant becomes a tracked obligation: what the borrower owes, how often, what proves it, and the threshold. Obligations are checked as they happen, and a person is accountable for every decision. Agreement reading and human review run in production today.
The prize is larger than servicing. Servicing creates the live, sourced record that every other lending workflow runs on. We start with commercial real estate. Next comes underwriting and portfolio management on the same record, then private credit, auto, personal and student loans, and eventually finance beyond lending. We think autonomous finance starts here.

Why cmdr

  • A growth model that compounds. We buy the servicer, not its clients. Every acquired book moves onto one platform, so improvements ship once, and what one book teaches, the next inherits.
  • A working product on real loan files. Agreement reading and human review run in production, and we are building with lenders under NDA. You start with a working system and real books to run it on.
  • A founder who has taken real estate public. Drew Sterrett, our founder and CEO, co-founded and led LEX, which took individual commercial buildings public through single-asset IPOs.
  • Studio backing. Stackpoint, the Boston venture studio started by the co-founders of Notarize (now Proof) and Convene, committed our founding capital and is our operating partner. Its co-founders have created more than $2 billion in combined equity value. An institutional co-investment round is in progress.
  • Real influence from day one. You will shape strategy, product, culture and execution from the start.

The Role

You'll be cmdr’s technical leader. You'll lead engineers at mixed levels, from early-career to principal, and shape how the team grows from there.

This is a hands-on, player-coach seat that spans architecture, code, evals, and how the team operates. You'll take the first version of the platform, built with Stackpoint's studio team. Together with the founding engineers, you'll set the technical foundation every future engineer builds on.

What You'll Drive

1. Own the architecture and the technical bar

  • Lead system architecture, data models, and platform direction with the engineering team, and make the call when the team doesn't converge.
  • Decide what to build, buy, or integrate, and when a prototype has earned the investment to scale.
  • Keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient as volume grows and we expand to new agencies and states.
  • Set the engineering standards the team works to: code review, testing, and deployment.

2. Ship agentic AI that holds up on real transactions

  • Lead how the team builds extraction, classification, and retrieval over messy loan and lease documents, including integrations with the legacy software, portals, and email- and file-based workflows the industry still runs on.
  • Define the evaluation system and guardrails: measure accuracy and confidence before anything ships, and decide what work goes to human review.

3. Build the human-in-the-loop product

  • Lead the build of the internal operations console where loan servicers review, correct, and approve AI output all day, with their corrections feeding back into evaluation.
  • Shape the client-facing experience servicers use to board loans, monitor obligations, and act on results.
  • Make PII and sensitive transaction data a design constraint across both, with access control, audit trails, and tenant isolation.

4. Turn discovery into what gets built

  • Partner with the Head of Product & Operations to translate operator and customer discovery into scoped, sequenced engineering work.
  • Join operator and customer discovery so engineering decisions start from how the work gets done today.

5. Build and lead the engineering team

  • Hire and grow the engineering team, and shape how it's organized and how it works as cmdr scales.
  • Mentor early-career engineers and give senior engineers real ownership.
  • Lead how the team uses AI to plan, build, review, and ship, and keep refining it as the tools change.

What Success Looks Like

  • Onboarding the next agency or workflow is configuration, not a project.
  • Automation and cost per file improve release over release, and the team can prove it in production data.
  • Operators trust the review console, and correction time keeps falling.
  • The team ships on a steady cadence without you as the bottleneck.

What You Bring

An engineering leader who still builds. You've led and grown engineers at different levels while staying hands-on in architecture and code, including meaningful production code in the last two years. AI coding agents and tools are core to how you work.

Production agentic AI. You've shipped LLM-powered workflows that real users depended on, and you know how to make them reliable: evals, structured outputs, retrieval, prompt design, and model and cost tradeoffs.

Full-stack and data range. You work across a Python or Node backend, a TypeScript/React frontend, relational and vector databases, and AWS or GCP. You've built pipelines that turn unstructured documents into structured data, integrated with legacy systems that lack clean APIs, and handled PII in a regulated setting.

Product sense for operational users. You've built internal or operator-facing tools for high-volume work, and improved them based on real usage.

A clear communicator across technical and non-technical teams. You've worked alongside product or operations leaders to turn discovery into plans engineers could execute, and explained technical risk and tradeoffs to non-technical leadership in plain terms.

Startup DNA. You've worked in ambiguous, resource-constrained environments, shipped quickly without lowering the quality bar, and moved between strategy and execution as the week required.

Experience

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, particularly in product-focused, full-stack roles.
  • Demonstrated success as an engineering leader in a fast-paced startup or high-growth environment.
  • At least one product taken from a blank page to production and scaled past its first customers.

This role is designed for a builder. If your recent experience is mostly managing managers, leading large-org transformation, or advising rather than shipping, it's unlikely to be the fit.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Ground truth from day one. Live orders, real volume, and operator corrections that become your evaluation set. Most AI startups spend their first year trying to get data like this.
  • Founder-level scope. Real ownership and influence over the product, the platform, and the team you build.

An Ecosystem of Exceptional Builders

Joining cmdr also means joining Stackpoint's tight-knit ecosystem of founders, product leaders, and operators building alongside you. Engineering leaders across the portfolio are peers, not silos:

  • Regular cross-portfolio sessions with founders and product and engineering leaders
  • Shared learning on AI, GTM, hiring, and scaling challenges
  • Direct access to other builders solving similar 0→1 problems in parallel, and pattern recognition across multiple early-stage companies

We value judgment, speed, and substance over process theater.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary calibrated for founding team members
  • Significant equity with asymmetric upside if we execute
  • Comprehensive health benefits

If you read this and want to build the platform and the team behind the AI operating layer loan servicing operations run on, we'd like to talk.
