title: Project General Manager, Strategic Shuttle Programs
description:
CharterUP is transforming the $365 billion global group transportation and mobility market with an AI native platform that powers modern charter, shuttle, and emerging autonomous vehicle operations. Trusted by many Fortune 500 companies, CharterUP connects enterprises, institutions, and event organizers with thousands of vehicles nationwide, while increasingly serving as the operating system for large scale shuttle and transit programs across airports, campuses, industrial sites, and major events.

Through real time availability, transparent pricing, intelligent routing, and AI driven dispatch and optimization, CharterUP replaces a fragmented and opaque industry with automation, accountability, and scale.

Why Join Us

  • Innovative Impact: Be part of the team that's revolutionizing group travel, setting new standards in an industry overdue for change.
  • Growth Opportunities: As a hyper growth company and one of the fastest-growing companies recognized by Inc., there’s no better time to join our dynamic, growth-stage organization.
  • Driven Team: Collaborate with some of the most driven minds in tech, all while working in a remote-first environment with a tech hub in Austin, TX.
  • Funding and Stability: Our $60 million Series A funding was just the start—we’re poised for even greater expansion, and you can be part of this exciting journey. CharterUp has achieved this growth profitability and efficiently, ensuring long-term stability.

Title: Project General Manager

Reports to: Market General Manager

Location: Phoenix, AZ

About the Role

CharterUP is seeking a Project General Manager to lead complex, large-scale shuttle programs, such as workforce transportation for data centers and major construction projects. As the primary operational lead onsite, you’ll own the program end to end—from launch and daily execution to client relationships, transportation partner performance, reporting, and continuous improvement.

Working across clients, transportation partners, and internal teams, you’ll ensure safe, reliable service and deliver on program commitments. Success requires strong operational leadership, the ability to manage across organizational boundaries, and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and driving results.

Compensation includes a competitive base salary and performance-based bonus tied to program launch, service continuity, and client satisfaction.

CharterUP is also hiring Market and National General Managers. Candidates may be considered for the level best aligned with their experience.

What You'll Do

Lead On-Site Operations

  • Own daily shuttle program execution, including route readiness, vehicle coverage, staging, passenger loading, and coordination across operating shifts.
  • Validate transportation partners’ staffing, fleet readiness, dispatch coverage, and contingency plans.
  • Lead service recovery during delays, missed trips, vehicle breakdowns, staffing shortages, and unexpected demand.
  • Develop and maintain operating procedures, escalation protocols, site instructions, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead assigned CharterUP site personnel, where applicable, and establish clear responsibilities and shift handoffs.
  • Validate daily and upcoming transportations schedules with operating partners to ensure alignment with client requirements, workforce shifts, anticipated ridership, and changing site conditions.
  • Establish and maintain a structured daily operating cadence, including operator coordination calls, onsite huddles, operational readiness reviews, and documented follow-up on outstanding commitments.
  • Oversee implementation and ongoing maintenance of CharterUP branding requirements across assigned vehicles, including signage, decals, vehicle presentation standards, and timely resolution of branding deficiencies in coordination with transportation partners.

Own the Client Relationship On Site

  • Serve as CharterUP’s primary on-site operational contact and build trusted relationships with client site leadership, facilities, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Proactively communicate service conditions, resolve concerns, and follow issues through to closure.
  • Lead regular operational meetings, presenting performance, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations.
  • Anticipate changes in workforce schedules, site activity, and transportation demand.
  • Share client insights and growth opportunities with your Market General Manager and CharterUP’s commercial team.
  • Participates in client and site coordination meetings to proactively identify changes in workforce headcount, construction schedules, site access, parking arrangements, and transportation requirements.
  • Maintain a centralized action-item tracker for client requests, operational commitments, and outstanding issues, ensuring timely follow-through and resolution.

Manage Transportation Partner Relationship and Performance

  • Develop strong, collaborative relationships with transportation partner leadership while maintaining accountability for contracted service levels, vehicle standards, staffing commitments, and reporting requirements.
  • Monitor actual service delivery through field observations, platform data, trip records, and client feedback.
  • Conduct daily operational check-ins with transportation partners, regularly review performance against contractual KPIs, and drive documented corrective actions through resolution.
  • Escalate persistent deficiencies and capacity needs so supplemental or replacement service can be secured.
  • Ensure client requests and service changes are documented and managed through CharterUP.
  • Serve as the projects relationship owner for assigned transportation partners, fostering open communication, resolving operational friction, and proactively collaborating on service improvements, resource planning, and long-term program success.

Support Service and Billing Accuracy

  • Track service hours, vehicle utilization, and trip completion against contractual commitments.
  • Validate delivered service and flag discrepancies across operational records, partner invoices, and client billing.
  • Identify client requests that fall outside the agreed scope and route them for pricing and approval before additional service is committed.
  • Recommend operational improvements that increase reliability and reduce waste.

Drive Safety, Visibility, and Improvement

  • Partner with CharterUP's Legal, Safety, and Compliance teams to verify transportation partner adherence to applicable federal, state, and local regulatory requirements, including prevailing wage laws, labor classifications, collective bargaining obligations, and contract-specific compliance requirements.
  • Monitor transportation partner adherence to applicable DOT, FMCSA, and state transportation safety requirements, including driver qualifications, vehicle inspections, insurance coverage, hours-of-service compliance, and established safety procedures, coordinating corrective actions with CharterUP's Safety and Compliance teams.
  • Lead onsite coordination of operational and safety incidents, ensuring immediate response, appropriate onsite support, timely escalation, and coordination with transportation partners, emergency responders, CharterUP leadership, and client stakeholders as applicable.
  • Deliver daily program reports and escalate issues promptly to CharterUP leadership and the client.
  • Maintain accurate operational records and service reports, ensuring all incidents are properly logged, documented, and tracked through investigation, corrective action, and closure.
  • Use GPS, ridership, trip-completion, and passenger feedback data to improve routes, capacity, reliability, and rider experience.
  • Ensure CharterUP systems provide an accurate, current record of program activity and performance.
  • Establish and maintain standardized daily ridership collection and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate passenger counts, trip activity, and capacity utilization.
  • Maintain a centralized program performance dashboard tracking service reliability, ridership, safety incidents, operational deficiencies, and corrective action status.
  • Coordinate the collection, validation, and tracking of required labor compliance documentation, including certified payroll records, applicable wage determinations, fringe benefit documentation, and union-related requirements, escalating discrepancies to CharterUP's Legal and Compliance teams.
  • Establish recurring compliance verification procedures with transportation partners, including confirmation of required vehicle inspections, active insurance coverage, driver eligibility, and daily and weekly hours-of-service compliance, escalating deficiencies and potential service risks before they impact operations.
  • Ensure incidents are reported through required internal and external channels within established timelines, including appropriate notifications to CharterUP leadership, Safety and Compliance teams, clients, and transportation partners, while monitoring incident resolution and follow-up actions.

What You’ll Bring

  • Three or more years of operations experience, including on-site leadership of a shuttle, transit, airport, campus, workforce transportation, or comparable field program.
  • Passenger transportation experience strongly preferred; experience in trucking, construction logistics, or other large-scale field operations will be considered.
  • Experience serving as the primary point of contact for a client on a live project and resolving service issues directly.
  • Experience coordinating third-party transportation providers or subcontractors at a job site and enforcing service commitments.
  • Strong working knowledge of dispatch, route planning, fleet readiness, staffing coverage, and transportation safety practices.
  • Understanding of motorcoach and passenger carrier operations, including driver hours-of-service limits, and the confidence to push back on client requests that are not operationally sound.
  • Ability to produce clear daily reporting and use operational data to improve service.
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, and/or project management tools.
  • Highly self-directed, with demonstrated ability to independently establish operational structure, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and coordinate multiple stakeholders during service disruptions.
  • Willingness to work on-site 8-10 hours daily, with flexibility to support critical operating periods and escalations outside standard business hours.
  • Experience implementing or managing operational technology platforms, including GPS tracking, ridership reporting, and performance dashboards.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience welcomed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting data center, large-scale construction, or other complex job-site environments.
  • Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) or hands-on technical knowledge of vehicles and fleet inspection.
  • Experience launching a new transportation program or site operation.

Recruiting Process

  • Step 1 - Video call: Talent Acquisition interview
  • Step 2 - Video call: Hiring Manager interview
  • Step 3 - Video call: Team interviews
  • Step 4 - Offer & reference check
  • Welcome aboard!

Global Benefits & Perks at CharterUP

We believe great people can live anywhere—and they deserve great benefits, too. While offerings may vary slightly by location, we prioritize hiring near our hubs in Austin, Atlanta, and Miami as we grow our global team.

  • Flexible Work Model: CharterUP operates as a remote-first company, with select roles requiring regular, in-office presence based on team and business needs. Role-specific expectations will be shared during the hiring process. U.S.-based employees may reside in any of our 19 approved states.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance, mental health support, virtual care, gym discounts, and family-building benefits. In the U.S., we cover 100% of premiums for employees. International benefits align with local standards.
  • Time Off to Recharge: Paid time off so you can truly unplug. U.S.: 15 PTO days (increasing to 20 after 2 years) + 8 paid holidays. International policies vary by country.
  • Financial Peace of Mind: Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance where available.
  • Performance-Driven Culture: Join a fast-moving, ambitious, and collaborative team that wins together.
  • Referral Rewards: Earn bonuses for bringing top talent to the team.
  • Planning for the Future: Long-term financial planning support. U.S.: 401(k) plan. International: region-specific savings programs where applicable.
  • Top-Tier Tech: Choose a Mac or PC, plus monitor, keyboard, and mouse to hit the ground running.

CharterUP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive, accessible, and respectful workplace. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws in the United States and Canada. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know. CharterUP is committed to providing reasonable accommodations during the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact your recruiter.

Hiring Locations: CharterUP U.S.-based candidates and employees must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, New Hampshire, Nevada, New York, Oklahoma, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Washington, and Wyoming.

We hire in the U.S. and Canada and are actively expanding our global footprint.

title: Sr. Manager, Operations
description:
The Senior Manager, Operations is responsible for leading operational strategy and execution for assigned large client account team(s), including sales support, workforce planning, onboarding, contracting, compliance, forecasting, and reporting. As a senior operational partner to client-facing project teams, this position ensures scalable processes, accurate data, effective communication, and timely deliverables that support business objectives.

The Senior Manager will provide operational oversight, drive accountability across workstreams, identify and lead process improvement opportunities. This position partners closely with recruiting, resourcing, marketing, finance, legal, compliance, and shared services to improve operational effectiveness, strengthen account performance, and support efficient and compliant service delivery.

Essential Job Functions:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead daily operations for assigned client account team(s), ensuring operational, compliance, financial, staffing, and reporting objectives are met.
  • Drive workforce planning and recruiting prioritization, including maintaining role requirements, tracking resourcing needs, anticipating future demand, partnering with recruiting and resourcing leaders to address critical needs.
  • Execute regular team succession planning to evaluate the long-term team structure, assess developmental needs of resources and propose changes to enhance team and/or individual success.
  • Drive compliance activities related to client Vendor Management Systems (VMS), onboarding requirements, contracting workflows, and internal company standards.
  • Lead forecasting and reporting activities, including revenue projections, utilization, headcount planning, staffing pipeline visibility, and profitability-related analysis.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance operational, staffing, financial, and compliance reporting to support leadership decision-making.
  • Analyze business performance metrics, staffing funnel data, onboarding progress, and operational KPIs to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Support sales enablement activities such as preparing account planning documents, coordinating account planning workshops, assisting with marketing activities, etc.
  • Maintain account qualification portfolio, including documentation of executed workstreams.
  • Identify operational gaps and lead cross-functional corrective actions to improve efficiency, quality, scalability, and compliance.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for operational processes, systems, and client requirements, acting as a liaison across business functions to achieve desired results.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, operational controls, and governance routines.
  • Lead or influence special projects and cross-functional initiatives that improve account operations, reporting accuracy, process consistency, or service delivery outcomes.

Desired Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking – Using data and insights to identify trends and drive appropriate action
  • Detail Oriented – Executing all tasks with precision and ensuring data accuracy
  • Active Leadership – Balances team leadership with hands-on execution of account responsibilities
  • Accountability – Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments
  • Action Oriented – Embracing new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm
  • Communicates Effectively – Develops and delivers written and verbal communication that conveys clear understanding of different audiences and their levels of comprehension. Active listener to ensure clear understanding
  • Customer Focused – Builds strong relationships and delivers customer-centric solutions
  • Optimizes Work Processes – Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement while driving needed change
  • Project Management - Managing scope, timelines, resources, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations to achieve desired business outcomes.
  • Resourcefulness – Identifying, securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently
  • Results Oriented – Consistently achieves results, even under tough circumstances
  • Multitasking – Ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment while meeting deadlines

Education and Experience:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 7-10 years of experience in operations management, program management, staffing operations, workforce management, business operations, or a related field, preferably within a professional services environment
  • Experience managing enterprise clients, large accounts, or large-scale staffing programs
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations
  • Demonstrates ability to effectively managing multiple priorities, projects, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with one or more of the following: NetSuite, Salesforce, PowerBI, Tableau, IntelAgree, or similar business applications
  • Experience with VMS platforms and enterprise business systems
  • Demonstrated experience leading projects, processes, or cross-functional initiatives
  • Experience developing executive-level reporting and operational dashboards

Travel Requirements:

Less than 5% (almost no travel)

title: Kodia - Ful Stack Developer
description:
Asiakkaamme Visma Sirius etsii nyt riveihinsä Full Stack Developeria vahvalla back end- ja tietokantapainotuksella rakentamaan modernia SaaS-tuotetta jolla mullistetaan niin kiinteistöjen hallinta kuin vuokraprosessitkin, Kodia tuotekehitystiimiin. Tässä roolissa pääset kehittämään tuotetta, jota käytetään päivittäin kiinteistöalan ammattilaisten työssä; tavoitteena on tehdä heidän arjestaan sujuvampaa ja tehokkaampaa.

“Markkinoiden moderneimman kiinteistöhallinnan työkalun pariin etsitään nyt devaajaa osaksi loistavaa ja monipuolista tiimiä. Visma Siriuksella Kodia tuoteperheen parissa pääset nauttimaan pienestä ja ketterästä työympäristöstä siten, että tueksesi saat koko Visma-konsernin suuret hartiat. Lähde mukaan kehittämään niin Kodiaa kuin itseäsi seuraavalle tasolle!” - Markus, rekrytointikonsultti, Talented

Rooli:

Software Developerina työskentelet osana Kodia-tuotekehitystiimiä ja vastaat tuotannollisen SaaS-tuotteen kehittämisestä ja ylläpidosta. Työssäsi pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan siihen, miten tuotetta rakennetaan, miten se skaalautuu kasvavaan asiakasmäärään ja millaisia teknisiä ratkaisuja tulevaisuuden kehityksessä tehdään.

Tiimissä on tällä hetkellä hyvää full stack -osaamista, mutta tuotteen kasvaessa ja datamassan lisääntyessä haetaan nyt mukaan vahvaa back end - ja tietokantapainotusta. Etsimme tekijää, joka nauttii reaalimaailman suorituskykyhaasteiden ratkomisesta ja dataan liittyvien ongelmien huolellisesta ratkomisesta. Työssäsi pääset vaikuttamaan suoraan siihen, miten järjestelmä skaalautuu kasvavaan datamassaan ja kiihtyvään asiakasmäärään.

Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat esimerkiksi:
- Ohjelmistojen laadukas toteutus ja ylläpito (Node.js / TypeScript / React)
- Skaalautuvien ja suorituskykyisten ratkaisujen rakentaminen jatkuvasti kasvavalle asiakasmäärälle ja datamassalle
- Tietokantojen, tietomallien ja datanmallinnuksen parissa työskentely sekä suorituskyvyn optimointi ja statistiikan seuranta
- Integraatioiden rakentaminen ja kehittäminen
- Ensiluokkaisen asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen tuotteen kautta
- Muiden kehittäjien sparraaminen ohjelmistokehityksen parhaissa käytännöissä
- Kehitystyön edistäminen itsenäisesti ja yhdessä tiimin kanssa

Visma Siriuksella hyödynnetään aktiivisesti myös tekoälyavusteisia työkaluja ohjelmistokehityksen eri vaiheissa, ja Visma-konsernin vahva panostus AI:n hyödyntämiseen tarjoaa kehittäjille mahdollisuuden kokeilla ja ottaa käyttöön uusia tapoja tehdä työtä entistä tehokkaammin. Odotamme myös sinulta vahvaa innostusta ja kiinnostusta tekoälyä kohtaan!

Sinä:

Etsimme ohjelmistokehittäjää, jolla on halu tehdä konkreettista ja laadukasta työtä, sekä viedä itseään eteenpäin kehittäjänä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset tekemään asioita monipuolisesti osana aktiivista tiimiä ja työyhteisöä. Työtä tehdään hyvin etäpainotteisesti, joten olisi hienoa jos olisit oma-aloitteinen ja tiimityöskentelystä pitävä henkilö, joka uskaltaa rohkeasti ottaa asioista omistajuutta.

- +5-vuotta kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä tuotannollisen softan parissa
- Node.js:n lisäksi TypeScript & React kuuluvat sinun vahvimman osaamisen piiriin
- Innostusta ja kykyä työskennellä tietokantaongelmien, datamallien ja reaalimaailman optimointien parissa
- Hyödynnät jo aktiivisesti tekoälyä ohjelmistokehityksen tukena
- Puhut sujuvasti suomen kielellä

Eduksesi katsotaan:
- Pilviosaaminen (AWS)
- Integraatio-osaaminen
- Aikaisempi kokemus ja mielenkiinto tietoturva-asioita kohtaan
- Aikaisempi kokemus taloushallinnon ja/tai -reskontran parista

Kodia:

Kodia on Visma Siriuksen kehittämä moderni pilvipohjainen SaaS-ohjelmisto, joka on suunniteltu helpottamaan ja tehostamaan kiinteistöjen hallintaa ja vuokrausprosesseja. Se tarjoaa kiinteistöalan ammattilaisille selkeän ja visuaalisen alustan, joka kattaa koko vuokrauksen elinkaaren markkinoinnista ja asukasvalinnasta aina sopimusten hallintaan ja kiinteistön tekniseen ylläpitoon.

Kodia vähentää manuaalista työtä pitkälle automatisoitujen prosessien ja saumattomien integraatioiden avulla, ja se on tunnettu erityisesti helppokäyttöisyydestään sekä modernista käyttökokemuksesta. Ohjelmisto kehittyy jatkuvasti hyödyntäen moderneja teknologioita ja tekoälyä, ja sillä on suora vaikutus siihen, miten kiinteistöalan ammattilaiset tekevät työtään päivittäin.

Muuta:

Visma Siriuksella työskentelet noin 160 hengen asiantuntijayhteisössä, jossa yhdistyvät pienen yrityksen ketteryys ja suuren Visma-konsernin vakaus. Visma Siriuksella toimitaan itsenäisesti ja päätökset tehdään lähellä tiimejä, hyödyntäen samalla Visma-konsernin tarjoamia työkaluja, käytäntöjä ja verkostoja. Yli tuhat yritystä käyttää jo Visma Siriuksen ratkaisuja.

Maantieteellisesti katsoen Visma Siriuksella työskennellään hajautetusti eri puolilta Suomea. Voit työskennellä etänä mistä päin Suomea tahansa. Työnantajan puolesta järjestetään yhteisiä tapaamisia ja tiimipäiviä, ja henkilöstön hyvinvoinnista sijainnista riippumatta pidetään tosissaan huolta.

Hae tehtävää 22.11.2026 mennessä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten suosittelemme hakemaan mahdollisimman pian. Rekrytointi suoritetaan yhteistyössä Talentedin & Visma Siriuksen kanssa.

title: Ford Certified Journeyman Tech
description:
Hawk Ford of Carol Stream is a dynamic and rapidly growing automotive group with multiple dealership locations across Illinois. As a certified Ford Journeyman t Automotive Technician, you will quickly and efficiently perform routine maintenance and identify the cause of breakdowns and repair them using the most optimal solutions. Automotive Technicians in our service departments can expect a clean, safe, and state-of-the-art environment to work in. The jobs are challenging, and extensive training is available to those who are career focused.

Generous compensation/benefits package is available!

Job Responsibilities:

  • Perform work specified on maintenance and repair orders with efficiency and in by dealership and/or Mopar standards
  • Diagnose and repair vehicle automotive systems including engine, transmission, electrical, steering, suspension, braking, air conditioning, etc., to specification
  • Provide labor and time estimates for additional automotive repairs
  • Explain mechanical diagnoses and required repairs in a non-technical manner to service advisors and customers
  • Continuously learn new technical information and techniques in formal training sessions in order to stay abreast with rapidly changing technology.

title: Manager, Corporate Communications
description:
Make a SPLASH with Latham, The Pool Company!

At Latham, The Pool Company, we don’t just make swimming pools; we create opportunities for backyard dreams to come true. As the leading manufacturer in North America, Australia, and New Zealand, we are committed to delivering innovation, quality, and sustainability in everything we do.

We believe in building an environment where everyone can thrive. That is why we offer:

  • A culture of integrity, collaboration, and respect.
  • Comprehensive benefits for you and your family.
  • Opportunities for growth, mentorship, and skill development.

A little about the position:

Job Summary

Our purpose at Latham is to create spaces where lifelong memories are made. The Manager, Corporate Communications plays a crucial role in achieving our purpose, by bringing Latham’s strategy, culture and story to life for our employees and external audiences. This is a highly visible, hands-on role for someone who can think strategically, write, plan and execute exceptionally well, and turn big ideas into communications people actually want to read, watch and engage with.

We are looking for a builder. Someone who sees what is possible, creates structure where it is needed and is not afraid to test new approaches. You will inherit important work already underway while helping shape how Corporate Communications operates and grows at Latham.

You will advise leaders and deliver leadership and change communications, employee engagement, corporate storytelling, and high-visibility enterprise initiatives. Equally energized by strategy and hands-on execution, you will ask smart questions, roll up your sleeves and get every word, visual, timeline and detail right.

Some of What You Will Do:

Corporate Communications Strategy & Execution

  • Partner with the Senior Director of Corporate Communications to develop and execute integrated communications strategies aligned with Latham Pool business objectives, culture and growth priorities.
  • Plan and execute communications for enterprise initiatives, aligning clear, consistent, audience-focused messaging with the right delivery channels.
  • Lead the strategy, design and build-out of Latham’s employee intranet, bringing proven intranet expertise and best practices to create an intuitive, engaging and sustainable digital destination that connects employees to the information, resources and stories they need.
  • Serve as a trusted communications partner to functional and business leaders, providing strategic counsel while maintaining a hands-on role in content development and execution.
  • Monitor communications performance, employee feedback and relevant external trends, using insights to strengthen future programs and campaigns.

Internal Communications & Employee Engagement

  • Develop and deliver employee communications that inform, connect and engage Latham Pool employees across corporate, field and manufacturing environments.
  • Create executive and leadership communications, including messages, talking points, presentations, scripts and materials for company Town Halls, leadership meetings and other employee forums.
  • Partner with Human Resources and business leaders on organizational change, culture, engagement and other people-focused communications.
  • Build opportunities for two-way communication and employee feedback, helping leaders listen, respond and reinforce key messages across the organization.
  • Manage content across Latham Pool internal communications channels and campaigns, adapting messages for different employee audiences and work environments.
  • Help identify and develop corporate stories that reinforce Latham Pool's strategy, culture, leadership and reputation with key stakeholders.
  • Manage timelines, stakeholders, approvals, budgets and deliverables for complex communications projects, leading the work from strategy through execution.
  • Use communications technologies, analytics, AI, planning and reporting platforms and emerging tools to improve the efficiency, reach and effectiveness of the Corporate Communications function.

What You Bring to the Table: (Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in communications, journalism, public relations, marketing, business or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Approximately 10 years of progressive experience in corporate communications, internal and change management communications, experience in a complex, multi-location organization strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional writing, editing and design skills, with demonstrated ability to adapt voice, tone and format for executives, employees (corporate and hourly), social media and other stakeholders.
  • Proven employee intranet and digital communications design and execution expertise.
  • Experience developing and executing communications strategies and managing high-visibility projects independently, on time and on budget.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships and work effectively with senior executives and cross-functional partners.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors and project budgets preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and communications, expert at Microsoft SharePoint, social media, analytics and media-monitoring tools; comfort using AI-enabled tools responsibly is preferred.


Key Capabilities

  • Strategic thinker who can connect communications activity to business priorities and employee needs.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to translate complex topics into clear, accessible and compelling messages.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated and an accountable project manager who can prioritize effectively, anticipate needs and deliver high-quality work on schedule in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities.
  • Sound judgment, discretion, and composure when handling sensitive or rapidly evolving issues.
  • A team-first self-starter who is action orientated and emotionally intelligent, with the confidence to provide thoughtful counsel.
  • A true communications advocate who always strives for excellence, educates and challenges constructively, and can “disagree and commit” to achieve success.

Why Join Latham? At Latham, we invest in your well-being, growth, and success. Our comprehensive benefits package supports you and your family with:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 24/7 telehealth and wellness resources
  • Personalized benefits advocacy and support
  • Expert second opinions and access to leading specialists
  • 401(k) with a 50% company match up to 6%, and financial protection benefits
  • Flexible PTO and 11 paid holidays
  • Mental health, family care, and financial wellness resources

Join a team that's invested in your well-being, your future, and your success.

Some Important Information for you:

Position Title: Manager, Corporate Communications

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time

Status: Exempt

Salary Range: $125,000-$160,000

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across US geographic markets. Starting pay for this role will vary based on multiple factors, including location, knowledge, skills, education, and experience. Pay ranges may be modified in the future.

Bonus: Target bonus of 7.5% of base pay

title: Engagement Specialist - Remote
description:
Engagement Specialist

Role & Compensation Details

  • 💰 Salary: $1,800 USD base salary + commissions (Target OTE: $2,800 – $3,000 USD/month upon hitting targets)

  • 📍 Location: Remote from Latin America

  • 💵 Payment Schedule: Bi-weekly base payments

  • 💼 Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Full-Time)

  • 🏝️ PTO: 10 days per year (Accrual basis)

  • 🇺🇸 Holidays: Standard U.S. holidays off

  • 💻 Equipment Requirement: Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) — Candidates must bring their own reliable laptop/computer capable of running CRM, communications, and AI platforms.

About Our Client

Latino Legends partners with innovative U.S. companies to connect top-tier Latin American talent with long-term, high-growth opportunities.

We are currently recruiting for an Engagement Specialist on behalf of our client—a vertically integrated U.S. real estate investment owner, operator, and prop-tech developer. Operating workforce apartment communities across the Southeast U.S., they build and implement proprietary AI-powered operational systems for their own portfolio as well as third-party real estate operators. They operate as an AI-first organization, leveraging technology and automation across every level of their business to maximize results. Their Mexico City office brings together investments, technology, and sales teams to work side by side.

Core Values

Our client hires, develops, and promotes based on these six core values:

  • Growth Mindset (Kaizen): Practice continuous improvement. Never settle, figure it out, and get 1% better every day.

  • High Integrity: Do what you say. Own your wins and your losses.

  • Discipline: Be purposeful, thoughtful, and diligent in everything you take on.

  • Build to Last: Take the long view—optimize decisions for 10–15 year outcomes.

  • Connection: Build genuine relationships that earn trust and respect with residents, investors, clients, and teammates.

  • All In, All Out: Work hard, play hard. Bring full energy and commitment every day.

Position Overview

As the Engagement Specialist, you serve as the first point of contact for every prospective partner and client. You own the complete initial funnel—from the moment a prospect notices the brand to the moment they are on the calendar for a qualification call.

Prospects engage through podcasts, webinars, social posts, live events, and direct outreach. Your mission is to reach out rapidly, spark genuine conversations, and book qualified prospects for portfolio analysis calls ("Punch List" reviews). Following meetings, you ensure NDAs and property data are collected promptly to keep operations moving on schedule. You will leverage scripts, workflows, and cutting-edge AI tools with urgency and discipline. This seat is built for growth—top performers routinely transition into direct sales roles.

Primary Relationships

  • Reports to: GTM & Partnerships Lead

  • Supports: Company Principals running portfolio analysis calls (prepares background briefs for every call).

  • Collaborates with: Content Manager (who logs social media engagement into HubSpot) and internal Investment/Technology teams.

  • External Engagement: Builds authentic relationships with property owners, operators, podcast guests, and their executive teams.

Essential Responsibilities

1. Speed to Lead & Engagement

  • Reply to every inbound lead, warm introduction, and positive response within one business hour.

  • Execute daily engagement outreach by messaging qualified ideal client profiles who like, comment on, or share content.

  • Run structured LinkedIn and email cadences; log all interactions in HubSpot the same day.

  • Follow up with webinar attendees fitting the target client profile within 48 hours.

  • Coordinate post-interview sharing kits for podcast guests while requesting referrals and reviews.

2. Meeting Generation & Qualification

  • Qualify each prospect against strict client profile standards prior to scheduling.

  • Book qualification calls, confirm appointments, and take ownership of meeting show rates.

  • Prepare brief briefing notes for call hosts prior to each scheduled meeting.

  • Nurture non-qualified leads by routing them to educational resources (podcasts, newsletters, webinars) for future follow-up.

3. Pipeline Management

  • Immediately issue NDAs and data requests once a prospect agrees to a portfolio analysis call.

  • Track document and data collection via persistent email and phone follow-up.

  • Escalate uncollected data to the GTM & Partnerships Lead if pending beyond 5 business days.

4. CRM Operations & Performance Tracking

  • Maintain total data hygiene in HubSpot: ensure every contact has an accurate source and open deals have documented next steps.

  • Record call outcomes and pipeline stage updates the same day they occur.

  • Review daily performance metrics (reply time, conversations started, meetings held, show rates, data collection turnarounds).

  • Participate in Call Lab (the internal training program), actively taking feedback within 24 hours to refine sales execution.

Who You Are

  • Fast & Relentless: You act with urgency—answering communications today, not tomorrow.

  • Accountable: You own your conversion numbers without making excuses.

  • Curious & Authentic: You build real human connections instead of relying on generic templates.

  • Disciplined Communicator: You possess excellent written and spoken English skills and feel comfortable communicating on phone/video with senior real estate executives.

  • Tech-Forward: You are eager to use AI tools to work smarter and view this role as a stepping stone into a long-term sales career.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 1–3 years in sales development (SDR), inside sales, client success, or outbound business-to-business (B2B) communications.

  • Language Skills: Fluent written and spoken English required (Spanish fluency is a plus).

  • Tech Stack: Hands-on experience with CRMs (preferably HubSpot), LinkedIn, email automation, and scheduling platforms. Familiarity with AI tools is highly preferred.

  • Industry Interest: Interest in real estate, finance, or prop-tech (prior industry experience is a plus, but not required).

  • Equipment: Must have a personal laptop/computer (BYOD) for daily work.

  • Pre-Hire Assessment: All candidates complete a Culture Index survey prior to the first interview to evaluate role alignment.

  • Travel: Occasional travel to U.S. industry conferences or events may be required (1–2 times per year).

Onboarding & Performance Framework

Before your start date, you will receive a structured 30/60/90-Day Plan covering script mastery, system training in Call Lab, live call shadowing, and deep dives into core values. Performance is measured using clear metrics reviewed daily with your direct manager.
